articles.title: This Vincent van Gogh Painting Has Not Been Seen in Public for Over 60 Years. It Is Now Poised to Set a Record at an Upcoming Auction

paras.en: Excitement in the art world is building over a rare viewing and upcoming auction of a Vincent van Gogh painting that has not been on public display for more than 60 years.
paras.zh: 文森特·梵高 (Vincent van Gogh) 的画作将在 60 多年来从未公开展出，此次罕见的观赏和拍卖即将在艺术界掀起轩然大波。

paras.en: Hundreds of people lined up in Hong Kong this week to catch a fleeting glimpse of Châtaigniers en fleurs, or Chestnut Trees in Blossom, in advance of its auction next month in New York, Reuters’ Joyce Zhou reports. It is expected to sell for around $180 million—a potential record for a van Gogh work at auction.
paras.zh: 据路透社的Joyce Zhou报道，本周有数百人在香港排队，在下个月在纽约拍卖之前瞥见Châtaigniers en fleurs或Chestnut Trees in Blossom。它预计售价约为1.8亿美元，这可能是梵高作品在拍卖会上的纪录。

paras.en: Painted in May 1890, the artwork is coveted not only for its aesthetic beauty but for the late chapter of van Gogh’s tumultuous life when it was created. After spending a year in a psychiatric asylum following a mental health crisis during which he cut off his ear, the painter traveled to the village of Auvers-sur-Oise, near Paris. There, van Gogh became inspired by what he described as “beautiful greenery in abundance” and felt that “the desire to work will devour me and make me insensible to everything else and in a good mood,” according to a statement from Sotheby’s, the auction house hosting the painting’s sale.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Van Gogh rented a small attic room above a café for three and a half francs per night and made daily trips into the countryside to paint. He also frequently visited Paul Gachet, a local doctor and art collector who encouraged him to continue painting. Van Gogh took heed of Gachet’s advice and painted prolifically again.
paras.zh: 梵高以每晚3.5法郎的价格在咖啡馆上方租了一个小阁楼房间，每天都去乡下画画。他还经常拜访当地医生和艺术收藏家Paul Gachet ，后者鼓励他继续绘画。梵高听取了加歇的建议，再次大量绘画。

paras.en: “This is a moment of extraordinary optimism, frenetic energy, enthusiasm, passion and color in the artist’s body of work,” Scott Niichel, a vice chairman at Sotheby’s, tells Reuters.
paras.zh: 苏富比副董事长斯科特·尼切尔（ Scott Niichel ）告诉路透社： “这是艺术家作品中充满非凡乐观情绪、狂热能量、热情、激情和色彩的时刻。”

paras.en: But just two months into van Gogh’s stay in Auvers-sur-Oise, the painter shot himself in the chest. He succumbed to his injury two days later on July 29, 1890, at 37 years old.

“Ah well, I risk my life for my own work and my reason has half foundered in it,” van Gogh wrote in an unfinished letter addressed to his brother, Theo, which he was carrying with him on the day of the shooting. “But what can you do?”

Chestnut Trees in Blossom, which features a row of blooming trees and a man who resembles van Gogh walking by a trio of women, passed into Theo’s hands following the painter’s death. It was later owned by Theo’s widow, then the couple’s son, before if left the family.

Its 20th-century provenance is storied. Chestnut Trees in Blossom was acquired by the famed literary magnate Samuel Fischer, whose publishing house was the first to publish Thomas Mann and Hermann Hesse. George Gard de Sylva, co-founder of Capitol Records, later owned the painting, as did the philanthropist and collector Harriet Harris-Jonas, whose private collection was so renowned that the Metropolitan Museum of Art led tours through her Manhattan apartment.
paras.zh: 它的 20 世纪起源是有故事的。 《花开的栗树》被著名文学大亨塞缪尔·费舍尔收购，他的出版社是第一家出版托马斯·曼和赫尔曼·黑塞的出版社。国会唱片公司联合创始人乔治·加德·德西尔瓦（George Gard de Sylva）后来拥有了这幅画，慈善家兼收藏家哈丽特·哈里斯·乔纳斯（Harriet Harris-Jonas）也拥有这幅画，她的私人收藏非常有名，以至于大都会艺术博物馆带领参观者参观了她位于曼哈顿的公寓。

paras.en: Since 1975, the painting has been owned by the late Carlos Pedro Blaquier and Nelly Arrieta de Blaquier, Argentine art collectors and patrons. Sotheby’s has titled the Blaquier-Arrieta Collection, simply, “Legendary.”

Joining Chestnut Trees in Blossom in the Blaquier-Arrieta sale are works by Impressionist masters Paul Cézanne, Pierre-Auguste Renoir and Camille Pissarro. The entire auction, which opens on November 18, is expected to generate $450 million in sales.

“What strikes me most is that the Blaquier-Arrieta collection doesn’t feel like a private collection at all. It feels like a small museum—a miniature Musée d’Orsay, now opening its doors for the very first time,” Simon Shaw, a senior adviser at Sotheby’s, says in the statement.

Chestnut Trees in Blossom is one of just eight landscapes van Gogh created in Auvers-sur-Oise that remains in private hands. Its enthusiastic reception in Hong Kong lead Niichel to speculate that “Asia is certainly a possibility” for where the painting will wind up, per the Agence France-Presse.

“I’d never heard of this painting before, so I wanted to see it with my own eyes,” Li Shanshan, an art lover who traveled two and half hours from Shenzhen to view the piece in Hong Kong, tells the BBC. “I think it will create a huge sensation around the world.”

articles.title: A New Contender for the World's Oldest Shipwreck Has Been Discovered Off the Coast of Turkey. Its Ancient Cargo Is a 'Time Capsule' From 4,700 Years Ago

paras.en: Archaeologists have discovered remnants of what could be the world’s oldest known shipwreck, located off the coast of modern-day Turkey. Though the boat itself decomposed long ago, its well-preserved cargo of ceramic amphorae suggests that the ship sank in the early Bronze Age, up to 4,700 years ago, around the same time Egypt’s first pyramids were being built.
paras.zh: 考古学家发现了世界上最古老的沉船残骸，位于现代土耳其海岸附近。虽然这艘船本身很久以前就已经分解了，但其保存完好的陶瓷两栖动物货物表明，这艘船在青铜时代早期沉没，大约在4700年前，大约在同一时间，埃及的第一座金字塔正在建造中。

paras.en: “These are the oldest known remains of a seagoing ship yet found,” Karin Sowada, an archaeologist at Macquarie University in Australia who worked on the project, tells People’s Becca Longmire. “While the wooden ship itself has disintegrated, the durable remains of the cargo are still preserved, giving archaeologists a time capsule from the past.”
paras.zh: 参与该项目的澳大利亚麦考瑞大学考古学家Karin Sowada告诉People's Becca Longmire ： “这些是迄今为止发现的最古老的海船遗骸。” “虽然木船本身已经解体，但货物的耐用残骸仍然保存下来，为考古学家提供了过去的时间胶囊。”

paras.en: Researchers from the Mediterranean Archaeology Association, led by underwater archaeologist Hakan Öniz, discovered the ancient two-handled jars embedded nearly 100 feet below the surface near Kekova Island. Located off Turkey’s southern Mediterranean coast, the site contained more than 30 ceramic pots and three stone anchors, per Euronews.
paras.zh: 由水下考古学家 Hakan Öniz 领导的地中海考古学协会的研究人员在 Kekova 岛附近的海面以下近 100 英尺处发现了古代的两柄罐子。据欧洲新闻报道，该遗址位于土耳其地中海南部海岸附近，包含 30 多个陶瓷罐和三个石锚。

paras.en: The archaeologists dated the finds by “comparing the decoration techniques” on the amphorae to other examples unearthed in the Egypt and the Middle East that were known to be between 4,400 and 4,700 years old, Öniz tells the BBC’s Alison Francis, Rebecca Morelle and Kevin Church. “We can definitely say our wreck is early Bronze Age. This is 100 percent.”
paras.zh: 奥尼兹告诉英国广播公司的艾莉森·弗朗西斯（ Alison Francis ）、丽贝卡·莫雷尔（ Rebecca Morelle ）和凯文·丘奇（ Kevin Church ） ，考古学家将这些发现与埃及和中东出土的其他已知有4400至4700年历史的例子进行了“比较”。“我们可以肯定地说，我们的残骸是青铜时代的早期。这是百分之百的。”

paras.en: The researchers brought the finds back to a laboratory, where Sowada examined them. Some of the amphorae were still intact and, remarkably, appeared to be coated with dregs of the liquids they once transported.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这些发现带回了一个实验室， Sowada在那里对其进行了检查。一些两栖动物仍然完好无损，值得注意的是，它们似乎被它们曾经运输过的液体渣滓所覆盖。

paras.en: “I looked inside and nearly fainted,” Sowada tells the BBC. “I could not believe how much [residue] was visible.”
paras.zh: “我看了看里面，差点晕倒，” Sowada告诉英国广播公司。“我简直不敢相信有多少[残留物]可见。”

paras.en: Amphorae were typically used to transport liquid commodities. Researchers believe these ones were made in the Jordan Valley, along the modern-day border between Jordan, Israel and the West Bank, according to a social media post from Mehmet Ersoy, Turkey’s culture and tourism minister.
paras.zh: 安芙兰通常用于运输液体商品。根据土耳其文化和旅游部长穆罕默德·埃尔索伊（ Mehmet Ersoy ）的社交媒体帖子，研究人员认为这些是沿着约旦、以色列和约旦河西岸之间的现代边界在约旦河谷制造的。

paras.en: “It appears the vessel sank while transporting olive oil or wine from that region westward—perhaps to Troy or to the Minoan civilization in Crete,” Öniz tells CBS News’ Archie Clarke.
paras.zh: Öniz告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻的Archie Clarke ： “这艘船似乎在从该地区向西运输橄榄油或葡萄酒时沉没了，可能是特洛伊或克里特岛的米诺斯文明。”

paras.en: Though the body of the wrecked ship is long gone, researchers have some ideas about how it looked. They believe it was a sail-powered cargo ship about 33 feet long. According to Ersoy, its sailors may have produced their own cheese or butter while on long maritime journeys.
paras.zh: 尽管失事船的残骸早已消失，但研究人员对它的外观有一些想法。他们认为这是一艘长约 33 英尺的风帆货船。根据厄索伊的说法，该船的水手可能在长途海上旅行时自己制作了奶酪或黄油。

paras.en: “It’s possible that [the residue] could actually be the result of reuse of the jars,” Sowada tells the BBC. “I mean, these jars are huge—they’re not things that you just ship away and then never see again. People would have emptied these jars on arrival and potentially used them for many, many, many years.”
paras.zh: “[残留物]实际上可能是罐子重复使用的结果，” Sowada告诉英国广播公司。“我的意思是，这些罐子是巨大的-它们不是你只是运走然后再也看不到的东西。人们会在抵达时清空这些罐子，并可能使用它们很多很多年。”

paras.en: - The world’s oldest known shipwreck site was long considered to be the Dokos Shipwreck, off the coast of Greece.
paras.zh: -世界上已知最古老的沉船遗址长期以来被认为是希腊海岸外的多科斯沉船。

paras.en: - Discovered in 1975, its cargo dates back about 4,200 years.
paras.zh: -发现于1975年，其货物可追溯到约4200年前。

paras.en: The Mediterranean’s long history of crisscrossing trade routes have made it into a hotbed for modern marine archaeology.
paras.zh: 地中海纵横交错的贸易路线悠久的历史使其成为现代海洋考古学的温床。

paras.en: The Kekova Island wreck “represents a ‘missing piece’ of the story about ancient trade relations in the eastern Mediterranean,” Sowada tells People. “It was [traveling] along the southern coast of Turkey with trade goods that we now know belonged to a much wider exchange network.”
paras.zh: 索瓦达告诉《人物》杂志，凯科瓦岛沉船“代表了地中海东部古代贸易关系故事中'缺失的一部分’。” “它沿着土耳其南部海岸[旅行] ，带着我们现在知道属于更广泛交换网络的贸易货物。”

articles.title: See the Stunning Winners of the Wildlife Photographer of the Year Contest, Capturing the Splendor and Drama of Nature

paras.en: From the beauty in blurry wings of birds to the gut-wrenching emotion of an elephant mourning a calf, the images honored in the latest Wildlife Photographer of the Year contest depict the highs and lows of nature.
paras.zh: 从鸟类模糊翅膀的美丽，到大象哀悼小牛的痛苦情绪，在最新的年度野生动物摄影师大赛中获得荣誉的图像描绘了大自然的高潮和低谷。

paras.en: Some zoom in to the millimeter scale, capturing fungus-like protists called slime molds, while others feature big, charismatic mammals.
paras.zh: 有些放大到毫米级，捕捉到像真菌一样的原生生物，称为粘菌，而另一些则以大型、有魅力的哺乳动物为特征。

paras.en: “These photographs capture moments that are at once intimate, surprising and profoundly revealing,” Doug Gurr, director of London’s Natural History Museum, says in a statement. “Together they remind us that every species plays a role in the complex web of life—and why understanding and protecting the natural world has never been more important.”
paras.zh: 伦敦自然历史博物馆馆长道格·格尔（ Doug Gurr ）在一份声明中说： “这些照片捕捉到了亲密、令人惊讶和深刻揭示的时刻。” “它们共同提醒我们，每个物种都在复杂的生命网络中发挥着作用，为什么理解和保护自然世界从未如此重要。”

paras.en: In its 62nd annual iteration, the Wildlife Photographer of the Year contest, developed and produced by the Natural History Museum in London, received a record-breaking number of entries: Photographers from 121 countries and territories sent in 65,403 submissions.
paras.zh: 在第62届年度迭代中，由伦敦自然历史博物馆开发和制作的年度野生动物摄影师大赛获得了创纪录的参赛作品数量：来自121个国家和地区的摄影师提交了65,403份参赛作品。

paras.en: Both the adult and young photographer winners were in black and white this year, a first for the contest. It demonstrates the “enduring power of monochrome imagery to tell compelling wildlife stories,” according to the statement.
paras.zh: 今年的成人和年轻摄影师获奖者都是黑白摄影，这是该比赛的首次获奖。根据声明，它展示了“单色图像讲述引人入胜的野生动物故事的持久力量”。

paras.en: The competition, widely considered the most prestigious wildlife photography contest in the world, aims to do more than just highlight animals. The wide-ranging scenes of life that earn accolades from the judges often have a conservation purpose, revealing “powerful stories from the natural world and the urgent need to protect it,” per the statement.
paras.zh: 这项比赛被广泛认为是世界上最负盛名的野生动物摄影比赛，其目的不仅仅是突出动物。声明称，赢得评委赞誉的广泛生活场景往往具有保护目的，揭示了“自然世界的强大故事以及保护自然的迫切需要”。

paras.en: Displayed in a gallery online, this year’s recognized images will also be on view at London’s Natural History Museum from October 16 through July 11, 2027. In the meantime, check out the winning photos below.
paras.zh: 今年公认的图片将在网上展出，并将于2027年10月16日至7月11日在伦敦自然历史博物馆展出。在此期间，请查看以下获奖照片。

paras.en: In Namibia’s Huab River Valley, Italian photographer Federico Veronesi was tracking elephants. He spotted drag marks in the sand of a dry riverbed and followed them to a group of the mammals. A female elephant revealed what had left the tracks: She was carrying a dead calf, with its leg wedged between her tusk and trunk.
paras.zh: 在纳米比亚的华布河谷，意大利摄影师Federico Veronesi正在追踪大象。他在干涸的河床的沙滩上发现了阻力痕迹，并跟着它们找到了一群哺乳动物。一头雌性大象露出了留下的痕迹：她抱着一只死去的小牛，它的腿夹在牙齿和躯干之间。

paras.en: “This photograph works on so many levels,” says Kathy Moran, chair of the jury that judged the images, in the statement. “Emotionally it’s a gut punch, heartbreakingly poignant. Intellectually it’s proof that animals have cognition.” Both Asian and African elephants have been known to mourn their dead and even bury them.
paras.zh: 评审团主席凯西·莫兰（ Kathy Moran ）在声明中说： “这张照片可以在很多层面上发挥作用。” “从情感上讲，这是一种直觉的冲击，令人心碎的痛苦。在智力上，这证明了动物有认知能力。“众所周知，亚洲和非洲的大象都会哀悼死者，甚至埋葬他们。

paras.en: Lying flat on the ground, young photographer Oscar Whitfield was eye-to-eye with this dung beetle in Zimbabwe. By rolling, eating and burying poop, the thousands of species of dung beetle worldwide help clean up environments and promote decomposition of waste.
paras.zh: 年轻的摄影师奥斯卡·惠特菲尔德（ Oscar Whitfield ）平躺在地上，与津巴布韦的这只粪甲虫目瞪口呆。通过滚动、食用和掩埋粪便，全世界成千上万种粪甲虫有助于清理环境并促进废物分解。

paras.en: “Photographing such a small, constantly moving subject is challenging, yet the image feels so intentional,” says Jasper Doest, a member of the jury, in the statement. “The photograph quietly reveals how life cycles depend on what we often overlook or dismiss.”
paras.zh: 陪审团成员贾斯珀·多斯特（ Jasper Doest ）在声明中说： “拍摄如此小巧、不断移动的主题具有挑战性，但图像却让人感到如此刻意。” “这张照片悄悄地揭示了生命周期如何取决于我们经常忽视或忽视的东西。”

paras.en: Freshly laid eggs of California newts are highly vulnerable to predation. Other newts, hungry and in densely packed populations, might be able to gulp down a clutch. So, female newts stick around to protect their eggs after laying, waiting until the gelatinous sac around them swells and the clutch becomes too big to be swallowed.
paras.zh: 新产的加利福尼亚蝾螈蛋极易受到捕食。其他蝾螈，饥饿和人口密集，可能能够吞下离合器。因此，雌性蝾螈在产卵后会留下来保护它们的卵，直到它们周围的凝胶囊膨胀，离合器变得太大而无法吞咽。

paras.en: Biologist and photographer Anton Sorokin has watched newts many times, but this was the first time he saw this posture. In his winning shot, a newt cradles another clutch of eggs in her arms as she lays, her feet interlocked on an underwater stem to protect the eggs.
paras.zh: 生物学家兼摄影师安东·索罗金（ Anton Sorokin ）曾多次观看蝾螈，但这是他第一次看到这种姿势。在他的获胜镜头中，一只蝾螈在躺下时将另一个鸡蛋抱在怀里，她的脚连锁在一个水下茎上以保护鸡蛋。

paras.en: Wild coyotes prowl San Francisco’s Bernal Heights Park, hunting rodents in the urban environment alongside humans and their dogs. Residents have mixed feelings about the canines, as they can pose a risk to pets, but also benefit from the predators’ natural rodent control.
paras.zh: 野生土狼在旧金山的伯纳尔高地公园徘徊，与人类和他们的狗一起在城市环境中狩猎啮齿动物。居民对犬科动物的感受复杂，因为它们可能对宠物构成风险，但也受益于捕食者的天然啮齿动物控制。

paras.en: Photographer Loren Elliott created a portfolio featuring the coyotes, which number roughly 100 in a city of 800,000 human residents. Although coyotes are native to California, a government-sponsored campaign in the early 20th century resulted in their local eradication. But by the start of the 2000s, the animals had mysteriously returned.
paras.zh: 摄影师洛伦·埃利奥特（ Loren Elliott ）创建了一个以土狼为特色的投资组合，在一个拥有80万人口的城市中，土狼的数量约为100只。虽然土狼原产于加利福尼亚州，但政府在20世纪初发起的一项运动导致它们在当地被消灭。但到了21世纪初，这些动物神秘地回来了。

paras.en: Afternoon Snack by Alexis Tinker-Tsavalas
paras.zh: Alexis Tinker-Tsavalas的午后小吃

paras.en: The bubbles in the eyes of this unfortunate flesh fly—the victim in this predation event—suggest it has been injected with digestive enzymes from the larger robber fly, also known as an assassin fly. Those enzymes liquify the insect’s internal organs so that the robber fly can easily consume them.
paras.zh: 这只不幸的肉苍蝇（在这次捕食事件中的受害者）眼中的气泡表明，它被注射了来自更大的强盗苍蝇的消化酶，也被称为刺客苍蝇。这些酶使昆虫的内脏器官液化，这样强盗就可以很容易地消耗它们。

paras.en: In his portfolio spanning Germany and Northern Ireland, photographer Alexis Tinker-Tsavalas brings attention to tiny insects and arachnids. He created images with a large depth of field by stacking several photos that were focused in different areas.
paras.zh: 摄影师Alexis Tinker-Tsavalas在德国和北爱尔兰的作品集中关注微小的昆虫和蛛形纲动物。他通过堆叠几张聚焦在不同区域的照片来创建具有较大景深的图像。

paras.en: Slime molds are mysterious and strange—not fitting into the categories of fungi, animals or plants, they can either be single cells or “supercells” with one cell membrane and many nuclei. They mostly grow on dead wood or leaf litter and tend to be small. The slime molds in this photograph are just one or two millimeters high.
paras.zh: 粘菌是神秘而奇怪的，不属于真菌、动物或植物的类别，它们可以是单细胞或具有一个细胞膜和多个细胞核的“超级细胞”。它们大多生长在枯木或枯叶上，往往很小。这张照片中的粘液霉菌只有一两毫米高。

paras.en: Photographer Kutub Uddin, who created a macro photography portfolio of slime molds, describes them in a statement as “tiny clusters or unusual textures on the wood, often appearing as minute pins, spheres or dust-like groupings.” Here, these slime molds in West Sussex, England, are sprouting fine threads called capillitium, which will help emit spores for reproduction.
paras.zh: 摄影师库图布·乌丁（ Kutub Uddin ）创建了一个粘菌微距摄影组合，他在一份声明中将其描述为“木材上的微小团簇或不寻常的纹理，通常表现为微小的针脚、球体或尘埃状的分组。“在这里，英格兰西萨塞克斯的这些粘液霉菌正在发芽称为毛细管的细丝，这将有助于释放孢子进行繁殖。

paras.en: In Argentina’s Santa Cruz province, where the hunting of pumas has been banned since last year, a dead puma is displayed tied to a fence as a hunting trophy. Photographer Francisco Negroni had “never witnessed or photographed” such a scene before, he says in a statement.
paras.zh: 在阿根廷的圣克鲁斯省，自去年以来一直禁止猎杀美洲狮，一只死去的美洲豹被拴在栅栏上作为狩猎奖杯展示。他在一份声明中说，摄影师弗朗西斯科·内格罗尼（ Francisco Negroni ）以前“从未见过或拍摄过”这样的场景。

paras.en: Humans who raise livestock might kill pumas to thwart livestock predation. According to the statement, keeping sheep indoors at night and using guard dogs could protect livestock without resorting to hunting the cats.
paras.zh: 饲养牲畜的人可能会杀死美洲狮以阻止牲畜捕食。根据声明，晚上将羊留在室内并使用警卫犬可以保护牲畜，而无需狩猎猫。

paras.en: A human-made line cuts through Stansbury Bay on Utah’s Great Salt Lake, cutting off an area turned pink by microbes that thrive in salty water.
paras.zh: 一条人工生产线穿过犹他州大盐湖的斯坦斯伯里湾，切断了在咸水中生长的微生物变成粉红色的区域。

paras.en: “The Great Salt Lake has been under pressure for decades from water diversion, climate change and industrial extraction,” photographer Alex Visbal writes on Instagram. “This photograph shows how a single engineered line can change an entire wetland.”
paras.zh: 摄影师Alex Visbal在Instagram上写道： “几十年来，大盐湖一直受到引水、气候变化和工业开采的压力。” “这张照片展示了单条工程线如何改变整个湿地。”

paras.en: Since this photo was taken, Utah has brought this area under conservation management, according to a statement.
paras.zh: 根据一份声明，自这张照片拍摄以来，犹他州已将该地区纳入保护管理。

paras.en: The second-largest lizard species in the world, a common water monitor carries a fish in Bangkok. These animals spend most of the day warming their bodies in the sun, but they’re also generalist predators that will eat anything they can find—making them well-adapted for city living.
paras.zh: 作为世界第二大蜥蜴物种，曼谷的普通水上监视器可携带一条鱼。这些动物每天大部分时间都在阳光下温暖身体，但它们也是多面手掠食者，会吃掉任何能找到的东西，使它们非常适合城市生活。

paras.en: At Lumphini Park in Thailand, photographer Seth Forestson waited for the creatures to become active, then captured this shot—lying low against the mud to include the city skyline.
paras.zh: 在泰国的Lumphini公园，摄影师Seth Forestson等待这些生物变得活跃，然后拍摄了这张照片-低躺在泥泞中，包括城市天际线。

paras.en: The mating behavior of Abbott’s moray eels had long been a mystery. But a team of biologists and photographer Tony Wu have been working to shine light on this hidden activity for years.
paras.zh: 雅培海鳗的交配行为一直是个谜。但是一个由生物学家和摄影师Tony Wu组成的团队多年来一直致力于揭示这种隐藏的活动。

paras.en: With a red-light source and custom fisheye lens, Wu began photographing this male in 2024 in Kyushu, Japan. His resulting images, which are helping inform scientific studies, might be the first to document Abbott’s moray eel courtship and spawning.
paras.zh: 凭借红光源和定制的鱼眼镜头， Wu于2024年在日本九州开始拍摄这位男性。他得到的图像有助于为科学研究提供信息，可能是第一个记录雅培海鳗求偶和产卵的图像。

paras.en: This photograph might look like forest with crisp, autumn leaves, but don’t be deceived. Photographer Michał Michalski stood in front of a sunflower field in Poland, which was filled with feeding birds like goldfinches and bramblings. When a sparrowhawk startled the flock, the birds took off in unison, and Michalski captured their beating wings, blurred in front of the bare birch trees.
paras.zh: 这张照片可能看起来像有着清脆秋叶的森林，但不要上当受骗。摄影师Michał Michalski站在波兰的一片向日葵田前，那里到处都是金翅雀和荆棘等鸟类。当一只麻雀鹰吓到羊群时，鸟儿们齐声起飞，米哈尔斯基抓住了他们的翅膀，在裸露的桦树前模糊不清。

paras.en: Under ultraviolet light, the stems of these beautiful bonnet mushrooms glow in a bright yellow. Some fungi produce their own light, but these, captured by photographer Agorastos Papatsanis on the lower slopes of Greece’s Mount Olympus, work a little differently. They are fluorescent, meaning that they absorb light of one wavelength—ultraviolet—and re-emit it at another wavelength of visible light.
paras.zh: 在紫外线照射下，这些美丽的帽子蘑菇的茎发出明亮的黄色光芒。有些真菌会产生自己的光线，但摄影师Agorastos Papatsanis在希腊奥林匹斯山下坡拍摄的这些真菌的工作方式略有不同。它们是荧光的，这意味着它们吸收一种波长的光（紫外线） ，并以另一种波长的可见光重新发射。

paras.en: At dawn, this mobile net-fishing platform, or bagan, provided the only light for photographer Alex Lindbloom’s drone flying off the coast of Papua, Indonesia. He found a whale shark, the biggest fish species alive, curious about the fishers’ catch.
paras.zh: 黎明时分，这个移动渔网平台（蒲甘）为摄影师亚历克斯·林德布鲁姆（ Alex Lindbloom ）的无人机在印度尼西亚巴布亚（ Papua ）海岸飞行提供了唯一的光线。他发现了一条鲸鲨，这是现存最大的鱼类物种，对渔民的渔获量感到好奇。

paras.en: Whale sharks have declined by 50 percent globally over the past 75 years, and off West Papua, Indonesia, almost two-thirds of them have injuries from human-related causes, such as tour boats and fishing gear. Bagans might cause minor injuries, but they don’t typically result in death, per a statement, and local communities attract tourists with the predictable appearance of sharks at these platforms.
paras.zh: 在过去的75年里，鲸鲨在全球范围内减少了50% ，在印度尼西亚西巴布亚，近三分之二的鲸鲨受到了旅游船和渔具等与人类有关的原因的伤害。根据一份声明，蒲甘可能会造成轻微伤害，但它们通常不会导致死亡，当地社区通过在这些平台上出现鲨鱼的可预测外观吸引游客。

paras.en: These flat-beaked shoebill birds might have been gathering nesting material as photographer Isak Pretorius watched them pull up vegetation and drop it. Shoebills are known to be elusive, so Pretorius felt lucky to find two of them when canoeing through Uganda’s Mabamba Swamp with a guide. Classified as a vulnerable species, fewer than 5,300 adult shoebills are thought to remain in the wild.
paras.zh: 当摄影师伊萨克·普雷托里乌斯（ Isak Pretorius ）看着这些扁嘴的鞋嘴鸟拉起植被并放下它时，它们可能正在收集筑巢材料。众所周知，鞋喙是难以捉摸的，所以Pretorius在导游的带领下划独木舟穿越乌干达的Mabamba沼泽时，很幸运地找到了其中两只。被归类为易受伤害的物种，只有不到5,300只成虫被认为留在野外。

paras.en: A common octopus makes eye contact with photographer Aaron Sanders from behind a curtain of kelp. “We remained perfectly still, watching one another with a seemingly shared curiosity,” he says in a statement. The silhouette of the cephalopod’s suckers can be seen through the seaweed.
paras.zh: 一只普通的章鱼在海带幕后与摄影师Aaron Sanders进行眼神交流。他在一份声明中说： “我们保持着完美的静止状态，看着彼此，似乎有着共同的好奇心。”通过海藻可以看到头足类动物吸盘的轮廓。

paras.en: Sanders spotted the creature when diving off England’s Porthkerris Beach. Common octopuses have been spotted more frequently in the region during the past two years. They prefer warm waters, typically found around the Mediterranean, but this recent “bloom” in abundance is thought to be linked to rising sea temperatures.
paras.zh: 桑德斯在英格兰波斯凯里斯海滩潜水时发现了这种生物。在过去两年中，该地区更频繁地发现了普通章鱼。他们更喜欢温暖的水域，通常在地中海周围发现，但最近这种丰富的“盛开”被认为与海水温度上升有关。

paras.en: Giraffes, zebras and elephants gather at a watering hole for a drink in Kenya’s Chyulu Hills National Park. Herbivores might spend more time in these areas when elephants are around, potentially because their large size could deter predators. Here, a young male elephant sprays zebras in a scene captured by photographer James Lewin.
paras.zh: 长颈鹿、斑马和大象聚集在肯尼亚丘鲁山国家公园的水坑里喝一杯。当大象出现在这些地区时，食草动物可能会花更多的时间在这些地区，这可能是因为它们的大尺寸可以阻止捕食者。在这里，一头年轻的雄性大象在摄影师詹姆斯·勒温（ James Lewin ）拍摄的场景中喷洒斑马。

paras.en: A scorpion tosses sand as it burrows to escape the heat of the rising sun in India’s Thar Desert. Photographer Sitaram Raul timed the shot to get the sand grains suspended in the air. Buthacus scorpions like this one use stiff bristles as snowshoes to keep from sinking into the dunes.
paras.zh: 印度塔尔沙漠中，一只蝎子在挖洞时抛掷沙子，以躲避初升太阳的热量。摄影师西塔拉姆·劳尔 (Sitaram Raul) 安排了拍摄时间，让沙粒悬浮在空中。像这样的布塔克斯蝎子使用坚硬的鬃毛作为雪鞋，以防止陷入沙丘中。

paras.en: “What you see in the final image is just a small part of the story,” Raul writes on Instagram. “Behind it are hours in the field, patience, curiosity and a desire to see nature a little differently.”
paras.zh: Raul在Instagram上写道：「您在最终图片中看到的只是故事的一小部分。“在这背后是田野里的几个小时，耐心、好奇心和以不同的方式看待大自然的愿望。”

paras.en: Using her dad’s iPhone, young photographer Amelie Davis captured a common carder bee mid-flight in a garden in southern England. Davis had spent months photographing bees, but on this particular day, the flowers were “teeming with bees,” she says in a statement.
paras.zh: 年轻的摄影师艾米莉·戴维斯（ Amelie Davis ）使用父亲的iPhone ，在英格兰南部的一个花园里捕捉到了一只普通的蜜蜂。她在一份声明中说，戴维斯花了几个月的时间拍摄蜜蜂，但在这一天，花朵“充满了蜜蜂”。

paras.en: Birdsong Painted in Light by Konrad Gräeter
paras.zh: Konrad Gräeter在灯光下绘制的鸟鸣声

paras.en: Male Eurasian blackbirds sit on elevated perches and sing to attract mates in spring—and their most complex songs come in the morning, according to a statement. Females, in reply, give a softer tune.
paras.zh: 根据一份声明，雄性欧亚黑鸟坐在高耸的栖息地上，在春天唱歌以吸引配偶，它们最复杂的歌曲出现在早上。作为回应，雌性给出了一个更柔和的曲调。

paras.en: In a German vineyard, young photographer Konrad Gräeter captured an image of this male blackbird singing, framed through the foliage at dawn. “With this image I try to show that the beauty of nature is all around us, if we only look,” Gräeter writes on Instagram.
paras.zh: 在德国的一个葡萄园里，年轻的摄影师康拉德·格莱特（ Konrad Gräeter ）拍摄了这只雄性黑鸟在黎明时分穿过树叶唱歌的照片。Gräeter在Instagram上写道： “通过这张照片，我试图表明，如果我们只看，大自然的美景就在我们身边。”

paras.en: You can also enjoy great benefits with Walmart+, a paid membership that gives early access to promotions and events like Walmart Black Friday deals, free delivery, free shipping with no order minimum, savings on fuel, streaming with Paramount+, and more. You can pay monthly or annually, and you’ll get a free trial of Walmart+ for 30 days to try it out. Walmart+ Assist helps qualifying government aid recipients get a membership at a lower cost.
paras.zh: 您还可以享受 Walmart+ 的巨大优惠，这是一种付费会员资格，可以提前享受沃尔玛黑色星期五优惠等促销和活动、免费送货、无最低订单限制的免费送货、节省燃油、通过 Paramount+ 进行流媒体播放等。您可以按月或按年付费，并且可以免费试用 Walmart+ 30 天。 Walmart+ Assist 帮助符合条件的政府援助接受者以较低的成本获得会员资格。

paras.en: Did you know that Walmart basically has its own Amazon Prime-esque membership plan? It's called Walmart+, and it's a great option for people who shop at Walmart often. It'll give you free grocery delivery, free shipping with no order minimum, savings on fuel, and early access to promotions and events. Plus, you can try Walmart+ free for 30 days to see if the service is right for you or your family. The annual plan is $98 (roughly $8 per month) after trial, meaning you’ll get $57 in savings annually.
paras.zh: 您是否知道沃尔玛基本上有自己的亚马逊 Prime 式会员计划？它被称为沃尔玛+，对于经常在沃尔玛购物的人来说是一个不错的选择。它将为您提供免费杂货配送、无最低订单限制的免费送货、节省燃油以及提前参与促销和活动。另外，您可以免费试用 Walmart+ 30 天，看看该服务是否适合您或您的家人。试用后，年度计划为 98 美元（每月约 8 美元），这意味着您每年将节省 57 美元。

paras.en: If you don’t want to leave your home, Walmart offers fast delivery in as fast as an hour! You’ll just need to book a timeslot through the site to get your favorites and essentials right to your door. This even includes delivery of important refrigerated prescriptions, like Insulin, GLP-1s, antibiotics, and more. Plus, it’s great for when you’re sick and need cold/flu remedies like DayQuil, Theraflu, tea, and more.
paras.zh: 如果您不想出门，沃尔玛提供最快一小时的送货服务！您只需通过网站预订时段，即可将您喜爱的商品和必需品送到家门口。这甚至包括运送重要的冷藏处方药，如胰岛素、GLP-1、抗生素等。另外，当您生病并需要 DayQuil、Theraflu、茶等感冒/流感药物时，它非常适合。

paras.en: The OnePay Walmart Spend Card is a Walmart-exclusive credit card (meaning that it can only be used at Walmart and Walmart.com). If you don’t qualify for the OnePay CashRewards Mastercard (and have poor credit scores), this is a great way to build credit history—but you won’t get the cash-back rewards of the CashRewards card. This card can not only help you build credit, but also doesn’t require an annual fee. Just know that when you apply for a OnePay Card, you will first be considered for the OnePay Cash Rewards Card, but if you don’t qualify, you’ll be considered for a OnePay Walmart Spend Card. Interested applicants can apply online at Walmart.com, the Walmart app, or in-store.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Being a student usually means sleep deprivation, caffeine over-consumption, and being broke. When students shop at Walmart, they can make their short funds stretch even further, with 50% off Walmart+ memberships for students. That means a student Walmart+ membership is $6.47 per month, or $49 per year. Plus, you can get a free 30-day trial to decide if the service is right for you! To get this deal, verify your eligibility, choose your discounted plan—either a monthly or annual plan—either option is still 50%. With the free trial, you’ll get perks like free delivery on orders over $35, free shipping, and either a free Paramount+ or Peacock streaming service (that amounts to up to $109 per year in video streaming savings!).
paras.zh: 作为一名学生通常意味着睡眠不足、咖啡因摄入过量以及破产。当学生在沃尔玛购物时，他们可以进一步利用他们的短缺资金，学生的 Walmart+ 会员资格可享受 50% 的折扣。这意味着 Walmart+ 学生会员的费用为每月 6.47 美元，或每年 49 美元。此外，您还可以获得 30 天免费试用，以确定该服务是否适合您！要获得此优惠，请验证您的资格，选择您的折扣计划（月度或年度计划），任一选项仍为 50%。通过免费试用，您将获得一些福利，例如订单超过 35 美元的免费送货、免费送货以及免费的 Paramount+ 或 Peacock 流媒体服务（每年最多可节省 109 美元的视频流媒体费用！）。

paras.en: Get 5% Cashback Walmart as a Walmart+ Member
paras.zh: 作为 Walmart+ 会员，获得 5% 现金返还

paras.en: Being a Walmart+ member has tons of perks, including 5% cash back when you shop at Walmart, plus, 1.5% cash back on all other purchases with zero annual fees. And when you open a OnePay Card and spend over $75 on that card within 30 days, you’ll get an extra $35 cash back. To get these rewards, all you need to do is pay with your OnePay CashRewards Card at Walmart (or anywhere Mastercard is accepted), earn OnePay points on your purchases, and redeem for cash (or a statement credit into a OnePay Cash Account).
paras.zh: 成为 Walmart+ 会员可享受大量福利，包括在 Walmart 购物时可享受 5% 的现金返还，此外，所有其他购物可享 1.5% 的现金返还，且年费为零。当您开立 OnePay 卡并在 30 天内在该卡上消费超过 75 美元时，您将获得额外 35 美元的现金返还。要获得这些奖励，您只需在沃尔玛（或接受万事达卡的任何地方）使用 OnePay CashRewards 卡付款，在购买时赚取 OnePay 积分，然后兑换现金（或将账单存入 OnePay 现金账户）。

paras.en: It can be anxiety-inducing to have a medical condition like diabetes, which needs managed care, and not to mention can get extremely expensive. (Thanks USA for not having universal healthcare!) Walmart knows that your health is a priority, and wants to make these medically necessary items cheaper for folks with diabetes. Walmart has a whole section online for (often) discounted diabetes essentials, to take the headache and guesswork out of shopping. You can get up to 35% off things like glucose monitors and insulin coolers, along with test strips, and medical bags. Plus, diabetic supplies and wearables like socks, footwear, and mobility aids are also available for fast shipping and most are FSA/HSA eligible.
paras.zh: 患有糖尿病等疾病可能会引起焦虑，需要管理式护理，更不用说可能会非常昂贵。 （感谢美国没有全民医疗保健！）沃尔玛知道您的健康是首要任务，并且希望为糖尿病患者提供更便宜的这些医疗必需品。沃尔玛在网上有一整块专区，出售（通常）打折的糖尿病必需品，以消除购物时的头痛和猜测。您可以享受高达 35% 的折扣，例如血糖监测仪、胰岛素冷却器、试纸条和医疗包等。此外，糖尿病用品和可穿戴设备（如袜子、鞋类和助行器）也可快速发货，并且大多数都符合 FSA/HSA 资格。

articles.title: Lenovo Coupon Codes: 15% Off in October 2026
articles.author: Luke Larsen

paras.en: Lenovo is currently the biggest PC and laptop company in the world, and they just so happen to make some of our favorite laptops and PC peripherals. In fact, our list of the Best Laptops you can buy include a number of Lenovo devices that we’ve tested and fully recommend, ranging from high-end premium laptops to options for budget-minded shoppers. If you are looking to save a few bucks while shopping for a new Lenovo product, here are the Lenovo coupon codes and special offers you need to know about.
paras.zh: 联想是目前世界上最大的个人电脑和笔记本电脑公司，他们恰好生产了一些我们最喜欢的笔记本电脑和个人电脑外围设备。事实上，您可以购买的最佳笔记本电脑列表包括我们已经测试并充分推荐的许多联想设备，从高端笔记本电脑到精打细算的购物者的选择。如果您想在购买新的联想产品时节省一些钱，这里是您需要了解的联想优惠券代码和特别优惠。

paras.en: Score Weekly Tech Deals, Price Match Guarantee, and Free Shipping
paras.zh: 获得每周技术优惠、价格匹配保证和免费送货

paras.en: In addition to the deals listed above, Lenovo has a number of other current offers available when shopping through Lenovo.com. There are weekly deals on PCs and tech that include free shipping with no minimums. For certain products, you can even choose to buy online and pick up in-store at Best Buy. If you’re looking for more Lenovo recommendations, we’re big fans of the Lenovo Idea Tab Pro, an Android tablet that’s currently on our Best Tablets list. It’s currently discounted by 26%, bringing the price down to $280.
paras.zh: 除了上面列出的优惠之外，通过 Lenovo.com 购物时，联想还提供许多其他当前优惠。每周都有电脑和科技产品优惠，其中包括无最低限额的免费送货。对于某些产品，您甚至可以选择在线购买并在百思买店内提货。如果您正在寻找更多联想推荐，我们是 Lenovo Idea Tab Pro 的忠实粉丝，这款 Android 平板电脑目前位于我们的最佳平板电脑列表中。目前它有 26% 的折扣，价格降至 280 美元。

paras.en: Lenovo is also offering price-matching on any comparable PC, including from many online retailers. That’s really helpful, as it’s not uncommon to see price discrepancies between different retailers.
paras.zh: 联想还提供任何同类电脑的价格匹配，包括来自许多在线零售商的电脑。这确实很有帮助，因为不同零售商之间的价格差异并不罕见。

paras.en: Get Exclusive Savings With Lenovo Discount Programs
paras.zh: 通过联想折扣计划获得独家优惠

paras.en: Lenovo does offer a fairly generous discount program for certain demographics as well. These include a 5% off Education, Healthcare, First Responder, and Senior (over 55) discount.
paras.zh: 联想也确实为某些人群提供了相当慷慨的折扣计划。其中包括教育、医疗保健、急救人员和老年人（55 岁以上）折扣 5%。

paras.en: You can use this discount on anything you find at Lenovo.com, which includes a lot more than just Lenovo-branded laptops. For example, Lenovo sells one of our favorite laptop docking stations, the Kensington Triple Video Mobile Dock. Despite its tiny size, this tiny device can power up to three 1080p (or two 4K) displays simultaneously. It’s a great example of the wide diversity of products you can use these discounts and coupon codes on.
paras.zh: 您可以在 Lenovo.com 上找到的任何商品上使用此折扣，其中不仅包括 Lenovo 品牌的笔记本电脑。例如，联想销售我们最喜欢的笔记本电脑扩展坞之一：Kensington 三重视频移动扩展坞。尽管尺寸很小，但这款微型设备最多可以同时为三个 1080p（或两个 4K）显示器供电。这是一个很好的例子，说明您可以使用这些折扣和优惠券代码的产品种类繁多。

paras.en: Back to School: 10% Off for Students at Lenovo
paras.zh: 返校：联想学生 10% 折扣

paras.en: It’s that time of year again—summer is winding down and fall will soon follow, bringing Back-to-School season—which means stocking up on all the tech essentials you (or your child) need to succeed this school year. Lenovo has a robust discount system for students, with a 10% off Lenovo discount for students, along with “Weekly Deals” on student-specific PCs and related accessories. With the Lenovo student discount code, you also get free shipping (with no minimum), price match guarantee, My Lenovo Rewards for rewards towards every purchase, and Lenovo financing to make those big purchases more attainable. There are tons of sales on Lenovo products to make your budget stretch further, including deals on monitors, laptops, tablets, phones, and storage solutions.
paras.zh: 又到了一年中的这个时候——夏天即将过去，秋天即将到来，返校季来临——这意味着要储备您（或您的孩子）在本学年取得成功所需的所有科技必需品。联想拥有强大的学生折扣体系，学生可享受 10% 的联想折扣，并针对学生专用电脑及相关配件提供“每周优惠”。使用联想学生折扣代码，您还可以获得免费送货（无最低限额）、价格匹配保证、每次购买的奖励“我的联想奖励”以及使这些大额购买更容易实现的联想融资。联想产品的大量促销活动可以让您的预算进一步增加，包括显示器、笔记本电脑、平板电脑、手机和存储解决方案的优惠。

paras.en: If you’re looking to buy multiple devices, or are planning to make a big tech purchase soon, I’d recommend buying now to get more savings. Use Lenovo promo code BUYMORELENOVO at checkout to save $15 on purchases of $500-$750, $25 off purchases of $750-$1,000, save $40 on purchases of $1,000-$2,000, and get $100 off when you purchase something $2,000 or more. (Excludes clearance and workstation items.)
paras.zh: 如果您想购买多台设备，或者计划很快购买大型科技产品，我建议您立即购买，以节省更多费用。在结帐时使用 Lenovo 促销代码 BUYMORELENOVO 购买满 500 美元至 750 美元可节省 15 美元，购买满 750 美元至 1,000 美元可节省 25 美元，购买满 1,000 美元至 2,000 美元可节省 40 美元，购买满 2,000 美元或以上可享受 100 美元折扣。 （不包括间隙和工作站项目。）

paras.en: The Lenovo Idea Tab Pro is a perfect tablet for students, with a vibrant nearly-13 inch 3K touchscreen display which is perfect for every day tasks, like reading, studying, and streaming. It also has a MediaTek processor, 8GB memory, and 128GB storage for seamless multitasking with ample storage for apps and files. Plus, it has dual cameras for Zoom calls. Although the Lenovo Idea Tab Pro is specifically designed with students in mind, it’s versatile enough to be a great fit for a multitude of people wanting a reliable tablet with tons of extra features. Plus, it’s 35% off right now. There’s no better time to buy.
paras.zh: Lenovo Idea Tab Pro 是一款非常适合学生的平板电脑，拥有色彩鲜艳的近 13 英寸 3K 触摸屏显示屏，非常适合阅读、学习和流媒体等日常任务。它还配备联发科处理器、8GB 内存和 128GB 存储空间，可实现无缝多任务处理，并为应用程序和文件提供充足的存储空间。此外，它还具有用于 Zoom 通话的双摄像头。尽管 Lenovo Idea Tab Pro 是专门为学生设计的，但它的多功能性足以满足许多想要拥有大量额外功能的可靠平板电脑的人的需求。另外，现在还有 35% 的折扣。没有比这更好的购买时机了。

paras.en: We all know being a student is expensive, and made even harder when you need pricey tech to thrive in academia. One of the easiest ways to save big on tech at Lenovo is with a student discount. All you need to nab this student discount at Lenovo is to verify your student or employee verification with a valid .edu email address or through ID.me verification. Then, create a Lenovo Education account to unlock benefits for one year, where discounts are automatically applied to eligible products. Once you log in with the verified account, you’ll save 5% off sitewide with your verified Lenovo Education account, and discounts will be automatically applied to eligible products. That means you’ll get 5% off in cart year-round—plus, you’ll be able to unlock even deeper discounts during special promo periods.
paras.zh: 我们都知道，当一名学生的成本很高，当你需要昂贵的技术才能在学术界蓬勃发展时，就更难了。在联想节省大量技术费用的最简单方法之一就是学生折扣。要在 Lenovo 获得此学生折扣，您只需使用有效的 .edu 电子邮件地址或通过 ID.me 验证来验证您的学生或员工验证。然后，创建一个联想教育帐户以解锁一年的福利，其中折扣将自动应用于符合条件的产品。使用经过验证的帐户登录后，您可以通过经过验证的联想教育帐户在全场范围内享受 5% 的折扣，并且折扣将自动应用于符合条件的产品。这意味着您全年均可在购物车中享受 5% 的折扣，此外，您还可以在特殊促销期间享受更大的折扣。

paras.en: Enjoy Perks When You Join My Lenovo Rewards
paras.zh: 加入“我的联想奖励”即可享受福利

paras.en: Lenovo Financing and Lease-to-Own Options
paras.zh: 联想融资和先租后买选项

paras.en: Lenovo uses Katapult to offer financing and lease-to-own options on its laptops. That might be useful if you’ve been eyeing one of Lenovo’s higher-end laptops. One of our favorite of these is the Lenovo Yoga 9i, a gorgeous 2-in-1 with a bright OLED screen and a luxurious design. This laptop is currently listed as one of our top recommendations for the Best Laptops and Best 2-in-1 Laptop.
paras.zh: 联想利用 Katapult 为其笔记本电脑提供融资和先租后买的选择。如果您一直在关注联想的一款高端笔记本电脑，这可能会很有用。其中我们最喜欢的一款是联想 Yoga 9i，这是一款华丽的二合一设备，拥有明亮的 OLED 屏幕和奢华的设计。这款笔记本电脑目前被列为我们最佳笔记本电脑和最佳二合一笔记本电脑的首选推荐之一。

paras.en: Katapult allows you to buy now and pay over time, without charging late fees. If you put down a $45 initial payment, you can check out the laptop today. Katapult offers up to $3,500 in pre-approved leases and allows you to make minimum payments over time or buyout early.
paras.zh: Katapult 允许您立即购买并分期付款，无需收取滞纳金。如果您支付 45 美元的首期付款，您今天就可以查看这台笔记本电脑。 Katapult 提供高达 3,500 美元的预先批准租赁，并允许您随时间支付最低付款或提前买断。

paras.en: If you’re a small business owner, Lenovo Pro can help you grow your business quickly and effectively. When you join, you’ll unlock a bevy of helpful support, including receiving expert advice, community insights, and you’ll get free Premier Support on Think PCs. And right now, when you join Lenovo Pro for business, new members can save $100 of their first purchase of $1,000 or more.
paras.zh: 如果您是小型企业主，Lenovo Pro 可以帮助您快速有效地发展业务。加入后，您将获得一系列有用的支持，包括获得专家建议、社区见解，并且您将获得 Think PC 上的免费高级支持。现在，当您加入 Lenovo Pro for Business 时，新会员首次购买 1,000 美元或以上可节省 100 美元。

articles.title: Suspicious white powder sent to election officials in three states

paras.en: Oct. 14 (UPI) -- Election officials in Ohio, Louisiana and Oklahoma said they were sent packages containing suspicious white powder, prompting law enforcement to investigate.
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日（UPI）——俄亥俄州、路易斯安那州和俄克拉荷马州的选举官员表示，他们收到了含有可疑白色粉末的包裹，促使执法部门展开调查。

paras.en: The suspicious powder was discovered in Louisiana and Oklahoma on Tuesday, while a similar mailing intended for Ohio was intercepted Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周二在路易斯安那州和俄克拉荷马州发现了可疑粉末，周三截获了一封发往俄亥俄州的类似邮件。

paras.en: Louisiana Secretary of State Nancy Landry said in a statement that her office in Baton Rouge was closed Tuesday after an Elections Division employee opened a package at around 12:20 p.m. CDT and found white powder inside.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州国务卿南希·兰德里在一份声明中表示，周二中午 12 点 20 分左右，一名选举部门员工打开了一个包裹，她在巴吞鲁日的办公室被关闭。 CDT，发现里面有白色粉末。

paras.en: The Oklahoma State Election Board said in a statement it received an envelope containing a "suspicious white powder" on Tuesday morning.
paras.zh: 俄克拉荷马州选举委员会在一份声明中表示，周二早上收到了一个装有“可疑白色粉末”的信封。

paras.en: And a statement from Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose on Wednesday states that U.S. Postal Service investigators intercepted a letter containing "a powdery white substance" intended for his office.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州国务卿弗兰克·拉罗斯周三发表声明称，美国邮政局调查人员截获了一封寄给他办公室的信件，其中含有“白色粉状物质”。

paras.en: The offices in Louisiana and Oklahoma were evacuated, while the Louisiana office was closed for the remainder of Tuesday.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州和俄克拉荷马州的办事处已被疏散，路易斯安那州办事处则在周二剩余时间内关闭。

paras.en: LaRose said investigators who intercepted the envelope intended for his Ohio office were "dealing with similar mailings sent to election officials in multiple states." He said the FBI was handling the matter.
paras.zh: 拉罗斯表示，截获寄给他俄亥俄州办公室的信封的调查人员正在“处理发送给多个州选举官员的类似邮件”。他表示，联邦调查局正在处理此事。

paras.en: "We have informed our county boards of elections to be vigilant in the days ahead," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们已通知县选举委员会在未来几天保持警惕。”

paras.en: Landry stated Tuesday that her office did not know what the substance was, but law enforcement was responding to the incident.
paras.zh: 兰德里周二表示，她的办公室不知道该物质是什么，但执法部门正在对这一事件做出回应。

paras.en: The Oklahoma State Election Board said the Oklahoma Highway Patrol was "immediately" notified after it received the envelope.
paras.zh: 俄克拉荷马州选举委员会表示，俄克拉荷马州公路巡逻队收到信封后“立即”收到通知。

paras.en: "Thankfully, no one from the State Election Board staff was harmed as a result of this incident," State Election Board Secretary Paul Ziriax said.
paras.zh: 州选举委员会秘书保罗·齐里亚克斯 (Paul Ziriax) 表示：“值得庆幸的是，州选举委员会工作人员没有人因这一事件而受伤。”

paras.en: "We want to assure Oklahoma voters that today's incident does not impact our ability to conduct elections. Election officials remain committed to ensuring safe and secure elections."
paras.zh: “我们希望向俄克拉荷马州选民保证，今天的事件不会影响我们进行选举的能力。选举官员仍然致力于确保安全可靠的选举。”

paras.en: The FBI told NBC News in a statement that it was working with its partners to identify those behind the letters, while declining to confirm where letters had been received.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局在一份声明中告诉 NBC 新闻，它正在与合作伙伴合作查明这些信件的幕后黑手，但拒绝确认信件的收件地点。

paras.en: The incidents come just weeks before Nov. 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 这些事件发生在 11 月 3 日中期选举前几周。

paras.en: The National Association of Secretaries of State and the National Association of State Election Directors said in a joint statement Wednesday that they are "deeply concerned by these incidents."
paras.zh: 全国国务卿协会和全国州选举主任协会周三在一份联合声明中表示，他们“对这些事件深感担忧”。

paras.en: "As we have each stated in the past, threats against election officials and workers have no place in our democracy. Those who administer our elections should never fear for their safety while carrying out their essential duties," it said.
paras.zh: “正如我们过去所说的那样，针对选举官员和工作人员的威胁在我们的民主制度中没有立足之地。那些管理我们选举的人在履行基本职责时永远不应该担心自己的安全，”它说。

articles.title: Appeals court hears arguments in National Guard deployment to D.C.

paras.en: WASHINGTON, Oct. 14 (UPI) -- An attorney for the Trump administration argued Wednesday in a federal appeals court that President Donald Trump has broad authority to deploy the National Guard in Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 华盛顿，10 月 14 日（UPI）——特朗普政府的一名律师周三在联邦上诉法院辩称，唐纳德·特朗普总统拥有在华盛顿特区部署国民警卫队的广泛权力。

paras.en: In response to the arguments by Trump lawyer Eric D. McArthur, a lawyer representing the city, Mitchell P. Reich, said that power applies only to invasions, insurrections or riots, meaning that it did not apply in the case of trying to combat routine crime.
paras.zh: 针对特朗普律师埃里克·D·麦克阿瑟的论点，代表该市的律师米切尔·P·赖克表示，权力仅适用于入侵、叛乱或骚乱，这意味着它不适用于试图打击常规犯罪的情况。

paras.en: Reich said the deployment of the National Guard is "dramatically altering life in the District" and making residents fearful in their daily lives. He added that it makes citizens less trusting of law enforcement and harder for the D.C. police to do their job.
paras.zh: 赖希表示，国民警卫队的部署正在“极大地改变该地区的生活”，并使居民在日常生活中感到恐惧。他补充说，这降低了公民对执法部门的信任，也让华盛顿警察更难开展工作。

paras.en: These arguments come more than a year after the Trump administration deployed the National Guard to the district. In August 2025, Trump made comments about what he said was a rise in violent crime in Washington, threatening a federal takeover.
paras.zh: 这些争论是在特朗普政府向该地区部署国民警卫队一年多后提出的。 2025 年 8 月，特朗普就他所说的华盛顿暴力犯罪上升发表评论，威胁要联邦接管。

paras.en: "If D.C. doesn't get its act together, and quickly, we will have no choice but to take Federal control of the city, and run this city how it should be run, and put criminals on notice that they're not going to get away with it anymore," Trump said in a Truth Social post.
paras.zh: 特朗普在《真相社会》帖子中表示：“如果华盛顿特区不尽快采取行动，我们将别无选择，只能接管这座城市的联邦控制权，并以应有的方式管理这座城市，并让犯罪分子意识到他们将不再逍遥法外。”

paras.en: Following his comments, the administration ordered National Guard members to conduct law enforcement activities in Washington and perform continuous, daily armed patrols. They also have the power to detain people, according to the U.S. Department of Defense.
paras.zh: 在他发表评论后，政府命令国民警卫队成员在华盛顿开展执法活动，并进行持续的日常武装巡逻。据美国国防部称，他们还有权拘留人员。

paras.en: In September 2025, D.C. Attorney General Brian Schwalb filed a lawsuit to challenge the deployment. U.S. District Judge Jia Cobb ruled it unlawful, finding that the president lacked the power to unilaterally deploy D.C. National Guard or out-of-state troops to help with crime control. In December, the federal appeals court paused Cobb's ruling.
paras.zh: 2025 年 9 月，华盛顿特区总检察长布莱恩·施瓦尔布 (Brian Schwalb) 提起诉讼，对这一部署提出质疑。美国地区法官贾·科布裁定该行为非法，认为总统无权单方面部署华盛顿特区国民警卫队或州外军队来帮助控制犯罪。 12月，联邦上诉法院暂停了科布的裁决。

paras.en: In an interview with Medill News Service, Janessa Goldbeck, CEO of the Vet Voice Foundation, said the situation in Washington, D.C., is unique. She added that using the National Guard in the District should not set a precedent for military families across the country.
paras.zh: 兽医之声基金会首席执行官珍妮莎·戈德贝克在接受梅迪尔新闻社采访时表示，华盛顿特区的情况很独特。她补充说，在该地区使用国民警卫队不应为全国各地的军人家庭树立先例。

paras.en: Goldbeck said she had four main concerns when it comes to the deployment of National Guard members in D.C.
paras.zh: 戈德贝克说，当谈到在华盛顿特区部署国民警卫队成员时，她有四个主要担忧。

paras.en: The first is the idea that domestic deployments like these could undermine the public's confidence in the military's non-partisan reputation. Second, National Guard members are not often trained in everyday civilian policing. Third, the deployments take funding from other military and emergency response groups. Lastly, constitutional accountability is at stake.
paras.zh: 第一个想法是，此类国内部署可能会损害公众对军队无党派声誉的信心。其次，国民警卫队成员并不经常接受日常民事警务培训。第三，部署需要其他军事和应急小组的资金。最后，宪法责任受到威胁。

paras.en: She also said the deployments negatively affect the members themselves.
paras.zh: 她还表示，部署对成员本身产生了负面影响。

paras.en: "So, it's really important that we understand that these people are our friends and neighbors," Goldbeck said. "They didn't necessarily volunteer to be policing the streets of Washington, D.C., and these extended domestic deployments really take a toll."
paras.zh: “因此，我们了解这些人是我们的朋友和邻居，这一点非常重要，”戈德贝克说。 “他们不一定自愿在华盛顿特区的街道上维持治安，这些长期的国内部署确实造成了损失。”

paras.en: Beginning with about 800, the number of troops steadily increased and reached its peak in July, when over 5,000 members from states all across the country were deployed in the District.
paras.zh: 从大约 800 人开始，部队数量稳步增加，并在 7 月份达到顶峰，当时有来自全国各州的 5000 多名士兵部署在该地区。

paras.en: The National Guard's presence has had mixed results on improving public safety, according to nonpartisan think tank Niskanen Center. A May analysis found that while the deployment led to a 24% reduction in "opportunistic" crimes, such as vehicle break-ins, the National Guard's presence did not had any measurable effect on violent crimes.
paras.zh: 无党派智库尼斯卡宁中心表示，国民警卫队的存在对改善公共安全产生了好坏参半的结果。 5 月份的一项分析发现，虽然国民警卫队的部署使车辆入室盗窃等“机会主义”犯罪减少了 24%，但国民警卫队的存在并没有对暴力犯罪产生任何可衡量的影响。

paras.en: Free DC, an organization that defends D.C. residents' right to self-governance against federal, congressional and executive interventions, hosted a rally outside the courthouse.
paras.zh: 自由华盛顿组织是一个捍卫华盛顿特区居民自治权、反对联邦、国会和行政部门干预的组织，该组织在法院外举办了一场集会。

paras.en: Protestors chanted "51st state, not a police state," reflecting opposition to the deployment.
paras.zh: 抗议者高呼“第51个州，不是警察国家”，反映了对部署的反对。

paras.en: For now, the National Guard will be allowed to remain in D.C. while the case is pending.
paras.zh: 目前，在案件悬而未决期间，国民警卫队将被允许留在华盛顿。

articles.title: Watchdog asks California bar to probe Katie Zacharia's lawyer claims

paras.en: Oct. 15 (UPI) -- A nonpartisan government watchdog has filed a complaint with the State Bar of California requesting an investigation into newly appointed White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia following reports that she is not licensed to practice law in the state.
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日（UPI）——无党派政府监管机构向加利福尼亚州律师协会提出申诉，要求对新任命的白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚（Katie Zacharia）进行调查，此前有报道称她没有在该州执业的执照。

paras.en: Zacharia, a resident of California who has repeatedly referred to herself as a lawyer, held her first briefing as White House press secretary on Tuesday amid reports that the Pepperdine Caruso School of Law graduate may not have passed the bar in California or in any other state. Asked Tuesday where she passed the bar, she told reporters outside the White House, "When I moved to China."
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚是加利福尼亚州居民，多次自称为律师，周二，她作为白宫新闻秘书举行了第一次简报会，有报道称这位佩珀代因卡鲁索法学院毕业生可能没有通过加利福尼亚州或任何其他州的律师资格。周二，当被问及她在哪里经过酒吧时，她在白宫外告诉记者，“当我搬到中国时。”

paras.en: Campaign for Accountability filed its complaint with the State Bar of California on Wednesday, saying if it is accurate that she is not licensed to practice law in the state, she may be breaking California law by publicly claiming she is entitled to practice law while being unlicensed.
paras.zh: 问责运动周三向加州律师协会提出申诉，称如果她没有在该州执业律师执照的说法属实，那么她公开声称自己有权在无执照的情况下执业，可能违反了加州法律。

paras.en: "Ms. Zacharia has represented herself as a lawyer repeatedly to buttress her reputation and credibility as a television commentator and now as the White House spokesperson, yet it seems it was all a lie," CfA Executive Director Michelle Kuppersmith said in a statement.
paras.zh: CfA 执行董事米歇尔·库珀史密斯 (Michelle Kuppersmith) 在一份声明中表示：“扎卡里亚女士多次以律师身份自称，以巩固她作为电视评论员以及现在作为白宫发言人的声誉和可信度，但这似乎都是谎言。”

paras.en: "In California, calling yourself a lawyer without a license isn't puffery; it's a crime. The State Bar should investigate whether Ms. Zacharia has misled the public about her credentials and hold her accountable if she has."
paras.zh: “在加州，自称没有执照的律师并不是吹嘘；而是犯罪。州律师协会应该调查扎卡里亚女士是否在其资质方面误导了公众，如果有的话，追究她的责任。”

paras.en: Holding oneself as entitled to practice law without being licensed is a misdemeanor offense in California, punishable by up to a year in jail or a fine of up to $1,000, or both.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州，未经许可而擅自从事律师工作属于轻罪，可判处最高一年监禁或最高 1,000 美元罚款，或两者并罚。

paras.en: The watchdog's filing includes several instances of Zacharia calling herself a lawyer and claiming to have worked as one for the World Bank and the International Finance Corporation. She also claims on her LinkedIn profile to have been general counsel for the right-wing Fix California nonprofit organization.
paras.zh: 该监管机构的文件包括扎卡里亚多次自称律师并声称曾在世界银行和国际金融公司工作。她还在 LinkedIn 个人资料中声称自己曾担任右翼非营利组织 Fix California 的总法律顾问。

paras.en: The complaint asks the State Bar of California to investigate whether Zacharia's employment with Fix California constituted the unauthorized practice of law and to refer violations to the Ventura County District Attorney for possible prosecution.
paras.zh: 诉状要求加州律师协会调查 Zacharia 与 Fix California 的雇佣关系是否构成未经授权的执业行为，并将违规行为提交给文图拉县地方检察官，以便可能进行起诉。

paras.en: "The rules against unlicensed lawyering exist to protect the public," Kuppersmith said.
paras.zh: “针对无证律师的规则的存在是为了保护公众，”库珀史密斯说。

paras.en: "To be meaningful, the rules must apply to people with the biggest megaphones, not just to those with no platform."
paras.zh: “为了有意义，这些规则必须适用于拥有最大扩音器的人，而不仅仅是那些没有平台的人。”

paras.en: White House Communications Director Steven Cheung lashed out at CfA over the complaint with insults, calling the nonpartisan group "a radical leftist-organization run by rabid numbskulls suffering from a severe case of Trump Derangement Syndrome."
paras.zh: 白宫通讯主任张史蒂文(Steven Cheung)对CfA的投诉进行了侮辱，称这个无党派组织是“一个由患有严重特朗普精神错乱综合症的疯狂傻瓜经营的激进左翼组织”。

paras.en: "Nobody takes them seriously because they are deranged low lifes," he said on X.
paras.zh: “没有人认真对待他们，因为他们是精神错乱的低等人，”他在 X 上说道。

paras.en: UPI has contacted the California State Bar for comment.
paras.zh: UPI 已联系加州律师协会征求意见。

articles.title: Former Recognition Music CEO Ben Katovsky Leaves Catalog Fund for Top Job at Pipeline
articles.author: Elizabeth Dilts Marshall

paras.en: Ben Katovsky, who previously ran the Blackstone-backed music catalog investment firm Recognition Music Group, was appointed CEO of the advance financing platform Pipeline on Thursday (Oct. 15).
paras.zh: 本·卡托夫斯基 (Ben Katovsky) 曾经营 Blackstone 支持的音乐目录投资公司 Recognition Music Group，周四（10 月 15 日）被任命为预付融资平台 Pipeline 的首席执行官。

paras.en: Founded and chaired by veteran music investor and former Francisco Partners private equity executive Matt Spetzler, Pipeline launched with $200 million in lending capital to independent music companies for artist finances, using the label’s digital royalties as the collateral. As more artists sign short-term distribution deals, which allow them to retain ownership and often the majority of the income their music generates, having enough cash on hand to keep rising stars is a persistent problem for indie companies.
paras.zh: Pipeline 由资深音乐投资者、前 Francisco Partners 私募股权执行官 Matt Spetzler 创立并担任主席，该公司以唱片公司的数字版税作为抵押品，向独立音乐公司提供 2 亿美元的贷款资金，用于艺术家融资。随着越来越多的艺术家签署短期发行协议，这使他们能够保留所有权以及音乐产生的大部分收入，手头有足够的现金来留住后起之秀对独立公司来说是一个持续存在的问题。

paras.en: Pipeline inked a partnership with Merlin and acquired the tech-forward music valuation firm Clarty Partners earlier this year. Now, fresh off the sale of Recognition’s portfolio of 45,000 songs, which included compositions by Neil Young, Shakira, Journey and Red Hot Chili Peppers, Katovsky teams up with Spetzler to bring the pair’s music rights, investment and business-building experience to Pipeline’s partners.
paras.zh: Pipeline 与 Merlin 建立了合作伙伴关系，并于今年早些时候收购了技术领先的音乐评估公司 Clarty Partners。现在，卡托夫斯基刚刚出售了 Recognition 的 45,000 首歌曲组合，其中包括 Neil Young、Shakira、Journey 和 Red Hot Chili Peppers 的作品，卡托夫斯基与 Spetzler 合作，将两人的音乐版权、投资和业务建设经验带给 Pipeline 的合作伙伴。

paras.en: “We started Pipeline because there is enormous value in music IP, and too many of the companies that own it haven’t had the backing to realize their ambitions,” Spetzler said in a statement. “Ben is one of very few people who has built, financed and run a world-class rights business at scale, delivering very strong outcomes for investors while caring for the music and the people behind it.”
paras.zh: 斯佩茨勒在一份声明中表示：“我们创办 Pipeline 是因为音乐 IP 具有巨大的价值，而太多拥有该 IP 的公司却没有获得实现其抱负的支持。” “本是极少数建立、资助和经营大规模世界级版权业务的人之一，他为投资者带来了非常强劲的成果，同时关心音乐及其背后的人。”

paras.en: During Katovsky’s time leading Recognition, it completed a $372 million asset-backed security issuance prior to the sale of its catalog to Sony Music Publishing in July. Before Recognition, Katovsky spent seven years at BMG, where he rose to the role of COO. Originally from South Africa, Katovsky got his start at Counterpoint Systems, developing technology solutions for managing intellectual property.
paras.zh: 在卡托夫斯基领导 Recognition 期间，该公司完成了 3.72 亿美元的资产支持证券发行，随后于 7 月份将其目录出售给索尼音乐出版公司。在获得认可之前，卡托夫斯基在 BMG 工作了七年，并晋升为首席运营官。卡托夫斯基来自南非，他在 Counterpoint Systems 开始了自己的职业生涯，开发管理知识产权的技术解决方案。

paras.en: “I’ve spent my career at the intersection of music, technology and investment, working with some of the most innovative companies in our business,” Katovsky added in a statement. “Pipeline is building a different model for how companies and creators can access capital, giving songwriters, artists, labels and publishers greater flexibility and control over how they grow. Matt and the team have built something impressive and I’m excited to be joining them to empower the music and wider creative industries.”
paras.zh: 卡托夫斯基在一份声明中补充道：“我的职业生涯一直在音乐、技术和投资的交叉领域度过，与我们行业中一些最具创新性的公司合作。” “Pipeline 正在为公司和创作者获取资金的方式构建一个不同的模式，为词曲作者、艺术家、唱片公司和发行商提供更大的灵活性，并更好地控制他们的发展方式。Matt 和他的团队已经创造了一些令人印象深刻的东西，我很高兴能加入他们，为音乐和更广泛的创意产业赋能。”

articles.title: Sienna Spiro to Perform at 2026 ARIA Awards
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Sienna Spiro is the first major international star announced for next month’s 2026 ARIA Awards.
paras.zh: 西耶娜·斯皮罗 (Sienna Spiro) 是第一位宣布参加下个月 2026 年 ARIA 颁奖典礼的国际大明星。

paras.en: The British pop artist will make her ARIAs debut when she performs on stage at Sydney’s Hordern Pavilion, just weeks after the release of her debut album Visitor.
paras.zh: 这位英国流行歌手将在悉尼 Hordern Pavilion 的舞台上首次亮相 ARIA，距离她的首张专辑 Visitor 发行仅几周后。

paras.en: When she graces the stage, the singer and songwriter will add herself to the lineup of international stars who’ve performed at the Australian recording industry’s flagship awards, a list that includes Alicia Keys, Ava Max, Billie Eilish, Dua Lipa, Ed Sheeran, Halsey, Kane Brown, Khalid, Lorde, One Direction, Robbie Williams, Sam Smith, Taylor Swift and Olivia Dean, who has been a force on the ARIA Charts ever since her performance at the 2025 edition.
paras.zh: 当她登上舞台时，这位歌手兼词曲作者将加入到曾在澳大利亚唱片业旗舰奖项上表演的国际巨星阵容中，其中包括艾丽西亚·凯斯 (Alicia Keys)、艾娃·麦克斯 (Ava Max)、比莉·艾利什 (Billie Eilish)、杜阿·利帕 (Dua Lipa)、艾德·希兰 (Ed Sheeran)、哈尔西 (Halsey)、凯恩·布朗 (Kane Brown)、哈立德 (Halsey)、洛德 (Lorde)、One Direction、罗比·威廉姆斯 (Robbie Williams)、萨姆·史密斯 (Sam Smith)、泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 和奥利维亚·迪恩 (Olivia Dean)，后者自在澳大利亚唱片业大奖颁奖典礼上表演以来一直是 ARIA 排行榜上的一股力量。 2025 年版。

paras.en: Aged just 21, the Londoner has already accumulated more than 33 million monthly listeners on Spotify, headline sponsor of the ARIAs, and 2 billion streams in total; bagged three simultaneous Billboard Hot 100 singles; and six entries on the ARIA Singles Chart. “Die On This Hill” is certified platinum by ARIA, while “You Stole The Show,” “MAYBE,” “Material Lover” and “The Visitor” are all certified Gold in these parts.
paras.zh: 这位伦敦人年仅 21 岁，在 ARIA 的主要赞助商 Spotify 上每月已积累了超过 3300 万听众，总播放量达 20 亿次；三首同时入围 Billboard Hot 100 单曲；以及 ARIA 单曲榜上的六首歌曲。 《Die On This Hill》被 ARIA 认证为白金唱片，而《You Stole The Show》、《MAYBE》、《Material Lover》和《The Visitor》在这些部分均被认证为金唱片。

paras.en: In her homeland, Spiro has six top 40 hits including a No. 1 with “Great Expectation,” which she performed last month at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards in Los Angeles — earning a standing ovation in the process. She also collected the Moonman for best new artist. Visitor peaked at No. 2 on the Official U.K. Albums Chart.
paras.zh: 在她的祖国，斯皮罗有六首进入前 40 名的热门歌曲，其中包括排名第一的《远大前程》，她上个月在洛杉矶举行的 2026 年 MTV 音乐录影带颁奖典礼上表演了这首歌曲，并在此过程中赢得了全场起立鼓掌。她还收集了《月亮人》最佳新人奖。 《Visitor》在英国官方专辑排行榜上名列第二。

paras.en: Spiro’s trip to the ARIAs will mark her second trip to Australia following an intimate fan event last year at Pleasure Club in Newtown, Sydney. She’ll return in January 2027 for her eight-date My House Tour of Australia and New Zealand, which includes two nights at the Hordern. The trek sold out in a matter of hours, according to promoter Frontier Touring.
paras.zh: 继去年在悉尼纽敦 Pleasure Club 举办了一场亲密的粉丝活动后，斯皮罗的 ARIA 之行将是她第二次前往澳大利亚。她将于 2027 年 1 月回归，参加澳大利亚和新西兰的八场 My House 之旅，其中包括在 Hordern 住两晚。据发起人 Frontier Touring 称，这次旅行在几个小时内就卖完了。

paras.en: “So excited and honored to be performing at the 2026 ARIA Awards,” Spiro says in a statement. “I love Australia and can’t wait to be back!”
paras.zh: “能够在 2026 年 ARIA 颁奖典礼上表演，我感到非常兴奋和荣幸，”斯皮罗在一份声明中说道。 “我爱澳大利亚，迫不及待地想回来！”

paras.en: With eight nominations each, Tame Impala and Genesis Owusu head the pack for the 40th annual ARIA Awards, while Ecca Vandal is close behind with seven chances. All told, 29 artist categories will be announced on the night.
paras.zh: Tame Impala 和 Genesis Owusu 分别获得 8 项提名，在第 40 届年度 ARIA 奖中遥遥领先，而 Ecca Vandal 则以 7 次提名紧随其后。总而言之，当晚将公布 29 个艺术家类别。

paras.en: The 2026 ARIA Awards is supported by Destination NSW, in partnership with Spotify, and will be live on Paramount+ and broadcast on 10. Performances and moments will also be available on the @ARIA.official YouTube channel.
paras.zh: 2026 年 ARIA 颁奖典礼由新南威尔士州旅游局与 Spotify 合作支持，将在 Paramount+ 上现场直播并于 10 日播出。表演和精彩时刻也将在@ARIA.official YouTube 频道上播出。

articles.title: Rauw Alejandro and Camilo’s ‘Tattoo (Remix)’ Enters YouTube’s Billion Views Club
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Rauw Alejandro and Camilo make it permanent with “Tattoo (Remix),” which gains entry into YouTube’s Billion Views Club.
paras.zh: Rauw Alejandro和Camilo凭借“Tattoo (Remix)”永久登陆YouTube的Billion Views Club。

paras.en: Six years after its release, the official video for the reggaeton hit is both Alejandro and Camilo’s third to reach the one billion view milestone as a lead, featured artist or collaborator.
paras.zh: 发布六年后，这首热门雷鬼音乐的官方视频是亚历杭德罗和卡米洛作为主要、特色艺术家或合作者第三次达到 10 亿观看次数里程碑。

paras.en: Puerto Rican star Alejandro inked us back in February 2020 with “Tattoo,” produced by Los Honeyboos (Rafa Rodríguez, Daniel Rondon) and Mr. Nais Gai.
paras.zh: 2020 年 2 月，波多黎各明星亚历杭德罗 (Alejandro) 凭借由 Los Honeyboos（拉法·罗德里格斯 (Rafa Rodríguez)、丹尼尔·朗登 (Daniel Rondon) 饰）和奈斯·盖 (Nais Gai) 制作的《Tattoo》给我们留下了深刻的印象。

paras.en: By July of the same year, the reimagined, pop-tinged version rolled out on YouTube featuring Camilo, the Colombian singer and songwriter.
paras.zh: 同年 7 月，由哥伦比亚歌手兼词曲作者卡米洛 (Camilo) 主演的重新演绎、带有流行色彩的版本在 YouTube 上推出。

paras.en: “Tattoo (Remix)” (via Sony Music Entertainment US Latin LLC/Duars Entertainment, Inc) marked the very first collaboration between the rising Latin artists, powered by a visual which depicts the pair having a big day out with friends on Miami Beach.
paras.zh: “Tattoo (Remix)”（来自 Sony Music Entertainment US Latin LLC/Duars Entertainment, Inc）标志着新兴拉丁艺术家之间的首次合作，其视觉效果描绘了两人在迈阿密海滩与朋友外出度过了重要的一天。

paras.en: Fans clamored to it and the song enjoyed new wings as a TikTok challenge, with the hashtag #TattooChallenge. The viral trend saw “Tattoo (Remix)” surge to the very top of the Latin Airplay and Latin Rhythm Airplay charts.
paras.zh: 粉丝们对这首歌大喊大叫，这首歌作为 TikTok 挑战获得了新的翅膀，并带有标签#TattooChallenge。这一病毒式传播趋势使“Tattoo (Remix)”飙升至拉丁音乐播放和拉丁节奏播放排行榜的榜首。

paras.en: “Tattoo (Remix)” was also produced and composed by Los Honeyboos and Mr. Nais Gai and composed by Alejandro, Camilo, Elena Rose, José M. Collazo, Eric Pérez Rovira, Eliel Lind Osorio, Aneudy Maysonet and Evaluna Montaner.
paras.zh: 《Tattoo (Remix)》也由 Los Honeyboos 和 Nais Gai 先生制作和作曲，由 Alejandro、Camilo、Elena Rose、José M. Collazo、Eric Pérez Rovira、Eliel Lind Osorio、Aneudy Maysonet 和 Evaluna Montaner 作曲。

paras.en: Across his career, Alejandro has soaked up 13 Billboard Hot 100 hits, and an impressive 88 titles on Billboard’s Hot Latin Songs chart. “Tattoo” is one of 17 top 10 appearances on the latter tally, peaking at No. 7. Camilo has made 21 appearances on Hot Latin Songs, including two top 10s.
paras.zh: 在他的整个职业生涯中，Alejandro 共获得 13 首 Billboard Hot 100 热门单曲，并在 Billboard 热门拉丁歌曲排行榜上获得 88 首歌曲，令人印象深刻。 《Tattoo》是后者排行榜前 10 名的 17 首歌曲之一，最高排名第 7。卡米洛曾 21 次出现在热门拉丁歌曲中，其中两次进入前 10 名。

paras.en: Alejandro’s career hasn’t slowed any. Just last month, he played multiple dates at Forest Hills Stadium in Queens, for Red Bull Chapters, a three-act performance that traced his roots and the musical influences that shaped him.
paras.zh: 亚历杭德罗的职业生涯并没有放缓。就在上个月，他在皇后区森林山体育场为红牛章节进行了多次演出，这是一场三幕表演，追溯了他的根源和塑造他的音乐影响。

paras.en: Gustavo Camacho directed the official music video for “Tattoo (Remix),” which can be seen in full below.
paras.zh: 古斯塔沃·卡马乔执导了“Tattoo (Remix)”的官方音乐视频，完整内容如下。

articles.title: R.J. Mitte Remembered by ‘Breaking Bad’ Casting Director Sharon Bialy
articles.author: Scott Feinberg

paras.en: Sharon Bialy of Bialy/Thomas & Associates is a revered, Emmy-nominated casting director who is perhaps best known for Breaking Bad, but has also cast many other high-profile projects including The Walking Dead, The Handmaid’s Tale, Barry, Dead to Me and Pluribus. Below, she pays tribute to the actor R.J. Mitte, who died on Oct. 12 at the age of 34.
paras.zh: Bialy/Thomas & Associates 的 Sharon Bialy 是一位备受尊敬的艾美奖提名选角导演，她最出名的作品可能是《绝命毒师》，但也曾为许多其他备受瞩目的项目选角，包括《行尸走肉》、《使女的故事》、《巴里》、《死而复生》和《Pluribus》。下面，她向演员 R.J. 致敬。米特于 10 月 12 日去世，享年 34 岁。

paras.en: The first time I met R.J. Mitte was when he came in to audition for the role of Walt Jr. on Breaking Bad.
paras.zh: 我第一次见到 R.J.米特参加《绝命毒师》中小沃尔特一角的试镜时正是这个时候。

paras.en: Vince Gilligan wrote the character as having cerebral palsy because he’d had a college roommate with that affliction and wanted to pay tribute to him. My partner, Sherry Thomas, and I, and Vince and his producers, Melissa Bernstein and Mark Johnson, were very firm on only casting the part with somebody who had CP.
paras.zh: 文斯·吉利根将这个角色写成患有脑瘫，因为他的一位大学室友患有这种疾病，并想向他致敬。我和我的搭档雪莉·托马斯、文斯以及他的制片人梅丽莎·伯恩斯坦和马克·约翰逊都非常坚定地只选择有 CP 的人来选角。

paras.en: We had never done a search for an actor with cerebral palsy, and we knew we had to search the entire country. We couldn’t just do the standard posting, because we wanted to explain what we were trying to accomplish with the part and the show — that a husband and wife had a son who had cerebral palsy, but it wasn’t really talked about. We reached out to cerebral palsy organizations all across the country, as well as local schools and nonprofits that supported disabilities.
paras.zh: 我们从未寻找过患有脑瘫的演员，而且我们知道我们必须寻找整个国家。我们不能只做标准的发布，因为我们想解释我们试图通过这个角色和节目来完成什么——一对丈夫和妻子有一个患有脑瘫的儿子，但这并没有真正被谈论。我们联系了全国各地的脑瘫组织以及当地学校和支持残疾人的非营利组织。

paras.en: I’ve kept notes on my sessions with the actors I have auditioned for every job I’ve ever done, and I just found my notes for Breaking Bad. It was Feb. 23, 2007 when R.J. came in to audition. He was 14 at the time, so he came with his mother. He was repped by a small agency at the time. He might have done a commercial audition or two, but he was very green, so we spent a lot of time together working on the scene, because he hadn’t had an opportunity for a role this big.
paras.zh: 我对我做过的每一份工作试镜的演员都做了笔记，我刚刚找到了《绝命毒师》的笔记。那是 2007 年 2 月 23 日，R.J.来试镜。当时他14岁，所以他和母亲一起来。当时他被一家小机构代理。他可能参加过一两次商业试镜，但他还很年轻，所以我们花了很多时间一起在现场工作，因为他没有机会扮演这么大的角色。

paras.en: It didn’t matter that he’d never done anything before, because he was so joyful and happy to be there. He was completely open to playing with the scene, and after the audition he was willing to talk about the struggles he’d gone through as someone dealing with cerebral palsy. He’d had years of physical therapy in order to be able to walk without crutches, and years of speech therapy in order to be able to be understood. We filled Vince in on his personal history.
paras.zh: 他以前从未做过任何事并不重要，因为他很高兴能在那里。他完全愿意参与这个场景，试镜后他愿意谈论他作为脑瘫患者所经历的挣扎。他接受了多年的物理治疗，以便能够不用拐杖行走，也接受了多年的言语治疗，以便能够被理解。我们向文斯讲述了他的个人经历。

paras.en: We ended up seeing approximately 20 actors before narrowing it down to two. We flew both R.J. and the other actor out to New Mexico because Vince was already there in pre-production, so they both read with Bryan Cranston and Anna Gunn. After that, there was quite a bit of discussion, because it wasn’t a matter of one actor being better than the other — they were quite different from each other, and there were a lot of things taken into consideration.
paras.zh: 我们最终见到了大约 20 名演员，然后将范围缩小到两名。我们乘坐 R.J.和另一位演员去了新墨西哥州，因为文斯已经在那里进行前期制作，所以他们都和布莱恩·科兰斯顿和安娜·古恩一起阅读。之后就有了很多讨论，因为这不是一个演员比另一个演员好的问题，他们彼此之间有很大的不同，需要考虑到很多东西。

paras.en: I felt strongly about R.J. for a variety of reasons. One plus was that he was so good-looking. I remember saying to Vince, “How great would it be if he was on the cover of Teen Beat magazine, a young actor with cerebral palsy?” The other actor may have been a little harder to understand. Vince’s writing was so beautiful, and we wanted to make sure that the audience would be able to hear all the dialogue. Eventually, Vince told R.J. directly that the part was his. But we also called R.J. and his mom to celebrate.
paras.zh: 我对 R.J. 有强烈的感觉。由于各种原因。一个优点是他长得非常好看。我记得对文斯说：“如果他是一位患有脑瘫的年轻演员，登上《Teen Beat》杂志的封面该多好啊？”另一位演员可能有点难以理解。文斯的写作非常优美，我们希望确保观众能够听到所有对话。最终，文斯告诉 R.J.直接说这个角色是他的。但我们也打电话给 R.J.和他的妈妈一起庆祝。

paras.en: Over the years, we stayed in touch with R.J. as best we could. Because Breaking Bad was shot on location in New Mexico, we didn’t spend much time on set; I would see him when we went to New Mexico, but most of our interactions were at Emmys parties and things like that. And during one hiatus from the show, we also cast him in a guest spot on the TV show Vegas. It was incredibly meaningful when, in 2011, Sherry and I were honored with the Media Access Award for fostering opportunities for actors with disabilities, and R.J. presented it to us.
paras.zh: 多年来，我们与 R.J. 保持着联系。尽我们所能。因为《绝命毒师》是在新墨西哥州拍摄的，所以我们没有在片场花费太多时间；当我们去新墨西哥州时，我会见到他，但我们的大部分互动都是在艾美奖派对之类的场合。在节目间歇期，我们还让他客串了电视节目《维加斯》。 2011 年，我和 Sherry 因为残疾演员提供了机会而荣获媒体访问奖，而 R.J.向我们展示了它。

paras.en: We didn’t get to spend as much time with him as the rest of the Breaking Bad family, who are just gutted, but we spent enough time with him to get to know and love him. The fact that he took his own life came as a big surprise to most of us. But given how hard life is today for all actors, I can only imagine how much harder it must have been for an actor with a disability, especially one who went from being a series regular on an amazing show with amazing people, to then having to go back out there and fight tooth and nail again just to be able to do what you love.
paras.zh: 我们没有像绝命毒师家族的其他成员那样花那么多时间和他在一起，他们只是被毁了，但我们花了足够的时间和他在一起来了解和爱他。他自杀的事实让我们大多数人感到非常惊讶。但考虑到今天所有演员的生活有多么艰难，我只能想象对于一个残疾演员来说，这一定是多么困难，尤其是一个从成为一部与出色的人在一起的精彩节目中的常规演员，到后来不得不回到那里，再次拼命奋斗才能做自己喜欢的事情的演员。

paras.en: When people think of R.J., I hope they will remember how talented he was, how he overcame so many struggles, how he approached everything with joy and fearlessness, and how he advocated for other people with disabilities to be considered for roles of all sorts. I know that I will remember all of that, and his million-megawatt smile.
paras.zh: 当人们想到 R.J. 时，我希望他们会记住他是多么有才华，他如何克服如此多的困难，他如何以快乐和无畏的态度对待一切，以及他如何倡导让其他残疾人被考虑担任各种角色。我知道我会记住这一切，还有他那百万兆瓦的微笑。

paras.en: If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, help is available. Call or text 988.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人正在挣扎或陷入危机，可以寻求帮助。致电或发短信988。

articles.title: Christy Carlson Romano Says She Was Paid Half of Shia LaBeouf’s Salary on ‘Even Stevens’
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Christy Carlson Romano is getting candid about the pay disparities on Disney‘s Even Stevens.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂·卡尔森·罗马诺 (Christy Carlson Romano) 坦诚地谈论了迪士尼《埃文·史蒂文斯》(Even Stevens) 中的薪酬差距。

paras.en: The actress, who played Ren Stevens, the older sister to Shia LaBeouf‘s Louis Stevens on the family sitcom, opened up about her past as a child star in her new memoir, Once Upon a Trainwreck: The Fall and Rise of a Child Star.
paras.zh: 这位女演员在家庭情景喜剧中扮演希亚·拉博夫扮演的路易斯·史蒂文斯的姐姐伦·史蒂文斯，她在她的新回忆录《火车失事往事：童星的陨落与崛起》中讲述了自己作为童星的过去。

paras.en: A few days after its Oct. 6 release, Romano took to Instagram to offer a peek at one of the stories featured in the book, specifically about getting paid half of what her male costar, LaBeouf, made on Even Stevens, which ran for three seasons from 2000 to 2003.
paras.zh: 该书于 10 月 6 日发行几天后，罗马诺在 Instagram 上浏览了书中的一个故事，特别是关于她的男搭档拉博夫在《Even Stevens》中获得一半报酬的故事，该剧从 2000 年到 2003 年播出了三季。

paras.en: “I was a kid and the female lead on Even Stevens. I was paid half of what Shia was paid; we were co-leads and had the same screen time. While writing my memoir, I dug through thousands of old photos and letters and found this,” she wrote. Romano also shared a throwback photo of her, LaBeouf and her mom, Sharon, in addition to a letter her mom sent to her agent in 2000.
paras.zh: “我还是个孩子，是《Even Stevens》中的女主角。我的片酬是 Shia 片酬的一半；我们是联合主演，有相同的放映时间。在写回忆录时，我翻阅了数千张旧照片和信件，发现了这一点，”她写道。罗马诺还分享了一张她、拉博夫和她妈妈莎伦的怀旧照片，以及她妈妈在 2000 年写给她经纪人的一封信。

paras.en: “My mom wrote it to my agent in 2000, asking for equal pay and admitting we were deep in debt,” the Kim Possible star continued. “By then, my paycheck was keeping us afloat. My mom was fighting for me, and she was also fighting for a household that depended on a teenage girl. It took me years to understand I could love her for advocating for me and still wish I had gotten to just be a kid. Shia earned every dollar, and this book is not about him or any other famous name you might recognize. They were part of my story. They were never the story. The story is a girl who grew up too fast, and a business that decided she was worth half. If you grew up taking care of the people who were supposed to take care of you, I wrote this book for you.”
paras.zh: “我妈妈在 2000 年写给我的经纪人，要求同工同酬，并承认我们负债累累，”这位《金可能》明星继续说道。 “那时，我的薪水让我们维持生计。我妈妈在为我奋斗，她也在为一个依赖一个十几岁女孩的家庭而奋斗。我花了好几年才明白，我可以爱她为我辩护，但仍然希望自己只是个孩子。什叶派赚了每一美元，这本书不是关于他或你可能认识的任何其他名人。他们是我故事的一部分。他们从来都不是故事。故事是一个成长得太快的女孩，一个企业这决定了她的价值是一半。如果你是在照顾那些应该照顾你的人的过程中长大的，那么我就为你写了这本书。”

paras.en: In Once Upon a Trainwreck, Romano “reveals what childhood fame cost her, the fantasies she had to unlearn and the ongoing story of finding her way back to herself,” according to the book’s description.
paras.zh: 根据书中的描述，罗马诺在《火车失事往事》中“揭示了她童年的名声所付出的代价、她必须放弃的幻想以及寻找回归自我的持续故事”。

paras.en: Even Stevens also starred Tom Virtue, Donna Pescow, A.J. Trauth and Nick Spano. The show centered on the sibling rivalry and clashing personalities of the two younger Stevens children, Ren and Louis, living in suburban Sacramento, California.
paras.zh: 就连史蒂文斯也出演过 Tom Virtue、Donna Pescow、A.J.特劳斯和尼克·斯帕诺。该剧以生活在加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托郊区的史蒂文斯的两个孩子伦（Ren）和路易斯（Louis）的兄弟姐妹竞争和个性冲突为中心。

articles.title: ‘The Lowdown’ Brings a New Case and New Problems for Ethan Hawke’s Lee in Season 2 Premiere
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: [This story contains spoilers for the first two episodes of The Lowdown season two on FX and Hulu.]
paras.zh: [本故事包含 FX 和 Hulu 播出的《内幕》第二季前两集的剧透。]

paras.en: Lee Raybon doesn’t need much help complicating his own life, but two characters who arrive in the season premiere of The Lowdown promise to make things considerably messier for the Tulsa “truthstorian.”
paras.zh: 李·雷邦并不需要太多帮助来使自己的生活复杂化，但在《内幕真相》季首首映式中出现的两个角色肯定会让这位塔尔萨“真相故事家”的事情变得更加混乱。

paras.en: Case in point on Lee not leaving well enough alone: Accepting a journalism award for the big exposé at the center of season one’s story, a nervous Lee (Ethan Hawke) takes a mushroom gummy and proceeds to go off the rails with a speech that basically calls everyone else in the room a sellout and a loser. It earns him a punch in the face (some things don’t change) from another reporter, but also the attention of public defender Ginger (Betty Gilpin), who puts Lee on the scent of what’s going to become the central mystery of this season.
paras.zh: 李的表现不够好：在接受新闻奖时，紧张的李（伊桑·霍克饰）拿着蘑菇软糖，发表了一篇演讲，基本上称房间里的其他人都是出卖者和失败者。这让李被另一位记者打了一拳（有些事情并没有改变），但也引起了公设辩护人金杰（贝蒂·吉尔平饰）的注意，他让李嗅到了将成为本季核心谜团的秘密。

paras.en: At the same time, and unbeknownst to Lee, his estranged father, Lee Sr. (Tommy Lee Jones), is headed his way. A police officer picks up Senior on a country road, where he’s wandering and seemingly confused, wearing in an ill-fitting suit and red baseball cap — though not that kind of red cap. It has “Pslams 107:29” on the front. The verse reads “He calms the storm, so that its waves are still” in the New King James version of the Bible.
paras.zh: 与此同时，李不知道的是，他疏远的父亲老李（汤米·李·琼斯饰）正朝他走来。一名警察在一条乡间小路上接走了高级，他穿着不合身的西装，戴着红色棒球帽，正在徘徊，看上去很困惑——尽管不是那种红色的帽子。正面有“诗篇 107:29”。在新钦定本圣经中，这节经文写道：“他平息风暴，使波涛平静”。

paras.en: “Seemingly confused” is a key qualifier here, because over the course of The Lowdown’s two-episode opener Wednesday on FX and Hulu, Senior slowly reveals himself to be more aware than he lets on at first. Even when the cop picks him up, Hawke and Jones told The Hollywood Reporter in an interview, he’s not necessarily as addled as he appears to be.
paras.zh: “看似困惑”是这里的一个关键限定词，因为在周三 FX 和 Hulu 播出的两集《The Lowdown》首播中，Senior 慢慢地透露出自己比一开始表现出来的更加清醒。霍克和琼斯在接受《好莱坞报道》采访时表示，即使警察来接他，他也不一定像看上去那么糊涂。

paras.en: “He’s hustling,” Hawke said with a laugh.
paras.zh: “他很忙碌，”霍克笑着说。

paras.en: “Yeah, he’s trying to get a free ride into town,” Jones added. “And what better way than to pretend you don’t know the date? He gets a ride precisely to his destination, which is his son’s doorstep.”
paras.zh: “是的，他想搭便车进城，”琼斯补充道。 “还有什么比假装不知道日期更好的方法呢？他乘车准确地到达了目的地，那就是他儿子的家门口。”

paras.en: Lee is adamant that his dad clear out as soon as possible, but Senior — thanks to having read about Lee’s award — knows he has a granddaughter, and he extracts some more information from Waylon (Cody Lightning), Henry (Jude Barnett) and record store owner Abel (Josh Fadem). The last we see of Senior in Wednesday’s episodes is him introducing himself to Francis (Ryan Kiera Armstrong). It’s not really a spoiler to say that act will lead to a lot of friction between father and daughter, who are already in a less-than-great place after Francis witnesses part of Lee’s award speech and walks out.
paras.zh: 李坚决要求他的父亲尽快离开，但高级——由于读到了李获奖的消息——知道他有一个孙女，他从韦伦（科迪·闪电饰）、亨利（裘德·巴内特饰）和唱片店老板阿贝尔（乔什·法德姆饰）那里获取了更多信息。我们在周三的剧集中最后一次看到高级的是他向弗朗西斯（瑞恩·基拉·阿姆斯特朗饰）介绍自己。说这一行为会导致父女之间产生很多摩擦，这并不是剧透，在弗朗西斯目睹了李的部分获奖感言并离开后，父女俩的处境已经不太好。

paras.en: Much more willingly, Lee entangles himself with Ginger, who informs him at the awards ceremony that she thinks two men are following her. Lee confirms it, and as a ruse to make the stalkers think they’re together, Ginger kisses Lee before getting in her ride home. Lee, of course, badly misreads the gesture and shows up at her office the next day, where Ginger is (understandably) a little jittery and unsure of what to do. She eventually tells him that a former client of hers, Mekko Dean, whom she still talks to, has seemingly gone missing from prison.
paras.zh: 李更愿意与金杰纠缠在一起，金杰在颁奖典礼上告诉他，她认为有两个男人在跟踪她。李证实了这一点，为了让跟踪者认为他们在一起，金杰在上车回家之前亲吻了李。当然，李严重误读了这个手势，第二天就出现在她的办公室，金杰（可以理解）有点紧张，不知道该怎么做。她最终告诉他，她的前客户梅科·迪恩（Mekko Dean）似乎在监狱里失踪了，她仍在与他交谈。

paras.en: Gilpin’s performance of Ginger’s nerves and her uncertainty about Lee — she correctly reads that he’s probably trouble, but Lee is also quite charismatic — is something to behold.
paras.zh: 吉尔平对金杰的紧张情绪和她对李的不确定性的表现——她正确地理解了他可能是个麻烦，但李也很有魅力——值得一看。

paras.en: “If you were to ask Ginger, ‘What would a show about your life be?,’ I think it would be all the opposite moments that you’re seeing,” Gilpin told THR. “I think she’d be like, ‘Oh, film me in the courtroom with my clients. Don’t show my house or my fridge or my love life.’ I think it’s sort of controlled mess for her, and The Lowdown is interested in lifting up the carpet and seeing what’s underneath every everyone’s mess.”
paras.zh: 吉尔平告诉《好莱坞报道》：“如果你问金杰，‘关于你生活的节目会是什么样？’我想你看到的将会是完全相反的时刻。” “我想她会说，‘哦，在法庭上拍摄我和我的客户。不要展示我的房子、我的冰箱或我的爱情生活。’我认为这对她来说是一种受控的混乱，而《内幕》感兴趣的是揭开地毯，看看每个人的混乱之下到底是什么。”

paras.en: Her nervousness is justified: One of the men following her comes to her house at the end of episode one, and she shoots him (off camera) through her window.
