By the end of episode two, Lee has dived headlong into the case: He discovers one of Ginger’s followers is a prison guard named McMann (Shane McRae) and befriends a recently fired guard, Chili (Paul Schneider, playing a very different kind of guy than he did on Parks and Recreation), in an effort to get information on Mekko.
paras.zh: 她的紧张是有道理的：在第一集结束时，跟踪她的一名男子来到她家，她通过窗户向他（镜头外）射击。在第二集结束时，李一头扎进了这个案件：他发现金杰的追随者之一是一名名叫麦克曼（肖恩·麦克雷饰）的狱警，并与最近被解雇的狱警辣椒（保罗·施奈德，饰演与他在《公园与休闲》中扮演的角色截然不同的人）成为朋友，试图获取有关梅科的信息。

paras.en: After an extended set of scenes between Lee and Chili that alternates between pathetic and unbearably tense, Chili claims he’s going to steal a few beers from a buddy’s house — then drives Lee to McMann’s. Lee manages to run away, but not before witnessing Chili’s murder by McMann.
paras.zh: 在李和辣椒之间发生了一系列时而可怜又令人难以忍受的紧张场面后，辣椒声称他要从一个朋友的家里偷几瓶啤酒，然后开车送李去麦克曼家。李设法逃跑，但在目睹了麦克曼谋杀辣椒之前。

paras.en: Despite the very noir-ish events described above, The Lowdown is also downright funny in the first two episodes of season two. Series creator Sterlin Harjo directed both episodes and wrote the premiere (Sneha Koorse penned episode two), and he told THR that he and his fellow writers are always looking for comedy within the show.
paras.zh: 尽管上面描述了非常黑色的事件，但《内幕》在第二季的前两集中也非常有趣。该剧主创斯特林·哈霍 (Sterlin Harjo) 执导了这两集并编写了首映式（第二集由斯内哈·库尔斯 (Sneha Koorse) 撰写），他告诉《好莱坞报道》，他和他的编剧同事们一直在寻找剧中的喜剧元素。

paras.en: “I think that if this feels funnier, it’s because I had more room,” Harjo told THR. “I was building a world in season one, and in this one, people already know the world, so I could really just hit the ground running, and that gave me the confidence to really go for it. I didn’t have to explain who Lee was or what he was doing. … I could really just lean into his life as we enter this moment. And I’m always looking for humor. I couldn’t do something that was not somewhat humorous, I don’t think.”
paras.zh: “我认为如果这感觉更有趣，那是因为我有更多的空间，”哈乔告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “我在第一季中构建了一个世界，而在这一季中，人们已经了解了这个世界，所以我真的可以立即开始工作，这给了我真正去做的信心。我不需要解释李是谁或他在做什么。……当我们进入这一刻时，我真的可以深入了解他的生活。而且我一直在寻找幽默。我认为我不能做一些不幽默的事情。”

articles.title: Oil falls as investors assess Mideast tensions, International Energy Agency's report

paras.en: Oil fell Thursday as traders assessed potential supply disruptions following attacks on ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz, while digesting the International Energy Agency's latest monthly report on the outlook of the oil market.
paras.zh: 周四油价下跌，交易员评估了穿越霍尔木兹海峡的船只遭受袭击后可能造成的供应中断，同时消化了国际能源署关于石油市场前景的最新月度报告。

paras.en: Futures for international benchmark Brent crude for December delivery dropped 1.66% to $104.31 a barrel. U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures for November fell 1.09% to $94.05 per barrel.
paras.zh: 12 月交割的国际基准布伦特原油期货下跌 1.66%，至每桶 104.31 美元。 11 月份美国西德克萨斯中质原油期货下跌 1.09%，至每桶 94.05 美元。

paras.en: A Singapore registered ship was sunk in the critical Strait of Hormuz, which raised worries of a prolonged Mideast conflict. "Such attacks are unprovoked, unjustifiable and a breach of international law," the Singapore maritime authority said in a statement Wednesday.
paras.zh: 一艘新加坡注册的船只在关键的霍尔木兹海峡沉没，引发了人们对中东长期冲突的担忧。新加坡海事管理局周三在一份声明中表示：“此类袭击是无端、无理的，违反了国际法。”

paras.en: Iran, meanwhile, has said it is "counting the moments" until it can start striking U.S. warships.
paras.zh: 与此同时，伊朗表示正在“计算时机”，直到可以开始攻击美国军舰。

paras.en: The International Energy Agency in its oil report for October out Wednesday cautioned that constraints on diesel markets could continue well into the next year, with fresh attacks on Saudi Arabia threatening to derail a recovery in oil supply.
paras.zh: 国际能源署在周三发布的 10 月份石油报告中警告称，对柴油市场的限制可能会持续到明年，而对沙特阿拉伯的新袭击可能会破坏石油供应的复苏。

paras.en: To help ease prices, the Trump administration is considering to ease sanctions on "shadow fleet" vessels which transports oil and petroleum products from countries such as Russia, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，为了帮助缓解价格，特朗普政府正在考虑放松对从俄罗斯等国家运输石油和石油产品的“影子舰队”船只的制裁。

paras.en: The lack of progress between U.S.-Iran diplomatic track "leaves little immediate prospect of a full reopening of the waterway," said Firas Bechwaty, head of business development at online trading platform ICM late Wednesday.
paras.zh: 在线交易平台 ICM 业务开发主管 Firas Bechwaty 周三晚间表示，美国与伊朗之间的外交轨道缺乏进展，“短期内全面重新开放水路的前景微乎其微”。

paras.en: "At the same time, Saudi crude continues to reach international buyers through alternative routes, while accelerated emergency stock releases by IEA members provide an additional buffer, preventing a sharp rise in prices, even as tensions remain elevated," Bechwaty noted.
paras.zh: 贝奇瓦蒂指出：“与此同时，沙特原油继续通过其他途径到达国际买家，而国际能源署成员国加速紧急释放库存提供了额外的缓冲，即使紧张局势仍然加剧，也能防止价格大幅上涨。”

articles.title: Elon Musk says Trump is 'ultimately' responsible for any curbs on Ukraine's Starshield systems

paras.en: SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk said Wednesday that the U.S. government and President Donald Trump was responsible for any curbs on Ukraine's military-grade Starlink network.
paras.zh: SpaceX 创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克周三表示，美国政府和总统唐纳德·特朗普应对乌克兰军用级星链网络的任何限制负责。

paras.en: Writing on X, Musk said that "Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the U.S. government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS."
paras.zh: 马斯克在 X 上写道，“星盾系统由美国政府拥有和控制。对速度或使用的任何限制均由美国军方决定，最终由美国总统决定。”

paras.en: Ukraine had accused SpaceX of imposing new restrictions on the Starshield internet service without warning, leading to disruptions to Ukrainian military operations amid fresh Russian strikes on its energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 乌克兰指责 SpaceX 在没有警告的情况下对 Starshield 互联网服务实施新的限制，导致乌克兰的军事行动在俄罗斯对其能源基础设施发动新一轮袭击的情况下受到干扰。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Serhii Beskrestnov, an advisor to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on defense technology, said SpaceX had implemented a speed limit on Starlink terminals in motion, without notifying the country's defense forces.
paras.zh: 周三，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 国防技术顾问谢尔希·别斯克雷斯诺夫 (Serhii Beskrestnov) 表示，SpaceX 在未通知乌克兰国防军的情况下，对运行中的星链终端实施了速度限制。

paras.en: That had disrupted some missions, and the same restrictions also applied to Starshield, he said on Telegram. Starlink is used to operate Ukraine's interceptor drones, the "most effective solution" against Moscow's Shahed drones, Beskrestnov said.
paras.zh: 他在 Telegram 上表示，这扰乱了一些任务，同样的限制也适用于“星盾”。贝斯克雷斯诺夫表示，星链用于操作乌克兰的拦截无人机，这是对抗莫斯科沙赫德无人机的“最有效的解决方案”。

paras.en: Starshield is a military-grade satellite network, while Starlink is only meant for "civilian or defensive activities," Musk said.
paras.zh: 马斯克表示，“星盾”是一个军用级卫星网络，而“星链”仅用于“民用或防御活动”。

paras.en: Some restrictions appear to have been partially lifted, with former Ukrainian defense minister Mykhailo Fedorov thanking Musk early Thursday morning that Starlink connectivity at speeds of up to 160 kilometers an hour had been restored. "Removing Starshield's speed limit entirely is now critical for Ukraine's defense," Fedorov added.
paras.zh: 一些限制似乎已经部分取消，乌克兰前国防部长米哈伊洛·费多罗夫周四凌晨感谢马斯克，速度高达每小时 160 公里的星链连接已经恢复。费多罗夫补充说：“完全取消星盾的速度限制现在对于乌克兰的防御至关重要。”

paras.en: The developments come amid tensions between Kyiv and Washington over an "energy ceasefire," between Ukraine and Russia announced by U.S. President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 这些事态发展正值基辅和华盛顿因美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布乌克兰和俄罗斯之间的“能源停火”而关系紧张之际。

paras.en: Ukraine has, however, welcomed a deal subject to Moscow honoring its commitment, while Russian authorities said talks were ongoing, without confirming whether they had reached an agreement. On Monday, Zelenskyy accused the Russians of breaching the ceasefire.
paras.zh: 然而，乌克兰对莫斯科兑现其承诺的协议表示欢迎，而俄罗斯当局则表示谈判正在进行中，但未确认是否已达成协议。周一，泽连斯基指责俄罗斯违反停火协议。

paras.en: Trump had also taken aim at Ukraine as it continues to strike Russian energy facilities, saying that Kyiv's attacks were responsible for the increase in diesel prices, instead of the U.S.' war with Iran.
paras.zh: 特朗普还把矛头指向乌克兰，因为乌克兰继续袭击俄罗斯能源设施，称柴油价格上涨是基辅的袭击造成的，而不是美国。与伊朗的战争。

paras.en: Washington has threatened to cut intelligence sharing with Kyiv, Reuters reported Wednesday, while Ukrainian officials said a day earlier that they have not received warnings of Russian attacks on the country for two straight days.
paras.zh: 据路透社周三报道，华盛顿威胁要切断与基辅的情报共享，而乌克兰官员一天前表示，他们已经连续两天没有收到俄罗斯袭击该国的警告。

paras.en: — CNBC's Elsa Olhen contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Elsa Olhen 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: S&P 500 futures fall ahead of more U.S. economic data; South Korea's Kospi slides 7%: Live updates

paras.en: Futures tied to the S&P 500 slid on Wednesday night, with traders looking ahead to more earnings reports and economic data following a losing session brought about by hotter-than-expected inflation data.
paras.zh: 周三晚间，与标准普尔 500 指数挂钩的期货下跌，在通胀数据超出预期导致股市下跌后，交易员期待更多盈利报告和经济数据。

paras.en: S&P 500 futures slipped 0.51%, while Nasdaq-100 futures dropped 1.11%. Dow Jones Industrial Average futures declined 0.12%, or 61 points.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 0.51%，纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌 1.11%。道琼斯工业平均指数期货下跌 0.12%，即 61 点。

paras.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite shed 1.9% during regular trading, marking its worst day since July 23 — when it dropped 2.2%. The S&P 500 dropped 1.1%, its biggest one one-day slide since July 29. The Dow was the relative outperformer, falling just 0.1%.
paras.zh: 以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数在常规交易中下跌 1.9%，这是自 7 月 23 日下跌 2.2% 以来最糟糕的一天。标准普尔 500 指数下跌 1.1%，创 7 月 29 日以来最大单日跌幅。道琼斯指数表现相对优于大盘，仅下跌 0.1%。

paras.en: In Asia, South Korea's Kospi fell over 7.84%, dragged by technology heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics. Japan's Nikkei 225 was down 4.4%, while the Hang Seng Index declined 1%. Mainland China's CSI 300 lost 1.41%. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 was down 0.85%.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，韩国综合股价指数下跌超过7.84%，受到科技巨头SK海力士和三星电子的拖累。日本日经225指数下跌4.4%，恒生指数下跌1%。中国内地沪深300指数下跌1.41%。澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数下跌 0.85%。

paras.en: There are growing concerns that the Federal Reserve could tighten monetary policy more aggressively before year-end, after new data showed consumer prices in September rose faster than expected on a year-over-year basis.
paras.zh: 在新数据显示 9 月份消费者价格同比涨幅快于预期后，人们越来越担心美联储可能在年底前更积极地收紧货币政策。

paras.en: "Inflation is cooking with gas," said Jamie Cox, managing partner for Harris Financial Group. "It is abundantly clear where the inflation impulse originates, but two wars need to end before we get any relief. The Federal Reserve made the mistake of calling Covid era inflation transitory, and now it appears they are set to make the same mistake in reverse on the energy supply shock."
paras.zh: 哈里斯金融集团执行合伙人杰米·考克斯表示：“通货膨胀正在用天然气来烹饪。” “通胀冲动的根源非常清楚，但在我们得到任何缓解之前，需要结束两场战争。美联储错误地认为新冠疫情时代的通胀是暂时的，现在看来，他们在能源供应冲击上将犯同样的错误。”

paras.en: Investors will get more inflation data on Thursday, with the September reading on producer prices due out at 8:30 a.m. ET. New retail sales figures and weekly jobless claims are also slated for release at that time.
paras.zh: 投资者将于周四获得更多通胀数据，9 月份生产者价格数据将于美国东部时间上午 8:30 公布。新零售销售数据和每周初请失业金人数也定于届时发布。

paras.en: The corporate earnings season continues as well, with regional banks U.S. Bancorp and PNC due to report. Charles Schwab is also scheduled to post earnings.
paras.zh: 企业财报季仍在继续，美国合众银行 (U.S. Bancorp) 和 PNC 等地区银行将发布财报。嘉信理财也计划公布收益。

articles.title: Microplastics are linked to inflammation—scientists might have finally worked out why

paras.en: Microplastics are a source of extreme concern for health: the presence of these tiny pieces of plastic has been linked to heart attacks, stroke, dementia and brain tumors. But what drives these associations is unclear. Now a study published in Nature offers a tantalizing clue: microplastics interact with water, generating highly reactive molecules.
paras.zh: 微塑料是人们对健康极度担忧的一个根源：这些微小塑料碎片的存在与心脏病、中风、痴呆和脑肿瘤有关。但驱动这些关联的因素尚不清楚。现在，《自然》杂志上发表的一项研究提供了一条诱人的线索：微塑料与水相互作用，产生高活性分子。

paras.en: When microplastics come into contact with water, the water near their surface can become chemically active, generating highly reactive species that can modify nearby substances, including biologically important molecules.
paras.zh: 当微塑料与水接触时，其表面附近的水会变得具有化学活性，产生高活性物质，可以改变附近的物质，包括具有重要生物学意义的分子。

paras.en: As plastics wear down to microscopic sizes, their surface-to-volume ratio increases dramatically. For example, when a credit card is fragmented into particles some 10 microns in diameter, there is a more than 200-fold increase in its surface area, says Wei Min, a chemist at Columbia University and one of the senior authors of the study. As a result, any chemical activity is amplified.
paras.zh: 当塑料磨损到微观尺寸时，它们的表面积与体积之比急剧增加。例如，当信用卡被破碎成直径约 10 微米的颗粒时，其表面积会增加 200 倍以上，哥伦比亚大学化学家、该研究的资深作者之一魏敏说。结果，任何化学活性都会被放大。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Min and his colleagues examined various microplastics—including polystyrene, polyethylene, polyvinyl chloride, polypropylene and polyethylene terephthalate. Plastic surfaces are hydrophobic, meaning they repel water, Min says. Thus, water molecules cannot form the hydrogen bonds they maintain in liquid form. That changes molecular arrangements, and, in turn, the change influences the local electrical environment and chemical reactivity.
paras.zh: 敏和他的同事检查了各种微塑料，包括聚苯乙烯、聚乙烯、聚氯乙烯、聚丙烯和聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯。敏说，塑料表面是疏水性的，这意味着它们可以排斥水。因此，水分子不能形成它们以液体形式维持的氢键。这会改变分子排列，反过来，这种变化会影响局部的电环境和化学反应性。

paras.en: The presumed chemical inertness of bulk plastics overlooks the toxicity of their fragmented microscale forms. “For microplastics, this is especially important because fragmentation creates enormous amounts of new surface area,” Min says.
paras.zh: 假定的散装塑料具有化学惰性，却忽略了其微小碎片的毒性。 “对于微塑料来说，这一点尤其重要，因为碎片会产生大量新的表面积，”敏说。

paras.en: In past research, microplastics have been shown to cause inflammation, oxidative stress and decreased mitochondrial activity. The new study provides a possible mechanism for this, showing that plastic-water interfaces can perturb proteins, cell membranes, and more.
paras.zh: 在过去的研究中，微塑料已被证明会引起炎症、氧化应激和线粒体活性降低。这项新研究为此提供了一种可能的机制，表明塑料-水界面可以扰乱蛋白质、细胞膜等。

paras.en: How this might contribute to damage in living tissues in humans is still unclear, Min says. “Ultimately, we hope to connect fundamental interfacial chemistry with quantitative measurements of biological effects, which would help us better understand potential health risks,” he adds.
paras.zh: 敏说，目前尚不清楚这如何导致人类活组织受损。 “最终，我们希望将基本的界面化学与生物效应的定量测量联系起来，这将有助于我们更好地了解潜在的健康风险，”他补充道。

paras.en: Martin Wagner, a toxicologist and a biologist at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, who was not involved in the new work, says the study’s findings are exciting. The paper gives scientists a new way to look at the effects of plastic pollution, Wagner says. “It implies microplastics themselves are a source of oxidative species ... and oxidative stress is not a secondary effect of exposure.”
paras.zh: 挪威科技大学毒理学家和生物学家马丁·瓦格纳（Martin Wagner）没有参与这项新工作，他表示这项研究的结果令人兴奋。瓦格纳说，这篇论文为科学家提供了一种研究塑料污染影响的新方法。 “这意味着微塑料本身就是氧化物质的来源……氧化应激并不是暴露的次要影响。”

articles.title: NIH appears to shut down public comments on science peer-review rule change ahead of schedule

paras.en: Members of the public who tried to submit their views on a proposed change to the National Institutes of Health’s grant funding system say they found themselves locked out after the system shut down ahead of schedule.
paras.zh: 试图就美国国立卫生研究院拨款资助系统拟议变更提出意见的公众表示，在该系统提前关闭后，他们发现自己被排除在外。

paras.en: The proposed change has been criticized as potentially reducing transparency. It seeks to revise how grant application scores—averaged measures of a research project's predicted outcomes—are communicated to both funding applicants and NIH program officers.
paras.zh: 拟议的改变被批评为可能降低透明度。它试图修改向资助申请人和 NIH 项目官员传达资助申请分数（研究项目预测结果的平均衡量标准）的方式。

paras.en: Under the change, applications would be sorted into three broad categories of merit, while their overall score, as determined by a panel of experts, would remain a secret. Some researchers have said this could open up the grant approval process to undue political influence.
paras.zh: 根据这一变化，申请将被分为三大类优点，而由专家小组确定的总体分数将仍然保密。一些研究人员表示，这可能会使拨款审批程序受到不当的政治影响。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Ahead of any rule change, the NIH invited members of the public to have their voices heard by submitting comments through a website portal, which opened in August. On a version of the site soliciting comments stored on the Wayback Machine, the deadline is shown as “11:59:59 P.M. EST [sic]” on October 13. The system for sending in comments appeared to shut down hours early, however, with several scientists posting on social media that when they tried to submit comments ahead of that time, they were unable to do so. Speaking to Scientific American, Joshua Weitz, a biology professor at the University of Maryland, says he attempted to access the site before the midnight deadline and could not.
paras.zh: 在任何规则改变之前，NIH 邀请公众通过 8 月份开放的门户网站提交评论来表达自己的意见。在 Wayback Machine 上存储的征求评论网站的一个版本中，截止日期显示为 10 月 13 日“美国东部时间晚上 11:59:59”。然而，发送评论的系统似乎提前了几个小时关闭，一些科学家在社交媒体上发帖称，当他们试图提前提交评论时，他们无法这样做。马里兰大学生物学教授约书亚·韦茨 (Joshua Weitz) 在接受《科学美国人》采访时表示，他试图在午夜截止日期之前访问该网站，但未能成功。

paras.en: The proposal marks the latest attempt by the Trump administration to have greater influence over federal science grants. Floated earlier this year, a separate bid to have political appointees—rather than independent expert panels—decide grant recipients garnered significant backlash. That earlier proposal was put on hold until at least December after Congress rejected the change.
paras.zh: 该提案标志着特朗普政府对联邦科学拨款施加更大影响的最新尝试。今年早些时候，一项由政治任命者（而不是独立专家小组）决定赠款接受者的单独提议遭到了强烈反对。在国会拒绝这一改变后，先前的提议被搁置至少到 12 月。

paras.en: The NIH did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Editor’s Note (10/14/26): This is a developing news story and may be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（10/14/26）：这是一个正在发展的新闻报道，可能会更新。

articles.title: New ‘First Proof’ exam reveals how AI-powered math is a pay-to-play sport

paras.en: Artificial intelligence models are getting good at math—but only the corporate AIs.
paras.zh: 人工智能模型在数学方面越来越擅长——但仅限于企业人工智能。

paras.en: The First Proof project, which aims to objectively evaluate the mathematical reasoning of publicly available AI models, released its third batch of results today. They underline what recent headlines have shown—that some large language models (LLMs) are becoming powerful research tools. They also suggest that proprietary subscription-based models from so-called frontier labs far exceed the math skills of more transparent and accessible “open-weight” models.
paras.zh: First Proof 项目旨在客观评估公开人工智能模型的数学推理，今天发布了第三批结果。他们强调了最近的头条新闻所表明的——一些大型语言模型（LLM）正在成为强大的研究工具。他们还认为，来自所谓前沿实验室的基于订阅的专有模型远远超过了更透明和易于访问的“开放权重”模型的数学技能。

paras.en: “The gap between the open-weight models and frontier models is very large in research mathematics—much larger than in other domains,” says Mohammed Abouzaid, a mathematician at Stanford University and a member of the First Proof team.
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学数学家、首次证明团队成员穆罕默德·阿布扎伊德 (Mohammed Abouzaid) 表示：“在研究数学中，开放权模型和前沿模型之间的差距非常大，远大于其他领域。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: In February a team of top mathematicians started First Proof as a rigorous, independent exam for cutting through the proliferation of imperfect “benchmarks” for scoring different models. The AI race to conquer math has accelerated dramatically since those quaint days, when its greatest successes concerned problems that were scarcely connected to actual research. OpenAI’s “slop drop” last week has put to rest scores of more pressing questions, many of which had stood unresolved for decades. And the company’s solution of the Navier-Stokes problem last month convinced many that LLMs are on the verge of superseding human mathematicians—if they have not already.
paras.zh: 今年二月，一个由顶尖数学家组成的团队启动了“首次证明”（First Proof），作为一项严格、独立的考试，旨在消除对不同模型进行评分的不完美“基准”的激增。自从那些古怪的日子以来，人工智能征服数学的竞赛急剧加速，当时它最大的成功涉及与实际研究几乎无关的问题。 OpenAI 上周的“下降”已经解决了数十个更紧迫的问题，其中许多问题几十年来一直悬而未决。该公司上个月对纳维-斯托克斯问题的解决方案让许多人相信法学硕士即将取代人类数学家——如果他们还没有的话。

paras.en: But these breakthroughs are far from controlled experiments. For the slop drop, OpenAI didn’t disclose the thousands of problems that the company’s new model attempted, most of which it didn’t solve. And that internal model remains completely inaccessible to outside mathematicians, preventing a direct comparison of its performance with others.
paras.zh: 但这些突破远非受控实验。对于溢油下降，OpenAI 没有透露该公司新模型尝试的数千个问题，其中大多数问题都没有解决。而且外部数学家仍然完全无法访问该内部模型，因此无法将其性能与其他模型进行直接比较。

paras.en: First Proof’s mathematicians solicited problems from experts in a broad range of subdisciplines and then selected 10. They asked each model under evaluation to answer the problems as written, with no further human input. Then they had three graders per problem evaluate the answers in a mock “peer review.”
paras.zh: First Proof 的数学家向各个学科领域的专家征求了问题，然后选出了 10 个。他们要求每个接受评估的模型回答书面问题，无需进一步的人工输入。然后，他们让每个问题的三位评分者在模拟的“同行评审”中评估答案。

paras.en: First Proof’s rules require any entrants to be openly available, so OpenAI’s blockbuster new model was excluded. The team tested OpenAI’s GPT 6 Astra, Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5, an aggregate model called “ProofCouncil” that combines an Astra agent with other agents to check its work and a similar “harness” built on Kimi K3, the leading open-weight model—one whose inner workings are made completely public, among other entrants. Producers of other major models, including Google, did not participate.
paras.zh: First Proof 的规则要求任何参与者都必须公开，因此 OpenAI 的重磅新模型被排除在外。该团队测试了 OpenAI 的 GPT 6 Astra、Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 5.5（一种名为“ProofCouncil”的聚合模型，它将 Astra 智能体与其他智能体结合起来检查其工作），以及基于 Kimi K3（领先的开放权重模型，其内部工作原理完全公开的模型）构建的类似“工具”。包括谷歌在内的其他主要机型的生产商并未参与其中。

paras.en: The best performer—ProofCouncil—solved nine out of the 10 research problems in a manner the judges deemed acceptable with “minor revisions” for publication in a peer-reviewed journal. This helped quantify the models’ rapid ascent at math over the course of 2026. (In the round one results that First Proof released in February, the top model got just a few problems correct. And in the round two results released in June, the winner got six or seven.)
paras.zh: 表现最好的 ProofCouncil 以法官认为可以接受的方式解决了 10 个研究问题中的 9 个，并进行了“小修改”，以便在同行评审的期刊上发表。这有助于量化模型在 2026 年数学方面的快速提升。（在 First Proof 2 月份发布的第一轮结果中，顶级模型只答对了几个问题。而在 6 月份发布的第二轮结果中，获胜者得到了六到七个。）

paras.en: For the main skill that First Proof tests—proving well-defined statements—“the models have become very good,” Abouzaid says, “so good that testing the frontier models on this task might not be that relevant in the future.”
paras.zh: 对于 First Proof 测试的主要技能——证明定义明确的陈述——“模型已经变得非常好，”阿布扎伊德说，“好到在未来测试这项任务的前沿模型可能不再那么重要。”

paras.en: Notably, the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, solved exactly zero problems. “It really fell flat on its face,” says Lauren Williams, a mathematician at Harvard University and a member of the First Proof team. “The open models are really, really far behind, so we would urge the community to invest a lot into improving them.”
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，最好的开放重量模型 Kimi K3 完全解决了零问题。 “它确实一败涂地，”哈佛大学数学家、“首次证明”团队成员劳伦·威廉姆斯 (Lauren Williams) 说道。 “开放模型确实非常落后，因此我们敦促社区投入大量资金来改进它们。”

paras.en: The First Proof team has received many requests to test open-weight models from mathematicians concerned about privacy after recent high-profile controversies. “I know people who use open-source models exclusively because they’re so paranoid about data leakage with the frontier models,” Williams says.
paras.zh: 在最近备受瞩目的争议之后，First Proof 团队收到了许多担心隐私问题的数学家提出的测试开放权重模型的请求。 “我认识一些专门使用开源模型的人，因为他们对前沿模型的数据泄露非常偏执，”威廉姆斯说。

paras.en: “We have a lot of questions from mathematicians telling us, ‘I would like to look for alternatives to using OpenAI’s or Anthropic’s models, but I don’t know whether they would work,’” Abouzaid says .
paras.zh: “数学家向我们提出了很多问题，他们告诉我们，‘我想寻找使用 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 模型的替代方案，但我不知道它们是否有效，’”阿布扎伊德说。

articles.title: An experimental drug kills fat cells, rather than shrinking them
articles.author: Tina Hesman Saey

paras.en: This is a human-written story voiced by AI. Got feedback?
paras.zh: 这是一个由人工智能配音的人类书写的故事。有反馈吗？

paras.en: An experimental drug may melt away a dangerous type of fat that packs around internal organs.
paras.zh: 一种实验药物可能会融化内脏周围的一种危险脂肪。

paras.en: The drug, called CBL-514, specifically triggers fat cells to enter a death program called apoptosis. People who got injections of the experimental drug in their lower abdomens lost visceral fat, researchers reported October 1 at the annual meeting of the European Association for the Study of Diabetes in Milan, Italy. Visceral fat sits deep in the abdomen where it chokes organs and can spur inflammation and health problems.
paras.zh: 这种药物名为 CBL-514，专门触发脂肪细胞进入称为细胞凋亡的死亡程序。研究人员 10 月 1 日在意大利米兰举行的欧洲糖尿病研究协会年会上报告称，在下腹部注射实验药物的人减少了内脏脂肪。内脏脂肪位于腹部深处，它会阻塞器官，并可能引发炎症和健康问题。

paras.en: Weight loss can shrink fat cells, but the cells are still there, poised to balloon up again.
paras.zh: 减肥可以缩小脂肪细胞，但细胞仍然存在，并准备再次膨胀。

paras.en: The team already knew the experimental drug could reduce subcutaneous fat, the pinchable fat that sits under the skin, in the abdomen. That surface fat doesn’t carry the same health risks that visceral fat does.
paras.zh: 研究小组已经知道这种实验药物可以减少皮下脂肪，即腹部皮下的可捏脂肪。表面脂肪不会带来与内脏脂肪相同的健康风险。

paras.en: In the new study, researchers examined MRIs from a subset of participants in two small clinical trials to track visceral fat levels. Study participants, who ranged from healthy weights to overweight, got injections of CBL-514 or placebo every three weeks for up to 12 weeks. The two groups started with about the same amount of visceral fat; 642.5 milliliters on average in the CBL-514 group and 677.4 milliliters in the placebo group. Four weeks after treatment, those who got the experimental drug had dropped almost 71 mL of visceral fat (a 12 percent decrease), while the placebo group gained 31 mL (a nearly 6 percent increase) of the dangerous fat in their abdomens.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，研究人员检查了两项小型临床试验中一部分参与者的核磁共振成像，以追踪内脏脂肪水平。研究参与者的体重范围从健康体重到超重，每三周注射一次 CBL-514 或安慰剂，持续长达 12 周。两组开始时的内脏脂肪量大致相同； CBL-514 组平均为 642.5 毫升，安慰剂组为 677.4 毫升。治疗 4 周后，服用实验药物的人减少了近 71 毫升的内脏脂肪（减少了 12%），而安慰剂组的腹部危险脂肪增加了 31 毫升（增加了近 6%）。

paras.en: Measurements taken at eight to 12 weeks after treatment showed the gap had widened. Those who got the experimental drug lost almost 63 mL — about a quarter cup — of visceral fat on average while the placebo group gained more than 78 mL of visceral fat over the starting point. Those results suggest that the drug might have health benefits by reducing visceral fat, which contributes to diabetes and heart problems. Larger clinical trials to test efficacy and safety of the drug are ongoing.
paras.zh: 治疗后 8 至 12 周进行的测量显示差距扩大了。那些服用实验药物的人平均减少了近 63 毫升（约四分之一杯）的内脏脂肪，而安慰剂组则比开始时增加了超过 78 毫升的内脏脂肪。这些结果表明，该药物可能通过减少内脏脂肪对健康有益，而内脏脂肪会导致糖尿病和心脏问题。更大规模的临床试验正在进行中，以测试该药物的功效和安全性。

articles.title: Kilauea’s display is revealing why volcanoes spew like a fountain show
articles.author: Carolyn Gramling

paras.en: Kilauea has been erupting almost continuously for nearly 200 years, and volcanologists have seen a lot of sides to Hawaii’s most active volcano. But in the last year, Kilauea started doing something new: firing up frequent fountains of lava.
paras.zh: 基拉韦厄火山近 200 年来几乎一直在喷发，火山学家已经看到了夏威夷最活跃火山的许多侧面。但去年，基拉韦厄开始做一些新的事情：频繁喷发熔岩喷泉。

paras.en: The volcano’s fountain era kicked off at dawn on December 23, 2024, with an eruption inside the summit crater of Halema’uma’u. Since then, Kilauea has put on a recurring pyrotechnic display of lava fountains, researchers report October 8 in Science. It produced 54 different lava fountains by September 2026, some of which shot as high as 457 meters into the sky.
paras.zh: 2024 年 12 月 23 日黎明，哈莱马乌马乌山顶火山口喷发，拉开了火山喷泉时代的序幕。研究人员于 10 月 8 日在《科学》杂志上报道称，从那时起，基拉韦厄火山就不断上演熔岩喷泉的烟火表演。到 2026 年 9 月，它产生了 54 个不同的熔岩喷泉，其中一些高达 457 米。

paras.en: During an eruption, which can last from hours to days, months or even years, occasional lava fountains aren’t unusual. But it’s rare to see repeated fountains — distinct bursts separated by minutes to weeks — during a single eruption. At Kilauea, these clustered spurts have only occurred three times since 1823, and never with such frequency.
paras.zh: 喷发可能持续数小时、数天、数月甚至数年，在喷发期间，偶尔出现熔岩喷泉并不罕见。但在单次喷发期间，很少看到重复的喷泉——间隔几分钟到几周的明显喷发。在基拉韦厄火山，自 1823 年以来，这种聚集性喷发只发生过 3 次，而且从未出现过如此频繁的情况。

paras.en: Thanks to their rarity, researchers have known relatively little about what initiates, sustains and ends these episodic fountains, say Ashton Flinders, a research geophysicist at the U.S. Geological Survey’s Hawaiian Volcano Observatory, based in Hilo, and colleagues. There have been two prevailing ideas: Water dissolved in magma — the underground, molten mix of rock and gas — rising from deep inside the volcano suddenly escapes as the pressure changes, leading to a burst of pyrotechnics; or a carbon dioxide–rich foam atop the trapped magma, like the pressurized froth over a shaken bottle of soda, suddenly and violently expands.
paras.zh: 美国地质调查局夏威夷火山观测站的研究地球物理学家阿什顿·弗林德斯 (Ashton Flinders) 及其同事表示，由于它们的稀有性，研究人员对这些间歇性喷泉的启动、维持和结束知之甚少。有两种流行的观点：溶解在岩浆中的水——地下岩石和气体的熔融混合物——随着压力的变化从火山深处升起，突然逸出，导致烟火爆发；或者被困岩浆顶部富含二氧化碳的泡沫，就像摇动的苏打水瓶上的加压泡沫一样，突然剧烈膨胀。

paras.en: Kilauea is the perfect laboratory in which to assess these hypotheses, the researchers say. It has been intensely studied by scientists and monitored by instruments for decades. Scientists continuously collect data on its seismic activity, temperature, low-frequency acoustics, how much the ground swells or deflates and the gases that escape. Using these data, researchers have begun to form a picture of what’s causing the relentless spewing.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，基拉韦厄火山是评估这些假设的完美实验室。数十年来，科学家们对其进行了深入研究并通过仪器对其进行了监测。科学家们不断收集有关其地震活动、温度、低频声学、地面膨胀或收缩程度以及逸出气体的数据。利用这些数据，研究人员已经开始了解导致不断喷涌的原因。

paras.en: Before each fountain, the team found, the floor of the bowl-shaped caldera would swell and tilt, suggesting magma was gathering beneath. As the eruption matured and the fountains continued, a pattern emerged, first appearing before the fourteenth fountain. Just before that eruption, the team detected a repetitive sequence of minutes-long bursts of seismic energy and low-frequency acoustics.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，在每个喷泉之前，碗状火山口的底部都会膨胀并倾斜，这表明岩浆正在聚集在下面。随着喷发的成熟和喷泉的持续，一种图案出现了，首先出现在第十四个喷泉之前。就在火山喷发之前，研究小组检测到了一系列重复的长达数分钟的地震能量爆发和低频声波。

paras.en: Those signals, the researchers say, are linked to the buildup and release of trapped gases in magma, which make it rise and fall through narrow volcanic vents in the rock like a piston in a car. The team also noted that while the volcano burped some sulfur dioxide gas, there was relatively little carbon dioxide, suggesting that the foam hypothesis wasn’t at work.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这些信号与岩浆中滞留气体的积聚和释放有关，这使得岩浆像汽车中的活塞一样通过岩石中狭窄的火山喷口上升和下降。研究小组还指出，虽然火山喷出一些二氧化硫气体，但二氧化碳相对较少，这表明泡沫假说并不成立。

paras.en: This is just a preliminary glimpse into this phenomenon, and a lot of questions remain, Flinders and his colleagues say.
paras.zh: 弗林德斯和他的同事说，这只是对这一现象的初步了解，仍然存在很多问题。

articles.title: Here’s a look at the Nobel Prizes for science
articles.author: Nikk Ogasa

paras.en: It’s Nobels season — that time of the year when we find out which groundbreaking, paradigm-shifting, world-changing achievements beat out the rest to win what is arguably the most prestigious award on Earth.
paras.zh: 现在是诺贝尔奖季——一年中的这个时候，我们会找出哪些突破性、范式转变、改变世界的成就击败其他成就，赢得可以说是地球上最负盛名的奖项。

paras.en: From a light switch for the brain to the discovery of an ultra-elusive subatomic particle hailing from beyond our solar system to a solution to one of the most enduring puzzles in all of organic chemistry, the researchers behind this year’s scientific prizes each revolutionized the ways that scientists understand the world around them.
paras.zh: 从大脑的光开关到发现来自太阳系之外的极其难以捉摸的亚原子粒子，再到解决有机化学中最持久的难题之一，今年科学奖项背后的研究人员都彻底改变了科学家理解周围世界的方式。

paras.en: Take a look at the science behind each of this year’s awards.
paras.zh: 看看今年每个奖项背后的科学原理。

paras.en: A galaxy of nearly 90 billion neurons exists within a single human brain. But unlike stars in the void, neurons communicate with one another via some 100 trillion connections, allowing the human mind to learn, adapt and interact with its surroundings.
paras.zh: 一个人脑内存在一个由近 900 亿个神经元组成的星系。但与虚空中的星星不同的是，神经元通过约 100 万亿个连接相互通信，使人类思维能够学习、适应周围环境并与之互动。

paras.en: For scientists to understand how individual actions arise from such complexity, they needed a tool to directly link neural circuits to specific behaviors, said Abdel El Manira, a neuroscientist at the Karolinska Institute in Stockholm. “Neuroscientists dreamed of a neuronal switch, a tool to turn specific neurons on or off with great precision,” El Manira said during the Oct. 5 announcement of this year’s prize in physiology or medicine by the Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institute.
paras.zh: 斯德哥尔摩卡罗林斯卡研究所的神经科学家阿卜杜勒·埃尔·马尼拉 (Abdel El Manira) 表示，为了让科学家了解个体行为如何从如此复杂的情况中产生，他们需要一种工具将神经回路与特定行为直接联系起来。 “神经科学家梦想有一个神经元开关，一种能够非常精确地打开或关闭特定神经元的工具，”埃尔·马尼拉在卡罗林斯卡学院诺贝尔大会 10 月 5 日宣布今年的生理学或医学奖时说道。

paras.en: Enter the bright idea that won. It’s a technology called optogenetics, which involves using light to precisely activate specific cells, like neurons, and watch how behavior changes. For their foundational contributions to optogenetics, biophysicists Peter Hegemann of Humboldt University in Berlin and Georg Nagel, of the Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg in Germany, and neuroscientist Karl Deisseroth of Stanford University shared this year’s prize.
paras.zh: 输入获胜的好主意。这是一种称为光遗传学的技术，涉及利用光精确激活特定细胞（例如神经元），并观察行为如何变化。柏林洪堡大学的生物物理学家 Peter Hegemann 和德国维尔茨堡朱利叶斯·马克西米利安大学的 Georg Nagel 以及斯坦福大学的神经科学家 Karl Deisseroth 分享了今年的奖项，以表彰他们对光遗传学的基础性贡献。

paras.en: The prize winners’ story starts in an unlikely place: the eye spot of a single celled green alga called Chlamydomonas. In the early 2000s, Hegemann, then at the Max Planck Institute for Biochemistry in Martinsreid, Germany, and Nagel, at the Max Planck Institute for Biophysics in Frankfurt, discovered a unique protein in the alga’s eye spot. When illuminated, the protein generated an electrical impulse, enabling the organism to move. Further research revealed that when the protein, called channelrhodopsin, was exposed to light, it opened like a pore, allowing positively charged ions to flow into a cell, generating the electrical impulse. “They had just discovered the switch neuroscientists had long dreamed of,” El Manira said.
paras.zh: 获奖者的故事始于一个意想不到的地方：一种称为衣藻的单细胞绿藻的眼点。 2000 年代初，当时在德国马丁斯里德马克斯普朗克生物化学研究所工作的赫格曼和在法兰克福马克斯普朗克生物物理研究所工作的内格尔在藻类的眼斑中发现了一种独特的蛋白质。当光照时，蛋白质产生电脉冲，使生物体能够移动。进一步的研究表明，当这种称为通道视紫红质的蛋白质暴露在光下时，它会像孔一样打开，允许带正电的离子流入细胞，产生电脉冲。 “他们刚刚发现了神经科学家梦寐以求的转变，”埃尔马尼拉说。

paras.en: Building on the Hegemann and Nagel’s work, Deisseroth began testing whether channelrhodopsin could be used to activate brain cells. He and his colleagues first inserted the gene for channelrhodopsin into cultures of rat nerve cells and found that the cells reacted to light instantaneously. They then introduced the gene into nerve cells in the brains of living mice, along with optical fibers fed through the rodents’ skulls. By beaming blue light through the fibers, the researchers were able to control the movements of the rodents’ whiskers. This technology gave researchers the ability to test the links between certain brain circuits and behaviors.
paras.zh: 在 Hegemann 和 Nagel 的工作基础上，Deisseroth 开始测试视紫红质通道蛋白是否可用于激活脑细胞。他和他的同事首先将视紫红质通道蛋白基因插入大鼠神经细胞培养物中，发现细胞对光立即做出反应。然后，他们将该基因引入活体小鼠大脑的神经细胞中，同时将光纤引入啮齿类动物的头骨中。通过通过纤维发射蓝光，研究人员能够控制啮齿动物胡须的运动。这项技术使研究人员能够测试某些大脑回路和行为之间的联系。

paras.en: “The technology, which soon became known as optogenetics, transformed neuroscience,” El Manira said. In addition to exposing the inner workings of healthy brains, he noted, “it has also helped reveal how brain circuits are disrupted, with implications for conditions such as blindness, depression and dementia.”
paras.zh: “这项技术很快被称为光遗传学，它改变了神经科学，”埃尔马尼拉说。他指出，除了揭示健康大脑的内部运作之外，“它还有助于揭示大脑回路如何被破坏，从而对失明、抑郁和痴呆等疾病产生影响。”

paras.en: For example, the technology has been used improve vision in some patients with retinitis pigmentosa, a disease that degrades light-sensing cells in the retina. It’s also helping researchers investigate the role that a person’s heart plays in how they experience and interact with their surroundings.
paras.zh: 例如，该技术已用于改善一些患有色素性视网膜炎的患者的视力，这种疾病会降低视网膜中的光敏细胞的功能。它还帮助研究人员调查一个人的心脏在他们如何体验和与周围环境互动中所扮演的角色。

paras.en: At the South Pole, there exists a block of ice unlike any other on Earth. Buried deep beneath the surface of the Antarctic ice sheet, a cubic kilometer of ice is threaded with thousands of beadlike sensors. Known as the IceCube Neutrino Observatory, this immense instrument enables researchers to detect the most elusive particle in the universe — the neutrino.
paras.zh: 在南极，有一块与地球上其他地方不同的冰块。深埋在南极冰盖表面下方，一立方公里的冰上布满了数千个珠状传感器。这个巨大的仪器被称为冰立方中微子观测站，使研究人员能够探测宇宙中最难以捉摸的粒子——中微子。

paras.en: Detecting neutrinos from beyond our solar system had been a goal of scientists for decades, as that could help understand where and how the universe accelerates particles to extraordinary energies.
paras.zh: 几十年来，探测太阳系以外的中微子一直是科学家的目标，因为这可以帮助了解宇宙在何处以及如何将粒子加速到非凡的能量。

paras.en: The researcher who led the creation of the Antarctic observatory, physicist Francis Halzen of the University of Wisconsin–Madison, received this year’s Nobel Prize in physics. Halzen was awarded “for his decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin,” Mark Pearce, a physicist and chair of the Nobel committee for physics, during the Oct. 6 announcement by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences.
paras.zh: 领导创建南极天文台的研究人员、威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的物理学家弗朗西斯·哈尔岑获得了今年的诺贝尔物理学奖。诺贝尔物理学委员会主席、物理学家马克·皮尔斯在瑞典皇家科学院于 10 月 6 日宣布的颁奖仪式上，哈尔岑“因其对冰立方中微子观测站和发现天体物理起源的高能中微子的决定性贡献”而获奖。

paras.en: Neutrinos are subatomic particles that are chargeless, incredibly small and so ethereal that they often pass through objects without interacting. In fact, billions of neutrinos pass through each of us every second, most of which are formed by nuclear fusion reactions in the sun. But some of these ghostly particles were thought to have originated much farther away, in high-energy particle collisions so distant as to lie beyond the limits of observations. Because neutrinos are not deflected by magnetic fields and rarely interact with matter, the detection of a high-energy neutrino’s trajectory could enable the identification of its distant source. An instrument capable of that task could therefore open a new window into the cosmos.
paras.zh: 中微子是亚原子粒子，不带电荷，非常小，而且如此飘逸，以至于它们经常穿过物体而不发生相互作用。事实上，每秒有数十亿个中微子穿过我们每个人，其中大部分是由太阳的核聚变反应形成的。但其中一些幽灵般的粒子被认为起源于更远的地方，是在高能粒子碰撞中产生的，距离如此之远，超出了观测的范围。由于中微子不会被磁场偏转，并且很少与物质相互作用，因此检测高能中微子的轨迹可以识别其遥远的来源。因此，能够完成这项任务的仪器可以打开一扇通向宇宙的新窗口。

paras.en: In the 1980s, Halzen realized that the South Pole was an ideal location for detecting the rare flashes of light that are generated when neutrinos collide with atomic nuclei. Ice deep inside the Antarctic ice sheet presented a large, transparent medium plunged in darkness, in a spot free from earthquakes and biological interference. It was the perfect stage for a neutrino lightshow.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 80 年代，哈尔岑意识到南极是探测中微子与原子核碰撞时产生的罕见闪光的理想地点。南极冰盖深处的冰呈现出一个巨大的、透明的介质，沉浸在黑暗中，没有地震和生物干扰。这是中微子灯光秀的完美舞台。

paras.en: Halzen’s vision was realized in 2011, when IceCube completed construction. “The biggest risk we took is that nobody knew whether a kilometer-field detector was actually large enough to discover neutrinos beyond our atmosphere from the universe,” Halzen said in a phone call during the announcement ceremony. “It only took us two years to detect them.”
paras.zh: Halzen 的愿景于 2011 年实现，当时 IceCube 竣工。哈尔岑在宣布仪式上的电话中说：“我们冒的最大风险是，没有人知道千米级探测器是否真的足够大，足以发现宇宙大气层之外的中微子。” “我们只花了两年时间就发现了它们。”

paras.en: And the discoveries didn’t end there. In 2018, researchers using IceCube data reported that they had traced a neutrino back to the brilliant core of a distant galaxy, called a blazar, thereby identifying a source for the energetic particles for the first time. And in 2023, researchers used a decade of IceCube data to produce the first map of the Milky Way using anything besides light, simultaneously reporting the first evidence of high-energy neutrinos hailing from within the galaxy.
paras.zh: 发现并没有就此结束。 2018年，研究人员使用IceCube数据报告说，他们已经将中微子追溯到遥远星系（称为耀变体）的明亮核心，从而首次确定了高能粒子的来源。 2023 年，研究人员利用十年来的 IceCube 数据绘制了第一张银河系地图，同时还报告了来自银河系内部高能中微子的第一个证据。

paras.en: Plans for a global network of neutrino detectors are now in motion. So scientists will soon be even better equipped to pinpoint and demystify the distant cosmic accelerators that launch the mysterious particles across the vast reaches of space.
paras.zh: 全球中微子探测器网络的计划现已启动。因此，科学家们很快就会有更好的装备来精确定位和揭开遥远宇宙加速器的神秘面纱，这些加速器在广阔的太空中发射神秘粒子。

paras.en: In nature, the building blocks of life exhibit a striking pattern. Many can exist in two versions that are mirrored images of one another, much like your right and left hand. Such molecules are said to be chiral. However, they overwhelmingly occur as just one of these chiral forms — for instance, amino acids are nearly always left-handed.
paras.zh: 在自然界中，生命的组成部分表现出惊人的模式。许多可以存在两个版本，彼此互为镜像，就像你的右手和左手一样。此类分子被认为是手性的。然而，它们绝大多数只是作为这些手性形式之一出现——例如，氨基酸几乎总是左旋的。

paras.en: This uniformity, known as homochirality, had long puzzled scientists. When chemists first attempted to produce chiral molecules in the lab, they ended up with even proportions of right- and left-handed molecules, or enantiomers.
paras.zh: 这种一致性被称为同手性，长期以来一直困扰着科学家。当化学家第一次尝试在实验室中生产手性分子时，他们最终得到了均匀比例的右旋分子和左旋分子或对映体。

paras.en: “It is this puzzle that this year’s laureates have solved,” Heiner Linke, chair of the Nobel Committee for Chemistry said during the Oct. 7 Nobel Prize in chemistry announcement by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences.
paras.zh: “今年的获奖者已经解决了这个难题，”诺贝尔化学委员会主席海纳·林克在瑞典皇家科学院于 10 月 7 日宣布诺贝尔化学奖时说道。

paras.en: Henri Kagan, of the Université Paris-Saclay, and Kenso Soai, of the Tokyo University of Science, split the prize for discoveries leading “to a chemical reaction that spontaneously, without the involvement of other chiral molecules, creates only one mirror image,” said Linke, a physicist at Lund University in Sweden. “This is the first time this had happened since the processes that led to the chirality of life billions of years ago.”
paras.zh: 瑞典隆德大学的物理学家林克说，巴黎萨克雷大学的亨利·卡根和东京理科大学的 Kenso Soai 平分了“一种化学反应的发现，这种化学反应在没有其他手性分子参与的情况下自发地只产生一个镜像”。 “自数十亿年前导致生命手性的过程以来，这是第一次发生这种情况。”

paras.en: Putting aside the laureates’ impact on one of organic chemistry’s greatest mysteries, their research has immensely benefitted the development of pharmaceuticals. So many active drug molecules are chiral, and one enantiomer of a drug might have the desired therapeutic effect while its other might have no effect or even be harmful, Linke said.
paras.zh: 抛开获奖者对有机化学最大谜团之一的影响不谈，他们的研究极大地有益于药物的开发。 Linke说，许多活性药物分子都是手性的，药物的一种对映体可能具有所需的治疗效果，而另一种对映体可能没有效果甚至有害。

paras.en: A notorious example of such harm occurred in the 1950s, when thousands of babies with severe birth defects were born to women who had taken a sedative called thalidomide. It was later revealed that one of thalidomide’s enantiomers was the source of the birth defects. Even making the drug with only the “safe” orientation didn’t solve the problem: It could switch handedness in the body.
paras.zh: 这种伤害的一个臭名昭著的例子发生在 20 世纪 50 年代，当时服用沙利度胺镇静剂的妇女生下了数千名患有严重先天缺陷的婴儿。后来发现，沙利度胺的一种对映体是出生缺陷的根源。即使仅以“安全”方向制造药物也无法解决问题：它可以改变体内的利手习惯。

paras.en: In 1986, Kagan and his colleagues became the first to report chemical reactions that produced specific enantiomers in proportions far exceeding what chemists previously assumed was possible using catalysts.
paras.zh: 1986 年，卡根和他的同事成为第一个报告产生特定对映异构体的化学反应，其比例远远超过化学家之前假设的使用催化剂的可能性。

paras.en: Nine years later, Soai and his colleagues reported that they had figured out how to make a chiral catalyst that could, in turn, be used to form itself. That allowed them to perform reactions that resulted in products made almost entirely of one enantiomer. “This is not the final answer,” Soai said of his groundbreaking work on chirality, while calling into the ceremony from Japan. Speaking to future generations, he said “the study of chirality should be more and more developed.”
paras.zh: 九年后，索艾和他的同事报告说，他们已经找到了制造手性催化剂的方法，而这种催化剂又可以用来形成自身。这使得他们能够进行反应，产生几乎完全由一种对映体制成的产品。 “这不是最终的答案，”Soai 在日本参加仪式时谈到他在手性方面的开创性工作。他对后代说：“手性研究应该越来越发展。”

paras.en: Even so, as Nobel committee member Peter Somfai, a chemist at Lund University in Sweden, said during the ceremony: “This is probably the coolest experiment in organic chemistry.”
paras.zh: 即便如此，正如诺贝尔委员会成员、瑞典隆德大学化学家 Peter Somfai 在颁奖典礼上所说：“这可能是有机化学领域最酷的实验。”

articles.title: A Rock Dragged 90 Km Into Earth Came Back With a Temperature Story That Breaks The Models
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: Scientists have discovered a mysterious rock in eastern Papua New Guinea that traveled to the underworld roughly 4.4 million years ago.
paras.zh: 科学家在巴布亚新几内亚东部发现了一块神秘的岩石，它在大约 440 万年前进入了地下世界。

paras.en: The story it has to tell is strange indeed.
paras.zh: 它所讲述的故事确实很奇怪。

paras.en: As the rock journeyed deeper into our planet's interior, pushed by the forces of a subduction zone, its temperature did not do what scientists expected.
paras.zh: 当岩石在俯冲带的力量推动下深入到地球内部时，它的温度并没有达到科学家的预期。

paras.en: At 45 kilometers below the surface, researchers estimate the rock became unusually warm, experiencing temperatures of about 700 °C (1,292 °F).
paras.zh: 研究人员估计，在地表以下 45 公里处，岩石变得异常温暖，温度达到约 700 °C (1,292 °F)。

paras.en: That's hotter than models predict subduction zones should be at that depth.
paras.zh: 这比模型预测的俯冲带在该深度的温度要高。

paras.en: But that's not all. When the rock reached more than 90 kilometers (56 miles) deep, its temperature only rose by a further 100 °C.
paras.zh: 但这还不是全部。当岩石到达超过 90 公里（56 英里）深时，其温度仅进一步上升了 100 °C。

paras.en: "What makes this rock so interesting is that it records two very different thermal conditions at different stages of its time deep inside Earth," says geologist Axel Schmitt from Curtin University in Australia.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚科廷大学的地质学家阿克塞尔·施密特说：“这块岩石之所以如此有趣，是因为它在地球深处的不同阶段记录了两种截然不同的热条件。”

paras.en: "At about 45 kilometers depth, the rock was surprisingly hot, but as it traveled deeper it entered an environment that was cooler than we would normally expect at that depth."
paras.zh: “在大约 45 公里深处，岩石出奇地热，但随着它深入，它进入的环境比我们在该深度通常预期的要凉爽。”

paras.en: It's a small slice of evidence that has traveled a long way, and its journey could reveal important clues about what lies beneath our planet's surface.
paras.zh: 这只是一小部分证据，已经传播了很长一段路，它的旅程可能会揭示有关我们星球表面之下的东西的重要线索。

paras.en: While it is generally true that Earth gets warmer the deeper you go, the temperature gradient isn't always clean and straight.
paras.zh: 虽然地球越往深处走，温度越高，这是事实，但温度梯度并不总是干净且平直的。

paras.en: The curious rock from Papua New Guinea is evidence of that.
paras.zh: 来自巴布亚新几内亚的奇怪岩石就是证明。

paras.en: It was collected from a larger exposed outcrop on Goodenough Island, which contains eclogite, a rock made under high pressure.
paras.zh: 它是从古迪纳夫岛上一个较大的裸露露头采集的，其中含有榴辉岩，一种在高压下形成的岩石。

paras.en: Based on an analysis, this rock appears to have been driven more than 90 kilometers deep at a local subduction zone.
paras.zh: 根据分析，这块岩石似乎已被推入当地俯冲带 90 多公里深处。

paras.en: Scientists know this because the sample contains a mineral called coesite, which only forms under pressures at this depth or deeper.
paras.zh: 科学家们之所以知道这一点，是因为样本中含有一种叫做柯石英的矿物，这种矿物只有在这个深度或更深处的压力下才会形成。

paras.en: Another mineral, called zircon, can help reveal when this pressure occurred.
paras.zh: 另一种叫做锆石的矿物可以帮助揭示这种压力何时发生。

paras.en: In this case, the coesite likely formed in this rock when it was deep inside Earth, around 4.4 million years ago.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，柯石英很可能是在这块岩石位于地球深处时（大约 440 万年前）形成的。

paras.en: The rock was once part of a fragment of continental crust that was carried down into a subduction zone at a tectonic plate boundary.
paras.zh: 该岩石曾经是大陆地壳碎片的一部分，被带入构造板块边界的俯冲带。

paras.en: Subduction zones are thought to push relatively cold rock downward into a hotter and more pressurized environment.
paras.zh: 人们认为俯冲带将相对较冷的岩石向下推入更热、压力更大的环境。

paras.en: But it can take a while for that colder rock to warm up to its new surroundings.
paras.zh: 但较冷的岩石可能需要一段时间才能适应新环境。

paras.en: That's why deeply buried rocks can remain relatively cold compared with their surroundings.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么深埋的岩石与周围环境相比可以保持相对较低的温度。

paras.en: But not so for the rock from Papua New Guinea.
paras.zh: 但来自巴布亚新几内亚的岩石却并非如此。

paras.en: It records an unexpectedly warm beginning to its descent, followed by a colder ending phase.
paras.zh: 它记录了下降过程中出人意料的温暖开始，随后是较冷的结束阶段。

paras.en: First author Jan Schönig, a geoscientist at Göttingen University in Germany, says this "contradicts our current thermal models of subduction zones."
paras.zh: 第一作者、德国哥廷根大学地球科学家 Jan Schönig 表示，这“与我们当前的俯冲带热模型相矛盾”。

paras.en: "Finding this change from relatively hot conditions at shallower depth to colder conditions deeper down was unexpected," agrees Schmitt.
paras.zh: 施密特同意：“发现从较浅深度相对较热的条件到较深处较冷条件的这种变化是出乎意料的。”

paras.en: "One possibility is that intense shearing where the tectonic plates meet generates additional heat at relatively shallow depths."
paras.zh: “一种可能性是，构造板块相遇处的强烈剪切会在相对较浅的深度产生额外的热量。”

paras.en: In other words, shearing forces where tectonic plates meet could be heating up shallow rocks more, relative to their pressure.
paras.zh: 换句话说，相对于压力，构造板块相遇处的剪切力可能会更多地加热浅层岩石。

paras.en: Another option, Schmitt explains, is that the system is young, and the subduction zone has not yet cooled to the lower temperatures scientists would expect.
paras.zh: 施密特解释说，另一种选择是该系统还很年轻，俯冲带尚未冷却到科学家预期的较低温度。

paras.en: "The findings suggest the thermal structure of these zones may be more complex than previously thought, helping scientists better understand how subduction operates over millions to billions of years," says Schmitt.
paras.zh: 施密特说：“研究结果表明，这些区域的热结构可能比之前想象的更复杂，这有助于科学家更好地了解俯冲作用在数百万至数十亿年间的运作方式。”

paras.en: "Understanding these temperature changes helps us build a clearer picture of the extreme conditions deep inside Earth, where tectonic plates collide and drive processes that shape the planet's surface."
paras.zh: “了解这些温度变化有助于我们更清晰地了解地球深处的极端条件，那里的构造板块碰撞并驱动塑造地球表面的过程。”

paras.en: One tiny rock can reveal crucial information about the big rock we all live on.
paras.zh: 一块小石头可以揭示我们赖以生存的大石头的重要信息。

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature Geoscience.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然地球科学》杂志上。

articles.title: Creatine Could Protect The Brain From Gut Inflammation
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: It started as a supplement for athletes, and now scientists are investigating the benefits of creatine for more than just muscle.
paras.zh: 它最初是作为运动员的补充剂，现在科学家们正在研究肌酸不仅对肌肉有好处。

paras.en: According to preliminary evidence, this natural organic compound could have perks for many parts of the body and brain even without exercise.
paras.zh: 根据初步证据，即使不运动，这种天然有机化合物也能为身体和大脑的许多部位带来好处。

paras.en: That idea remains contentious; however, a new study among rats suggests that creatine is highly effective at protecting the brain from a disrupted gut.
paras.zh: 这个想法仍然存在争议。然而，一项针对老鼠的新研究表明，肌酸在保护大脑免受肠道破坏方面非常有效。

paras.en: The findings, published in Brain, Behavior, and Immunity, are limited to animal models, but researchers in Spain believe there are clinical implications.
paras.zh: 发表在《大脑、行为和免疫》杂志上的研究结果仅限于动物模型，但西班牙的研究人员认为具有临床意义。

paras.en: In individuals with gut-brain inflammatory disorders, they argue, creatine could be an "excellent candidate" to preserve brain health.
paras.zh: 他们认为，对于患有肠脑炎症性疾病的个体，肌酸可能是保护大脑健康的“优秀候选者”。

paras.en: "From a clinical perspective, creatine supplementation emerges as a powerful, complementary and preventive strategy," the research team concludes, led by neurophysiologists Alejandro Ruiz-Calero and Maria Ortego-Domínguez at the University of Seville in Spain.
paras.zh: 由西班牙塞维利亚大学神经生理学家亚历杭德罗·鲁伊斯·卡莱罗和玛丽亚·奥尔特戈·多明格斯领导的研究小组总结道：“从临床角度来看，补充肌酸是一种强大的、补充性的预防策略。”

paras.en: "… it restores hippocampal creatine content, preserves neuronal integrity, and normalizes neuronal excitability by selectively targeting parameters disrupted by inflammation."
paras.zh: “......它恢复海马肌酸含量，保持神经元完整性，并通过选择性地针对炎症破坏的参数使神经元兴奋性正常化。”

paras.en: Last year, some of the same researchers found that creatine supplementation in rodents reduced gut inflammation and disease-related damage within the intestine.
paras.zh: 去年，一些研究人员发现啮齿类动物补充肌酸可以减少肠道炎症和肠道内与疾病相关的损伤。

paras.en: Their new experiments show perks for the hippocampus, too, which is a crucial brain region involved in learning and memory.
paras.zh: 他们的新实验也显示了海马体的好处，海马体是涉及学习和记忆的重要大脑区域。

paras.en: When rats with gut inflammation took creatine daily, the supplement successfully restored creatine levels in their hippocampus.
paras.zh: 当患有肠道炎症的老鼠每天服用肌酸时，该补充剂成功地恢复了其海马体中的肌酸水平。

paras.en: It also reduced inflammation and damage to neurons in this region.
paras.zh: 它还减少了该区域神经元的炎症和损伤。

paras.en: The results align with several preliminary studies linking creatine supplementation to improved brain health.
paras.zh: 该结果与几项初步研究一致，这些研究将补充肌酸与改善大脑健康联系起来。

paras.en: The brain is known to use a huge amount of the body's energy, and creatine plays an important role in maintaining our cellular energy balance.
paras.zh: 众所周知，大脑消耗大量的身体能量，而肌酸在维持我们的细胞能量平衡方面发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: For humans, a typical omnivorous diet involves about 1 to 2 grams of creatine a day. This natural organic compound is also made by the liver, the kidneys, and the pancreas.
paras.zh: 对于人类来说，典型的杂食性饮食每天大约需要 1 到 2 克肌酸。这种天然有机化合物也是由肝脏、肾脏和胰腺产生的。

paras.en: Once produced or consumed, it is mostly stored within muscle, but creatine can also cross the blood-brain barrier and be taken up by neurons and other brain cells.
paras.zh: 一旦产生或消耗，它主要储存在肌肉内，但肌酸也可以穿过血脑屏障并被神经元和其他脑细胞吸收。

paras.en: What it does once it is in the central nervous system is less clear.
paras.zh: 一旦进入中枢神经系统，它的作用就不太清楚了。

paras.en: This new research suggests that creatine supplements may impact the health and function of certain brain cells.
paras.zh: 这项新研究表明肌酸补充剂可能会影响某些脑细胞的健康和功能。

paras.en: The rodents in experiments were modeled on a human condition called ulcerative colitis, which, together with Crohn's disease, is considered a chronic inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).
paras.zh: 实验中的啮齿动物以一种称为溃疡性结肠炎的人类疾病为模型，这种疾病与克罗恩病一起被认为是一种慢性炎症性肠病（IBD）。

paras.en: Ulcerative colitis causes the immune system to attack the intestinal lining, leading to open sores in the colon and rectum.
paras.zh: 溃疡性结肠炎会导致免疫系统攻击肠道内壁，导致结肠和直肠出现开放性溃疡。

paras.en: But its symptoms are not confined to the gut. They are also apparent in the brain.
paras.zh: 但其症状并不局限于肠道。它们在大脑中也很明显。

paras.en: When IBD flares up and is considered 'active', patients often report brain fog, and display memory loss, attention deficits, and declining executive functions.
paras.zh: 当 IBD 发作并被认为是“活跃的”时，患者经常报告脑雾，并表现出记忆力减退、注意力缺陷和执行功能下降。

paras.en: In rats with colitis, previous studies have shown that the disease leads to greater inflammation in the hippocampus.
paras.zh: 在患有结肠炎的老鼠中，之前的研究表明，这种疾病会导致海马体出现更严重的炎症。

paras.en: Now, researchers in Spain have extended those results and shown that gut inflammation in rats can also lead to damage and dysfunction within hippocampal neurons.
paras.zh: 现在，西班牙的研究人员扩展了这些结果，并表明大鼠的肠道炎症也会导致海马神经元的损伤和功能障碍。

paras.en: The good news, however, is that oral doses of creatine seem to help.
paras.zh: 然而，好消息是口服肌酸似乎有帮助。

paras.en: In experiments, some rats were given water containing one gram of creatine per kilogram of their body weight.
paras.zh: 在实验中，一些老鼠被给予每公斤体重含有一克肌酸的水。

paras.en: Then 10 days later, the scientists induced symptoms of colitis. The daily creatine dose continued for the rest of the experiment.
paras.zh: 10天后，科学家们诱发了结肠炎症状。在实验的其余部分继续每日肌酸剂量。

paras.en: In rats that took creatine but didn't have colitis, researchers did not measure a significant change to creatine levels in the hippocampus.
paras.zh: 在服用肌酸但没有患结肠炎的老鼠中，研究人员没有测量到海马体肌酸水平的显着变化。

paras.en: But in rats with colitis, creatine improved several markers of healthy brain activity.
paras.zh: 但在患有结肠炎的老鼠中，肌酸改善了健康大脑活动的几个标志物。

paras.en: "The supplementation restored hippocampal creatine levels, preserved neuronal integrity, and normalized impaired excitability," the authors conclude.
paras.zh: 作者总结道：“补充剂恢复了海马肌酸水平，保留了神经元完整性，并使受损的兴奋性恢复正常。”

paras.en: Interestingly, the research team found that the benefits of creatine for male rats with colitis were more apparent than for females.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，研究小组发现肌酸对患有结肠炎的雄性大鼠的益处比雌性更明显。

paras.en: This is probably because in males, the brain damage associated with colitis seems to be worse than in the opposite sex.
paras.zh: 这可能是因为男性与结肠炎相关的脑损伤似乎比异性更严重。

paras.en: The findings suggest that some inflammatory conditions may impact the male and female brain differently, and that creatine supplementation may help prevent some of these ramifications.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，某些炎症状况可能对男性和女性大脑产生不同的影响，而补充肌酸可能有助于预防其中一些后果。

paras.en: "Beyond colitis, reduced brain creatine content has been linked to systemic and central nervous system inflammatory disorders, including neurodegeneration, traumatic brain injury, and neuropsychiatric disease," the authors explain.
paras.zh: “除了结肠炎之外，大脑肌酸含量减少还与全身和中枢神经系统炎症性疾病有关，包括神经变性、创伤性脑损伤和神经精神疾病，”作者解释道。

paras.en: But much of the research on creatine and the brain remains in the preclinical stage, so it is unclear how effective this supplement might be in humans.
paras.zh: 但大部分关于肌酸和大脑的研究仍处于临床前阶段，因此尚不清楚这种补充剂对人类的效果如何。

paras.en: Initial findings among rodents suggest that not everyone will benefit in the same way.
paras.zh: 在啮齿类动物中的初步研究结果表明，并非每个人都会以同样的方式受益。

paras.en: Earlier this year, on the Health vs Hype podcast, Jason Mitchell, the chief medical officer at healthcare company Geisinger, said that recent results on creatine and brain health were intriguing but hardly definitive.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，在 Health vs Hype 播客中，医疗保健公司 Geisinger 的首席医疗官杰森·米切尔 (Jason Mitchell) 表示，最近关于肌酸和大脑健康的结果很有趣，但很难确定。

paras.en: "We don't have the data to say, yeah, this is something you should be taking for your brain, but I don't want to discount that. There are some studies out there."
paras.zh: “我们没有数据表明，是的，这是你应该为大脑服用的东西，但我不想忽视这一点。有一些研究。”

paras.en: Researchers from Spain have now added another to the list.
paras.zh: 来自西班牙的研究人员现在又在名单中添加了另一个。

paras.en: The research has been published in Brain, Behavior, and Immunity.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《大脑、行为和免疫》杂志上。

articles.title: Astronomers Have Detected A Mysterious Signal Coming From Empty Space. Nobody Knows What It Is.
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: In the southern constellation of Fornax lies a tiny patch of sky just like any other. Your eyes may have brushed past it a hundred times without a thought.
paras.zh: 在天炉座南部，有一小片天空，就像其他天空一样。你的眼睛可能已经不假思索地与它擦肩而过一百次了。

paras.en: Yet this otherwise unremarkable speck of the cosmos is among the most well-cataloged in the sky. The Hubble Space Telescope stared at it for more than 270 hours to obtain its famous Ultra Deep Field (HUDF) – and contained therein are nearly 10,000 galaxies extending billions of light-years into the Universe.
paras.zh: 然而，这个看似不起眼的宇宙斑点却是天空中分类最齐全的斑点之一。哈勃太空望远镜对它进行了 270 多个小时的观察，以获得其著名的超深场 (HUDF)，其中包含近 10,000 个星系，延伸到数十亿光年的宇宙中。

paras.en: When the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) launched, it was only natural that its golden mirrors would turn to the same region of space, using its vastly more sensitive infrared capabilities to find what Hubble may have missed.
paras.zh: 当詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）发射时，它的金色镜子很自然地会转向同一空间区域，利用其更加灵敏的红外功能来寻找哈勃可能错过的东西。

paras.en: Now, it has revealed that a patch of space astronomers have been poring over for decades may yet hold some surprises.
paras.zh: 现在，它揭示了太空天文学家数十年来研究的一小片区域可能仍会带来一些惊喜。

paras.en: In a tiny corner of the tiny field, JWST detected a strange signal – not once, but twice, in observations nearly three months apart.
paras.zh: 在这片小田野的一个小角落里，JWST 检测到了一个奇怪的信号——不是一次，而是两次，观察间隔近三个月。

paras.en: There's just one problem. In every other prior observation from both JWST and Hubble, there's absolutely nothing there.
paras.zh: 只有一个问题。在 JWST 和哈勃望远镜之前的所有其他观测中，绝对没有任何东西。

paras.en: That doesn't mean that there is nothing there – there may be something otherwise too dim to detect that briefly unleashed a powerful flare – but it does make that signal a mystery that, currently, has no satisfying explanation.
paras.zh: 这并不意味着那里什么都没有——可能有一些东西太暗而无法探测到，短暂地释放了强大的耀斑——但它确实使这个信号成为一个谜，目前还没有令人满意的解释。

paras.en: To understand why this signal is so strange, though, first you need to know a little more about how astronomers study the Universe.
paras.zh: 然而，要理解为什么这个信号如此奇怪，首先你需要更多地了解天文学家如何研究宇宙。

paras.en: When you look into an optical telescope, you see an image formed from the light collected by its mirror. That's pretty much what you're looking at when you gaze upon the HUDF – a composite of images taken through different filters, each capturing a particular range of wavelengths.
paras.zh: 当您观察光学望远镜时，您会看到由镜子收集的光线形成的图像。当您凝视 HUDF 时，这几乎就是您所看到的——通过不同滤光片拍摄的图像的组合，每个滤光片捕获特定的波长范围。

paras.en: But some telescopes can also split light into different wavelengths – think of how a prism can split white light into a rainbow, but on a much more granular scale.
paras.zh: 但一些望远镜也可以将光分成不同的波长——想想棱镜如何将白光分成彩虹，但在更细粒度的尺度上。

paras.en: This can reveal features in the light that are hard to distinguish in a multi-wavelength image. For example, if you collect all the light from the Sun, it looks white; but when split into a spectrum, you'll see dark lines where specific wavelengths have been absorbed by atoms in the solar atmosphere.
paras.zh: 这可以揭示在多波长图像中难以区分的光特征。例如，如果你收集来自太阳的所有光，它看起来是白色的；但当分成光谱时，您会看到暗线，其中特定波长已被太阳大气中的原子吸收。

paras.en: Other objects produce bright lines instead, where atoms or molecules release energy as light at specific wavelengths. These are called emission lines.
paras.zh: 其他物体则产生亮线，其中原子或分子以特定波长的光形式释放能量。这些称为发射线。

paras.en: Astronomers use a technique called spectroscopy to detect these absorption and emission lines, a clever way to determine the chemical composition and other properties of astrophysical objects.
paras.zh: 天文学家使用一种称为光谱学的技术来检测这些吸收线和发射线，这是确定天体物理物体的化学成分和其他特性的巧妙方法。

paras.en: Astrophysicist Mason Huberty of the University of Minnesota and colleagues wanted to try something a little bit different.
paras.zh: 明尼苏达大学的天体物理学家梅森·休伯蒂和同事想要尝试一些不同的东西。

paras.en: Rather than using spectroscopy to study already known objects, they wanted to see if JWST's Near-Infrared Spectrograph (NIRSpec) could be used as a tool to find objects that hadn't been found yet.
paras.zh: 他们不想使用光谱学来研究已知的物体，而是想看看 JWST 的近红外光谱仪 (NIRSpec) 是否可以用作寻找尚未发现的物体的工具。

paras.en: Normally, astronomers select known targets from existing observations, and then position the instrument's tiny shutters so that light from the selected target enters the spectrograph. It's a really useful technique, with one limitation – it relies on knowing where the target is first.
paras.zh: 通常，天文学家从现有观测中选择已知目标，然后定位仪器的微型快门，以便来自所选目标的光进入光谱仪。这是一种非常有用的技术，但有一个限制——它依赖于知道目标首先在哪里。

paras.en: Huberty and his team did sort of the complete opposite.
paras.zh: 休伯蒂和他的团队做了完全相反的事情。

paras.en: They opened up nearly all the shutters, closing only those covering known foreground objects identified in previous Hubble observations, whose light could contaminate the spectra they wanted to collect.
paras.zh: 他们打开了几乎所有的百叶窗，只关闭那些覆盖先前哈勃观测中识别出的已知前景物体的百叶窗，这些物体的光可能会污染他们想要收集的光谱。

paras.en: Then, they split the light collected into spectra and searched the resulting data for emission lines.
paras.zh: 然后，他们将收集到的光分成光谱，并在所得数据中搜索发射线。

paras.en: And they did it twice – two observation windows, 88 days apart in August and November 2023, and – crucially – at different observation angles. This would help eliminate artifacts and glitches.
paras.zh: 他们做了两次——两个观察窗口，分别在 2023 年 8 月和 11 月，相隔 88 天，而且最重要的是——在不同的观察角度。这将有助于消除伪影和故障。

paras.en: The aim was to find faint, distant objects that conventional observations might have missed, using a technique called Multiobject Coronagraphy for Slitless Spectroscopy (MOCSS).
paras.zh: 其目的是使用一种称为无缝光谱多目标日冕术（MOCSS）的技术来寻找传统观测可能错过的微弱遥远天体。

paras.en: The HUDF was an ideal testing ground, with its wealth of existing observations allowing the researchers to check their results against known galaxies.
paras.zh: HUDF 是一个理想的试验场，其丰富的现有观测数据使研究人员能够根据已知星系检查他们的结果。

paras.en: And it worked. After all was said and done, six detections that passed their strict criteria could be matched to distant galaxies in the HUDF.
paras.zh: 它奏效了。总而言之，通过严格标准的六个探测结果可以与 HUDF 中的遥远星系相匹配。

paras.en: It was a single, bright line that appeared in both near-infrared observations at about 1.6 micrometers. In isolation, that's not so weird; near-infrared emission is super normal.
paras.zh: 这是一条约 1.6 微米的单条亮线，出现在两次近红外观测中。孤立地看，这并不奇怪。近红外发射超正常。

paras.en: It's the isolation that caused the drama. There was no other emission line accompanying it – and in prior observations from Hubble and JWST, nothing else could be seen in that patch of space.
paras.zh: 正是这种孤立造成了戏剧性的后果。没有其他发射线伴随它——而且在哈勃望远镜和 JWST 之前的观测中，在那片空间中看不到任何其他东西。

paras.en: It can't easily be explained away as a glitch, either. It appeared in all four sets of combined exposures, across both observing orientations, 88 days apart, and the measurements were consistent.
paras.zh: 它也不能轻易地被解释为一个小故障。它出现在所有四组组合曝光中，跨两个观察方向，相隔 88 天，并且测量结果是一致的。

paras.en: Here's the real kicker. The emission line was bright enough that it should have shown up in the earlier JWST images.
paras.zh: 这是真正的关键。发射线足够亮，应该会出现在早期的 JWST 图像中。

paras.en: Had it been present during JWST's JADES survey conducted in October 2022, there's no way the telescope could have missed it.
paras.zh: 如果它在 2022 年 10 月 JWST 进行的 JADES 巡天期间出现过，望远镜就不可能错过它。

paras.en: Which raises the possibility that maybe it wasn't present then.
paras.zh: 这就提出了一种可能性，即当时它并不存在。

paras.en: But just one line is really tricky to identify, unless you know exactly how far away it is. That's because, as space expands, it stretches light into redder and redder wavelengths.
paras.zh: 但只有一条线确实很难识别，除非你确切知道它有多远。这是因为，随着空间的膨胀，它会将光拉伸成越来越红的波长。

paras.en: So an infrared photon could be energetic light from really far away, or less energetic light from much closer; you need more information than just its wavelength to figure out which it is – and how it was produced.
paras.zh: 因此，红外光子可能是来自很远的地方的高能光，也可能是来自更近的地方的低能光。你需要更多的信息而不仅仅是它的波长来弄清楚它是什么以及它是如何产生的。

paras.en: There are several different things that maybe could have produced the emission line – with four main suspects, none of which fit the bill cleanly.
paras.zh: 有几种不同的东西可能会产生排放线——有四个主要嫌疑人，但没有一个完全符合要求。

paras.en: A galaxy in the early Universe is the first in the lineup, with two main problems – that emission line would struggle to travel through the neutral hydrogen that filled the early Universe, and it should have appeared in the JADES observations.
paras.zh: 早期宇宙中的星系是该系列中的第一个，它有两个主要问题——发射线很难穿过充满早期宇宙的中性氢，而且它应该出现在 JADES 观测中。

paras.en: A more recent galaxy could also be the culprit, but – in addition to the JADES problem – it should have other emission lines, not just the one.
paras.zh: 一个更新的星系也可能是罪魁祸首，但是——除了 JADES 问题之外——它应该还有其他发射线，而不仅仅是一条。

paras.en: It could have been a supernova, but again, it should have produced another emission line that wasn't detected.
paras.zh: 它可能是一颗超新星，但同样，它应该产生另一条未被检测到的发射线。

paras.en: And finally, a black hole tearing apart a star can produce a strong emission line, even without much other detectable light. But there's not enough evidence to establish that this is what happened.
paras.zh: 最后，即使没有太多其他可检测到的光，撕裂恒星的黑洞也可以产生强烈的发射线。但没有足够的证据证明这就是所发生的事情。

paras.en: Which means that there's only one thing to do.
paras.zh: 这意味着只有一件事要做。

paras.en: "This object is highly unusual and probes extreme physical conditions," the researchers write.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“这个物体非常不寻常，可以探测极端的物理条件。”

paras.en: "Follow-up observations are essential to confirm the redshift and determine the physical origin of the emission … Deeper, more sensitive spectroscopy could reveal additional emission lines and definitively establish the redshift and nature of the source."
paras.zh: “后续观测对于确认红移和确定发射的物理起源至关重要……更深、更灵敏​​的光谱可以揭示额外的发射线，并明确确定红移和源的性质。”

paras.en: The research has been published in The Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。

articles.title: Scientists reveal 93% of Australia's Indigenous population was lost in just 73 years

paras.en: Scientists reveal 93% of Australia's Indigenous population was lost in just 73 years
paras.zh: 科学家揭示澳大利亚93%的原住民人口在短短73年内消失

paras.en: - A groundbreaking study suggests that 2.22 million Indigenous Australians lived on the continent before European colonization, far more than previously believed. Researchers estimate that 93% of this population was lost within 73 years, revealing a demographic catastrophe on a scale that dramatically changes our understanding of Australian history.
paras.zh: - 一项开创性的研究表明，在欧洲殖民之前，有 222 万澳大利亚原住民生活在这片大陆上，远远超出了之前的预期。研究人员估计，93% 的人口在 73 年内消失，这揭示了一场人口灾难，其规模极大地改变了我们对澳大利亚历史的理解。

paras.en: New research suggests that Australia's Indigenous population before European colonization was far larger than historical estimates have indicated. Scientists now estimate that approximately 2.22 million Indigenous people lived across the continent before the arrival of the First Fleet in 1788, potentially up to seven times the number suggested by some earlier calculations.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，欧洲殖民之前澳大利亚的原住民人口远远多于历史估计。科学家们现在估计，在 1788 年第一舰队抵达之前，大约有 222 万原住民生活在这片大陆上，这一数字可能是一些早期计算得出的数字的七倍。

paras.en: The findings also reveal the devastating scale of the population decline that followed colonization. According to the researchers, an estimated 93% of Australia's Indigenous population was lost within less than 80 years of European arrival, a much greater decline than previously recognized.
paras.zh: 研究结果还揭示了殖民化后人口急剧下降的严重程度。据研究人员称，估计 93% 的澳大利亚原住民人口在欧洲人抵达后不到 80 年内就消失了，下降幅度比之前认识的要大得多。

paras.en: Professor Corey Bradshaw, a Global Ecology Professor at Flinders University and Chief Investigator at the Australian Research Council Centre of Excellence for Indigenous and Environmental Histories and Futures (CIEHF), contributed to the national research effort. Working alongside Indigenous partners, the team is investigating how Indigenous population numbers have changed throughout Australia's history.
paras.zh: 弗林德斯大学全球生态学教授、澳大利亚研究委员会土著和环境历史与未来卓越中心（CIEHF）首席研究员科里·布拉德肖（Corey Bradshaw）教授为国家研究工作做出了贡献。该团队与原住民合作伙伴合作，正在调查原住民人口数量在澳大利亚历史上是如何变化的。

paras.en: By combining advanced computer models with several sources of historical and scientific evidence, the researchers developed new estimates that substantially challenge previous assumptions.
paras.zh: 通过将先进的计算机模型与多种历史和科学证据来源相结合，研究人员得出了新的估计，极大地挑战了之前的假设。

paras.en: "Understanding the size of Indigenous populations in Australia before European invasion in 1788 is essential to truth-telling and reconciliation," says Professor Bradshaw.
paras.zh: “了解 1788 年欧洲入侵之前澳大利亚土著人口的规模对于讲真话与和解至关重要，”布拉德肖教授说。

paras.en: New Evidence Reveals Millions of Indigenous Australians Before Colonization
paras.zh: 新证据显示数百万澳大利亚原住民在殖民化之前

paras.en: To reconstruct Australia's Indigenous population before European settlement, the researchers brought together ethnographic observations, archaeological findings, genetic reconstructions, and computer models. They also examined how many people different environments across the continent could have supported.
paras.zh: 为了重建欧洲殖民之前澳大利亚的原住民人口，研究人员汇集了人种学观察、考古发现、遗传重建和计算机模型。他们还研究了整个大陆的不同环境可以支持多少人。

paras.en: Earlier population estimates often relied heavily on calculations made during the 1930s by anthropologist Alfred Radcliffe-Brown. His influential assessment placed Australia's Indigenous population before colonization at approximately 250,000 people.
paras.zh: 早期的人口估计通常在很大程度上依赖于人类学家阿尔弗雷德·拉德克利夫-布朗 (Alfred Radcliffe-Brown) 在 20 世纪 30 年代所做的计算。他的影响力评估显示，殖民前澳大利亚原住民人口约为 250,000 人。

paras.en: However, Radcliffe-Brown recognized that his estimate did not fully account for the devastating effects of deadly diseases, violence along colonial frontiers, and broader structural violence. Subsequent research has shown that these forces had a much greater impact than was historically acknowledged, suggesting that many early population figures were already substantial underestimates.
paras.zh: 然而，拉德克利夫-布朗承认，他的估计并未充分考虑致命疾病、殖民边境暴力以及更广泛的结构性暴力的破坏性影响。随后的研究表明，这些力量的影响比历史上承认的要大得多，这表明许多早期的人口数据已经被大大低估了。

paras.en: Using modeled and genetics-based estimates (supported by, but not relying on, historical or ethnographic accounts), the team calculated a median Indigenous population of 2.22 million before colonization. This corresponds to approximately 0.29 people per square kilometer across Australia.
paras.zh: 使用模型和基于遗传学的估计（得到历史或人种学记载的支持，但不依赖于此），该团队计算出殖民之前原住民人口中位数为 222 万。这相当于澳大利亚每平方公里大约有 0.29 人。

paras.en: The figure is substantially higher than earlier historical estimates, which generally ranged from 250,000 to 1 million people.
paras.zh: 这个数字大大高于早期的历史估计，一般在 25 万到 100 万人之间。

paras.en: Researchers believe those lower estimates were influenced by the widespread population losses caused by disease, frontier violence, and systemic oppression before the earliest Australian censuses were conducted.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这些较低的估计值是由于在澳大利亚最早进行人口普查之前，疾病、边境暴力和系统性压迫造成的广泛人口流失的影响。

paras.en: A Devastating 93% Population Collapse After 1788
paras.zh: 1788 年之后，毁灭性的 93% 人口锐减

paras.en: The revised population estimate also allowed scientists to calculate the scale of the demographic catastrophe that followed European colonization.
paras.zh: 修订后的人口估计数还使科学家能够计算出欧洲殖民统治后人口灾难的规模。

paras.en: Using their model alongside early census records, the researchers estimated that approximately 2.06 million excess deaths occurred between 1788 and 1861. That represents an average of roughly 28,200 excess deaths annually over the 73-year period.
paras.zh: 研究人员利用他们的模型和早期人口普查记录估计，1788 年至 1861 年间大约有 206 万人超额死亡。这意味着在 73 年期间，每年平均约有 28,200 人超额死亡。

paras.en: By 1861, the Indigenous population had declined to an estimated 7% of its size before colonization, representing a staggering 93% reduction.
paras.zh: 到 1861 年，土著人口估计已减少至殖民前规模的 7%，减少了 93%，令人震惊。

paras.en: "These devastating findings highlight the major impacts of invasion experienced by Indigenous Australians, and demonstrate their remarkable survival, resilience and recovery over the past century," says lead author Associate Professor Alan Williams, a Partner Investigator in CIEHF representing EMM Consulting and who is also an Adjunct Research Fellow at James Cook University.
paras.zh: “这些毁灭性的发现突显了澳大利亚原住民所经历的入侵的重大影响，并展示了他们在过去一个世纪中非凡的生存、复原力和恢复能力，”主要作者、代表 EMM Consulting 的 CIEHF 合作研究员、詹姆斯库克大学兼职研究员艾伦·威廉姆斯 (Alan Williams) 副教授说道。

paras.en: Although Australia's Indigenous population has increased since the 1950s, it has not yet returned to its estimated size before European arrival.
paras.zh: 尽管澳大利亚原住民人口自 20 世纪 50 年代以来有所增加，但尚未恢复到欧洲人到来之前的估计规模。

paras.en: According to the 2021 Australian census, the Indigenous population was approximately 37% of the study's estimated median population in 1788.
paras.zh: 根据 2021 年澳大利亚人口普查，1788 年土著人口约占该研究估计人口中位数的 37%。

paras.en: If population growth continues along current trends, the researchers project that Indigenous population numbers may not return to their estimated pre-colonial level until around 2047.
paras.zh: 如果人口继续按照目前的趋势增长，研究人员预计土著人口数量可能要到 2047 年左右才能恢复到殖民前的估计水平。

paras.en: What the Findings Mean for Australia's History
paras.zh: 研究结果对澳大利亚历史意味着什么

paras.en: Beyond revising historical population figures, the study highlights the long-lasting consequences of colonization for Indigenous Australians.
paras.zh: 除了修改历史人口数据之外，该研究还强调了殖民化对澳大利亚土著人的长期影响。

paras.en: The researchers say the scale of the demographic collapse has important implications for understanding intergenerational trauma, persistent disadvantage, and the development of policies that better support Indigenous communities.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，人口崩溃的规模对于理解代际创伤、持续的劣势以及制定更好支持原住民社区的政策具有重要意义。

paras.en: "The findings highlight the scale of demographic catastrophe experienced by Indigenous Australians due to colonization, with the implications being a heightened understanding of intergenerational trauma and to inform future policy that assists Indigenous people. In addition to recognizing this intergenerational trauma and disadvantage, it is also time to recognize intergenerational privilege," says co-author Distinguished Professor Lynette Russell of the Monash University Indigenous Studies Centre and CIEHF.
paras.zh: “研究结果突显了澳大利亚原住民因殖民化而经历的人口灾难的规模，其影响是加深对代际创伤的理解，并为未来帮助原住民的政策提供信息。除了认识到这种代际创伤和劣势之外，现在也是时候认识到代际特权了，”莫纳什大学原住民研究中心和 CIEHF 的共同作者、杰出教授 Lynette Russell 说。

paras.en: The findings also demonstrate why scientists must draw on several independent methods when reconstructing population histories, particularly when written records are incomplete, unreliable, or shaped by historical biases.
paras.zh: 研究结果还证明了为什么科学家在重建人口历史时必须利用几种独立的方法，特别是当书面记录不完整、不可靠或受到历史偏见影响时。

paras.en: By combining genetic research, archaeological evidence, environmental modeling, and historical information, the team was able to develop a more comprehensive picture of Australia's Indigenous population before and after European colonization.
paras.zh: 通过结合基因研究、考古证据、环境模型和历史信息，该团队能够更全面地了解欧洲殖民前后澳大利亚土著人口的情况。

paras.en: Distinguished Professor Larissa Behrendt AO, Chair of the CIEHF Centre Advisory Committee, says the findings demand a fundamental reassessment of the country's history while also recognizing the extraordinary endurance of Indigenous Australians.
paras.zh: CIEHF 中心咨询委员会主席、杰出教授 Larissa Behrendt AO 表示，调查结果要求对澳大利亚的历史进行根本性的重新评估，同时也要认识到澳大利亚原住民非凡的忍耐力。

paras.en: "These research findings challenge us to rethink the scale of what happened after 1788. We are not talking about a marginal consequence of colonization but a demographic catastrophe at the heart of the Australian story. But the research also tells us something extraordinary. Our survival is one of Australian history's most remarkable stories," said Distinguished Professor Larissa Behrendt AO Chair, CIEHF Centre Advisory Committee.
paras.zh: “这些研究结果要求我们重新思考 1788 年之后发生的事情的规模。我们谈论的不是殖民化的边际后果，而是澳大利亚故事核心的人口灾难。但这项研究也告诉我们一些非同寻常的事情。我们的生存是澳大利亚历史上最引人注目的故事之一，”CIEHF 中心咨询委员会主席、杰出教授 Larissa Behrendt AO 说道。

paras.en: The study, "Large size of the Australian Indigenous population prior to its massive decline following colonial invasion," was published in Nature Human Behaviour. Its authors are Alan Williams, Raymond Tobler, Billy Griffiths, Sean Ulm, Matthew Nitschke, Michael Bird, Shane Ingrey, Frédérik Saltré, Kirsty Beller, Ian McNiven, Nicholas Pitt, Lynette Russell, Alistair Paterson, Christopher Wilson, and Corey Bradshaw.
paras.zh: 这项研究发表在《自然·人类行为》杂志上，题为“澳大利亚原住民人口在殖民入侵后大幅下降之前的规模”。其作者包括艾伦·威廉姆斯、雷蒙德·托布勒、比利·格里菲思、肖恩·乌尔姆、马修·尼奇克、迈克尔·伯德、肖恩·英格雷、弗雷德里克·索尔特、科斯蒂·贝勒、伊恩·麦克尼文、尼古拉斯·皮特、莱内特·拉塞尔、阿利斯泰尔·帕特森、克里斯托弗·威尔逊和科里·布拉德肖。

paras.en: The research received joint funding from the Australian Research Council Centre of Excellence for Indigenous and Environmental Histories and Futures (CE230100009) and the Australian Research Council Centre of Excellence for Australian Biodiversity and Heritage (CE17010001).
paras.zh: 该研究获得了澳大利亚研究委员会土著和环境历史与未来卓越中心（CE230100009）和澳大利亚研究委员会澳大利亚生物多样性和遗产卓越中心（CE17010001）的联合资助。
