paras.zh: 基辅令人担忧的另一个原因可能是美国威胁暂停与乌克兰的情报共享并阻止 PURL（乌克兰优先需求清单）计划，除非乌克兰停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的攻击。根据PURL计划，欧洲国家为乌克兰采购美国武器。

paras.en: European alternatives to US intelligence
paras.zh: 美国情报的欧洲替代品

paras.en: A possible US decision to stop sharing intelligence with Ukraine for strikes on Russian territory would have "dramatic" consequences for Kyiv, Masala said, but European intelligence, particularly from France, could help mitigate the impact.
paras.zh: 马萨拉表示，美国可能决定停止与乌克兰分享有关袭击俄罗斯领土的情报，这将对基辅产生“巨大”后果，但欧洲情报，特别是来自法国的情报，可能有助于减轻影响。

paras.en: While French intelligence is "not as comprehensive as American intelligence," the Ukrainian military already uses it to carry out strikes in Russia with French weapons systems.
paras.zh: 虽然法国情报“不像美国情报那么全面”，但乌克兰军方已经利用法国的武器系统对俄罗斯进行了打击。

paras.en: As for the weapons European countries procure from the US for Ukraine under the PURL program, Masala noted that the program's most important component — interceptor missiles for air defense — has barely been available to Ukraine since the start of the war with Iran.
paras.zh: 至于欧洲国家根据PURL计划从美国为乌克兰采购的武器，马萨拉指出，自与伊朗的战争爆发以来，该计划最重要的组成部分——用于防空的拦截导弹——几乎没有提供给乌克兰。

paras.en: Support for Ukraine across both US parties
paras.zh: 美国两党对乌克兰的支持

paras.en: Ahead of the US midterm elections, experts point out that Ukraine enjoys broad support not only among Democrats but also among Republicans. One example is the bipartisan passage this summer of legislation to tighten US sanctions against Russia, known as the "Lindsey Graham Act," named after its Republican congressional sponsor, who has since died.
paras.zh: 美国中期选举前夕，专家指出，乌克兰不仅得到民主党的广泛支持，也得到共和党的广泛支持。一个例子是今年夏天两党通过了一项旨在加强美国对俄罗斯制裁的立法，该法案被称为“林赛·格雷厄姆法案”，以其共和党国会发起人的名字命名，但该法案现已去世。

paras.en: Signed by Trump in September, the law gives the president a broad range of tools. He can impose sanctions on Russian officials, oligarchs, financial institutions and Russia's shadow fleet, which is used to circumvent restrictions on oil exports. He can also impose punitive tariffs on buyers of Russian energy products.
paras.zh: 特朗普于 9 月签署了该法律，为总统提供了广泛的工具。他可以对俄罗斯官员、寡头、金融机构和俄罗斯用来规避石油出口限制的影子舰队实施制裁。他还可以对俄罗斯能源产品的买家征收惩罚性关税。

paras.en: "Trump may resist, but political forces, particularly after the US midterms, may push the administration in the direction of trying to seek an end to the war by using the tools available," former US diplomat Daniel Fried told DW.
paras.zh: 美国前外交官丹尼尔·弗里德 (Daniel Fried) 告诉德国之声：“特朗普可能会抵制，但政治力量，特别是在美国中期选举之后，可能会推动政府朝着利用现有工具寻求结束战争的方向发展。”

paras.en: He added that the "Lindsey Graham Act" and the 2022 law banning US imports of Russian oil are "not absolute, but strong barriers against dumb ideas like a unilateral unrequited diesel deal with Russia."
paras.zh: 他补充说，“林赛·格雷厄姆法案”和2022年禁止美国进口俄罗斯石油的法律“不是绝对的，而是对像与俄罗斯单方面无回报的柴油交易这样的愚蠢想法的强大障碍。”

paras.en: Several Democratic and Republican senators cited this legislation in a joint statement in which they described the diesel deal with Russia as illegal, calling on the US government to "immediately correct" its decision.
paras.zh: 几位民主党和共和党参议员在一份联合声明中引用了这项立法，他们在声明中称与俄罗斯的柴油交易是非法的，呼吁美国政府“立即纠正”其决定。

paras.en: This article was originally published in Ukrainian
paras.zh: 本文最初发表于乌克兰语

articles.title: OpenAI bugging suspect allegedly booked one-way trip to Saudi Arabia

paras.en: The Saudi national accused of bugging OpenAI’s headquarters booked a one-way flight to Saudi Arabia before his arrest, US prosecutors have alleged.
paras.zh: 美国检察官称，这名被指控窃听 OpenAI 总部的沙特国民在被捕前预订了飞往沙特阿拉伯的单程航班。

paras.en: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former OpenAI engineer, had been scheduled to fly to Saudi Arabia with his wife and another family member on October 12, prosecutors said in a court filing unsealed on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 检察官在周三公布的一份法庭文件中称，前 OpenAI 工程师 Abdulrahman Alfozan 原定于 10 月 12 日与妻子和另一名家庭成员飞往沙特阿拉伯。

paras.en: The FBI arrested Alfozan, who worked at OpenAI for about 15 months until his termination last week, on October 9, after OpenAI personnel reported the discovery of a hidden listening device in a conference room at the company’s San Francisco headquarters.
paras.zh: 10 月 9 日，FBI 逮捕了阿尔福赞，阿尔福赞在 OpenAI 工作了约 15 个月，直到上周被解雇，此前 OpenAI 人员报告称，在该公司旧金山总部的一间会议室中发现了隐藏的窃听设备。

paras.en: Alfozan, 35, has been charged with “using or endeavoring to use an electronic, mechanical, or other device to intercept oral communications”.
paras.zh: 35 岁的阿尔福赞被指控“使用或试图使用电子、机械或其他设备拦截口头通信”。

paras.en: The offence carries a maximum punishment of five years in prison and a $250,000 fine.
paras.zh: 该罪行最高可判处五年监禁和 25 万美元罚款。

paras.en: Prosecutors disclosed the alleged flight booking to a judge on October 8 in a motion seeking to seal the criminal complaint against Alfozan, arguing he had the “means – and will have an incentive – to flee” the United States.
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日，检察官在一项动议中向法官披露了所指控的航班预订情况，寻求封存针对阿尔福赞的刑事诉讼，称他“有手段——并且有动机——逃离”美国。

paras.en: William Pernik, Alfozan’s lawyer, said he and his client planned to contest the criminal allegations and his client’s ongoing detention in court.
paras.zh: 阿尔福赞的律师威廉·佩尔尼克表示，他和他的当事人计划在法庭上对刑事指控以及他当事人的持续拘留提出异议。

paras.en: “We trust that the American justice system will treat our client fairly, despite the narrative painted in the media at this time,” Pernik told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 佩尔尼克告诉半岛电视台：“我们相信美国司法系统会公平对待我们的当事人，尽管此时媒体上有这样的说法。”

paras.en: “Our client is a well regarded professional with long standing ties to the community,” Pernik added.
paras.zh: “我们的客户是一位备受尊敬的专业人士，与社区有着长期的联系，”佩尼克补充道。

paras.en: “He is presumed innocent and is entitled to fair treatment and due process of law. The emphasis on his national origin and therefore suggestions of lack of trustworthiness or flight risk harken back to dark chapters of our nation’s history that we intend to fight fully.”
paras.zh: “他被认为是无辜的，有权获得公平待遇和正当法律程序。对他的国籍的强调以及因此而导致的缺乏可信度或潜逃风险的暗示让人回想起我们国家历史上的黑暗篇章，而我们打算全力与之抗争。”

paras.en: Alfozan’s arrest has shone a spotlight on concerns that frontier tech firms are a target for spying and industrial espionage amid the global race to gain an upper hand in AI.
paras.zh: 阿尔福赞的被捕引发了人们的担忧，即在全球人工智能竞赛中，前沿科技公司成为间谍和工业间谍活动的目标。

paras.en: Before joining OpenAI in July last year, Alfozan worked as a systems engineer at Meta and interned at Microsoft, according to a LinkedIn profile in his name.
paras.zh: 根据他名下的 LinkedIn 个人资料，在去年 7 月加入 OpenAI 之前，Alfozan 曾在 Meta 担任系统工程师，并在微软实习。

paras.en: Alfozan is also listed as a venture partner at Raed Ventures, a Riyadh-based venture capital firm whose other partners include Prince Khalid bin Bandar bin Sultan bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, a member of the Saudi royal family.
paras.zh: Alfozan 还被列为 Raed Ventures 的风险合作伙伴，这是一家总部位于利雅得的风险投资公司，该公司的其他合作伙伴包括沙特王室成员哈立德·本·班达尔·本·苏丹·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·阿勒沙特王子。

paras.en: In a statement announcing Alfozan’s appointment in February 2025, Raed Ventures described the engineer as “a seasoned professional with extensive experience in tech startups” and said his role would involve “identifying promising investment opportunities and supporting startups on their journey toward growth and success”.
paras.zh: Raed Ventures 在 2025 年 2 月宣布任命 Alfozan 的声明中，将这位工程师描述为“一位经验丰富的专业人士，在科技初创企业方面拥有丰富的经验”，并表示他的职责将包括“识别有前途的投资机会，并支持初创企业走向成长和成功”。

articles.title: Argentina’s Milei backs Trump for US midterms, calls vote crucial for West

paras.en: Argentine President Javier Milei has urged his ally, US President Donald Trump, to come out of the United States midterm elections in a stronger position, calling the vote important for the West as a whole.
paras.zh: 阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱敦促他的盟友美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在美国中期选举中占据更有利的地位，称这次投票对整个西方都很重要。

paras.en: Milei made the appeal on Wednesday at a Hispanic Heritage gala in Washington, where a Hispanic association gave him an award, ahead of November’s vote.
paras.zh: 周三，米雷在华盛顿举行的拉美裔传统晚会上发出了呼吁，在 11 月投票之前，拉美裔协会为他颁发了奖项。

paras.en: Conservatives, he said, “cannot give an inch in our reconquest of the hemisphere”, according to Agence France-Presse (AFP).
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，他表示，保守派“在重新征服西半球的过程中不能让步”。

paras.en: Milei flew into the US capital on Wednesday for meetings with investors and the gala. He is due to address the US Chamber of Commerce on Thursday.
paras.zh: 米莱周三飞往美国首都参加与投资者的会面和晚会。他定于周四在美国商会发表讲话。

paras.en: Trump firmly backed Milei a year ago, when his government also faced crucial legislative elections. He has called Milei his “favorite president”.
paras.zh: 一年前，特朗普坚定支持米莱，当时他的政府也面临着关键的立法选举。他称米莱是他“最喜欢的总统”。

paras.en: That backing, together with a currency swap agreement with the US Treasury, helped Milei to success in those polls, analysts have argued.
paras.zh: 分析师认为，这种支持，加上与美国财政部达成的货币互换协议，帮助米雷在这些民意调查中取得了成功。

paras.en: The centrepiece of the package, announced by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, was a $20bn swap with Argentina’s central bank, in which the US exchanged dollars for pesos. The swap came shortly after Milei’s party lost a key provincial election.
paras.zh: 财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 宣布，该计划的核心内容是与阿根廷央行进行 200 亿美元的互换，即美国将美元兑换成比索。这次交换是在米莱的政党输掉一次重要的省级选举后不久进行的。

paras.en: Trump made clear at the time that the support hinged on a Milei victory. “I’m with this man because his philosophy is correct,” he said ahead of a White House lunch with the Argentine leader. “If he wins, we’re staying with him. And if he doesn’t win, we’re gone.”
paras.zh: 特朗普当时明确表示，支持率取决于米莱的胜利。 “我支持这个人，因为他的哲学是正确的，”他在白宫与阿根廷领导人共进午餐之前说道。 “如果他赢了，我们就会和他在一起。如果他没有赢，我们就离开。”

paras.en: Trump also warned that the US would not be “generous” if Milei lost. The remarks unsettled Argentine markets, with the main stock index giving up earlier gains and falling about 2 percent, The Associated Press reported.
paras.zh: 特朗普还警告称，如果米雷落败，美国不会“慷慨”。据美联社报道，这一言论令阿根廷市场感到不安，主要股指回吐早前涨幅，下跌约 2%。

paras.en: The package drew criticism in the US. Democratic lawmakers accused Trump of prioritising a foreign bailout while the US government was shut down.
paras.zh: 该计划在美国引起了批评。民主党议员指责特朗普在美国政府关闭时优先考虑外国救助。

articles.title: X suspends 13,000 accounts, alleging foreign influence ahead of US midterms

paras.en: The social media platform X has suspended more than 13,000 accounts related to three suspected foreign influence operations linked to Iran, Russia and China that sought to shape the political debate in the United States.
paras.zh: 社交媒体平台 X 已暂停了 13,000 多个与三个涉嫌外国影响力行动有关的账户，这些行动涉及伊朗、俄罗斯和中国，这些行动试图影响美国的政治辩论。

paras.en: The company announced the suspensions on Wednesday as it outlined measures ahead of the November 3 US midterm elections.
paras.zh: 该公司周三宣布暂停运营，并概述了 11 月 3 日美国中期选举前的措施。

paras.en: X said its investigations found the networks used fake accounts to post and amplify political content targeting candidates and public figures “across the political spectrum”.
paras.zh: X表示，其调查发现这些网络使用虚假账户发布和放大针对“各个政治派别”的候选人和公众人物的政治内容。

paras.en: The company said it identified the accounts through “proactive sweeps and investigations” under its rules against spam and coordinated inauthentic behaviour.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，根据其反垃圾邮件和协调不真实行为的规则，通过“主动扫描和调查”来识别这些帐户。

paras.en: “Free speech is the bedrock of a functioning democracy, and we are proud that X is the global town square where these debates happen. Our job is to keep that conversation authentic, open, and safe,” X Global Government Affairs said in announcing the suspensions.
paras.zh: “言论自由是民主运作的基石，我们很自豪 X 是发生这些辩论的全球城镇广场。我们的工作是保持对话真实、开放和安全，”X 全球政府事务部在宣布暂停时表示。

paras.en: X also outlined rules against misleading information regarding how, when or where to vote in the US midterms, as well as attempts to suppress turnout and voter intimidation, including calls for violence near polling stations.
paras.zh: X还概述了针对美国中期选举如何、何时或何地投票的误导性信息的规则，以及试图抑制投票率和恐吓选民的行为，包括呼吁在投票站附近实施暴力。

paras.en: The company said users can report election-related posts through the “civic integrity” option to request a community note providing context. In urgent cases, X may also apply labels to posts that violate its election rules in cases requiring attention, the platform said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，用户可以通过“公民诚信”选项举报与选举相关的帖子，以请求提供背景信息的社区说明。该平台表示，在紧急情况下，X还可能在需要关注的情况下对违反其选举规则的帖子贴上标签。

paras.en: The announcement comes a week after OpenAI said it had shut down two alleged influence operations from Russia and Iran that used ChatGPT to push fake journalist personas and run a “think-tank” that covertly spread anti-Ukraine propaganda.
paras.zh: 一周前，OpenAI 表示，它已经关闭了两个涉嫌来自俄罗斯和伊朗的影响力行动，这些行动利用 ChatGPT 推销假记者角色，并运营一个秘密传播反乌克兰宣传的“智囊团”。

paras.en: X has previously acted against suspected foreign influence networks. In 2021, Twitter, as X was then known, said it had suspended 238 accounts purportedly operating from Iran.
paras.zh: X 此前曾针对可疑的外国影响网络采取过行动。 2021 年，Twitter（当时名为 X）表示已暂停了 238 个据称在伊朗运营的账户。

articles.title: Trump's ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, resigns after allegations of improper conduct
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Trump's ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, resigns after allegations of improper conduct
paras.zh: 特朗普驻希腊大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔因不当行为指控而辞职

paras.en: WASHINGTON — The White House publicly asked for U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation on Tuesday as she faced mounting accusations of improper conduct, and she announced within two hours that she was quitting, ending days of talk and speculation about her professional fate. Guilfoyle insisted that she would "vigorously defend" herself.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——周二，白宫公开要求美国驻希腊大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔辞职，因为她面临着越来越多的不当行为指控，她在两小时内宣布辞职，结束了数天来有关她职业命运的讨论和猜测。吉尔福伊尔坚称她会“大力捍卫”自己。

paras.en: President Donald Trump's administration had said earlier Tuesday it had asked Guilfoyle to leave her post after she faced severe criticism over allegations she engaged in improper and possibly illegal conduct before and during her tenure in Athens.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府周二早些时候表示，吉尔福伊尔因在雅典任职之前和任职期间从事不当甚至可能非法行为的指控而受到严厉批评，因此已要求她辞职。

paras.en: That revelation came in response to a question to freshly minted White House press secretary Katie Zacharia at her first media briefing Tuesday morning. Zacharia said Guilfoyle "has been a wonderful asset to the team, and we wish her well."
paras.zh: 这一消息是在周二上午的首次媒体吹风会上回答新任白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚提出的问题时透露的。扎卡里亚表示，吉尔福伊尔“对团队来说是一笔宝贵的财富，我们祝愿她一切顺利。”

paras.en: "She went to Greece. She was doing a good job, but we didn't like what we were reading," Trump said just after Guilfoyle's resignation, which was posted on her X account. He said he had not spoken to her but "she will not be there."
paras.zh: “她去了希腊。她做得很好，但我们不喜欢我们读到的内容，”特朗普在吉尔福伊尔辞职后说道，辞职发布在她的 X 账户上。他说他没有和她说过话，但“她不会在那里。”

paras.en: Guilfoyle's departure comes after its possibility was previewed to The Associated Press over the weekend and Trump registered his unhappiness on Monday at reports about her alleged conduct. Those comments came a day after the AP, citing a senior U.S. official, reported that Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio were "extremely pissed off" by Guilfoyle's reported conduct.
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔的离职是在周末向美联社预演的，特朗普周一对有关她涉嫌行为的报道表示不满。这些评论是在美联社援引一名美国高级官员的话报道后一天发表的，特朗普和国务卿马可·鲁比奥对吉尔福伊尔报道的行为“非常愤怒”。

paras.en: Guilfoyle denies the accusations and cites her 'decades of public service'
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔否认这些指控并引用了她“数十年的公共服务”

paras.en: In a series of stories dating to late last month, The Wall Street Journal has reported questionable conduct by Guilfoyle, including an alleged threat to a host country official, accepting improper gifts and services and offering to use her influence inside the Republican administration in return for the payment of a large credit card bill.
paras.zh: 在上个月末的一系列报道中，《华尔街日报》报道了吉尔福伊尔的可疑行为，包括涉嫌威胁东道国官员、接受不当礼物和服务以及提出利用她在共和党政府内部的影响力以换取大笔信用卡账单。

paras.en: Guilfoyle addressed the accusations directly in her resignation post on X, saying, "These allegations are false, and I intend to vigorously defend my name, my reputation, and my integrity."
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔在 X 的辞职帖子中直接回应了这些指控，她说：“这些指控是虚假的，我打算大力捍卫我的名字、我的声誉和我的正直。”

paras.en: "I have dedicated my professional life to fighting for justice, standing up for what is right, and defending the values that make America exceptional," she said. "I will not allow false accusations to define my decades of public service."
paras.zh: 她说：“我的职业生涯致力于为正义而战，捍卫正义，捍卫使美国与众不同的价值观。” “我不会允许虚假指控来定义我数十年的公共服务。”

paras.en: In a statement released late Sunday, Guilfoyle's lawyers denied that she had done anything wrong and claimed that the money she was seeking from a Trump donor was payment for services — public appearances and speaking engagements that predate her ambassadorial nomination — that had not been paid.
paras.zh: 在周日晚间发布的一份声明中，吉尔福伊尔的律师否认她做错了任何事，并声称她向特朗普捐助者寻求的资金是她尚未支付的服务费用——在她获得大使提名之前的公开露面和演讲活动。

paras.en: The lawyers, David Schwartz and Jesse Binnall, also rejected allegations of impropriety related to Guilfoyle's travel on private planes, saying that before every such trip she "sought, obtained and followed State Department guidance and followed the Department's travel regulations."
paras.zh: 律师大卫·施瓦茨（David Schwartz）和杰西·宾纳尔（Jesse Binnall）也驳回了与吉尔福伊尔乘坐私人飞机旅行有关的不当行为的指控，称在每次此类旅行之前，她“都寻求、获得并遵循国务院的指导，并遵守国务院的旅行规定”。

paras.en: They did not immediately return calls Tuesday.
paras.zh: 他们周二没有立即回电。

paras.en: The allegations began surfacing weeks ago
paras.zh: 这些指控几周前就开始浮出水面

paras.en: After defending Guilfoyle following the first report, Rubio declined to comment publicly on the growing allegations. Last week, Rubio said: "Our ambassador has been a strong ambassador here."
paras.zh: 在第一份报告后为吉尔福伊尔辩护后，卢比奥拒绝就日益增多的指控公开发表评论。上周，卢比奥表示：“我们的大使在这里一直是一位强有力的大使。”

paras.en: But after another report appeared later, Rubio — speaking Thursday before leaving Athens — berated journalists for asking about the allegations. He said that he didn't know if they were true and that he would not respond if he could not confirm them.
paras.zh: 但在另一份报道出现后，卢比奥周四在离开雅典之前发表讲话，斥责记者询问这些指控。他表示，他不知道这些消息是否属实，如果无法证实，他不会回应。

paras.en: "You guys walk around thinking that because some source told you something and you reported it, it's the gospel. It's not the gospel. It's not the gospel for me. That's not the way we do things," Rubio said at the foot of his plane as Guilfoyle, who was there to see him depart, looked on.
paras.zh: 卢比奥在飞机脚下说道：“你们四处走动，认为因为某个消息来源告诉了你们一些事情，而你们报道了，那就是福音。这不是福音。这对我来说不是福音。这不是我们做事的方式。”卢比奥在飞机脚下说道，吉尔福伊尔在现场目送他离开。

paras.en: A second U.S. official, who also spoke on the condition of anonymity to discuss personnel matters, said the State Department's inspector general was looking into the allegations, which first began surfacing in the Journal late last month and have since multiplied.
paras.zh: 另一位因讨论人事问题而不愿透露姓名的美国官员表示，国务院监察长正在调查这些指控，这些指控上个月末首次出现在《华尔街日报》上，此后数量不断增加。

paras.en: The second official could not say if a formal IG probe had begun. Inspectors general often conduct informal inquiries into complaints against staffers, and many times those inquiries do not result in a full-on investigation, which can result in disciplinary action up to and including dismissal. The State Department has declined to comment on a potential IG investigation.
paras.zh: 第二名官员无法透露 IG 的正式调查是否已经开始。监察长经常对针对工作人员的投诉进行非正式调查，很多时候这些调查不会导致全面调查，这可能会导致纪律处分，甚至解雇。美国国务院拒绝就监察长办公室可能进行的调查发表评论。

paras.en: There was no immediate response to Zacharia's statement from the Greek government or Cabinet members.
paras.zh: 希腊政府或内阁成员没有立即回应扎卡里亚的声明。

paras.en: Ahead of Tuesday's announcement, Greek opposition parties had called on the Foreign Ministry to summon Guilfoyle to respond to the allegations made against her. "This, most importantly, is an issue of national dignity," Sia Anagnostopoulou, a former deputy foreign minister, said in parliament Friday. Foreign Minister Giorgos Gerapetritis responded that Guilfoyle had been treated "the same way as every other ambassador" and argued that an official summons had not been necessary.
paras.zh: 在周二宣布这一消息之前，希腊反对党呼吁外交部传唤吉尔福伊尔，以回应针对她的指控。 “最重要的是，这是一个国家尊严问题，”前外交部副部长西亚·阿纳格诺斯托普卢周五在议会表示。外交部长乔治·杰拉佩特里蒂斯回应称，吉尔福伊尔受到“与其他大使一样的对待”，并辩称没有必要发出正式传票。

paras.en: Hours earlier, Guilfoyle had posted photos of her meeting this week with the Spanish ambassador to Athens as well as birthday wishes for Lara Trump, the president's daughter-in-law, accompanied by Dua Lipa's "Dance the Night," from the 2023 soundtrack of the movie "Barbie."
paras.zh: 几个小时前，吉尔福伊尔发布了她本周与西班牙驻雅典大使会面的照片，以及对总统儿媳劳拉·特朗普的生日祝福，并配上了杜阿·利帕 (Dua Lipa) 2023 年电影《芭比娃娃》原声带中的《舞夜》。

paras.en: Greece has taken on an increasingly important and influential role because of its geographic location in Southeastern Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean, particularly on energy issues as the war with Iran has spiked global oil prices. Besides the vast number of Greek-registered oil tankers that regularly ply the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea, Greece is well positioned to be a pipeline conduit for liquefied natural gas imports into the Balkans and beyond.
paras.zh: 由于其位于东南欧和东地中海的地理位置，希腊发挥着越来越重要和有影响力的作用，特别是在能源问题上，因为与伊朗的战争导致全球油价飙升。除了大量在希腊注册的油轮定期往返于霍尔木兹海峡和红海之外，希腊还处于有利位置，可以成为向巴尔干及其他地区进口液化天然气的管道。

paras.en: As the U.S. ambassador to Greece, Guilfoyle had put an emphasis on energy issues, although her close association with executives in that sector was part of what got her into trouble.
paras.zh: 作为美国驻希腊大使，吉尔福伊尔一直强调能源问题，尽管她与该行业高管的密切联系是她陷入困境的部分原因。

paras.en: The top two Democrats on the House Foreign Affairs and Senate Foreign Relations committees, Rep. Gregory Meeks of New York and Sen. Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire, as well as the ranking member on the House Committee for Oversight and Government Reform, Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif., have already called for an investigation into Guilfoyle.
paras.zh: 众议院外交事务委员会和参议院外交关系委员会的两位民主党领袖，纽约众议员格雷戈里·米克斯和新罕布什尔州参议员珍妮·沙欣，以及众议院监督和政府改革委员会的高级成员、加利福尼亚州民主党众议员罗伯特·加西亚，已经呼吁对吉尔福伊尔进行调查。

paras.en: Since late September, the Journal has detailed numerous accounts of questionable conduct by Guilfoyle. Its first report said that she had told guests at a reception that the United States could undermine the Greek government if it chose to, promoted the business interests of one particular Greek construction and energy company and allowed its lobbyist into private diplomatic meetings.
paras.zh: 自九月底以来，《华尔街日报》详细报道了吉尔福伊尔的大量可疑行为。第一份报告称，她在一次招待会上告诉客人，如果美国愿意的话，美国可以削弱希腊政府，促进某家特定希腊建筑和能源公司的商业利益，并允许其游说者参加私人外交会议。

paras.en: While Rubio was in Athens, the Journal reported — citing text messages — that Guilfoyle had asked a Trump donor and supporter to pay a $100,000 credit card bill just before her confirmation hearing, promising him access to administration officials if he did.
paras.zh: 当卢比奥在雅典时，《华尔街日报》援引短信报道称，吉尔福伊尔在她的确认听证会之前要求特朗普的一位捐助者和支持者支付 10 万美元的信用卡账单，并承诺如果他这样做，他可以与政府官员会面。

paras.en: The Journal then reported that Guilfoyle had been enraged about not being invited to a Greek-themed event at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, earlier this year and demanded to attend while boasting about luxury travel to France with energy company executives.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》随后报道称，吉尔福伊尔对今年早些时候没有被邀请参加在瑞士达沃斯举行的世界经济论坛上以希腊为主题的活动感到愤怒，并要求参加，同时吹嘘与能源公司高管一起前往法国的豪华旅行。

paras.en: Another report, from the British tabloid The Daily Mail, said that Guilfoyle had alienated staff at the U.S. Embassy in Athens and had pushed the bounds of behavior appropriate for the top representative of the U.S. government to Greece.
paras.zh: 英国小报《每日邮报》的另一篇报道称，吉尔福伊尔疏远了美国驻雅典大使馆的工作人员，并突破了美国政府驻希腊最高代表的行为界限。

paras.en: Guilfoyle is a former Fox News Channel host and California prosecutor who was married to Democrat Gavin Newsom when he was San Francisco's mayor, before he became California's governor. She later was engaged to Trump's son Donald Trump Jr.
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔是前福克斯新闻频道主持人和加州检察官，在担任旧金山市长期间与民主党人加文·纽瑟姆结婚，后来成为加州州长。她后来与特朗普的儿子小唐纳德·特朗普订婚。

articles.title: Aboard an icebreaker, a writer got a closer look at the Arctic's 'Sea Change'
articles.author: Dave Davies

paras.en: Aboard an icebreaker, a writer got a closer look at the Arctic's 'Sea Change'
paras.zh: 在破冰船上，一位作家近距离观察了北极的“海洋变化”

paras.en: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar got an up-close look aboard the USS Healy, a Coast Guard icebreaker. She says that traversing the North Pole by ship — once a "largely conceptual" route — is now becoming a "real possibility" for two or three weeks a year.
paras.zh: 随着北极极地冰层融化，航道正在开放，使该地区成为超级大国竞争的新区域。作家拉纳·福鲁哈尔 (Rana Foroohar) 登上海岸警卫队破冰船希利号 (USS Healy) 进行了近距离观察。她说，乘船穿越北极——曾经是一条“很大程度上是概念性的”路线——现在正成为每年两到三周的“真正的可能性”。

paras.en: "If you are taking one of these Arctic routes, you can save as much as 40% of the time it would take you to go from the Atlantic to the Pacific, and depending on the price of oil, that's a heck of a lot of money," she says. "China and Russia together are clearly trying to make the top of the world an area over which they have the most interest."
paras.zh: “如果你选择其中一条北极航线，你可以节省多达 40% 的时间，从大西洋到太平洋，而且根据石油价格，这是一笔很大的钱，”她说。 “中国和俄罗斯显然正在共同努力使世界之巅成为他们最感兴趣的地区。”

paras.en: In her new book, Sea Change: America's New Great Game in the Arctic Circle, Foroohar makes the case that the "High North" may become as critical to world shipping as the Suez or Panama canals. But she also notes that beneath the Arctic waters are large deposits of oil, natural gas and rare earth minerals, as well as underwater cables, which carry a large part of the world's intercontinental information flow.
paras.zh: 福鲁哈尔在她的新书《海洋变化：美国在北极圈的新大博弈》中指出，“高北地区”可能会像苏伊士运河或巴拿马运河一样对世界航运至关重要。但她也指出，北极水域下方蕴藏着大量石油、天然气和稀土矿物，还有水下电缆，承载着世界洲际信息流的很大一部分。

paras.en: "Undersea cables have become a real touchstone in wars and conflicts around the world," she says. "So you are seeing a race to lay down new cable, and who can get there fastest, and then who can potentially commercialize and even militarize areas where those cables have been laid."
paras.zh: “海底电缆已成为世界各地战争和冲突的真正试金石，”她说。 “因此，你会看到一场铺设新电缆的竞赛，谁能最快到达那里，然后谁有可能将这些电缆已铺设的地区商业化甚至军事化。”

paras.en: Foroohar describes the Arctic Circle as one of the few areas of the globe where countries and companies can still "hunt" for territory and "duke it out potentially with rivals." And she predicts more conflict in the coming decades as the region continues to warm.
paras.zh: 福罗哈尔将北极圈描述为全球少数几个国家和公司仍然可以“寻找”领土并“与竞争对手一决高下”的地区之一。她预计，随着该地区持续变暖，未来几十年将会发生更多冲突。

paras.en: "There is going to be more commerce done through this area. There is gonna be greater military interest in the area, and all of that matters because it really is in America's backyard," she says. "I just think that everything in the High North is going to be higher priority for America in the future."
paras.zh: “将会有更多的商业活动通过这个地区进行。该地区将会有更大的军事利益，所有这些都很重要，因为它确实是在美国的后院，”她说。 “我只是认为，未来高北地区的一切都将成为美国更优先考虑的事情。”

paras.en: On increased international interest in the Arctic
paras.zh: 国际社会对北极兴趣的增加

paras.en: China and Russia together are clearly trying to make the top of the world an area over which they have the most interest. And that's very interesting because it starts to dovetail with something that's happening in U.S. policy, which is more of a sense of we need to protect what's close to home. And so if you look at things that way, then you have the U.S. and China coming into much closer geographic conflict. Whether or not it would ever be a hot conflict, I hope not, but certainly competition in that area.
paras.zh: 中国和俄罗斯显然正在共同努力使世界之巅成为他们最感兴趣的地区。这非常有趣，因为它开始与美国政策中正在发生的事情相吻合，这更多的是我们需要保护离家较近的东西。因此，如果你这样看问题，那么美国和中国就会陷入更加密切的地理冲突。无论这是否会成为一场激烈的冲突，我希望不会，但肯定是该领域的竞争。

paras.en: On the debate over rights to resources in international waters
paras.zh: 关于国际水域资源权的争论

paras.en: There's some debate over that. There is something called the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, which governs maritime activities, including those in the Arctic. It has ... rules about where you can mine, how you can mine, who gets what. But the U.S. never signed on to that convention. Various presidents from Clinton to Bush [to] Obama did support it, but key Republican senators opposed it, basically on ideological grounds, the notion that no international body should have sovereign right over what the U.S. does. ... And so it makes it much more of a free-for-all as to who gets what in the Arctic. And then you throw in the fact that Russians and Chinese don't always play by the U.N. rules either.
paras.zh: 对此存在一些争论。有一个叫做《联合国海洋法公约》的公约，它管辖海上活动，包括北极地区的活动。它有......关于你可以在哪里开采、如何开采、谁得到什么的规则。但美国从未签署该公约。从克林顿到布什到奥巴马，多位总统都支持它，但主要的共和党参议员反对它，基本上是出于意识形态的原因，即任何国际机构都不应该对美国的行为拥有主权。 ......因此，这使得北极地区的竞争变得更加自由。然后你再说一个事实，俄罗斯人和中国人也不总是遵守联合国规则。

paras.en: On how Arctic power struggles are part of a larger global trend
paras.zh: 关于北极权力斗争如何成为更大的全球趋势的一部分

paras.en: It's kind of part and parcel of a bigger collapse of international rule and a pendulum shift from globalization to something that is much more about regionalization and spheres of power ... and influence, which is exactly what's happening in the Arctic, which to me is so interesting, not only just for itself, but because it's a mirror into what's happening in other parts of the world. Some of the same conflicts over territory and mineral rights and ports that you see in the Arctic now are also happening in Latin America or West Africa or parts of the South China Sea. So it's a bit of a bellwether for geostrategy more broadly. …
paras.zh: 这是国际规则更大崩溃的重要组成部分，也是从全球化转向更加注重区域化和权力范围……和影响力的钟摆的一部分，这正是北极正在发生的事情，对我来说，这非常有趣，不仅是为了它本身，而且因为它是世界其他地区正在发生的事情的一面镜子。现在在北极看到的一些关于领土、矿权和港口的冲突也发生在拉丁美洲、西非或南中国海的部分地区。因此，它可以说是更广泛的地缘战略的风向标。 ……

paras.en: And then there's this — kind of largely theoretical up until now, but becoming more realistic — trans-polar route where right now it might be a couple of weeks that you could consider going right across the pole, but if global warming continues the way it seems to be going in the next decade or two, that could turn into a month, two months, three months. And so who's going to control that area? This is what's up for stake now.
paras.zh: 然后是这种——到目前为止主要是理论上的，但变得更加现实——跨极地路线，现在你可能需要几周的时间才能考虑直接穿越极地，但如果全球变暖在未来一两年内继续下去，这可能会变成一个月、两个月、三个月。那么谁将控制该地区呢？这就是现在的赌注。

paras.en: On what it's like to be onboard an Arctic icebreaker
paras.zh: 关于登上北极破冰船的感觉

paras.en: You begin to feel and hear the ice as it is being broken by the ship. And I remember being down on the mess hall, which is a couple floors down from the waterline, and I was sitting eating my lunch and you begin to hear this shhhhhh kind of sound, like something traveling through sound, and then it becomes squeaky, like fingers on chalkboard, and you can kind of feel vibration and it gets louder and louder and you're like, "Wow, there are only 12 inches of reinforced steel between me and death." That's very sobering.
paras.zh: 当冰被船打破时，你开始感觉到并听到冰。我记得在距离水线几层楼的食堂里，我坐着吃午饭，你开始听到这种“嘘”的声音，就像有什么东西在声音中传播，然后它变得吱吱作响，就像手指在黑板上一样，你可以感觉到振动，它变得越来越大，你会想，“哇，我和死亡之间只有 12 英寸的钢筋。”这非常发人深省。

paras.en: I actually touched base with some of those scientists several months after we had come off of the Healy, and they were starting to go through that data and look at it. And there is some real scientific data showing that these areas are changing. They are warming. They are becoming different than they have been in the past. And that affects all kinds of things. It affects the kind of fish that could live there. It affects wind and wave patterns that you might get, which could in turn affect things like the Canadian boreal forest fires that I experience in my home in Brooklyn, New York. You would think that has nothing to do with the Arctic, but it actually has everything to do with what's happening in the High North.
paras.zh: 实际上，在我们离开希利号几个月后，我就与其中一些科学家取得了联系，他们开始仔细检查这些数据并进行研究。并且有一些真实的科学数据表明这些领域正在发生变化。他们正在变暖。他们正在变得与过去不同。这会影响到各种各样的事情。它会影响那里生活的鱼类种类。它会影响你可能遇到的风和波浪模式，这反过来又可能影响我在纽约布鲁克林家中经历的加拿大北方森林火灾。你可能会认为这与北极无关，但实际上它与高北地区发生的事情有关。

paras.en: Therese Madden and Susan Nyakundi produced and edited this interview for broadcast. Bridget Bentz, Molly Seavy-Nesper and Beth Novey adapted it for the web.
paras.zh: Therese Madden 和 Susan Nyakundi 制作并编辑了本次采访并进行广播。 Bridget Bentz、Molly Seavy-Nesper 和 Beth Novey 将其改编为网络版。

articles.title: Tony Dungy tells Sage Steele that NBC wasn't happy with his pro-life views: 'They knew where I stood'

paras.en: Legendary NFL head coach and football analyst Tony Dungy is not going to apologize for being convicted in his religious beliefs.
paras.zh: NFL 传奇主教练兼足球分析师托尼·邓吉 (Tony Dungy) 不会因为宗教信仰被定罪而道歉。

paras.en: Dungy spent years as an analyst on NBC, sharing his insight after a 13-year head coaching career in the NFL and a Super Bowl championship with the Indianapolis Colts. But curiously, despite his popularity and wealth of experience, Dungy and NBC parted ways in early 2026.
paras.zh: 邓吉在 NBC 担任分析师多年，分享了他在 NFL 13 年主教练生涯以及随印第安纳波利斯小马队夺得超级碗冠军后的见解。但奇怪的是，尽管邓吉颇受欢迎且经验丰富，他还是在 2026 年初与 NBC 分道扬镳。

paras.en: He told former ESPN personality Sage Steele that he had a sneaking suspicion as to why. During a recent, lengthy interview on "The Sage Steele Show", Dungy explained what he believed led to his exit and why he doesn't regret what he did.
paras.zh: 他告诉前 ESPN 名人 Sage Steele，他隐隐怀疑其中的原因。在最近“圣人斯蒂尔秀”的一次冗长采访中，邓吉解释了他认为导致他退出的原因以及为什么他不后悔自己所做的事情。

paras.en: Steele brought up NBC, then said from the outside, it seemed like it "was tied to you being more and more vocal about your beliefs with faith, with being pro-life."
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔提到了 NBC，然后从外部来看，这似乎“与你越来越多地表达自己的信仰、反堕胎有关”。

paras.en: Dungy didn't deny it, saying he felt that it wasn't always appreciated that he spoke out about his faith.
paras.zh: 邓吉没有否认，他说他觉得人们​​并不总是赞赏他说出自己的信仰。

paras.en: "There are some things that, I guess in TV especially, they want you to be careful because they want to attract everybody. They want to have an audience of everyone. They don’t always appreciate you speaking about your faith. But for me, I’m always going to do that. I'm going to try and do it in a respectful way, but people are going to know that I’m a Christian."
paras.zh: “有些事情，我想尤其是在电视上，他们希望你要小心，因为他们想吸引所有人。他们希望拥有所有人的观众。他们并不总是欣赏你谈论你的信仰。但对我来说，我总是会这样做。我会尝试以尊重的方式这样做，但人们会知道我是基督徒。”

paras.en: Relatedly, Dungy also spoke at the "March for Life" event, which he later told Steele was not a popular decision with the NBC brass. Steele asked Dungy if he'd asked permission before speaking, to which he confirmed he hadn't.
paras.zh: 与此相关的是，邓吉也在“生命游行”活动中发表了讲话，他后来告诉斯蒂尔，这并不是 NBC 高层的一个受欢迎的决定。斯蒂尔问邓吉在讲话前是否征求过许可，邓吉证实没有。

paras.en: "And they were not happy that I went because … their point is, ‘Hey, we’ve got audience on all sides of the spectrum. We don’t want to push away anyone just making statements like that.’ And I said, ‘Well, I get it, but this is an important topic to me. I was asked to speak and because it was important to me, I did.’"
paras.zh: “他们对我去不高兴，因为……他们的观点是，‘嘿，我们有来自各个方面的观众。我们不想把任何发表这样言论的人推开。’我说，‘好吧，我明白了，但这对我来说是一个重要的话题。我被邀请发言，因为这对我来说很重要，我就这么做了。’”

paras.en: Steele interjected, saying that he kept talking about it anyway, including making posts on social media.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔插嘴说，无论如何，他一直在谈论这件事，包括在社交媒体上发帖。

paras.en: "They knew where I stood. I knew where they stood… there are some things I’m not going to try to turn an audience away, but things that are important to me I’m going to talk about. If somebody asked me a question about my faith and am I a Christian, I’m not going to say no. I’m not going to shy away from it."
paras.zh: “他们知道我的立场。我知道他们的立场……有些事情我不会试图把观众拒之门外，但对我来说重要的事情我会谈论。如果有人问我关于我的信仰的问题，我是基督徒吗，我不会说不。我不会回避它。”

paras.en: When Steele wondered whether he'd thought of backing off his public statements on faith and being pro-life, Dungy again said no. "I said I've got to do it in the right way, and I can't do it in a belligerent manner."
paras.zh: 当斯蒂尔想知道他是否考虑过放弃关于信仰和反堕胎的公开声明时，邓吉再次表示没有。 “我说过我必须以正确的方式去做，我不能以好斗的方式去做。”

paras.en: Then he makes the important distinction: "You're also not doing it on 'Sunday Night Football.' I'm not going to use that platform as, 'Oh, by the way, stop talking about the game tonight. Let me just make a point about abortion.'"
paras.zh: 然后他做出了重要的区分：“你也不会在‘周日橄榄球之夜’上这样做。我不会使用这个平台，‘哦，顺便说一句，今晚别再谈论游戏了。让我谈谈堕胎问题。”

paras.en: A few minutes later, Dungy admitted that he was "pretty sure" his time at the network would be coming to an end over publicly sharing his religious views.
paras.zh: 几分钟后，邓吉承认，由于公开分享他的宗教观点，他“非常确定”他在该网络的时间即将结束。

paras.en: "I was pretty sure it was. There were things that they didn't want me to talk about and we had a good understanding. They knew who I was when I got hired and, you know, it is what it is."
paras.zh: “我很确定是这样。有些事情他们不想让我谈论，我们有很好的理解。当我被雇用时，他们知道我是谁，你知道，事情就是这样。”

paras.en: Though he knew it was coming, Dungy didn't go as far as saying that's definitively why he was let go. When asked directly, he said, "I don't know. And it really doesn't matter."
paras.zh: 尽管邓吉知道这一天即将到来，但他并没有说这就是他被解雇的明确原因。当被直接问到时，他说：“我不知道。而且这真的不重要。”

paras.en: Another "job" Dungy lost? He was taken off the Hall of Fame voting committee. When Steele brought that up, potentially wondering if that too was related to his public comments, he said he was told it was completely unrelated, "I don't know exactly, they said that they wanted to go from 50 voters to 25. They thought it would make an easier process."
paras.zh: 邓吉又失去了一份“工作”？他被排除在名人堂投票委员会之外。当斯蒂尔提出这个问题时，可能想知道这是否也与他的公开评论有关，他说他被告知这完全无关，“我不太清楚，他们说他们想从 50 名选民增加到 25 名。他们认为这会让过程更容易。”

paras.en: It's interesting to contrast how NBC apparently handled Dungy's public statements of faith, and how that relates to his views on abortion, with how many networks have little problem with comments supporting the political left or left-wing issues.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，对比 NBC 显然如何处理邓吉的公开信仰声明，以及这与他对堕胎的看法有何关系，以及有多少电视网对支持政治左翼或左翼问题的评论没有什么问题。

paras.en: Does anyone really believe that NBC would have a problem if one of their football analysts appeared at a "No Kings" protest? Or a pro-choice march? Or spoke about gun control? Of course not. The concerns over political topics only ever go in one direction. Because the right is viewed as divisive by liberal corporations, and the left is viewed as empathetic common sense.
paras.zh: 有人真的相信 NBC 的一名足球分析师出现在“禁止国王”抗议活动中会有问题吗？还是支持堕胎的游行？或者谈到枪支管制？当然不是。对政治话题的担忧只会朝一个方向发展。因为右派被自由主义企业视为分裂，而左派则被视为具有同理心的常识。

articles.title: Trump wishes Pope Leo speedy recovery after lung cancer diagnosis, speaks highly of pontiff's brother

paras.en: President Donald Trump wished Pope Leo XIV a speedy recovery Wednesday following his lung cancer diagnosis, revealing that he is friends with the pontiff's brother, whom he described as an enthusiastic MAGA supporter.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周三在诊断出肺癌后祝愿教皇利奥十四世早日康复，并透露他是教皇兄弟的朋友，他称教皇兄弟是一位热心的 MAGA 支持者。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters aboard Air Force One while traveling from Arizona to Montana, Trump expressed optimism about the 71-year-old pontiff's recovery following surgery to remove part of his right lung.
paras.zh: 特朗普在从亚利桑那州飞往蒙大拿州的空军一号上对记者发表讲话，对这位 71 岁的教皇在接受部分右肺切除手术后的康复情况表示乐观。

paras.en: "I want to see Pope Leo get well. I hear the prognosis for that type of a problem. It's a cancer. It's big stuff. Anytime you have cancer," the president said. "But the prognosis seems to be good, I've watched. And we just want to wish him our love and our best wishes."
paras.zh: “我希望看到利奥教皇康复。我听到了这类问题的预后。这是一种癌症。这是一件大事。任何时候你患有癌症，”总统说。 “但我看过，预后似乎不错。我们只想向他表达我们的爱和最美好的祝愿。”

paras.en: Trump then discussed his friendship with the pope's brother and his wife, describing them as enthusiastic supporters of the president.
paras.zh: 特朗普随后讨论了他与教皇的兄弟和他的妻子的友谊，称他们是总统的热情支持者。

paras.en: "His brother is a friend of mine, who's a great — he's a fantastic guy — and his wife. You know, they're big Trump supporters. They have MAGA all over their house," he continued. "And I can say that his brother loves him a lot. Loves the pope a lot, and that's good, but I just want to wish him well. Get better fast."
paras.zh: “他的兄弟是我的一个朋友，他是一个很棒的人，他是一个很棒的人，还有他的妻子。你知道，他们是特朗普的坚定支持者。他们的房子里到处都是‘让美国再次伟大’，”他继续说道。 “我可以说，他的兄弟非常爱他。非常爱教皇，这很好，但我只想祝他一切顺利。快点好起来。”

paras.en: The president's remarks came one day after the Vatican announced that Leo had been diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, a form of lung cancer, following surgery at Agostino Gemelli University Hospital in Rome.
paras.zh: 总统发表上述言论的一天前，梵蒂冈宣布利奥在罗马阿戈斯蒂诺·杰梅利大学医院接受手术后被诊断出患有肺腺癌（肺癌的一种形式）。

paras.en: According to the Holy See Press Office, doctors removed the lower lobe of the pontiff's right lung during a procedure that lasted approximately 90 minutes. Doctors reported no complications.
paras.zh: 据教廷新闻办公室称，医生在持续约 90 分钟的手术中切除了教宗右肺下叶。医生报告没有并发症。

paras.en: The Vatican said the cancer diagnosis was confirmed through an examination of tissue collected during surgery, consistent with findings from tests conducted before the procedure.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈表示，癌症诊断是通过对手术期间收集的组织进行检查而确认的，这与手术前进行的测试结果一致。

paras.en: Leo had previously disclosed that doctors discovered a small lump in his lung at an early stage and recommended surgery. Following the operation, he awoke normally and returned to his hospital room after a brief observation period, according to the Vatican.
paras.zh: Leo此前曾透露，医生在早期发现他的肺部有一个小肿块，建议进行手术。据梵蒂冈称，手术后，他正常醒来，并在短暂观察后返回病房。

paras.en: Fox News Digital's Anders Hagstrom and Jasmine Baehr contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道的 Anders Hagstrom 和 Jasmine Baehr 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Brewers steal Game 3 on Dodgers' home turf to go up 3-0, pushing LA to brink of elimination

paras.en: The Milwaukee Brewers pushed the Los Angeles Dodgers to the brink of elimination Wednesday night with a 6-2 Game 3 victory at Dodger Stadium.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，密尔沃基酿酒人队在道奇体育场以 6-2 战胜洛杉矶道奇队，将洛杉矶道奇队逼到了淘汰的边缘。

paras.en: One win now separates Milwaukee from completing the sweep and returning the favor for last year's NLCS.
paras.zh: 现在，密尔沃基队只需一场胜利就能完成横扫并回报去年 NLCS 的青睐。

paras.en: Jackson Chourio ambushed Blake Snell’s first pitch of the night for a leadoff blast, and Robert Gasser protected the lead with five shutout frames.
paras.zh: 杰克逊·乔里奥（Jackson Chourio）伏击了布雷克·斯内尔（Blake Snell）当晚的第一个投球，取得了领先优势，罗伯特·加塞尔（Robert Gasser）以五个绝杀帧保护了领先优势。

paras.en: After the Dodgers briefly went ahead in the sixth on Will Smith’s two-run double, Milwaukee answered in three batters. Snell walked Andrew Vaughn to open the seventh before Jake Bauers won an 11-pitch battle with a go-ahead, two-run missile. Garrett Mitchell hammered the next pitch over the wall to chase Snell and make it 4-2.
paras.zh: 在道奇队凭借威尔·史密斯的两分双打在第六局短暂领先后，密尔沃基队以三名击球手回应。斯内尔保送安德鲁·沃恩 (Andrew Vaughn) 进入第七洞，随后杰克·鲍尔斯 (Jake Bauers) 凭借一记领先的两分导弹赢得了 11 场比赛。加勒特·米切尔 (Garrett Mitchell) 下一球越过人墙追击斯内尔 (Snell)，将比分改写为 4-2。

paras.en: A wild pitch in the eighth, a Joey Ortiz RBI single in the ninth, and 3.2 scoreless relief innings from DL Hall and Trevor Megill finished the job.
paras.zh: 第八局的疯狂投球，第九局乔伊·奥尔蒂斯打点单打，DL Hall 和特雷弗·梅吉尔的 3.2 分救援局完成了任务。

paras.en: For the first time in the Shohei Ohtani era, the Dodgers look utterly spent. This series has mirrored the 2004 NBA Finals, when the Detroit Pistons dismantled the Shaq-and-Kobe Lakers through relentless collective force. There are no 2024 Tommy Edman heroics and no 2025 Ohtani masterclasses to save them.
paras.zh: 在大谷翔平时代，道奇队第一次显得精疲力竭。这个系列赛与 2004 年 NBA 总决赛如出一辙，当时底特律活塞队通过无情的集体力量击败了沙克和科比组成的湖人队。没有 2024 年汤米·埃德曼 (Tommy Edman) 的英雄事迹，也没有 2025 年大谷 (Ohtani) 的大师班来拯救他们。

paras.en: This year, with nobody willing to sound the alarm, an exhausted lineup is simply dragging bats through the zone with so little fight that fans online have cynically wondered if LA is throwing the series to kill the sport's salary-cap debate.
paras.zh: 今年，没有人愿意敲响警钟，精疲力竭的阵容只是拖着球棒穿过区域，几乎没有任何战斗，以至于网上的粉丝们愤世嫉俗地怀疑洛杉矶是否会放弃这个系列赛来平息这项运动的工资上限争论。

paras.en: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts offered the only posture left for a manager running out of runway.
paras.zh: 道奇队主教练戴夫·罗伯茨为冲出跑道的主教练提供了唯一的姿势。

paras.en: "You just gotta win tomorrow," Roberts said. "We've just got to get a win and find a way to build some momentum."
paras.zh: “你明天必须赢，”罗伯茨说。 “我们必须赢得一场胜利，并找到一种方法来建立一些动力。”

paras.en: After the win, Bauers noted that last year's squad "flew to LA knowing we were heading to a funeral," while this group arrived fully expecting to win.
paras.zh: 获胜后，鲍尔斯指出，去年的球队“知道我们要去参加葬礼而飞往洛杉矶”，而这支球队抵达时完全期待着胜利。

paras.en: The Dodgers built what was supposed to be an indestructible machine. Milwaukee has reduced it to a team on fumes, with a chance to lower the casket Thursday night in Game 4.
paras.zh: 道奇队打造了一台坚不可摧的机器。密尔沃基队已经将其降级为一支陷入困境的球队，并有机会在周四晚上的第四场比赛中降下棺材。

paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Victoria to become first state to make abortions free as Coalition matches Labor election promise
articles.author: Benita Kolovos Victorian state correspondent

paras.en: Victoria will become the first state in Australia to make access to abortion care free, no matter who wins the November election, with the Coalition matching Labor’s promise just hours after it was announced as it attempts to neutralise the issue.
paras.zh: 无论谁赢得 11 月的选举，维多利亚州都将成为澳大利亚第一个提供免费堕胎服务的州，联盟党在宣布这一承诺几小时后就兑现了工党的承诺，试图解决这一问题。

paras.en: The opposition leader, Jess Wilson, on Thursday afternoon told Guardian Australia a Liberal National Coalition government would match Labor’s commitment to cover out-of-pocket costs for abortion care up to 16 weeks’ gestation. This would include GP and specialist consultations, scans, tests or medication, which can quickly add up to more than $1,000.
paras.zh: 周四下午，反对党领袖杰西·威尔逊 (Jess Wilson) 告诉澳大利亚卫报，自由党全国联盟政府将履行工党的承诺，承担妊娠 16 周以内的堕胎护理费用。这包括全科医生和专家咨询、扫描、测试或药物治疗，这些费用很快就会超过 1,000 美元。

paras.en: The commitment means Victoria will become the first state in Australia to offer free universal access to abortion services, following the Australian Capital Territory which began covering out-of-pocket costs in 2023.
paras.zh: 这一承诺意味着，继澳大利亚首都特区于 2023 年开始承担自付费用之后，维多利亚州将成为澳大利亚第一个免费普及堕胎服务的州。

paras.en: The Coalition would also expand the Victorian patient transport assistance scheme so that women in regional Victoria who must travel long distances for abortion care would also be eligible for subsidised travel and accommodation.
paras.zh: 联盟还将扩大维多利亚州患者交通援助计划，以便维多利亚州地区必须长途跋涉进行堕胎护理的妇女也将有资格获得旅行和住宿补贴。

paras.en: “The Liberals and Nationals will not allow Labor to play politics on this issue,” Wilson said.
paras.zh: “自由党和国家党不会允许工党在这个问题上玩弄政治，”威尔逊说。

paras.en: “Labor has had 12 years to improve access to healthcare but are instead choosing to play politics.”
paras.zh: “工党有 12 年的时间来改善医疗保健的普及，但现在却选择玩弄政治。”

paras.en: However, the Victorian opposition would not match Labor’s commitment to extend access to medical abortion from nine to 10 weeks’ gestation or its plan to commission a clinical review into whether it could safely be offered at up to 12 weeks’ gestation.
paras.zh: 然而，维州反对党不会兑现工党的承诺，将药物流产范围从妊娠 9 周延长至 10 周，也不会委托临床审查是否可以安全地在妊娠 12 周以内提供药物流产。

paras.en: Currently, medical abortion is subsidised through the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme for use up to nine weeks but the World Health Organization’s guidance allows for up to 12.
paras.zh: 目前，药物流产通过药物福利计划获得补贴，有效期最长为 9 周，但世界卫生组织的指导允许最多 12 周。

paras.en: “Only Labor will protect a woman’s right to choose,” Labor’s health minister, Ingrid Stitt, said when she announced the election commitment on Thursday morning.
paras.zh: “只有工党才能保护女性的选择权，”工党卫生部长英格丽德·斯蒂特(Ingrid Stitt)在周四上午宣布选举承诺时表示。

paras.en: Stitt’s statement suggested that One Nation could use abortion as a negotiating chip with the Coalition in the event of a hung parliament. It read: “Polling shows the Liberals and One Nation can only form a government together. And One Nation wants to make abortion a criminal offence.”
paras.zh: 斯蒂特的声明暗示，如果出现悬浮议会，一国党可以利用堕胎作为与联盟党的谈判筹码。上面写着：“民意调查显示自由党和一国党只能共同组建政府。而一国党希望将堕胎定为刑事犯罪。”

paras.en: However, Wilson on Thursday again ruled out changes to abortion laws under a Coalition government.
paras.zh: 然而，威尔逊周四再次排除了联合政府领导下修改堕胎法的可能性。

paras.en: “Victorians know where I stand on this issue. There will be no changes to abortion laws under a government I lead. Full stop. And I think it’s incredibly disappointing to see Labor playing politics with women’s reproductive rights five minutes before an election,” she said.
paras.zh: “维多利亚州人知道我在这个问题上的立场。在我领导的政府领导下，堕胎法不会有任何改变。完全停止。我认为在选举前五分钟看到工党在妇女生殖权利问题上玩弄政治是非常令人失望的，”她说。

paras.en: Wilson has previously described abortion as a personal decision that should be made by women in consultation with healthcare professionals.
paras.zh: 威尔逊此前曾将堕胎描述为个人决定，应由女性在咨询医疗保健专业人员后做出。

paras.en: The premier, Ben Carroll, earlier on Thursday said Labor “decriminalised abortion and we will stand up for it” as he warned that One Nation posed a threat.
paras.zh: 周四早些时候，州长本·卡罗尔 (Ben Carroll) 表示，工党“将堕胎合法化，我们将支持它”，同时他警告说，一国党构成了威胁。

paras.en: “Let’s be very clear: you’ve seen the leader of One Nation very clearly say that he wants to roll back access to abortion. He wants to rob women of their right to choose their own future,” Carroll told reporters.
paras.zh: 卡罗尔对记者说：“我们要明确一点：你已经看到一国党领导人非常明确地表示，他希望减少堕胎。他想剥夺妇女选择自己未来的权利。”

paras.en: Abortion was decriminalised in Victoria in 2008, with women able to obtain a termination during the first 24 weeks of pregnancy, and later if they obtain the agreement of two doctors.
paras.zh: 2008年，维多利亚州将堕胎合法化，妇女可以在怀孕的前24周内终止堕胎，随后如果获得两名医生的同意，则可以终止堕胎。

articles.title: Indonesia fights fire with dry ice as toxic haze spreads across region
articles.author: Kate Lamb and agencies

paras.en: As fires ravage Indonesia, emitting a toxic smoke that has drawn the ire of regional neighbours, the government is testing an unusual new approach to tackle the haze: dry ice.
paras.zh: 随着火灾肆虐印度尼西亚，释放出的有毒烟雾引起了地区邻国的愤怒，政府正在测试一种不同寻常的新方法来应对雾霾：干冰。

paras.en: Having tried cloud seeding, water bombing and sending in army personnel to fight the fires, Indonesia’s coordinating security minister said dry ice would be dropped on the province of South Sumatra on Thursday.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚协调安全部长在尝试了播云、水弹和派遣军队人员灭火后表示，周四将在南苏门答腊省投放干冰。

paras.en: “This trial of dry ice dispersal is being conducted under the president’s direct instruction to help tackle the haze in South Sumatra,” minister Dudung Abdurachman, was quoted as saying by state news agency Antara.
paras.zh: 国家通讯社安塔拉援引部长杜东·阿卜杜拉赫曼的话说：“这项干冰驱散试验是在总统的直接指示下进行的，以帮助解决南苏门答腊省的雾霾问题。”

paras.en: “We will first observe the results, and if effective, there is a possibility that this method could be implemented in other regions.”
paras.zh: “我们会先观察结果，如果有效的话，这个方法有可能在其他地区推广。”

paras.en: Since January, almost 900,000 hectares have been burned Indonesia-wide in the worst fire season in more than a decade, exacerbated by this year’s “godzilla” El-Nino and as the practice of “slash and burn” to clear land for crops such as palm oil persists.
paras.zh: 自一月以来，印度尼西亚全国近 90 万公顷土地被烧毁，这是十多年来最严重的火灾季节，今年的“哥斯拉”厄尔尼诺现象以及为种植棕榈油等作物而开垦土地的“刀耕火种”做法持续存在，加剧了这一情况。

paras.en: For months, millions of Indonesians have been subject to thick smoke and an apocalyptic tangerine haze, with criticism mounting of the government’s response, including a class action lawsuit filed last week accusing it of “gross negligence”. Tens of thousands of people have sought treatment for respiratory illness linked to the haze.
paras.zh: 几个月来，数百万印度尼西亚人一直生活在浓烟和末日般的橘红色烟雾中，对政府反应的批评越来越多，包括上周提起的集体诉讼，指控政府“重大过失”。数以万计的人因与雾霾有关的呼吸道疾病而寻求治疗。

paras.en: Air quality has also plummeted in neighbouring countries, shuttering schools, grounding flights and driving a spike in respiratory illness.
paras.zh: 邻国的空气质量也大幅下降，导致学校关闭、航班停飞，导致呼吸道疾病激增。

paras.en: The haze has drifted into neighbouring Singapore, Malaysia and as far afield as the Philippines. Timor-Leste has said it would shut schools nationwide for three days from Thursday and urged families to keep children indoors or to use “respiratory protection” if going outside.
paras.zh: 雾霾已经飘到邻国新加坡、马来西亚，甚至远至菲律宾。东帝汶表示，从周四开始，全国学校将关闭三天，并敦促家庭将孩子留在室内，或在外出时使用“呼吸防护装置”。

paras.en: Singapore rolled out subsidies for haze-related medical treatment starting on Monday, a measure last activated in 2015 when similar blazes occurred. The city-state has also begun distributing N95 masks to eligible residents.
paras.zh: 新加坡从周一开始推出针对雾霾相关医疗的补贴，上一次启动这项措施是在 2015 年，当时发生了类似的火灾。该城邦还开始向符合条件的居民分发 N95 口罩。

paras.en: In the past week, the financial hub of Singapore was listed among the most polluted cities globally. Kuala Lumpur, also deeply affected, was at number two.
paras.zh: 过去一周，新加坡金融中心被列为全球污染最严重的城市之一。吉隆坡也深受影响，排名第二。

paras.en: On Thursday, a Cessna aircraft will reportedly disperse 1.5 tons of dry ice over the South Sumatran city of Palembang, a move the government hopes will ease the smoke and improve air quality and visibility.
paras.zh: 据报道，周四，一架塞斯纳飞机将在南苏门答腊省巨港市上空撒播 1.5 吨干冰，政府希望此举能够缓解烟雾并改善空气质量和能见度。

paras.en: The technique was first deployed in the 1940s to promote ice formation in clouds, Bloomberg reported.
paras.zh: 据彭博社报道，该技术于 20 世纪 40 年代首次采用，用于促进云中冰的形成。

paras.en: But experts say the use of dry ice, or solid carbon dioxide, might only offer local, and limited relief.
paras.zh: 但专家表示，使用干冰或固体二氧化碳可能只能提供局部且有限的缓解。

paras.en: “It’s got some potential for local relief that might work for a while,” says Rick McRae, an adjunct professor from the University of New South Wales’ (UNSW) bushfire research group.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士大学 (UNSW) 丛林火灾研究小组的兼职教授里克·麦克雷 (Rick McRae) 表示：“它对当地救援有一定的潜力，可能会持续一段时间。”

paras.en: “Weather systems are all moving from east to west. So if you’re in a town under that and you clear the smoke, there’s gonna be more blowing all the time,” he says, “So it’s a constant … It’s not going to be simple and it’s not going to be a permanent fix in any way.”
paras.zh: “天气系统都在从东向西移动。所以，如果你在这样的城镇里，并且清除了烟雾，就会一直有更多的风，”他说，“所以这是一个恒定的......这不会很简单，也不会以任何方式永久解决。”

paras.en: In the Indonesian province of central Kalimantan on Wednesday, the ISPU air pollution index exceeded 1,200 – or four times the “hazardous” level of 300 – environment ministry data showed.
paras.zh: 环境部数据显示，周三，印度尼西亚中部加里曼丹省的 ISPU 空气污染指数超过 1,200，是“危险”水平 300 的四倍。

paras.en: Local news footage showed thick haze blanketing the provincial city of Palangka Raya, cutting visibility for motorists to a minimum.
paras.zh: 当地新闻画面显示，厚重的雾霾笼罩着省城帕朗卡拉亚，使驾车者的能见度降至最低。

paras.en: Indonesian president Prabowo Subianto has ordered firefighting efforts to be stepped up, and called for a crackdown on those suspected of starting fires.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏比安托已下令加强灭火工作，并呼吁严厉打击涉嫌纵火的人。

paras.en: But the government has struggled to combat the fires, the worst of occur in peatland areas, which can burn for weeks underground and are difficult to extinguish.
paras.zh: 但政府一直在努力扑灭火灾，最严重的火灾发生在泥炭地地区，这些火灾可以在地下燃烧数周，而且很难扑灭。

paras.en: “As time goes by and climate change kicks in, I think it could become a global problem, not just the fix that one country needs to find,” said McRae, of the widening regional issue. “There’s a lot of interconnectedness on a global scale.”
paras.zh: “随着时间的推移和气候变化的开始，我认为这可能成为一个全球性问题，而不仅仅是一个国家需要找到的解决方案，”麦克雷在谈到日益扩大的区域问题时说道。 “全球范围内存在很多相互联系。”

articles.title: Australian politics live: Shoebridge denies knowing about Steele-John allegations and says he’s entitled to fair process
articles.author: Krishani Dhanji

paras.en: Shoebridge denies knowing about Steele-John allegations
paras.zh: 舒布里奇否认了解斯蒂尔-约翰的指控

paras.en: Asked if he knew about the allegations or was aware of rumours about Jordon Steele-John, Shoebridge responds:
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否知道这些指控或了解有关乔丹·斯蒂尔·约翰的谣言时，舒布里奇回应道：

paras.en: No, I received the correspondence in my capacity as leader of the Australian Greens, and I’ve dealt with it with the urgency which I think is appropriate.
paras.zh: 不，我以澳大利亚绿党领袖的身份收到了这封信，并且我已经以我认为适当的紧急程度处理了它。

paras.en: Shoebridge states inquiry by WA Greens will be independent
paras.zh: Shoebridge表示西澳绿党的调查将是独立的

paras.en: Shoebridge defers several questions, saying there needs to be a “fair and independent” inquiry.
paras.zh: 舒布里奇推迟了几个问题，称需要进行“公平和独立”的调查。

paras.en: That inquiry will be done by the WA Greens.
paras.zh: 该调查将由西澳绿党进行。

paras.en: Shoebridge is asked if that’s really “independent” if a branch of the organisation is investigating its own.
paras.zh: 舒布里奇被问到，如果该组织的一个分支机构正在调查自己的分支机构，这是否真的“独立”。

paras.en: I have confidence that there will be that degree of independence.I have confidence, that the independence is necessary for all parties to be involved, it is not my role and it would be inappropriate for me as the leader of the Australian in the federal parliament to be imposing controls on that.
paras.zh: 我有信心会有这种程度的独立性。我有信心，独立性对于所有各方参与都是必要的，这不是我的角色，而且我作为联邦议会中的澳大利亚领导人对此施加控制是不合适的。

paras.en: Asked if the party is in disarray, Shoebridge says the party has been united and effective in the Senate this sitting week.
paras.zh: 当被问及该党是否陷入混乱时，舒布里奇表示，本周该党在参议院的表现是团结且有效的。

paras.en: Shoebridge denies knowing about Steele-John allegations
paras.zh: 舒布里奇否认了解斯蒂尔-约翰的指控

paras.en: Asked if he knew about the allegations or was aware of rumours about Jordon Steele-John, Shoebridge responds:
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否知道这些指控或了解有关乔丹·斯蒂尔·约翰的谣言时，舒布里奇回应道：

paras.en: No, I received the correspondence in my capacity as leader of the Australian Greens, and I’ve dealt with it with the urgency which I think is appropriate.
paras.zh: 不，我以澳大利亚绿党领袖的身份收到了这封信，并且我已经以我认为适当的紧急程度处理了它。

paras.en: Steele-John entitled to fair process, says Shoebridge
paras.zh: 舒布里奇表示，斯蒂尔-约翰有权享有公平的程序

paras.en: The Greens leader, David Shoebridge, is addressing the media following claims in the Nine newspapers of Jordon Steele-John making inappropriate comments to women.
paras.zh: 绿党领袖大卫·舒布里奇 (David Shoebridge) 在九号报纸声称乔丹·斯蒂尔·约翰 (Jordon Steele-John) 对女性发表不当言论后向媒体发表讲话。

paras.en: Steele-John has taken leave from the party room after complaints were made, triggering an independent review.
paras.zh: 在收到投诉后，斯蒂尔-约翰已离开聚会室，引发了独立审查。

paras.en: Shoebridge tells journalists Steele-John asked to temporarily leave the party room and he accepted that request.
paras.zh: 舒布里奇告诉记者，斯蒂尔-约翰要求暂时离开聚会室，他接受了这一请求。

paras.en: He says he won’t “be engaging in a running commentary on the matter”.
paras.zh: 他表示，他不会“对此事进行持续评论”。

paras.en: I received correspondence in relation to Senator Steele-John earlier this week and I want to be clear that I in the party room take these matters incredibly seriously. And [once] matters like this are raised they require a fair and independent and timely process for them to be dealt with. The WA Greens are commissioning that process and the matter has been referred across to the WA Greens for that process.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，我收到了与参议员斯蒂尔-约翰有关的信件，我想明确表示，我在党室里非常认真地对待这些问题。一旦提出此类问题，就需要一个公平、独立和及时的流程来处理。西澳绿党正在委托该流程，此事已提交给西澳绿党进行该流程。

paras.en: Liberal MP Mary Aldred is next and asks the small business minister how much the trust tax will add to the cost of housing, with more than 60,000 small businesses in the construction sector operating as a trust.
paras.zh: 接下来是自由党议员 Mary Aldred，她向小企业部长询问信托税将增加多少住房成本，建筑行业有超过 60,000 家小企业以信托形式运营。

paras.en: Assistant treasurer Daniel Mulino takes the question again.
paras.zh: 助理财务主管丹尼尔·穆利诺再次回答这个问题。

paras.en: He says there are mechanisms for small businesses to more easily be able to handle their tax affairs – called schedule two and schedule three.
paras.zh: 他说，小企业有一些机制可以更轻松地处理其税务事务，称为附表二和附表三。

paras.en: Schedule two contains a mechanism by which it is possible for a business to move to a corporate structure, and there will be rollover relief
paras.zh: 附表二包含一种机制，通过该机制，企业可以转变为公司结构，并且将有展期减免

paras.en: Schedule three relates to an election method, which is something which has been added again after stakeholder consultation, and that will provide for relief, which includes in our advice relief from state transaction taxes.
paras.zh: 附表三涉及选举方法，这是在利益相关者协商后再次添加的内容，并且将提供减免，其中包括我们的建议减免州交易税。

paras.en: Anthony Albanese is defending his economic track record, after Greens MP Elizabeth Watson-Brown asked if he would take responsibility for real wages going backwards, corporate profits increasing, while Australians’ living standards are worse.
paras.zh: 在绿党议员伊丽莎白·沃森-布朗询问安东尼·阿尔巴内斯是否愿意为实际工资下降、企业利润增加而澳大利亚人的生活水平却恶化负责后，安东尼·阿尔巴内斯正在捍卫自己的经济记录。

paras.en: Employment is now 14.8 million. It was 13.5 million when we were elected. Participation rate is higher today than it was then, even in spite of the growth in population. 66.8%, up 0.5%, even with the increased population. Gender pay gap, it was 14.2 and it’s now 11.3%, a record low.
paras.zh: 目前就业人数为 1480 万人。我们当选时有1350万。尽管人口在增长，但今天的参与率仍高于当时。 66.8%，尽管人口增加，但仍增长了0.5个百分点。性别工资差距由 14.2% 降至 11.3%，创历史新低。

paras.en: Watson-Brown makes a point of order on relevance, saying she was asking about the cost of living. But Milton Dick bats it off and says she never used the words “cost of living” and the PM is being relevant.
paras.zh: 沃森-布朗就相关性提出了程序问题，称她询问的是生活费用。但米尔顿·迪克对此表示否认，并表示她从未使用过“生活成本”这个词，而总理的说法是相关的。

paras.en: A $78bn deficit was anticipated in the [budget] last year and we turned that into a $22bn surplus, thanks to the treasurer. The next year, the $56bn deficit was turned into a $15bn surplus by this government.
paras.zh: 去年[预算]预计会有 780 亿美元的赤字，多亏了财务主管，我们将其变成了 220 亿美元的盈余。第二年，本届政府将 560 亿美元的赤字转变为 150 亿美元的盈余。

paras.en: ‘I’m also the minister for international development’ Aly defends travel bill
paras.zh: “我也是国际发展部长”阿里为旅行法案辩护

paras.en: Anne Aly is still copping heat from the Coalition, now asking her about a $150,000 bill for several international trips over 17 months.
paras.zh: Anne Aly 仍在承受来自联盟党的压力，现在向她询问 17 个月内多次国际旅行的 15 万美元账单。

paras.en: She says it’s a fundamental part of her other portfolio:
paras.zh: 她说这是她其他投资组合的基本组成部分：

paras.en: As the member is aware, I’m also the minister for international development, which is a portfolio within foreign affairs and trade and which, obviously, has a requirement for me to travel internationally on behalf of our country.
paras.zh: 正如该成员所知，我也是国际发展部长，这是外交和贸易领域的一个职务，显然，它要求我代表我们的国家进行国际旅行。

paras.en: Independent MP asks attorney general about recommendation for program in family law and justice systems
paras.zh: 独立议员向总检察长询问家庭法和司法系统计划的建议

paras.en: When will the attorney general’s department implement a five-year time-bound program as recommended by the Domestic, Family and Sexual Violence Commissioner to stop continual harm being caused in the family law and justice systems, asks independent Kate Chaney.
paras.zh: 独立人士凯特·钱尼 (Kate Chaney) 询问，司法部长部门何时会按照家庭、家庭和性暴力专员的建议实施一项为期五年的计划，以制止家庭法和司法系统造成的持续伤害。

paras.en: The attorney general, Michelle Rowland, says work is being done on the second national action plan to end violence against women and children.
paras.zh: 总检察长米歇尔·罗兰表示，正在制定第二个国家行动计划，以结束针对妇女和儿童的暴力行为。

paras.en: She doesn’t give any commitments on the recommendation by the commissioner but says more broadly:
paras.zh: 她没有对专员的建议做出任何承诺，但更广泛地说：

paras.en: In March this year, we announced the establishment of new specialised trauma informed sexual violence pilots in New South Wales and Queensland and they build on the expansion and extension of the pilots already operating in the ACT and in Western Australia and the establishment of new pilots in South Australia, the Northern Territory and Tasmania, which we announced in November 2025.
paras.zh: 今年 3 月，我们宣布在新南威尔士州和昆士兰州建立新的专门性创伤知情性暴力试点项目，这些试点项目是在 ACT 和西澳大利亚州已经开展的试点项目的扩展和扩展基础上进行的，并在 2025 年 11 月宣布的南澳大利亚州、北领地和塔斯马尼亚州设立了新的试点项目。

paras.en: Trust compliance costs for small businesses ‘a fraction’ of public claims, says Labor
paras.zh: 工党表示，小企业的信托合规成本仅占公众索赔的“一小部分”

paras.en: We’re back to small business and trusts.
paras.zh: 我们又回到了小企业和信托。

paras.en: Nationals frontbencher Anne Webster asks the small business minister about the roughly 350,000 businesses who use trusts that will face tens of thousands of dollars to rejig their finances if the minimum 30% trust tax is implemented.
paras.zh: 国家党前座议员 Anne Webster 向小企业部长询问大约 35 万家使用信托的企业，如果实施最低 30% 的信托税，这些企业将面临数万美元的财务调整。

paras.en: The minister, Anne Aly, and the assistant treasurer, Daniel Mulino, exchange looks and give each other a small nod.
paras.zh: 部长安妮·阿里 (Anne Aly) 和助理财务主管丹尼尔·穆利诺 (Daniel Mulino) 交换了眼神，并互相点了点头。

paras.en: Mulino will take the question (prompting jeers from the Coalition).
paras.zh: 穆利诺将回答这个问题（引起了联盟党的嘲笑）。

paras.en: Mulino defends the policy, and says as a proportion hardly any small businesses use trusts, and the compliance costs being quoted publicly are totally blown out.
paras.zh: Mulino 为这项政策辩护，并表示几乎没有任何小企业使用信托，而且公开引用的合规成本完全被夸大了。

paras.en: In the last 20 years, the number of trusts have doubled and a significant proportion of that growth is discretionary trusts. The majority of trust income flows to the top-earning 10% of families and about 90% … it is important to note that the compliance costs of our reforms are set out and they’ll be a fraction of some of the figures that are in the public realm.
paras.zh: 在过去 20 年中，信托的数量翻了一番，其中很大一部分增长是全权信托。大部分信托收入流向收入最高的 10% 家庭和大约 90% 的家庭……值得注意的是，我们的改革的合规成本已经列出，而且它们只是公共领域中一些数字的一小部分。

paras.en: ‘That’s just what they need, more compliance’: Liberals probe minister on digital duty of care regulations for small business
paras.zh: “这正是他们所需要的，更多的合规性”：自由党就小企业的数字注意义务法规调查部长

paras.en: Liberal frontbencher, Aaron Violi, is up next and asks the small business minister, Anne Aly, to confirm if the digital duty of care bill will require all small businesses with a website to undertake annual risk assessments, which must be kept for six years.
paras.zh: 接下来是自由党前座议员 Aaron Violi，他要求小企业部长 Anne Aly 确认数字谨慎责任法案是否要求所有拥有网站的小企业进行年度风险评估，该评估必须保留六年。

paras.en: Long story short, Aly says there will be a small level of compliance for small businesses because they generally don’t have private messaging mechanisms between strangers or allow people to upload harmful or classified material.
paras.zh: 长话短说，阿里表示，小型企业的合规性较低，因为它们通常没有陌生人之间的私人消息传递机制，也不允许人们上传有害或机密材料。

paras.en: Providers of low-risk services like websites and applications run by small businesses will have minimum obligations under the Digital Duty of Care. The eSafety Commissioner will provide further regulatory guidance in due course.
paras.zh: 低风险服务（例如小型企业运营的网站和应用程序）的提供商将根据数字谨慎义务承担最低义务。电子安全专员将适时提供进一步的监管指导。

paras.en: Someone from the Coalition shouts “that’s just what they need, more compliance”.
paras.zh: 联盟党中的一些人喊道“这正是他们所需要的，更多的服从”。

paras.en: We’re now a second MP down – during the last dixer to Mark Butler, Nationals backbencher Alison Penfold got the boot, with several other MPs on warnings.
paras.zh: 我们现在是第二位议员被淘汰——在马克·巴特勒的最后一次投票中，国民队后座议员艾莉森·彭福德被解雇，其他几名议员受到警告。

paras.en: Howard government had ‘rivers of gold flowing in’ when it gave over-65s extra private health insurance rebates
paras.zh: 霍华德政府为 65 岁以上的老年人提供额外的私人医疗保险回扣，可谓“金河般涌来”

paras.en: Humiliation seems to be the word of the day in the House, with Liberal frontbencher Melissa McIntosh asking when Labor will stop “waging war on senior Australians” after suffering a “humiliating” defeat when its private health insurance premiums bill was thrown out of the Senate yesterday.
paras.zh: 耻辱似乎是众议院的热门话题，自由​​党前座议员梅丽莎·麦金托什(Melissa McIntosh)询问，工党昨天在其私人医疗保险保费法案被参议院否决后遭受了“耻辱”的失败，并询问工党何时会停止“对澳大利亚老年人发动战争”。

paras.en: The prime minister, Anthony Albanese, maintains the reforms are fair and that the rebates were originally put in during a very different economic era.
paras.zh: 总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯坚称改革是公平的，而且退税最初是在一个非常不同的经济时代实施的。

paras.en: That measure that came in by the government during the mining boom, where they had to actually make changes to the aged discrimination act in order to bring it in, because they had rivers of gold flowing in.
paras.zh: 这项措施是政府在采矿业繁荣时期采取的，他们必须真正修改老年歧视法才能实施，因为他们有大量的黄金流入。

paras.en: We’re one MP down during this question: at the end of the last dixer to the PM, Liberal backbencher Ben Small got kicked out of the chamber for interjecting too much.
paras.zh: 在这个问题上，我们落后了一位国会议员：在与首相最后一次辩论结束时，自由党后座议员本·斯莫尔（Ben Small）因插话太多而被赶出了会议厅。

articles.title: 'Nowhere to escape' - Indonesians share footage of orange haze blanketing towns

paras.en: 'Nowhere to escape' - Indonesians share footage of orange haze blanketing towns
paras.zh: “无处可逃”——印度尼西亚人分享橙色雾霾笼罩城镇的镜头

paras.en: A thick orange smog has descended on the Indonesian city of Palangka Raya.
paras.zh: 浓浓的橙色烟雾降临在印度尼西亚城市帕朗卡拉亚。

paras.en: Witnesses captured videos of the haze washing over the Kalimantan region not far from where wildfires continue to burn.
paras.zh: 目击者拍摄到距离野火持续燃烧不远的加里曼丹地区烟雾弥漫的视频。

paras.en: The ISPU air pollution index exceeded 1,200, according to data from the national environment ministry, four times higher than the "hazardous" level of 300 on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 根据国家环境部的数据，ISPU空气污染指数超过1,200，比周三的“危险”水平300高出四倍。

paras.en: Toxic smog is choking millions across Indonesia, Singapore and Malaysia, with authorities partly blaming the agricultural clearing method known as "slash and burn" for compounding the intense haze.
paras.zh: 有毒烟雾正在印度尼西亚、新加坡和马来西亚造成数百万人窒息，当局部分将其归咎于被称为“刀耕火种”的农业清理方法，加剧了浓重的雾霾。

articles.title: Anthropic flags revenue surge to investors ahead of stock market debut

paras.en: Artificial intelligence (AI) giant Anthropic saw its revenue surge by 45% to $16.8bn (Â£12.7bn) in the three months to the end of September, the BBC understands.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司了解，截至 9 月底的三个月内，人工智能 (AI) 巨头 Anthropic 的收入猛增 45%，达到 168 亿美元（127 亿英镑）。

paras.en: The figures were revealed by the Claude-developer as it briefed prospective investors on Wednesday at its headquarters in San Francisco as it lays the groundwork for a stock market listing, which is expected to take place before the end of the year.
paras.zh: 周三，这家克劳德开发商在旧金山总部向潜在投资者介绍了这些数据，为预计将于今年年底前上市的股票市场奠定了基础。

paras.en: It comes as some tech stocks, including firms that make the chips and other hardware that power data centres, have fallen in recent days over concerns about the hundreds of billions of dollars being spent on AI infrastructure.
paras.zh: 与此同时，一些科技股，包括制造芯片和其他为数据中心提供动力的硬件的公司，最近几天因人们对人工智能基础设施花费数千亿美元的担忧而下跌。

paras.en: An Anthropic spokesperson declined to comment.
paras.zh: Anthropic 发言人拒绝发表评论。

paras.en: Anthropic's revenue has risen in successive quarters this year, from $4.7bn in the first three months to $11.6bn the following period.
paras.zh: Anthropic 今年的收入连续几个季度增长，从前三个月的 47 亿美元增至接下来的一个时期的 116 亿美元。

paras.en: The company also reportedly said that it made a profit for the second quarter in a row.
paras.zh: 据报道，该公司还表示，第二季度已连续盈利。

paras.en: Its revenue figures, along with those of rival OpenAI, offer an important gauge of the AI industry's growth and ability to finance the infrastructure needed to develop the technology.
paras.zh: 其收入数据以及竞争对手 OpenAI 的收入数据，提供了衡量人工智能行业增长以及为开发技术所需的基础设施提供资金的能力的重要指标。

paras.en: Stocks in some US technology companies fell on Wednesday over concerns around investments in AI.
paras.zh: 由于对人工智能投资的担忧，一些美国科技公司的股票周三下跌。

paras.en: Share in chip makers - including AMD, Nvidia and Intel - fell sharply.
paras.zh: AMD、Nvidia 和英特尔等芯片制造商的份额大幅下滑。

paras.en: In Asia, shares in Japanese tech investment firm Softbank fell by more than 9% on Thursday morning. South Korean semiconductor giants were also down, with Samsung falling by 9.4% and SK Hynix dropping 10.8%.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，日本科技投资公司软银的股价周四上午下跌超过 9%。韩国半导体巨头也纷纷下跌，其中三星下跌9.4%，SK海力士下跌10.8%。

paras.en: Tech-heavy indexes in the region were also down. Trading on South Korea's Kospi and Kosdaq was temporarily halted after falling by more than 8%, while Japan's Nikkei 225 fell by over 5%.
paras.zh: 该地区科技股指数也下跌。韩国综合指数和科斯达克指数跌幅超过8%后暂时停止交易，日本日经225指数跌幅超过5%。

paras.en: The falls come after remarks by Hock Tan, the chief executive of US tech manufacturer Broadcom, over AI spending.
paras.zh: 美国科技制造商博通公司首席执行官 Hock Tan 就人工智能支出发表言论后，股价出现下跌。

paras.en: Tan said at an conference in Singapore on Monday that many investors have "no clue" and have set "extreme expectations only to find out that it's almost like they are in a casino".
paras.zh: 谭周一在新加坡举行的一次会议上表示，许多投资者“毫无头绪”，并“设定了极高的期望，结果却发现这几乎就像在赌场里一样”。

paras.en: There also been concerns over the safety of AI models.
paras.zh: 人们还担心人工智能模型的安全性。

paras.en: OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman said in September that his company will not go public this year as it addresses concerns about the technology's safety.
paras.zh: OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 在 9 月份表示，他的公司今年不会上市，因为它会解决对该技术安全性的担忧。

paras.en: The ChatGPT-developer is also eyeing a bumper stock market listing, which is expected to value the firm at more than $1tn.
paras.zh: ChatGPT 开发商还着眼于在股市上市，预计该公司的估值将超过 1 万亿美元。

paras.en: Anthropic has also been vocal about AI's risks, with its chief executive Dario Amodei calling on the pace of development to slow down.
paras.zh: Anthropic 也一直直言不讳地谈论人工智能的风险，其首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 呼吁放慢发展速度。

paras.en: The company has continued expanding globally, opening an office in Singapore on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 该公司继续在全球扩张，周三在新加坡开设了办事处。

articles.title: Musk says US government may be behind slowdown of Ukraine drone speeds

paras.en: Elon Musk has suggested that the US government may be behind restrictions on the speed at which some of Ukraine's weapons can travel and stay connected to SpaceX's Starlink internet network.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，美国政府可能是对乌克兰部分武器的飞行速度和与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 互联网网络保持连接的限制的幕后黑手。

paras.en: Starlink is a vital tool allowing Kyiv to guide drones to Russian targets and also protect its own skies, but on Tuesday night Ukraine said unexpected new speed limits were disrupting its battlefield missions.
paras.zh: 星链是基辅引导无人机飞向俄罗斯目标并保护本国天空的重要工具，但乌克兰周二晚间表示，意外的新速度限制正在扰乱其战场任务。

paras.en: An adviser to President Volodymyr Zelensky said he believed the restrictions were not a coincidence and were related to the latest strains between Kyiv and Washington.
paras.zh: 总统泽连斯基的一名顾问表示，他认为这些限制并非巧合，而是与基辅和华盛顿之间最新的紧张局势有关。

paras.en: Musk said that Starshield, the military-grade sister service to Starlink, is controlled by the US government, and "any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately [the US president]".
paras.zh: 马斯克表示，星盾是星链的军用级姊妹服务，由美国政府控制，“对速度或使用的任何限制均由美国军方决定，并最终由[美国总统]决定”。

paras.en: Musk - writing on X - had been responding to pleas from Ukrainian officials to restore connectivity, including from Zelensky who told UK media: "I hope that it's a mistake, maybe [a] huge technical problem. I don't know, but we are asking to... switch [it] on."
paras.zh: 马斯克在 X 上撰文，一直在回应乌克兰官员恢复连接的请求，其中包括泽伦斯基，他告诉英国媒体：“我希望这是一个错误，也许是一个巨大的技术问题。我不知道，但我们要求……打开它。”

paras.en: Starlink, which is owned by Musk's SpaceX, restricted speed limits on Tuesday night to 100mph (160km/h), meaning any weapons that travelled faster than that lost connectivity to the network.
paras.zh: 马斯克旗下的 SpaceX 公司旗下的 Starlink 在周二晚上将速度限制为 100 英里/小时（160 公里/小时），这意味着任何飞行速度超过该速度的武器都会失去与网络的连接。

paras.en: It had been partially restored by Wednesday evening, Ukraine's former defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰前国防部长米哈伊洛·费多罗夫表示，到周三晚上，该设施已部分恢复。

paras.en: "Removing Starshield's speed limit entirely is now critical for Ukraine's defense," he wrote on X, thanking Elon Musk and asking for his "continued support".
paras.zh: 他在 X 上写道：“完全取消星盾的速度限制现在对乌克兰的国防至关重要。”他感谢埃隆·马斯克并请求他“继续支持”。

paras.en: About an hour later, Musk replied to that post, defending his company's involvement.
paras.zh: 大约一个小时后，马斯克回复了该帖子，为他的公司的参与辩护。

paras.en: "Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS," he wrote.
paras.zh: “星盾系统由美国政府拥有和控制。对速度或使用的任何限制均由美国军方决定，最终由美国总统决定，”他写道。

paras.en: Musk added that Starlink is for "civilian or defensive activities and cannot be used for offensive military action, as doing so would be inappropriate for a commercial company".
paras.zh: 马斯克补充说，星链用于“民用或防御活动，不能用于进攻性军事行动，因为这样做对于商业公司来说是不合适的”。

paras.en: In the early hours of Thursday, Russian strikes killed two people in the Dnipropetrovsk region, regional governor Oleksandr Hanzha said.
paras.zh: 第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克地区州长亚历山大·汉扎 (Oleksandr Hanzha) 表示，周四凌晨，俄罗斯的空袭造成两人死亡。

paras.en: While both companies are owned by Musk's SpaceX, Starlink is a civilian service that uses satellites in low Earth orbit to provide internet access, particularly in remote areas, while Starshield is designed for government and military use.
paras.zh: 虽然这两家公司都属于马斯克旗下的 SpaceX 公司，但 Starlink 是一项民用服务，利用近地轨道卫星提供互联网接入，特别是在偏远地区，而 Starshield 则专为政府和军事用途而设计。

paras.en: The restrictions on Tuesday night came as Russia launched deadly attacks against Ukraine that killed several people in Kyiv, officials said, and hit communications and energy facilities used by Ukraine's military.
paras.zh: 官员称，周二晚间俄罗斯对乌克兰发动致命袭击，造成基辅数人死亡，并袭击了乌克兰军方使用的通讯和能源设施。

paras.en: Zelensky said it was "one of the largest attacks" from Russia, and while "a significant part of the drones were shot down" there were "also hits".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，这是来自俄罗斯的“最大规模的袭击之一”，虽然“很大一部分无人机被击落”，但“也有击中”。

paras.en: At least 600,000 people across Ukraine were left without electricity, and residents said they received no warning of incoming drones before they hit.
paras.zh: 乌克兰各地至少有 60 万人断电，居民表示，他们在无人机袭击之前没有收到任何警告。

paras.en: "It is clear that this action cannot be a coincidence and is related to the current political situation," Zelensky's adviser Serhiy Beskrestnov wrote on Telegram on Wednesday morning.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基的顾问谢尔盖·别斯克雷斯诺夫周三上午在 Telegram 上写道：“很明显，这一行动不可能是巧合，而是与当前的政治局势有关。”

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has grown increasingly frustrated towards Ukraine as it continues to strike Russian energy facilities.
paras.zh: 随着乌克兰继续袭击俄罗斯能源设施，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对乌克兰越来越失望。

paras.en: Late on Wednesday, Musk wrote on X, responding to a post saying that Zelensky would not end the war until Russia was defeated, "And so the slaughter continues â¦ Time for Zelensky to go". He has made similar comments before.
paras.zh: 周三晚些时候，马斯克在 X 上写道，回应一篇帖子，称泽伦斯基在俄罗斯被击败之前不会结束战争，“所以屠杀仍在继续……泽伦斯基是时候下台了”。他之前也曾发表过类似言论。

paras.en: Earlier this week he said said: "I agree, time for Ukraine to get a new leader," after Trump said it was "time for Ukraine to get a new president".
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，在特朗普表示“乌克兰是时候找到新总统了”之后，他表示：“我同意，乌克兰是时候找到新领导人了”。

paras.en: Since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022 the country has been under martial law, meaning elections have been suspended.
paras.zh: 自俄罗斯于 2022 年入侵乌克兰以来，该国一直处于戒严状态，这意味着选举已暂停。

paras.en: Speaking during a visit to London on Wednesday, Zelensky agreed that he had felt betrayed after the US made a deal with Russia to import 300,000 tonnes of its diesel.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周三访问伦敦时表示，在美国与俄罗斯达成协议进口 30 万吨柴油后，他感到自己被背叛了。

paras.en: "Really yes... but it's a little bit more complicated than just my emotions or my feelings," Zelensky said, when asked by UK journalist Piers Morgan if he felt betrayed.
paras.zh: 当英国记者皮尔斯·摩根问他是否感到被背叛时，泽伦斯基说道：“确实是的……但这比我的情绪或感受要复杂一点。”

paras.en: During his one-day visit, Zelensky was greeted with a hug by UK PM Andy Burnham at Downing Street and held an audience with King Charles.
