paras.en: "Daily consumption of meat was associated with a 44 percent higher likelihood of reaching 100 years old [compared to a vegetarian diet] in the underweight group, whereas this association did not present in the normal weight or overweight group," the study authors conclude.
paras.zh: 研究作者总结道：“在体重不足的人群中，每天吃肉与吃素的人活到 100 岁的可能性高出 44% 相关，而在正常体重或超重的人群中，这种关联并不存在。”

paras.en: What's more, vegetarians who ate fish, dairy, or eggs had a similar chance of reaching 100 as meat eaters.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，吃鱼、奶制品或鸡蛋的素食者与肉食者达到 100 的几率相似。

paras.en: This suggests that older female adults who eat enough calories and essential nutrients may increase their odds of becoming a centenarian.
paras.zh: 这表明，摄入足够热量和必需营养素的老年女性可能会增加成为百岁老人的几率。

paras.en: The findings support recent research that suggests protecting muscle mass by eating protein is vital to healthy aging.
paras.zh: 这些发现支持了最近的研究，即通过摄入蛋白质来保护肌肉质量对于健康衰老至关重要。

paras.en: The new data come from one of the largest studies on older adults anywhere in the world: the Chinese Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey (CLHLS).
paras.zh: 新数据来自世界上最大的老年人研究之一：中国纵向健康长寿调查（CLHLS）。

paras.en: Researchers at Fudan University, the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention, and Shanghai Jiao Tong University compared the outcomes of 1,459 centenarians with those of 3,744 non-centenarians in their 80s and 90s.
paras.zh: 复旦大学、中国疾病预防控制中心和上海交通大学的研究人员对 1,459 名百岁老人与 3,744 名 80 岁和 90 岁的非百岁老人的结果进行了比较。

paras.en: The team found that body mass index (BMI) partly explained the association between vegetarianism and shorter life expectancy.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，体重指数（BMI）在一定程度上解释了素食主义与较短预期寿命之间的关联。

paras.en: Given that older populations are more likely to be underweight, the authors suggest that the role of BMI in longevity is "worth exploring" further.
paras.zh: 鉴于老年人群更有可能体重不足，作者认为体重指数在长寿中的作用“值得进一步探讨”。

paras.en: The "obesity paradox", for instance, is a term that describes how more body weight seems to be associated with better health outcomes in older populations. This is the opposite of what is found in younger populations.
paras.zh: 例如，“肥胖悖论”这个术语描述了老年人群中体重增加与更好的健康结果之间的关系。这与年轻人中的情况相反。

paras.en: The centenarian study in China can only reveal associations, which means it's possible that other factors are impacting the results.
paras.zh: 中国的百岁老人研究只能揭示关联性，这意味着其他因素可能会影响结果。

paras.en: The study, for instance, doesn't account for how eating habits might change over time; the surveys only assessed what participants ate in their later years, and that may be influenced by how easy the foods are to chew.
paras.zh: 例如，这项研究并没有考虑饮食习惯如何随着时间的推移而改变。这些调查仅评估了参与者晚年吃的东西，这可能会受到食物咀嚼容易程度的影响。

paras.en: Previous research, however, supports the idea that lifestyle choices, such as diet, could be major reasons why some people live to 100.
paras.zh: 然而，之前的研究支持这样一种观点，即饮食等生活方式的选择可能是某些人活到 100 岁的主要原因。

paras.en: In fact, by some estimates, reaching age 90 can be explained by 70 percent healthy behaviors, such as sleep, physical activity, or diet.
paras.zh: 事实上，根据一些估计，70% 的健康行为可以解释 70% 的人能活到 90 岁，例如睡眠、体力活动或饮食。

paras.en: It's possible that older adults may have different nutritional needs, yet many studies on vegetarianism focus on younger cohorts.
paras.zh: 老年人可能有不同的营养需求，但许多关于素食主义的研究都集中在年轻人身上。

paras.en: One study of more than 65,000 people, young and old, found that those who eat a vegetarian diet may face a higher risk of fractures, possibly due to lower calcium and protein intake.
paras.zh: 一项针对超过 65,000 名年轻人和老年人的研究发现，吃素食的人可能面临更高的骨折风险，这可能是由于钙和蛋白质摄入量较低所致。

paras.en: Though that's not entirely settled either – a 2026 review from University of Wisconsin-Madison researchers argued the opposite case, that lower protein intake may actually support healthier aging in several organisms, possibly because high-protein diets can keep cells locked in a constant growth mode. Exactly how much protein older adults need remains a live debate.
paras.zh: 尽管这个问题还没有完全解决——威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校研究人员在 2026 年发表的一篇评论提出了相反的观点，即较低的蛋白质摄入量实际上可能支持多种生物体更健康的衰老，可能是因为高蛋白饮食可以使细胞保持恒定的生长模式。老年人到底需要多少蛋白质仍然是一个争论不休的话题。

paras.en: Nutrition, however, is an extremely complex area of research, and health outcomes can be influenced by a plethora of societal, environmental, and individual factors.
paras.zh: 然而，营养是一个极其复杂的研究领域，健康结果可能受到多种社会、环境和个人因素的影响。

paras.en: In all probability, the best food choices for extending life require diversity and balance, differing from person to person.
paras.zh: 很可能，延长寿命的最佳食物选择需要多样性和平衡，因人而异。

paras.en: Vegetarian diets, plant-based diets, and low-meat diets have been linked to lower risks of certain health issues, such as heart disease, stroke, type 2 diabetes, and obesity.
paras.zh: 素食、植物性饮食和低肉饮食与降低某些健康问题的风险有关，如心脏病、中风、2 型糖尿病和肥胖。

paras.en: Still, not all meat is equally associated with negative health outcomes, and the amount can matter. Processed meats and red meat, for instance, are often linked to poorer health and shorter longevity, which is why they are generally recommended to be eaten in moderation.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，并非所有肉类都与负面健康结果同等相关，而且肉类的数量也很重要。例如，加工肉类和红肉通常与健康状况不佳和寿命较短​​有关，这就是为什么通常建议适量食用它们。

paras.en: Related: Study Reveals a Turning Point When Your Body's Aging Accelerates
paras.zh: 相关：研究揭示了身体加速衰老的转折点

paras.en: "Our findings emphasized the importance of a balanced diet from both animal- and plant-derived food for healthy longevity," write the team.
paras.zh: 研究小组写道：“我们的研究结果强调了动物性和植物性食品的均衡饮食对于健康长寿的重要性。”

paras.en: "Future studies focusing on older adults of advanced age are needed for the formulation of dietary guidance."
paras.zh: “未来需要针对高龄老年人进行研究，以制定饮食指导。”

paras.en: The study was published in The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《美国临床营养学杂志》上。

articles.title: Ending Clock Changes? Health Experts Say There's a Winner Between Standard And Daylight Saving Time
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Keeping the clocks on summer time all year means lighter evenings, but it also delays winter sunrise by an hour on the clock. People getting up early for work or school spend more of the morning in darkness.
paras.zh: 全年将时钟保持在夏季时间意味着夜晚会更明亮，但也会使冬季日出时间延迟一个小时。人们早起去上班或上学，早上的大部分时间都在黑暗中度过。

paras.en: A new Canadian analysis concludes that permanent standard time is the better choice for health if seasonal clock changes are abolished, because it preserves earlier access to morning light.
paras.zh: 加拿大的一项新分析得出的结论是，如果废除季节性时钟变化，永久标准时间对健康来说是更好的选择，因为它可以保留较早的晨光。

paras.en: British Columbia adopted permanent daylight saving time in March. Alberta and the Northwest Territories have also adopted year-round daylight saving time and will skip the November clock change. In the US, the House passed a bill to make daylight saving time permanent on July 14, and it was referred to a Senate committee the following day.
paras.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省于三月采用永久夏令时。艾伯塔省和西北地区也采用了全年夏令时，并将跳过 11 月份的时钟变化。在美国，众议院于 7 月 14 日通过了一项永久实行夏令时的法案，并于第二天提交给参议院委员会。

paras.en: Psychiatrist Raymond Lam of the University of British Columbia and his colleagues assessed the health consequences of the two options: standard time, usually observed in winter, and daylight saving time, which runs an hour ahead.
paras.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚大学的精神病学家雷蒙德·林（Raymond Lam）和他的同事评估了两种选择的健康后果：标准时间（通常在冬季）和夏令时（提前一小时）。

paras.en: Sleep and circadian rhythms researcher Ralph Mistlberger of Simon Fraser University co-authored the peer-reviewed analysis, which reviewed published research on biological rhythms, sleep, mood, education, and economic effects. The team also examined countries' experiences with permanent time policies and compared sunrise and sunset times across Canadian cities.
paras.zh: 西蒙弗雷泽大学的睡眠和昼夜节律研究员拉尔夫·米斯特伯格 (Ralph Mistlberger) 共同撰写了这份同行评审的分析报告，该分析回顾了已发表的有关生物节律、睡眠、情绪、教育和经济影响的研究。该团队还研究了各国在永久时间政策方面的经验，并比较了加拿大各城市的日出和日落时间。

paras.en: In Toronto, the latest winter sunrise, in early January, would come at 7:51 am under permanent standard time and 8:51 am under permanent daylight saving time.
paras.zh: 在多伦多，最晚的冬季日出时间为 1 月初，永久标准时间为上午 7:51，永久夏令时为上午 8:51。

paras.en: A Toronto resident waking at 7 am in early January would get up before sunrise under either setting, but daylight would arrive an hour sooner under standard time. Neither option changes the length of the day.
paras.zh: 在任何一种情况下，一月初早上 7 点起床的多伦多居民都会在日出前起床，但在标准时间下，日出会提前一个小时。这两个选项都不会改变一天的长度。

paras.en: The brain's main circadian clock coordinates sleep, alertness, and other daily functions. It needs daily adjustment to stay in step with the day. Morning light helps move it earlier, while evening light pushes it later.
paras.zh: 大脑的主要生物钟协调睡眠、警觉性和其他日常功能。它需要每天进行调整才能与时俱进。晨光有助于将其提前移动，而傍晚的光线则将其推得较晚。

paras.en: "Imagine a wristwatch that runs 10 minutes slow each day, and every morning you make the 10 minute correction by setting it forward," Mistlberger explained to ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: Mistlberger 向 ScienceAlert 解释道：“想象一下，一只手表每天走慢 10 分钟，每天早上你都可以通过将其向前拨动来进行 10 分钟的校正。”

paras.en: With less morning light, sleep rhythms can slip later while school and work still begin at the same hour. Getting up on time may mean cutting sleep short.
paras.zh: 由于早晨光线较少，睡眠节奏可能会变晚，而学校和工作仍会在同一时间开始。准时起床可能意味着缩短睡眠时间。

paras.en: Social jetlag, the gap between the body clock and school or work schedules, has been linked to poorer physical and mental health, as has insufficient sleep. Seasonal clock changes can also disrupt sleep.
paras.zh: 社交时差，即生物钟与学校或工作时间之间的差距，与睡眠不足一样，与较差的身心健康有关。季节的时钟变化也会扰乱睡眠。

paras.en: The analysis also draws on geographic comparisons: people living farther west within a time zone get later sunrises by the clock. Studies have linked this position with shorter sleep and some poorer health and economic outcomes, though these associations do not prove causation.
paras.zh: 该分析还利用了地理比较：居住在某个时区内较西边的人们，日出时间较晚。研究已将这种姿势与较短的睡眠以及一些较差的健康和经济结果联系起来，尽管这些关联并不能证明因果关系。

paras.en: The researchers considered seasonal affective disorder, a form of depression often experienced in winter. One leading explanation involves the body clock slipping later when morning light is delayed. Morning bright-light therapy helps move it earlier; a later sunrise on the clock works in the opposite direction.
paras.zh: 研究人员考虑了季节性情感障碍，这是一种在冬季经常出现的抑郁症。一种主要的解释是，当晨光延迟时，生物钟就会变慢。早晨的强光疗法有助于提早移动；时钟上较晚的日出以相反的方向运行。

paras.en: Teenagers and young adults may be especially vulnerable because their body clocks naturally shift later at that age.
paras.zh: 青少年和年轻人可能特别容易受到伤害，因为他们的生物钟在这个年龄段自然会变晚。

paras.en: "Later school and work times would help," Mistlberger said. Brighter indoor lighting in the morning could also help, he added.
paras.zh: “推迟上学和工作时间会有所帮助，”米斯特伯格说。他补充说，早上更明亮的室内照明也会有所帮助。

paras.en: Several countries have tried year-round daylight saving time before. The US introduced it in 1974 and abandoned it within the year, following concerns about dark winter mornings and children traveling to school before sunrise. Russia adopted it in 2011 and reversed it in 2014.
paras.zh: 一些国家此前曾尝试过全年夏令时。美国于 1974 年引入该制度，但出于对黑暗的冬季早晨和儿童在日出前上学的担忧，一年内就放弃了该制度。俄罗斯于2011年采用该法案，并于2014年撤销。

paras.en: Permanent daylight saving time would keep evenings lighter, allowing more time for outdoor activity and socializing. Standard time brings earlier winter dusk, while early summer sunrise may wake some people too early. Latitude and location within time zones also determine how much the choice matters in a given place.
paras.zh: 永久夏令时将使夜晚变得更加明亮，从而有更多时间进行户外活动和社交。标准时间带来了更早的冬季黄昏，而初夏的日出可能会过早地唤醒一些人。时区内的纬度和位置也决定了选择在特定地点的重要性。

paras.en: Much of the evidence comes from observational research and geographic comparisons, leaving uncertainty about permanent policies' long-term health consequences.
paras.zh: 大部分证据来自观察性研究和地理比较，这使得永久性政策对健康的长期影响存在不确定性。

paras.en: The researchers recommend permanent standard time. If governments choose year-round daylight saving time, they advise considering later school and work starts, improving morning light exposure, and tracking whether sleep problems, winter depression, absenteeism, and road injuries rise.
paras.zh: 研究人员推荐永久标准时间。如果政府选择全年夏令时，他们建议考虑推迟上学和上班时间，改善早晨的光照，并跟踪睡眠问题、冬季抑郁、缺勤和道路伤害是否增加。

paras.en: The research has been published in Canadian Medical Association Journal.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《加拿大医学会杂志》上。

articles.title: The secret to easier exercise as an adult may start in childhood

paras.en: The secret to easier exercise as an adult may start in childhood
paras.zh: 成年人更轻松锻炼的秘诀可能从童年开始

paras.en: A surprising new study suggests that staying active while growing up could make exercise easier and less exhausting for the rest of your life.
paras.zh: 一项令人惊讶的新研究表明，在成长过程中保持活跃可以让你在余生中更轻松地锻炼，减少疲劳。

paras.en: - Exercise during childhood could have a surprising lifelong benefit, potentially making physical activity less exhausting in adulthood. In a study involving guinea fowl, researchers discovered that birds accustomed to carrying weights while growing up could carry those weights as adults without using extra energy, while untrained birds burned 23% more.
paras.zh: - 童年时期的锻炼可能会带来令人惊讶的终生益处，有可能使成年后的体力活动不再那么疲惫。在一项涉及珍珠鸡的研究中，研究人员发现，习惯于在成长过程中负重的鸟类在成年后可以在不消耗额外能量的情况下负重，而未经训练的鸟类燃烧的热量多出 23%。

paras.en: How much energy your body needs to move as an adult could be influenced by how active you were during childhood. A new study led by researchers at Penn State suggests that physical activity early in life may have lasting effects on movement efficiency. Using birds as a model, the scientists provided the first direct evidence that experiences during development can change how much energy animals expend when moving as adults.
paras.zh: 作为一个成年人，你的身体运动所需的能量可能会受到你童年时期的活跃程度的影响。宾夕法尼亚州立大学研究人员领导的一项新研究表明，生命早期的身体活动可能对运动效率产生持久影响。科学家们以鸟类为模型，提供了第一个直接证据，证明发育过程中的经历可以改变动物成年后运动时消耗的能量。

paras.en: According to Jonas Rubenson, a professor of kinesiology at Penn State, the ability to move efficiently could play an important role in animal evolution. Animals that spend less energy getting around may have more resources available for essential activities such as finding food, hunting, and reproducing. The findings, published in Proceedings of the Royal Society B, Biological Sciences, suggest that the energy demands of movement are more adaptable than scientists previously believed.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学运动机能学教授乔纳斯·鲁本森表示，有效移动的能力可能在动物进化中发挥重要作用。花费较少能量四处走动的动物可能有更多的资源可用于基本活动，例如寻找食物、狩猎和繁殖。发表在《英国皇家学会学报 B 生物科学》上的研究结果表明，运动的能量需求比科学家之前认为的更具适应性。

paras.en: To investigate, the researchers attached small weights to one leg of young guinea fowl, birds closely related to chickens that walk on two legs like humans. They wanted to determine whether carrying extra weight during development would change how efficiently the birds moved once they matured.
paras.zh: 为了进行研究，研究人员在幼年珍珠鸡的一条腿上安装了小重物，这种鸟类与像人类一样用两条腿行走的鸡密切相关。他们想确定在发育过程中携带额外的重量是否会改变鸟类成熟后的移动效率。

paras.en: The results revealed a striking difference. Birds that grew up carrying the weights could walk with the added load without expending additional energy. By comparison, birds raised without weights required 23% more energy when the same load was attached to their legs.
paras.zh: 结果显示出显着的差异。从小就负重长大的鸟类可以在增加的负重下行走，而无需消耗额外的能量。相比之下，当相同的负重施加到腿上时，没有负重饲养的家禽需要多 23% 的能量。

paras.en: "This study showed how limb loading -- the application of mechanical stress on arms or legs, typically through weights or exercise -- during development can help an animal save energy during movement throughout its lifespan," said Rubenson, senior author of the study. "This is one of the first studies to indicate that animals' behaviors and environments in youth can affect how effortful moving is as adults."
paras.zh: 该研究的资深作者鲁本森说：“这项研究表明，在发育过程中，肢体负荷（通常通过举重或锻炼对手臂或腿部施加机械应力）可以帮助动物在其整个生命周期的运动过程中节省能量。” “这是首批表明动物幼年时的行为和环境会影响成年后移动的费力程度的研究之一。”

paras.en: Why Childhood Exercise Could Matter for Lifelong Health
paras.zh: 为什么童年锻炼对终生健康很重要

paras.en: Although the experiment involved birds, the findings raise important questions about human physical activity. One widely accepted scientific hypothesis proposes that people tend to avoid movement when it feels physically demanding or requires substantial energy.
paras.zh: 尽管实验涉及鸟类，但研究结果提出了有关人类身体活动的重要问题。一项被广泛接受的科学假设认为，当人们感到体力消耗大或需要大量能量时，人们往往会避免运动。

paras.en: If early activity influences movement efficiency in humans as it does in these birds, people who were less active during childhood might need to expend more energy to perform the same movements as adults. That additional effort could make them less inclined to exercise, potentially reinforcing a pattern of inactivity.
paras.zh: 如果早期活动影响人类的运动效率，就像这些鸟类一样，那么童年时期不太活跃的人可能需要花费更多的能量来执行与成年人相同的运动。这种额外的努力可能会让他们不太愿意锻炼，可能会强化不活动的模式。

paras.en: Rubenson believes the discovery could have broad implications for public health, particularly as children today are generally less physically active than those in earlier generations.
paras.zh: 鲁本森认为，这一发现可能对公共健康产生广泛影响，特别是因为当今的儿童普遍比前几代人的身体活动较少。

paras.en: "Overall, children in the U.S. today are much less active than previous generations," Rubenson said. "This study suggests that more exercise through play and exercise during childhood could make it easier for people to remain or become more active as adults. If people do not need to exert as much energy to move as adults, then exercise -- and all its health benefits -- will be more accessible to them. This could have implications for many aspects of our nation's well-being, from heart health to mental health."
paras.zh: “总体而言，当今美国的儿童比前几代人活跃得多，”鲁本森说。 “这项研究表明，在童年时期通过玩耍和锻炼进行更多的锻炼可以使人们在成年后更容易保持或变得更加活跃。如果人们不需要像成年人那样消耗那么多的能量来运动，那么他们将更容易获得锻炼及其所有健康益处。这可能会对我们国家福祉的许多方面产生影响，从心脏健康到心理健康。”

paras.en: How Researchers Tested the Effects of Early Exercise
paras.zh: 研究人员如何测试早期锻炼的效果

paras.en: The experiment followed 12 guinea fowl from two weeks of age until they reached 16 weeks, when the birds were approaching their full adult size.
paras.zh: 该实验对 12 只珍珠鸡进行了跟踪调查，从两周大到 16 周，此时这些珍珠鸡已接近成年。

paras.en: Half of the birds wore lead bands on one leg, with each band weighing 4% of the bird's body weight. The remaining six birds developed without any added weight. Apart from this difference, all 12 animals experienced the same living conditions and exercise routines.
paras.zh: 一半的鸟在一条腿上佩戴了铅带，每条带的重量为鸟体重的 4%。剩下的六只鸟在没有增加任何体重的情况下发育。除了这种差异之外，所有 12 只动物的生活条件和锻炼习惯都是相同的。

paras.en: When the birds reached nine weeks of age, the researchers began training them to walk on a treadmill.
paras.zh: 当这些鸟长到九周大时，研究人员开始训练它们在跑步机上行走。

paras.en: At 16 weeks, the team assessed their energy expenditure using a flow-through metabolic chamber fitted to the treadmill. This equipment measured the oxygen each bird consumed, along with the carbon dioxide and water vapor it released. According to the researchers, this approach is considered the gold standard for determining how much energy an animal uses during a particular activity.
paras.zh: 第 16 周时，研究小组使用跑步机上安装的流通代谢室评估了他们的能量消耗。该设备测量每只鸟消耗的氧气，以及释放的二氧化碳和水蒸气。研究人员表示，这种方法被认为是确定动物在特定活动中消耗多少能量的黄金标准。

paras.en: Each bird was tested under three conditions: standing still, walking on the treadmill without added weight, and walking while wearing a weight band on one leg. By comparing oxygen consumption and carbon dioxide production across these conditions, the scientists could determine how the additional load affected energy use.
paras.zh: 每只鸟都在三种条件下进行测试：静止站立、在不增加重量的情况下在跑步机上行走以及单腿佩戴负重带行走。通过比较这些条件下的耗氧量和二氧化碳产生量，科学家们可以确定额外的负荷如何影响能源使用。

paras.en: Early Training Produced a Surprising Energy-Saving Effect
paras.zh: 早期训练产生了惊人的节能效果

paras.en: The researchers found no differences in energy consumption when the birds were standing still. However, their responses changed considerably once they began walking with weights.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，当鸟儿静止不动时，能量消耗没有差异。然而，一旦他们开始负重行走，他们的反应就会发生很大变化。

paras.en: Birds that had not carried weights while growing up experienced a 23% increase in energy expenditure when walking with the added load compared with walking without it.
paras.zh: 与成长过程中没有负重的鸟类相比，在负重行走时，其能量消耗增加了 23%。

paras.en: The birds that had worn weights throughout development showed a remarkably different response. Their bodies had adapted so effectively that walking with the extra load required slightly less energy than walking without it. This unexpected result surprised the research team.
paras.zh: 在整个发育过程中承受负重的鸟类表现出截然不同的反应。他们的身体已经有效地适应了，带着额外负重行走所需的能量比不负重行走时需要的能量略少。这个意想不到的结果让研究团队感到惊讶。

paras.en: "The birds became so efficient that they were not using any more energy to carry the weight than they needed to walk without the weight," Rubenson said.
paras.zh: 鲁本森说：“这些鸟变得如此高效，以至于它们携带重量所消耗的能量并不多于它们在没有重量的情况下行走所需的能量。”

paras.en: Another unexpected finding emerged when the researchers compared the two groups. On average, birds accustomed to carrying weights throughout development used no more energy while walking with their bands than ordinary birds used when walking without any added weight.
paras.zh: 当研究人员比较两组时，出现了另一个意想不到的发现。平均而言，在整个发育过程中习惯负重的鸟类在带着带子行走时，并不比普通鸟类在没有任何额外重量的情况下行走时消耗更多的能量。

paras.en: Together, these observations suggest that experiences early in life can substantially influence how efficiently animals move as adults.
paras.zh: 总之，这些观察结果表明，生命早期的经历可以极大地影响动物成年后的移动效率。

paras.en: "This shows that animals -- and this probably includes humans -- can become more efficient based on their life experiences. So, when humans exercise regularly throughout our childhood and adolescence, it could build our capacity for exercise throughout our lives."
paras.zh: “这表明动物——可能包括人类——可以根据其生活经历变得更有效率。因此，当人类在整个童年和青春期定期锻炼时，可以增强我们一生的锻炼能力。”

paras.en: The findings provide new evidence that physical activity during development can have lasting effects on the energy required for movement. Whether the same adaptations occur in humans remains to be established, but the research suggests a potential mechanism through which childhood exercise could help support physical activity later in life.
paras.zh: 这些发现提供了新的证据，表明发育过程中的体力活动可以对运动所需的能量产生持久的影响。人类是否也会发生同样的适应仍有待确定，但研究表明，童年时期的锻炼可以帮助支持以后生活中的身体活动。

paras.en: Stephen Piazza, a professor of kinesiology at Penn State, also participated in the research, along with several current and former graduate students working with Piazza and Rubenson.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学运动机能学教授斯蒂芬·皮亚扎（Stephen Piazza）以及与皮亚扎和鲁本森一起工作的几名现任和前任研究生也参与了这项研究。

paras.en: The study's two co-first authors were Talayah Johnson and Kavya Katugam-Dechene. Johnson completed her master's degree at Penn State and is now pursuing a doctorate at the University of Pennsylvania. Katugam-Dechene received her doctorate from Penn State and currently serves as a research assistant professor of biomedical and rehabilitation engineering at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
paras.zh: 该研究的两位共同第一作者是 Talayah Johnson 和 Kavya Katugam-Dechene。约翰逊在宾夕法尼亚州立大学完成了硕士学位，目前正在宾夕法尼亚大学攻读博士学位。卡图甘-德切恩 (Katugam-Dechene) 在宾夕法尼亚州立大学获得博士学位，目前担任北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校生物医学和康复工程研究助理教授。

paras.en: Other contributors included Ian Dechene, who worked as research staff on the project and is now a software engineer, and Roberto Castro, a Penn State doctoral student jointly advised by Piazza and Rubenson.
paras.zh: 其他贡献者包括曾担任该项目研究人员、现为软件工程师的 Ian Dechene，以及由 Piazza 和 Rubenson 共同指导的宾夕法尼亚州立大学博士生 Roberto Castro。

paras.en: Funding was provided by the National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases, part of the National Institutes of Health, through awards R21AR071588 and R01AR080711. The researchers are solely responsible for the study's content, which does not necessarily reflect the official positions of the National Institutes of Health.
paras.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院下属的国家关节炎、肌肉骨骼和皮肤疾病研究所通过 R21AR071588 和 R01AR080711 奖项提供了资金。研究人员对研究内容全权负责，研究内容并不一定反映美国国立卫生研究院的官方立场。

paras.zh: 材料由宾夕法尼亚州立大学提供。原著由亚伦·瓦格纳撰写。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Cornell scientists identify rare human genetic disorder in two unusually long-legged cats

paras.en: Cornell scientists identify rare human genetic disorder in two unusually long-legged cats
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学的科学家在两只异常长腿的猫身上发现了罕见的人类遗传疾病

paras.en: - Two unusually long-legged cats have helped scientists uncover the first genetically confirmed cases of Marfan syndrome in domestic felines. Researchers at Cornell University discovered that the brothers carried two altered copies of a gene linked to the rare connective tissue disorder, which can affect the eyes, heart, and blood vessels. Surprisingly, the cats survived into adulthood because their genetic mutation still allowed some normal function.
paras.zh: - 两只异常长腿的猫帮助科学家发现了第一例家养猫科动物中经基因证实的马凡氏综合症病例。康奈尔大学的研究人员发现，兄弟俩携带与罕见结缔组织疾病相关的基因的两个改变的副本，这种疾病会影响眼睛、心脏和血管。令人惊讶的是，这些猫能够存活到成年，因为它们的基因突变仍然允许一些正常功能。

paras.en: Two brothers named Gary and Shaggy have helped Cornell University researchers make a rare genetic discovery. In a study published in Scientific Reports, scientists reported the first molecular characterization of Marfan syndrome in domestic cats, a condition primarily recognized in humans.
paras.zh: 加里和沙吉两兄弟帮助康奈尔大学的研究人员做出了一项罕见的基因发现。在《科学报告》上发表的一项研究中，科学家们首次报告了家猫马凡氏综合症的分子特征，这种疾病主要在人类身上发现。

paras.en: Gary and Shaggy first stood out as kittens because of their unusually long limbs. As they grew older, veterinarians also identified abnormalities in their eye structures and an enlarged aorta, the body's main artery. Together, these symptoms suggested Marfan syndrome, an inherited condition that weakens connective tissues throughout the body. The disorder affects approximately 1 in 4,000 people, but these brothers represented the first known documented feline cases.
paras.zh: 加里和夏吉在小时候就因其四肢异常长而引人注目。随着它们年龄的增长，兽医还发现它们的眼睛结构异常，并且主动脉（身体的主动脉）增大。这些症状综合起来表明马凡氏综合症，这是一种削弱全身结缔组织的遗传性疾病。这种疾病影响了大约四千分之一的人，但这些兄弟代表了第一批已知的有记录的猫科动物病例。

paras.en: "The findings provide a foundation for improved veterinary diagnostics," said senior author Dr. Jacquelyn Evans, assistant professor in the College of Veterinary Medicine and at the Baker Institute for Animal Health. "It can help veterinarians recognize similar cases in the future and may help develop genetic tests."
paras.zh: “这些发现为改进兽医诊断奠定了基础，”资深作者、兽医学院和贝克动物健康研究所助理教授杰奎琳·埃文斯博士说。 “它可以帮助兽医将来识别类似的病例，并可能有助于开发基因测试。”

paras.en: Scientists Uncover a Surprising Genetic Twist
paras.zh: 科学家发现了令人惊讶的基因扭曲

paras.en: To determine what caused the brothers' unusual symptoms, researchers from multiple disciplines conducted thorough medical examinations and analyzed their DNA. Their investigation identified changes in a gene called FBN1, which provides instructions for producing fibrillin-1. This protein is essential for healthy connective tissue, helping support structures throughout the body, including blood vessels, bones, ligaments, skin, and eyes.
paras.zh: 为了确定兄弟俩出现异常症状的原因，来自多个学科的研究人员进行了彻底的医学检查并分析了他们的 DNA。他们的研究发现了一种名为 FBN1 的基因发生了变化，该基因为产生 fibrillin-1 提供了指令。这种蛋白质对于健康的结缔组织至关重要，有助于支撑整个身体的结构，包括血管、骨骼、韧带、皮肤和眼睛。

paras.en: Genetic testing revealed that Gary and Shaggy each had two altered copies of FBN1, having inherited one from each parent. This was especially notable because, in humans, a mutation in just one copy of the gene can be enough to cause Marfan syndrome. Having two altered copies is exceptionally uncommon and can severely disrupt the production of normal fibrillin-1.
paras.zh: 基因测试显示，Gary 和 Shaggy 各有两个 FBN1 变异拷贝，分别从父母那里继承了一个。这一点尤其值得注意，因为在人类中，仅一个基因拷贝的突变就足以引起马凡氏综合症。拥有两个改变的副本非常罕见，并且会严重破坏正常原纤维蛋白-1 的产生。

paras.en: Yet the brothers' genetic changes had an unexpected effect. Further analysis showed that their particular variant did not completely disable the gene. Instead, it interfered with how the gene's instructions were processed while still allowing some normal activity to continue. That remaining function helps explain why Gary and Shaggy were able to survive into adulthood, even though carrying two copies of such a mutation could otherwise have resulted in a much more severe form of the disorder.
paras.zh: 然而兄弟俩的基因变化产生了意想不到的效果。进一步的分析表明，他们的特定变体并没有完全禁用该基因。相反，它干扰了基因指令的处理方式，同时仍然允许一些正常活动继续进行。剩余的功能有助于解释为什么加里和沙吉能够存活到成年，尽管携带这种突变的两个拷贝可能会导致更严重的疾病形式。

paras.en: Materials provided by Cornell University. Original written by Teresa Griffin. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由康奈尔大学提供。原创作者：特蕾莎·格里芬。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Scientists reveal why some workout recovery tricks can backfire

paras.en: Scientists reveal why some workout recovery tricks can backfire
paras.zh: 科学家揭示了为什么一些锻炼恢复技巧会适得其反

paras.en: - Ice baths, massages, compression garments, and recovery supplements promise faster muscle recovery, but research suggests their benefits are often overstated, and some techniques may even undermine long-term gains. Scientists say the most effective recovery methods are far simpler and cheaper: getting enough sleep, eating well, and giving muscles time to rebuild.
paras.zh: - 冰浴、按摩、压缩衣和恢复补充剂有望加快肌肉恢复速度，但研究表明它们的好处常常被夸大，有些技术甚至可能会损害长期收益。科学家表示，最有效的恢复方法要简单得多、成本也低：充足的睡眠、良好的饮食以及给肌肉时间重建。

paras.en: Finishing a tough workout always feels good. That is, until a few hours later when those uncomfortable muscle aches start setting in. This discomfort can linger for days – making easy, everyday tasks a challenge.
paras.zh: 完成艰苦的锻炼总是感觉很好。也就是说，直到几个小时后，那些不舒服的肌肉疼痛开始出现。这种不适可能会持续数天——使简单的日常任务成为一项挑战。

paras.en: In search of relief, some recreational gym-goers are adopting the kind of recovery techniques once reserved for elite athletes. Social media and professional sport have helped popularize everything from ice baths and compression garments to massage and recovery supplements.
paras.zh: 为了寻求缓解，一些休闲健身爱好者正在采用曾经为精英运动员保留的恢复技术。社交媒体和职业运动帮助普及了从冰浴和压缩衣到按摩和恢复补充剂的一切。

paras.en: While many of these products promise faster recovery, reduced soreness and improved performance, the science is often more nuanced.
paras.zh: 虽然其中许多产品承诺更快的恢复、减少疼痛和提高性能，但科学原理往往更加微妙。

paras.en: Few recovery strategies have received as much attention as ice baths. This involves immersing oneself in water that is below 15°C to boost recovery. But the evidence for this benefit is mixed.
paras.zh: 很少有恢复策略像冰浴一样受到如此多的关注。这包括将自己浸入低于 15°C 的水中以促进恢复。但证明这种好处的证据是好坏参半。

paras.en: Ice baths help ease inflammation, which research suggests can reduce muscle soreness and help athletes recover muscle function more effectively in a 24-hour period.
paras.zh: 冰浴有助于缓解炎症，研究表明，冰浴可以减轻肌肉酸痛，帮助运动员在 24 小时内更有效地恢复肌肉功能。

paras.en: But there’s a catch. While inflammation causes soreness, it also triggers adaptations that build muscle. Dampening this response with ice baths may limit some of the long-term benefits of training – particularly if they’re used regularly.
paras.zh: 但有一个问题。虽然炎症会引起酸痛，但它也会引发增强肌肉的适应。用冰浴抑制这种反应可能会限制训练的一些长期好处——特别是如果经常使用的话。

paras.en: When it comes to ice baths, side-stepping short-term pain may sacrifice long-term gains. It’s best to only use them when rapid recovery is vital.
paras.zh: 当谈到冰浴时，回避短期痛苦可能会牺牲长期收益。最好只在快速恢复至关重要时才使用它们。

paras.en: Compression garments are commonly worn after exercise to speed recovery. The idea is that the external pressure they apply supports circulation, enhances blood flow to the muscles, and reduces swelling.
paras.zh: 运动后通常穿压缩衣以加速恢复。他们的想法是，他们施加的外部压力支持循环，增强流向肌肉的血液，并减少肿胀。

paras.en: But while compression garments might make you think they’re helping as they reduce soreness, evidence showing they actually improve muscle recovery is generally less convincing.
paras.zh: 但是，虽然压缩衣可能会让您认为它们有助于减轻酸痛，但表明它们实际上可以改善肌肉恢复的证据通常不太令人信服。

paras.en: A study from 2022 put them to the test. One group was given compression garments; the other group was given a placebo tablet that they were told was equally as effective as compression.
paras.zh: 2022 年的一项研究对它们进行了测试。一组获得压缩衣；另一组获得压缩衣。另一组则服用安慰剂片剂，并被告知与压力疗法同样有效。

paras.en: The compression garments were shown to improve circulation and muscle blood flow, while the placebo had no effect on these measures. This suggests the effects of compression garments on recovery are physiological and aren’t simply due to expectation or perception.
paras.zh: 压缩衣被证明可以改善血液循环和肌肉血流，而安慰剂对这些措施没有影响。这表明压缩衣对恢复的影响是生理性的，而不仅仅是由于期望或感知。

paras.en: However, whether these changes meaningfully improve performance is less clear. Although emerging evidence suggests compression garments genuinely affect some markers of recovery, this is unlikely to directly restore muscle function.
paras.zh: 然而，这些变化是否能有效提高性能尚不清楚。尽管新的证据表明压缩衣确实会影响某些恢复标志，但这不太可能直接恢复肌肉功能。

paras.en: So, compression garments may mainly help because they make you feel better recovered.
paras.zh: 因此，压缩衣可能主要有帮助，因为它们让您感觉恢复得更好。

paras.en: Massage is one of the few recovery interventions with relatively consistent scientific support. It can reduce soreness and improve perceived recovery after exercise.
paras.zh: 按摩是少数具有相对一致科学支持的恢复干预措施之一。它可以减少运动后的酸痛并改善感知恢复。

paras.en: It’s not currently clear what mechanisms actually trigger the recovery benefits of massage. But it could be due to the fact that massage reduces muscle stiffness, improves circulation and boosts relaxation.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚是什么机制真正触发了按摩的恢复功效。但这可能是因为按摩可以减少肌肉僵硬，改善血液循环并促进放松。

paras.en: But although athletes feel less sore and perceptions of recovery are improved after a massage, objective measures of performance and muscle function are modest and inconsistent.
paras.zh: 但是，尽管按摩后运动员的酸痛感减轻了，恢复的感觉也得到了改善，但对表现和肌肉功能的客观测量却是适度且不一致的。

paras.en: Massage might ease the discomfort of training, but don’t expect miraculous performance restoration.
paras.zh: 按摩可能会缓解训练时的不适，但不要指望奇迹般的恢复表现。

paras.en: The nutrition supplement market is a big business, with hundreds of brightly coloured recovery drinks and capsules promising reduced soreness and faster recovery. But not all supplements are created equal. Some appear to confer small benefits, while some come with hype that science doesn’t back up.
paras.zh: 营养补充剂市场是一个大市场，有数百种颜色鲜艳的恢复饮料和胶囊，有望减少酸痛并加快恢复速度。但并非所有补充剂都是一样的。有些似乎带来了一些小好处，而有些则带有科学依据的炒作。

paras.en: Whey protein, for instance, is a well-researched supplement. Rich in amino acids (the building blocks of protein), it stimulates muscle protein synthesis – the process which helps your muscles grow. Whey protein is shown to have small-to-moderate benefits for muscle recovery – but evidence that it can alleviate soreness is inconsistent.
paras.zh: 例如，乳清蛋白是一种经过充分研究的补充剂。它富含氨基酸（蛋白质的组成部分），可刺激肌肉蛋白质的合成，这一过程有助于肌肉生长。乳清蛋白被证明对肌肉恢复有小到中等的好处，但它可以缓解酸痛的证据并不一致。

paras.en: Branch chain amino acids (BCAAs) are widely-used supplements that typically contain a mixture of the amino acids leucine, isoleucine and valine. BCAAs are popular because it’s believed the leucine they contain switches on protein synthesis.
paras.zh: 支链氨基酸 (BCAA) 是广泛使用的补充剂，通常含有亮氨酸、异亮氨酸和缬氨酸的混合物。支链氨基酸很受欢迎，因为人们相信它们所含的亮氨酸可以开启蛋白质合成。

paras.en: Yet despite their popularity, BCAAs appear less effective than complete protein sources for muscle recovery. This is because muscle repair requires all essential amino acids – not just the ones found in BCAAs. Food sources such as chicken, beef, salmon and tofu contain all the essential amino acids.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管支链氨基酸很受欢迎，但它对于肌肉恢复的效果似乎不如完整的蛋白质来源。这是因为肌肉修复需要所有必需氨基酸，而不仅仅是支链氨基酸中的氨基酸。鸡肉、牛肉、鲑鱼和豆腐等食物含有所有必需氨基酸。

paras.en: Tart cherry juice is a relatively new supplement in the fitness world. It’s rich in polyphenols – plant compounds that are said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant (reducing or preventing cell damage) effects. It’s for these reasons that tart cherry juice is thought to help reduce muscle damage and soreness.
paras.zh: 酸樱桃汁是健身界相对较新的补充剂。它富含多酚——一种植物化合物，据说具有抗炎和抗氧化（减少或防止细胞损伤）作用。正是由于这些原因，酸樱桃汁被认为有助于减少肌肉损伤和酸痛。

paras.en: Although this is still an emerging area of research, evidence suggests these compounds have small-to-moderate effects on reducing soreness after workouts, and may also help restore muscular strength and power.
paras.zh: 尽管这仍然是一个新兴的研究领域，但有证据表明这些化合物对减轻锻炼后的酸痛有小到中度的作用，并且还可能有助于恢复肌肉的力量和力量。

paras.en: Omega-3 (fish oil) supplements are often championed as a way to reduce inflammation and accelerate recovery after exercise. While some research suggests they can modestly reduce muscle soreness and help preserve muscle function after strenuous exercise, results are far from consistent. As such, omega-3 supplements are unlikely to vastly improve recovery.
paras.zh: Omega-3（鱼油）补充剂通常被认为是减少炎症和加速运动后恢复的一种方法。虽然一些研究表明它们可以适度减轻肌肉酸痛并有助于在剧烈运动后保持肌肉功能，但结果远不一致。因此，Omega-3 补充剂不太可能大幅改善康复效果。

paras.en: Importantly, all of these nutrients can be obtained from a healthy, balanced diet. Science also shows that it’s better to get these nutrients from whole foods over expensive supplements, as whole foods provide other important nutrients that may interact synergistically to support health.
paras.zh: 重要的是，所有这些营养素都可以从健康、均衡的饮食中获得。科学还表明，从天然食品中获取这些营养比从昂贵的补充剂中获取更好，因为天然食品提供了其他重要的营养物质，这些营养物质可以协同作用来支持健康。

paras.en: Popular recovery techniques might have small benefits for reducing feelings of soreness, but they don’t actually tend to restore muscle function all that much. Instead, the strongest evidence for good recovery comes from the basics:
paras.zh: 流行的恢复技术可能对减轻酸痛感有一点好处，但它们实际上并不能恢复肌肉功能。相反，良好恢复的最有力证据来自于以下基础：

paras.en: - Prioritize sleep: Get 7-9 hours of sleep per night so the body can conduct vital recovery and adaptive processes.
paras.zh: - 优先考虑睡眠：每晚获得 7-9 小时的睡眠，以便身体进行重要的恢复和适应过程。

paras.en: - Fuel properly: Consume 20-40g of protein after exercise for muscle repair and adequate carbohydrate intake to replenish energy stores.
paras.zh: - 适当补充能量：运动后摄入20-40克蛋白质以修复肌肉，并摄入足够的碳水化合物以补充能量储存。

paras.en: - Train smart: Pair good sleep and nutrition with a sensible, well-structured training plan. This includes allowing rest days between sessions, challenging yourself a bit more each time, and scheduling easier sessions when needed to allow recovery.
paras.zh: - 明智地训练：将良好的睡眠和营养与合理、结构良好的训练计划相结合。这包括在训练之间留出休息日，每次都挑战自己一点，以及在需要恢复时安排更轻松的训练。

paras.en: So, perhaps the biggest lesson here is that recovery cannot be bottled and sold.
paras.zh: 所以，也许这里最大的教训是回收不能装瓶和出售。

paras.en: Materials provided by The Conversation. Original written by Max Davis, Postgraduate Research Student, Centre for Nutrition, Exercise and Metabolism, University of Bath. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由对话提供。原文由巴斯大学营养、运动和代谢中心研究生 Max Davis 撰写。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: 'The X-Files' is officially returning as Hulu picks up Ryan Coogler's 'reimagining' of the sci-fi icon
articles.author: Ian Stokes

paras.en: The truth is once again out there, as Disney & Hulu confirmed today that they have picked up a new "The X-Files" show for a full season.
paras.zh: 真相再一次浮出水面，迪士尼和 Hulu 今天确认他们已经选择了新的《X 档案》一整季。

paras.en: Described as a "reimagining" of the classic series, the project comes from Ryan Coogler, the acclaimed writer and director of "Creed", "Black Panther", and "Sinners", and will star Danielle Deadwyler and Himesh Patel.
paras.zh: 该项目被描述为经典系列的“重新想象”，由《信条》、《黑豹》和《罪人》的著名编剧兼导演瑞恩·库格勒执导，由丹妮尔·戴德威勒和希米什·帕特尔主演。

paras.en: The show's premise will sound very familiar to fans of the original, as it centers on "two highly decorated but vastly different FBI agents who form an unlikely bond when they are assigned to a long-shuttered division devoted to cases involving unexplained phenomena."
paras.zh: 该剧的前提对于原作的粉丝来说听起来非常熟悉，因为它的中心是“两名功勋卓著但截然不同的联邦调查局特工，当他们被分配到一个长期关闭的专门处理涉及无法解释现象的案件的部门时，他们形成了一种不太可能的联系。”

paras.en: "I've loved 'The X-Files' for a long time, so getting the chance to write and direct the pilot has meant a great deal to me," said Coogler. "What Chris Carter created is special, and we wanted to honor everything that made the original series connect with so many people while also finding our own way into that world."
paras.zh: 库格勒说：“我很喜欢《X档案》，所以有机会编写和导演试播集对我来说意义重大。” “克里斯·卡特创作的作品很特别，我们希望向那些让原版系列与这么多人产生联系的一切致敬，同时也找到我们自己进入这个世界的方式。”

paras.en: Coogler wrote, directed, and executive produced the pilot for this new show, which impressed executives over at Hulu enough to give the show the greenlight. He's certainly got the pedigree when it comes to "spooky", as "Sinners" was a modern horror masterpiece, winning the Best Original Screenplay Oscar at the 2025 Academy Awards. The X-Files is one of the greatest sci-fi shows of all time, and we can't wait to see what a modern take on the classic formula looks like.
paras.zh: 库格勒为这部新剧编写、导演并执行制作了试播集，这给 Hulu 的高管留下了深刻的印象，足以让该剧获得批准。说到“恐怖”，他无疑是有血统的，因为《罪人》是一部现代恐怖杰作，赢得了 2025 年奥斯卡最佳原创剧本奖。 《X 档案》是有史以来最伟大的科幻剧之一，我们迫不及待地想看看经典公式的现代演绎是什么样子。

paras.en: Alongside the leads, the cast will include Amy Madigan, Ben Foster, Devery Jacobs, Lochlyn Munro, Tantoo Cardinal, Joel D. Montgrand, Sofia Grace Clifton, and Hollywood legend Steve Buscemi (an inspired casting choice for any show, but especially here. He looks like a man who's seen the truth).
paras.zh: 除了主演之外，演员阵容还包括艾米·马迪根、本·福斯特、德弗里·雅各布斯、洛奇林·芒罗、坦图·卡迪纳尔、乔尔·D·蒙特格朗、索菲亚·格蕾丝·克利夫顿和好莱坞传奇人物史蒂夫·布西密（史蒂夫·布西密是任何剧集的灵感选角选择，尤其是在这里。他看起来像一个看到了真相的人）。

paras.en: Both Coogler and Hulu are being coy about how this new series will fit into the continuity of the original show. It's being described as a reimagining, but they've stopped short of calling it a reboot, which could leave the door open for Mulder and Scully to return in some capacity.
paras.zh: 库格勒和 Hulu 都对这个新剧集将如何融入原剧的连续性保持沉默。它被描述为重新构思，但他们并没有将其称为重新启动，这可能为穆德和斯卡利以某种身份回归敞开了大门。

paras.en: The original creator of "The X-Files", Chris Carter, is also on board as an executive producer, which is great news for fans who are hoping this new incarnation keeps the spirit of the original alive.
paras.zh: 《X 档案》的原创作者克里斯·卡特 (Chris Carter) 也担任执行制片人，这对于那些希望这个新版本能够保持原作精神的粉丝来说是个好消息。

paras.en: There is no confirmed release date yet, but Ryan Coogler's The X-Files project will launch exclusively on Hulu (US) & Disney+ (UK).
paras.zh: 目前尚未确定发布日期，但 Ryan Coogler 的《X 档案》项目将在 Hulu（美国）和 Disney+（英国）独家发布。

paras.en: Ian is the Entertainment Editor at Space.com, covering movies, TV series, and games in the space and sci-fi realms. He's a massive sci-fi nerd and has been writing about games and entertainment for over eight years, with articles on sites like Space, LiveScience, GamesRadar, and more. With a degree in biology, a PhD in chemistry, and his previous role at the Institute of Physics Publishing, Ian is taking a world tour through the different scientific disciplines.
paras.zh: Ian 是 Space.com 的娱乐编辑，报道太空和科幻领域的电影、电视剧和游戏。他是一位超级科幻迷，八年来一直在撰写有关游戏和娱乐的文章，并在 Space、LiveScience、GamesRadar 等网站上发表文章。伊恩 (Ian) 拥有生物学学位和化学博士学位，此前曾在物理出版社工作过，他正在世界各地探索不同的科学学科。

articles.title: Life after the moon: Artemis II's Christina Koch steps down from active astronaut duty
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Don't expect any of the Artemis II moon astronauts to fly again soon.
paras.zh: 不要指望阿耳忒弥斯二号月球宇航员很快就能再次飞行。

paras.en: On Tuesday (Oct. 13), NASA announced that Artemis II mission specialist Christina Koch will become the agency’s acting deputy chief engineer, effective Nov. 1.
paras.zh: 周二（10 月 13 日），NASA 宣布阿耳忒弥斯二号任务专家克里斯蒂娜·科赫（Christina Koch）将成为该机构代理副总工程师，从 11 月 1 日起生效。

paras.en: "With this appointment, Koch will transition to management astronaut status and will no longer be eligible for future spaceflight assignments," NASA officials wrote in a statement on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局官员在周二的一份声明中写道：“通过这一任命，科赫将过渡到管理宇航员身份，并且将不再有资格执行未来的航天任务。”

paras.en: Her three Artemis II crewmates had already shared their next moves, none of which put another spaceflight in play in the near future.
paras.zh: 她的三位阿耳忒弥斯二号船员已经分享了他们的下一步行动，但都没有在不久的将来进行另一次太空飞行。

paras.en: Mission commander Reid Wiseman and pilot Victor Glover, both of NASA, became "emeritus" astronauts last month, a role that seems to include planning, advising and mentoring duties but no flights into the final frontier. Glover will also work full-time at his alma mater, the California Polytechnic State University (Cal Poly) in San Luis Obispo.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的任务指挥官里德·怀斯曼和飞行员维克多·格洛弗上个月成为“荣誉”宇航员，这一角色似乎包括规划、建议和指导职责，但没有飞往最后边境的航班。格洛弗还将在他的母校圣路易斯奥比斯波的加州理工州立大学 (Cal Poly) 全职工作。

paras.en: "I'm grateful they will continue sharing what they learned with our astronauts, flight controllers and engineers as we prepare for Artemis III in 2027 and the missions that follow," NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said of Wiseman and Glover in a Sept. 9 statement.
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 在 9 月 9 日的一份声明中谈到怀斯曼和格洛弗时表示：“我很感激他们在我们为 2027 年阿尔忒弥斯 III 号和后续任务做准备时，将继续与我们的宇航员、飞行控制员和工程师分享他们所学到的知识。”

paras.en: The fourth Artemis II astronaut, mission specialist Jeremy Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency, announced a change of his own in July: He planned to become a reservist in the Royal Canadian Air Force, where he's also a colonel. That move became official last month as well.
paras.zh: 第四位阿耳忒弥斯二号宇航员、加拿大航天局的任务专家杰里米·汉森 (Jeremy Hansen) 在 7 月份宣布了自己的改变：他计划成为加拿大皇家空军的预备役军人，同时也是一名上校。这一举措也在上个月正式生效。

paras.en: Artemis II sent the four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the moon in an Orion capsule. It was the first crewed mission of NASA's Artemis program and the first human spaceflight beyond low Earth orbit (LEO) since Apollo 17 in 1972.
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号让四名宇航员乘坐猎户座太空舱进行了为期 10 天的绕月旅行。这是美国宇航局阿尔忒弥斯计划的首次载人飞行任务，也是自 1972 年阿波罗 17 号以来首次超越近地轨道 (LEO) 的载人航天飞行。

paras.en: As Isaacman mentioned, the next mission in the program is Artemis III, a docking test in LEO scheduled to launch next year. The Artemis III crew, which was announced in June, consists of NASA astronauts Randy Bresnik (commander), Andre Douglas and Frank Rubio (mission specialists) and Luca Parmitano of the European Space Agency (pilot).
paras.zh: 正如艾萨克曼提到的，该计划的下一个任务是阿尔忒弥斯 III，计划于明年发射的近地轨道对接测试。 6月宣布的阿耳忒弥斯三号机组人员包括美国宇航局宇航员兰迪·布雷斯尼克（指挥官）、安德烈·道格拉斯和弗兰克·卢比奥（任务专家）以及欧洲航天局的卢卡·帕尔米塔诺（飞行员）。

paras.en: If all goes according to plan, Artemis IV will land astronauts near the moon's south pole in 2028. We don't yet know who will fly on that historic mission.
paras.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，阿耳忒弥斯四号将于 2028 年将宇航员降落在月球南极附近。我们还不知道谁将执行这一历史性任务。

paras.en: Koch will succeed current NASA Deputy Chief Engineer Katherine Van Hooser, who will retire on Oct. 21 after more than 35 years of work for the space agency.
paras.zh: 科赫将接替现任 NASA 副总工程师凯瑟琳·范·胡瑟 (Katherine Van Hooser)，凯瑟琳·范胡瑟 (Katherine Van Hooser) 在为航天局工作超过 35 年之后将于 10 月 21 日退休。

paras.en: "In her new role, Koch will help lead NASA's engineering community, supporting technical oversight, mission readiness, and engineering excellence across the agency's programs and projects," agency officials said in Tuesday's statement.
paras.zh: 该机构官员在周二的声明中表示：“在她的新职位上，科赫将帮助领导 NASA 的工程界，支持该机构整个计划和项目的技术监督、任务准备和工程卓越性。”

paras.en: Koch is a natural choice for the job, given her education and experience. She holds bachelor's degrees in electrical engineering and physics and a master's in electrical engineering, and she began her NASA career as an electrical engineer at Goddard Space Flight Center in Maryland.
paras.zh: 考虑到科赫的教育背景和经验，她是这份工作的自然选择。她拥有电气工程和物理学学士学位以及电气工程硕士学位，并在马里兰州戈达德太空飞行中心担任电气工程师，开始了她的 NASA 职业生涯。

paras.en: NASA selected Koch as an astronaut candidate in 2013. She has two spaceflights under her belt: Artemis II and a 328-day-flight to the International Space Station that launched in March 2019. That's the longest space mission ever conducted by a woman, and it featured the first three all-female spacewalks, which Koch conducted with fellow NASA astronaut Jessica Meir.
paras.zh: NASA 于 2013 年选择科赫作为宇航员候选人。她曾进行过两次太空飞行：阿耳忒弥斯二号和 2019 年 3 月发射的前往国际空间站的 328 天飞行。这是有史以来由女性执行的最长的太空任务，其中包括科赫与 NASA 宇航员杰西卡·梅尔一起进行的前三次全女性太空行走。

paras.en: "Christina has seen NASA engineering from both sides of the equation: developing complex systems on the ground and trusting them with her life in space," Isaacman said in the Tuesday statement.
paras.zh: 艾萨克曼在周二的声明中说：“克里斯蒂娜从等式的两边看到了美国宇航局的工程：在地面上开发复杂的系统，并将她在太空中的生活托付给它们。”

paras.en: "After spending nearly a year living and working aboard the International Space Station and helping lead America back around the moon on Artemis II this year, she brings an extraordinary combination of technical expertise, operational experience, and judgment to this role," he added. "I am excited to see the impact she will have across NASA as we return Americans to the lunar surface, build the Moon Base, get underway on nuclear power in space, and develop the capabilities that will ultimately take us on to Mars."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“在国际空间站上生活和工作了近一年，并在今年帮助美国在阿耳忒弥斯二号上重返月球之后，她为这一角色带来了技术专长、操作经验和判断力的非凡结合。” “我很高兴看到她将对美国宇航局产生影响，因为我们让美国人重返月球表面，建造月球基地，在太空开发核电，并开发最终将我们带到火星的能力。”

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 14, 1947: Test pilot Chuck Yeager breaks the sound barrier in the Bell X-1, the first X-plane
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Oct. 14, 1947, Chuck Yeager broke the sound barrier for the first time!
paras.zh: 1947 年 10 月 14 日，查克·耶格尔 (Chuck Yeager) 首次突破音障！

paras.en: Chuck Yeager was a test pilot for the U.S. Air Force who made history by flying an aircraft faster than the speed of sound.
paras.zh: 查克·耶格尔是美国空军的一名试飞员，他驾驶飞机的速度超过音速，创造了历史。

paras.en: Yeager made his historic flight in a Bell X-1 rocket plane that he named "Glamorous Glennis" after his wife. Yeager had broken two ribs the night before when he fell off a horse, but that didn't stop him!
paras.zh: 耶格尔驾驶贝尔 X-1 火箭飞机完成了他的历史性飞行，他以妻子的名字将这架飞机命名为“迷人的格伦尼斯”。耶格尔前一天晚上从马上摔下来时摔断了两根肋骨，但这并没有阻止他！

paras.en: His aircraft was dropped from a Boeing B-29 bomber before accelerating to a speed of Mach 1.07, which is about 821 mph (1,321 km/h). The speed of sound, Mach 1, is about 760 mph (1,223 km/h).
paras.zh: 他的飞机从一架波音 B-29 轰炸机上坠落，然后加速到 1.07 马赫，约合 821 英里/小时（1,321 公里/小时）。声速为 1 马赫，约为 760 英里/小时（1,223 公里/小时）。

paras.en: Before Yeager made his daring Bell X-1 flight, piloted supersonic flight was only a concept.
paras.zh: 在耶格尔进行大胆的贝尔 X-1 飞行之前，有人驾驶超音速飞行只是一个概念。

paras.en: The Bell X-1 began its life as the XS-1, a cooperative project between NASA's predecessor the National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics (NACA) and the U.S. Army Forces, which would evolve later into the U.S. Air Force. Bell Aircraft won the contract to build the experimental plane in March 1945 and was delivered in December of that year.
paras.zh: 贝尔 X-1 最初名为 XS-1，是 NASA 的前身国家航空咨询委员会 (NACA) 与美国陆军（后来演变为美国空军）之间的合作项目。贝尔飞机公司于1945年3月赢得了建造这架实验飞机的合同，并于当年12月交付。

paras.en: The final vehicle was a single-piloted aircraft that was just over 30 feet (nearly 11 meters) long, had a wingspan of about 28 feet (8.5 m) and powered by a rocket engine using liquid oxygen and ethyl alcohol in water as propellant. Yeager's historic flight followed a series of unpowered glide tests, incuding three by Yeager himself in August of 1947, followed by ever faster subsonic powered flights.
paras.zh: 最终的飞行器是一架单人驾驶飞机，长度超过 30 英尺（近 11 米），翼展约 28 英尺（8.5 m），由火箭发动机提供动力，使用液氧和乙醇水溶液作为推进剂。耶格尔的历史性飞行是在一系列无动力滑翔测试之后完成的，其中包括 1947 年 8 月耶格尔本人进行的三次测试，随后进行了更快的亚音速动力飞行。

paras.en: "The first generation X-1 aircraft changed aviation history in numerous ways, and not simply because they were the first aircraft to fly faster than the speed of sound," NASA wrote in an overview. "Rather, they established the concept of the research aircraft, built solely for experimental purposes, and unhampered by any military or commercial requirements."
paras.zh: NASA 在一份概述中写道：“第一代 X-1 飞机在很多方面改变了航空历史，不仅仅是因为它们是第一架飞行速度超过音速的飞机。” “相反，他们建立了研究飞机的概念​​，仅为实验目的而制造，不受任何军事或商业要求的阻碍。”

paras.en: According to NASA, Yeager's history-making flight wasn't immediately known to the public, a departure from the agency's X-plane tests today.
paras.zh: 据 NASA 称，耶格尔创造历史的飞行并未立即为公众所知，这与该机构今天的 X 飞机测试不同。

paras.en: "Yeager reached a speed of Mach 1.06 at 43,000 feet, becoming the first man to fly supersonic. Air Force officials designated the flight and all data as Top Secret two hours later," NASA wrote. "Not until December 1947 would word leak of the achievement, and it was not until March 1948 that the U.S. Air Force officially confirmed the achievement."
paras.zh: “耶格尔在 43,000 英尺的高度达到了 1.06 马赫的速度，成为第一个超音速飞行的人。两小时后，空军官员将这次飞行和所有数据列为最高机密，”美国宇航局写道。 “直到 1947 年 12 月，这一成果才被泄露，直到 1948 年 3 月，美国空军才正式确认了这一成果。”

paras.en: Yeager's flight and the X-1 program laid the foundation for an ever-more-ambitious X-plane program that continues at NASA and in the U.S. military today.
paras.zh: 耶格尔的飞行和 X-1 计划为如今 NASA 和美国军方继续开展的更加雄心勃勃的 X 飞机计划奠定了基础。

paras.en: NASA's latest X-plane is the X-59 supersonic plane, which is designed to test supersonic flight with quieter sonic booms as way to open up supersonic travel over land for wider commercial use.
paras.zh: NASA 最新的 X 飞机是 X-59 超音速飞机，该飞机旨在测试具有更安静音爆的超音速飞行，以开辟超音速陆地旅行以供更广泛的商业用途。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Deposition Sciences, Inc. Expands Sunshade® Tape Offering with New 12″ × 30″ Format
articles.author: Deposition Sciences, Inc

paras.en: Santa Rosa, CA — October 2026 — Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI), a leader in advanced thin film coatings, proudly announces the introduction of a new 12″ × 30″ format for its Sunshade® Tape thermal control material. This expanded size provides engineers and designers with greater flexibility for integrating thermal protection into larger aerospace and industrial systems.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣罗莎 — 2026 年 10 月 — 先进薄膜涂层领域的领导者 Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI) 自豪地宣布为其 Sunshade® Tape 热控制材料推出新的 12" × 30" 格式。这种扩大的尺寸为工程师和设计人员提供了更大的灵活性，可以将热保护集成到更大的航空航天和工业系统中。

paras.en: Sunshade® Tape is engineered for solar reflectance, thermal stability, and durability in extreme environments. Its lightweight, flexible design reduces energy demands while safeguarding sensitive components from heat exposure. The new format ensures easier application across broader surfaces, enhancing mission reliability and equipment performance.
paras.zh: Sunshade® 胶带专为极端环境下的太阳反射率、热稳定性和耐用性而设计。其轻质、灵活的设计降低了能源需求，同时保护敏感部件免受热暴露。新格式确保更轻松地在更广泛的表面上应用，从而提高任务可靠性和设备性能。

paras.en: “Our customers asked for more versatility, and we delivered,” said Justin Mosier, Sr. Mgr Space Materials at DSI. “The new 12″ × 30″ format makes Sunshade® Tape even more adaptable to complex thermal control challenges.”
paras.zh: “我们的客户要求更多的多功能性，我们满足了，”DSI 空间材料高级经理 Justin Mosier 说道。 “新的 12 英寸 × 30 英寸规格使 Sunshade® 胶带更能适应复杂的热控制挑战。”

paras.en: For more information about Sunshade® Tape and its applications, visit Deposition Sciences, Inc. at https://www.depsci.com.
paras.zh: 有关 Sunshade® Tape 及其应用的更多信息，请访问 Deposition Sciences, Inc.，网址为 https://www.depsci.com。

articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, a panel of industry experts discuss what’s needed to build a moon base. During a live event at the Johns Hopkins University Bloomberg Center, leaders Astrolab, Firefly Space and APL share what a lunar future could look like and what has to happen in the next couple of years to make it a reality.
