articles.title: Preventing EV Lithium-ion Battery Fires
articles.author: Steve Lockwood

paras.en: Electric and hybrid vehicles carry a component that traditional vehicles don’t: lithium-ion batteries. And lithium batteries pose a significant fire safety risk.
paras.zh: 电动和混合动力汽车配备了传统汽车所没有的组件：锂离子电池。而且锂电池存在重大的火灾安全风险。

paras.en: While these fires occur less frequently than gasoline fires, they can be more dangerous because of how hot they burn and how quickly they spread. They are susceptible to “thermal runaway,” a condition in which a failing cell ignites neighboring cells, triggering a rapid chain reaction that can engulf the entire battery.
paras.zh: 虽然这些火灾比汽油火灾发生的频率要低，但由于燃烧的温度和蔓延的速度，它们可能更加危险。它们很容易受到“热失控”的影响，在这种情况下，失效的电池会点燃相邻的电池，引发快速的连锁反应，吞噬整个电池。

paras.en: These fires are powerful, difficult to extinguish and have a high risk of reignition hours or even days later. Shop owners and managers need to be prepared in case a fire emergency were to occur, but do everything they can to prevent it.
paras.zh: 这些火灾非常强大，难以扑灭，并且在数小时甚至数天后重燃的风险很高。店主和经理需要为发生火灾紧急情况做好准备，但要尽一切努力防止火灾发生。

paras.en: Because of the danger involved, prevention is your best defense. Technicians who work on electric vehicles need specialized training to handle high-voltage electrical systems, so they typically understand the risks. However, every member of the shop must be aware of the dangers and know what to do in an emergency.
paras.zh: 由于存在危险，预防是最好的防御。从事电动汽车工作的技术人员需要接受专门的培训来处理高压电气系统，因此他们通常了解其中的风险。然而，店里的每个成员都必须意识到危险并知道在紧急情况下该怎么做。

paras.en: Lithium batteries catch fire in several ways. Swelling, cracking and overcharging are the primary risks. Make sure your crew asks customers about their charging habits and inform them that overcharging can significantly degrade the battery and increase fire risk. This helps you identify hazards and informs the customer of potential risks.
paras.zh: 锂电池起火的方式有多种。膨胀、开裂和过度充电是主要风险。确保您的工作人员询问顾客的充电习惯，并告知他们过度充电会显着降低电池性能并增加火灾风险。这可以帮助您识别危险并告知客户潜在的风险。

paras.en: Even if your technicians are certified, pay close attention to how they handle these vehicles. Punctures, cracks and drops can all lead to fires, so the crew needs to handle the battery components delicately.
paras.zh: 即使您的技术人员获得了认证，也要密切注意他们如何处理这些车辆。刺穿、裂纹和跌落都可能导致火灾，因此工作人员需要小心处理电池组件。

paras.en: They should be keeping an eye out for warning signs such as bulging, cracks or an acrid, metallic smell. These are indicators that the battery might be a hazard.
paras.zh: 他们应该留意警告信号，例如鼓起、裂缝或刺鼻的金属气味。这些迹象表明电池可能存在危险。

paras.en: If a tech notices a battery that may have an issue, take immediate precautions. Remove it from the vehicle and place it in a proper storage container away from the facility. There are protocols in place if this happens. Consult your local fire prevention office for more information, as requirements vary from place to place.
paras.zh: 如果技术人员发现电池可能有问题，请立即采取预防措施。将其从车辆上卸下，并将其放置在远离设施的适当存储容器中。如果发生这种情况，有适当的协议。由于各地的要求有所不同，因此请咨询当地的消防办公室以获取更多信息。

paras.en: If a fire occurs, make sure the crew is trained to use specialized equipment to contain it, then call the fire department right away. Do not try to fight the fire yourself. Even if you think the fire was extinguished, call the fire department anyway. The battery can reignite anywhere from within minutes to days later.
paras.zh: 如果发生火灾，请确保工作人员接受过使用专用设备来控制火灾的培训，然后立即致电消防部门。请勿尝试自行灭火。即使您认为火已被扑灭，也请致电消防部门。电池可以在几分钟到几天后的任何地方重新点燃。

paras.en: Make sure every person in your crew knows not to put out a fire with water. Water is never your friend in a shop fire. You never know what type of oil and grease came into contact with the blaze. Always and only use specific fire equipment.
paras.zh: 确保团队中的每个人都知道不能用水灭火。在商店火灾中，水永远不是你的朋友。你永远不知道什么类型的油和油脂与火焰接触。始终且仅使用特定的消防设备。

paras.en: You need to have the right fire extinguisher. When it comes to lithium batteries, a traditional ABC extinguisher won’t cut it. Specialized lithium battery fire extinguishers are now available, specifically designed for lithium-ion risks and thermal runaway.
paras.zh: 您需要拥有合适的灭火器。对于锂电池，传统的 ABC 灭火器无法解决问题。现在可以使用专门的锂电池灭火器，专门针对锂离子风险和热失控而设计。

paras.en: The size of your shop and how many vehicles you handle will determine how many you need. It needs to be within 30 feet of any potentially active fire.
paras.zh: 您商店的规模和您处理的车辆数量将决定您需要多少车辆。它需要位于任何潜在火灾的 30 英尺范围内。

paras.en: Lithium-ion battery fire blankets are essential. But, it’s important to understand that a fire blanket will not fully stop the fire. They simply contain it until the fire department arrives. However, a battery can burst into intense flames within 10 seconds. The fire can trigger a room-wide blaze in minutes. So be sure to have a fire blanket close by.
paras.zh: 锂离子电池灭火毯是必不可少的。但是，重要的是要了解灭火毯并不能完全阻止火灾。他们只是简单地控制住它，直到消防部门到达。然而，电池可能会在 10 秒内突然起火。火灾可能在几分钟内引发整个房间的大火。因此，请务必在附近备有防火毯。

paras.en: Train your team on how to use these fire extinguishers. There are plenty of fire safety courses at your disposal with a quick Google search. Some will even hold group training sessions with several different shops to lower costs.
If the car has a lithium battery, it needs to be held in a separate area, especially if the battery will be exposed.
paras.zh: 如果汽车配备锂电池，则需要将其放置在单独的区域，特别是如果电池会暴露在外。

paras.en: When the battery is punctured or has a crack, flammable vapors come out. Therefore, they must be kept away from excessive heat or sparks. Have an area dedicated to working on electric or hybrid vehicles with lithium batteries.
paras.zh: 当电池被刺穿或出现裂纹时，会释放出易燃蒸气。因此，必须使它们远离过热或火花。拥有专门用于使用锂电池的电动或混合动力汽车的工作区域。

paras.en: Be proactive and keep an eye out for hazards. If you see flames, the situation has already escalated. Constantly remind your crew about fire safety, provide equipment training and ensure everyone knows the warning signs. As electric vehicles take a larger share of the market, the shops that plan will keep their crews safe. A little extra preparation now is far less expensive than a fire later.
paras.zh: 积极主动并留意危险。如果看到火焰，则表明情况已经升级。不断提醒船员注意消防安全，提供设备培训并确保每个人都知道警告标志。随着电动汽车占据更大的市场份额，计划中的商店将确保其员工的安全。现在做一点额外的准备比以后发生火灾要便宜得多。

articles.title: APCIA Report: Vehicle Repair Costs Rise 34% Despite Improvements in Road Safety
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Vehicle repair costs have increased 34.4% over the past five years, while automotive repair parts prices have climbed 55.6%, according to a new report from the American Property Casualty Insurance Association (APCIA), highlighting the growing financial pressures associated with repairing increasingly sophisticated vehicles.
paras.zh: 美国财产伤亡保险协会 (APCIA) 的一份新报告显示，过去五年，汽车维修成本增加了 34.4%，而汽车维修零部件价格则上涨了 55.6%，凸显了与维修日益复杂的车辆相关的日益增长的财务压力。

paras.en: The September 2026 report, A New Road Ahead for Auto Insurance: Safer Vehicles, Higher Claim Costs?, examines how improvements in vehicle safety, changing driving patterns, repair complexity and litigation are reshaping the auto insurance market.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月的报告《汽车保险的新道路：更安全的车辆，更高的索赔成本？》研究了车辆安全的改进、驾驶模式的改变、维修复杂性和诉讼如何重塑汽车保险市场。

paras.en: One of its central findings is that safer vehicles are not necessarily translating into lower insurance claim costs. Although advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) are reducing certain types of crashes, the vehicles equipped with those technologies are often more expensive to repair.
paras.zh: 其核心发现之一是，更安全的车辆并不一定意味着更低的保险索赔成本。尽管先进驾驶辅助系统 (ADAS) 正在减少某些类型的碰撞事故，但配备这些技术的车辆往往维修成本更高。

paras.en: For collision repairers, the report reinforces an increasingly familiar reality: The growing complexity of modern vehicles is contributing to higher repair costs, even as safety technology helps prevent accidents.
paras.zh: 对于碰撞维修人员来说，该报告强化了一个日益熟悉的现实：现代车辆日益复杂，导致维修成本更高，尽管安全技术有助于预防事故。

paras.en: According to APCIA, vehicle repair costs increased 34.4% over the five-year period examined, while automotive repair parts prices rose 55.6%. During the same period, used vehicle values declined 7.8%, and personal auto insurance premiums increased 24.4%.
paras.zh: 根据 APCIA 的数据，在调查的五年期间，汽车维修成本上涨了 34.4%，而汽车维修零部件价格上涨了 55.6%。同期，二手车价值下降7.8%，个人车险保费增长24.4%。

paras.en: The association identifies vehicle technology and repair complexity as significant contributors to these increases.
paras.zh: 该协会认为车辆技术和维修复杂性是导致这些增长的重要因素。

paras.en: Modern vehicles incorporate sensors, cameras and integrated electronic systems that require specialized repair procedures, diagnostic equipment and technical expertise. As a result, collision repairs increasingly involve additional parts replacement, higher-skilled labor, scanning and calibration.
paras.zh: 现代车辆配备了传感器、摄像头和集成电子系统，需要专门的维修程序、诊断设备和技术专业知识。因此，碰撞修复越来越多地涉及额外的零件更换、更高技能的劳动力、扫描和校准。

paras.en: Citing data from CCC Intelligent Solutions, the report notes that the average total cost of repair exceeded $4,800 in 2025, nearly doubling since 2010.
paras.zh: 报告援引 CCC 智能解决方案的数据指出，到 2025 年，平均维修总成本将超过 4,800 美元，自 2010 年以来几乎翻了一番。

paras.en: Repair costs are also significantly higher for newer vehicles, reflecting their increasingly sophisticated construction and safety technologies.
paras.zh: 较新车辆的维修成本也明显更高，反映出其结构和安全技术日益复杂。

paras.en: ADAS Reduces Crashes but Adds Repair Complexity
paras.zh: ADAS 减少了碰撞，但增加了维修复杂性

paras.en: APCIA acknowledges the substantial safety benefits of ADAS while emphasizing that the technology has not produced a corresponding reduction in overall insurance claim costs.
paras.zh: APCIA 承认 ADAS 具有显着的安全优势，同时强调该技术并未相应降低总体保险索赔成本。

paras.en: Automatic emergency braking (AEB), for example, has reduced front-to-rear crashes by approximately 50% and front-to-rear crashes involving injuries by approximately 56%, according to research cited in the report.
paras.zh: 例如，根据报告中引用的研究，自动紧急制动 (AEB) 已将前后碰撞事故减少了约 50%，将导致受伤的前后碰撞事故减少了约 56%。

paras.en: The effectiveness of these systems also appears to be improving as the technology evolves. APCIA cites National Highway Traffic Safety Administration research showing rear-end crash reductions of approximately 46% for model-year 2015-2017 vehicles, compared with 52% for model-year 2021-2023 vehicles.
paras.zh: 随着技术的发展，这些系统的有效性似乎也在提高。 APCIA 援引美国国家公路交通安全管理局的研究显示，2015-2017 年车型的追尾事故减少了约 46%，而 2021-2023 年车型的追尾事故减少了 52%。

paras.en: However, the association says ADAS-equipped vehicles present additional challenges when repairs are necessary.
paras.zh: 然而，该协会表示，当需要维修时，配备 ADAS 的车辆会带来额外的挑战。

paras.en: Cameras, radar sensors and other electronic components can require replacement, diagnostics and recalibration following a collision. These procedures add costs that may offset some of the financial benefits associated with preventing crashes.
paras.zh: 碰撞后，摄像头、雷达传感器和其他电子部件可能需要更换、诊断和重新校准。这些程序增加的成本可能会抵消一些与防止事故相关的经济效益。

paras.en: The report concludes that ADAS is changing the types of accidents and insurance claims occurring rather than eliminating the financial pressures associated with vehicle damage.
paras.zh: 报告的结论是，ADAS 正在改变发生的事故和保险索赔的类型，而不是消除与车辆损坏相关的财务压力。

paras.en: For collision repair businesses, these findings underscore the growing importance of investments in technician training, diagnostic capabilities, calibration equipment and access to OEM repair information.
paras.zh: 对于碰撞修复业务来说，这些发现强调了在技术人员培训、诊断能力、校准设备和获取 OEM 维修信息方面的投资日益重要。

paras.en: The report also identifies repair cycle times as a continuing source of insurance claim costs.
paras.zh: 该报告还将维修周期时间确定为保险索赔成本的持续来源。

paras.en: Citing Enterprise Rent-A-Car data, APCIA reports that average rental duration increased from 13 days in 2019 to 16 days in 2026, although that figure has improved from a peak of 19 days in 2022.
paras.zh: APCIA 援引 Enterprise Rent-A-Car 的数据报告称，平均租赁时间从 2019 年的 13 天增加到 2026 年的 16 天，尽管这一数字较 2022 年 19 天的峰值有所改善。

paras.en: The association points to parts availability and access to repair information as factors that can contribute to longer repair times.
paras.zh: 该协会指出，零件可用性和维修信息的获取是导致维修时间延长的因素。

paras.en: These delays create additional costs beyond the physical vehicle repair, including extended replacement-vehicle expenses.
paras.zh: 这些延误会产生超出实际车辆维修的额外成本，包括延长更换车辆的费用。

paras.en: APCIA also raises concerns that limited access to parts, tools and repair data can restrict competition, extend repair times and increase costs throughout the claims process.
paras.zh: APCIA 还担心，对零件、工具和维修数据的访问受限可能会限制竞争、延长维修时间并增加整个索赔过程的成本。

paras.en: Despite persistent repair cost pressures, the report indicates that the personal auto insurance market has experienced a significant financial recovery.
paras.zh: 尽管维修成本压力持续存在，但报告表明个人汽车保险市场已经历了显着的财务复苏。

paras.en: According to APCIA, U.S. private passenger auto insurers recorded a loss ratio of 60.8% as of the second quarter of 2025, compared with an industry average of 67% between 2016 and 2023.
paras.zh: 根据 APCIA 的数据，截至 2025 年第二季度，美国私人乘用车保险公司的赔付率为 60.8%，而 2016 年至 2023 年的行业平均赔付率为 67%。

paras.en: The association attributes the improvement partly to moderating claims inflation and faster regulatory approval of insurance rate increases.
paras.zh: 该协会将这一改善部分归功于理赔通胀的缓和以及监管机构对保险费率上涨的更快批准。

paras.en: Private passenger auto premiums increased approximately 35% to 37% in aggregate since 2023, with most of those increases occurring during 2023 and 2024. Premium growth subsequently began to moderate.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年以来，私人乘用车保费总计增加了约 35% 至 37%，其中大部分增长发生在 2023 年和 2024 年期间。保费增长随后开始放缓。

paras.en: However, APCIA cautions that the industry’s improved underwriting results should not be mistaken for a return to predictable claim costs.
paras.zh: 然而，APCIA 警告称，该行业承保业绩的改善不应被误认为是可预测索赔成本的回归。

paras.en: Litigation Adds Another Layer of Expense
paras.zh: 诉讼又增加了一层费用

paras.en: Beyond physical vehicle damage, the report identifies litigation, attorney involvement and third-party litigation funding as major contributors to rising auto insurance costs.
paras.zh: 除了车辆实际损坏之外，该报告还指出诉讼、律师参与和第三方诉讼资金是汽车保险费用上涨的主要原因。

paras.en: APCIA contends that increasingly complex legal claims, medical billing practices and longer settlement periods are creating additional financial uncertainty for insurers.
paras.zh: APCIA 认为，日益复杂的法律索赔、医疗计费实践和更长的结算周期给保险公司带来了额外的财务不确定性。

paras.en: The association argues that these developments have changed the economics of auto insurance claims, particularly those involving bodily injury and commercial vehicles.
paras.zh: 该协会认为，这些发展改变了汽车保险索赔的经济性，特别是那些涉及人身伤害和商用车辆的索赔。

paras.en: According to the report, insurers face longer claim-resolution periods, higher defense expenses and greater difficulty predicting ultimate claim costs.
paras.zh: 报告称，保险公司面临更长的索赔解决期、更高的辩护费用以及预测最终索赔成本的更大困难。

paras.en: APCIA advocates reforms intended to improve litigation transparency, reduce fraud and strengthen insurers’ ability to manage claim costs.
paras.zh: APCIA 倡导旨在提高诉讼透明度、减少欺诈并增强保险公司管理索赔成本的能力的改革。

paras.en: For collision repair facilities, the report illustrates how several developments are reshaping the business of repairing vehicles.
paras.zh: 对于碰撞修复设施，该报告阐述了多项发展如何重塑车辆维修业务。

paras.en: Although vehicle safety technologies are reducing certain types of accidents, the cost of repairing vehicles that are involved in collisions continues to rise. More sophisticated components, additional diagnostic requirements, ADAS calibrations and specialized labor are increasing the resources needed to complete repairs.
paras.zh: 尽管车辆安全技术正在减少某些类型的事故，但修复发生碰撞的车辆的成本仍在持续上升。更复杂的组件、额外的诊断要求、ADAS 校准和专业劳动力正在增加完成维修所需的资源。

paras.en: At the same time, repair delays and higher replacement-vehicle expenses are placing additional pressure on the insurance claims process.
paras.zh: 与此同时，维修延误和更高的更换车辆费用给保险索赔流程带来了额外的压力。

paras.en: The findings suggest that collision repairers will continue to face challenges involving repair complexity, technician capabilities, parts availability and cycle-time management.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，碰撞维修人员将继续面临维修复杂性、技术人员能力、零件可用性和周期时间管理等方面的挑战。

paras.en: APCIA’s report also highlights a broader disconnect between improving highway safety and the economics of vehicle repair.
paras.zh: APCIA 的报告还强调了改善公路安全与车辆维修经济之间存在更广泛的脱节。

paras.en: As vehicles become better equipped to prevent crashes and protect occupants, the cost of restoring those vehicles following a collision remains a significant challenge for insurers, repairers and consumers alike.
paras.zh: 随着车辆在预防碰撞和保护乘员方面的装备越来越完善，碰撞后修复车辆的成本对于保险公司、维修商和消费者来说仍然是一个重大挑战。

articles.title: Drive Your Collision Repair Business Forward at the 2026 SEMA Show
articles.author: SEMA Show

paras.en: As vehicle technology continues to evolve and collision repair businesses face increasing operational complexity, staying ahead requires more than keeping up with the latest equipment. It demands a deeper understanding of vehicle engineering, repair procedures, business management and the technologies shaping the industry’s future.
paras.zh: 随着车辆技术的不断发展，碰撞修复业务面临着日益增加的操作复杂性，保持领先地位需要的不仅仅是跟上最新的设备。它需要对车辆工程、维修程序、业务管理和塑造行业未来的技术有更深入的了解。

paras.en: The 2026 SEMA Show, taking place Nov. 3-6 at the Las Vegas Convention Center, will provide collision repair professionals with opportunities to explore these developments firsthand through industry education, interactive demonstrations, new products and direct engagement with automotive manufacturers and technology experts.
paras.zh: 2026 年 SEMA 展将于 11 月 3 日至 6 日在拉斯维加斯会议中心举行，将为碰撞修复专业人士提供机会，通过行业教育、互动演示、新产品以及与汽车制造商和技术专家的直接接触，亲身探索这些发展。

paras.en: Among the show’s highlights are the Society of Collision Repair Specialists’ (SCRS) Repairer Driven Education (RDE) series, an expanded SEMA ADAS Showcase and the OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit. Together, these programs will help collision repairers better understand the technologies influencing modern repairs while identifying practical strategies to improve profitability, strengthen operations and prepare for future opportunities.
paras.zh: 展会的亮点包括碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 维修驱动教育 (RDE) 系列、扩大的 SEMA ADAS 展示和 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会。这些计划将共同帮助碰撞维修人员更好地了解影响现代维修的技术，同时确定提高盈利能力、加强运营并为未来机会做好准备的实用策略。

paras.en: Education Designed to Deliver Real-World Results
paras.zh: 旨在提供现实世界成果的教育

paras.en: The 2026 RDE series features 19 sessions addressing business management, repair planning, financial performance, technical operations and leadership development.
paras.zh: 2026 年 RDE 系列有 19 个会议，涉及业务管理、维修计划、财务绩效、技术运营和领导力发展。

paras.en: Designed for collision repair shop owners, managers, estimators and technicians, the program emphasizes practical information that attendees can implement when they return to their businesses.
paras.zh: 该计划专为碰撞维修店业主、经理、估算员和技术人员而设计，强调与会者返回业务后可以实施的实用信息。

paras.en: “Each year, we work to reimagine the RDE experience based on feedback from our attendees and the evolving needs of the industry,” said Aaron Schulenburg, executive director of the SCRS. “The 2026 program reflects a deliberate focus on practical application, and these are sessions built to help shops make better decisions the moment they return home.”
paras.zh: SCRS 执行董事 Aaron Schulenburg 表示：“每年，我们都会根据与会者的反馈和行业不断变化的需求来重新构想 RDE 体验。” “2026 年计划体现了对实际应用的刻意关注，这些会议旨在帮助商店在回家后做出更好的决策。”

paras.en: Business-focused presentations will explore digital marketing, repair planning, revenue protection, employee development and financial management.
paras.zh: 以业务为重点的演讲将探讨数字营销、维修计划、收入保护、员工发展和财务管理。

paras.en: Sessions such as “Repair Planning That Pays: Protecting Revenue Through Research” and “Run Your Collision Business Like a Fortune 100 Company” will offer strategies for strengthening operational and financial performance.
paras.zh: “有价值的维修计划：通过研究保护收入”和“像财富 100 强公司一样经营您的碰撞业务”等会议将提供加强运营和财务绩效的策略。

paras.en: Other presentations will examine potential growth opportunities, including capturing mechanical labor already being performed during collision repairs, bringing additional mechanical services in-house and expanding into automotive glass repair and replacement.
paras.zh: 其他演讲将探讨潜在的增长机会，包括捕捉碰撞修复过程中已经执行的机械劳动、在内部引入额外的机械服务以及扩展到汽车玻璃修复和更换领域。

paras.en: Leadership sessions will address accountability, communication, employee development and turning training investments into measurable improvements in shop performance.
paras.zh: 领导力课程将讨论责任、沟通、员工发展以及将培训投资转化为车间绩效的可衡量的改进。

paras.en: Wednesday’s IDEAS Collide Showcase will feature fast-paced presentations exploring artificial intelligence, ADAS, business growth, evolving consumer search behavior and other developments influencing the collision repair industry.
paras.zh: 周三的 IDEAS Collide Showcase 将进行快节奏的演示，探讨人工智能、ADAS、业务增长、不断变化的消费者搜索行为以及影响碰撞修复行业的其他发展。

paras.en: SEMA ADAS Showcase Expands With Hands-On OEM Engineering Experience
paras.zh: SEMA ADAS 展示扩大了 OEM 工程实践经验

paras.en: One of the most significant additions to the 2026 SEMA Show’s collision repair programming is an expanded SEMA ADAS Showcase, developed through collaboration between SCRS, its ADAS Division and SEMA Show organizers.
paras.zh: 2026 年 SEMA 展会碰撞修复项目最重要的新增内容之一是扩展的 SEMA ADAS 展示柜，该展示是通过 SCRS、其 ADAS 部门和 SEMA 展会组织者之间的合作开发的。

paras.en: Located in Upper South Hall, booth no. 32100, adjacent to the Collision Repair & Refinish section, the showcase will provide an interactive workshop environment where attendees can explore the relationship between vehicle engineering, collision repair and advanced driver-assistance systems.
paras.zh: 位于上南厅，展位号： 32100，毗邻碰撞修复和修补部分，展示将提供一个交互式研讨会环境，与会者可以探索车辆工程、碰撞修复和先进驾驶辅助系统之间的关系。

paras.en: Programming will run Nov. 3-6 from 9:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. in two specially constructed calibration bays.
paras.zh: 节目将于 11 月 3 日至 6 日上午 9:30 至下午 1:30 进行。在两个专门建造的校准室中。

paras.en: Rather than relying on traditional classroom presentations, the showcase will feature focused technical discussions conducted around late-model vehicles, components, repair scenarios and approved equipment.
paras.zh: 该展示将不再依赖传统的课堂演示，而是围绕新型车辆、零部件、维修场景和批准的设备进行集中的技术讨论。

paras.en: OEM engineering and technical experts from Ford, General Motors and Rivian will participate throughout the week, giving repairers access to professionals involved in developing, evaluating and supporting the technologies they encounter in today’s vehicles.
paras.zh: 来自福特、通用汽车和 Rivian 的 OEM 工程和技术专家将参加整个星期，让维修人员能够接触到参与开发、评估和支持他们在当今车辆中遇到的技术的专业人士。

paras.en: The goal is to help collision professionals understand not simply what an OEM requires during repair and calibration, but why those requirements exist and how they relate to vehicle safety performance.
paras.zh: 目标是帮助碰撞专业人士不仅了解原始设备制造商在维修和校准过程中的要求，而且了解这些要求存在的原因以及它们与车辆安全性能的关系。

paras.en: Understanding the Engineering Behind ADAS Requirements
paras.zh: 了解 ADAS 要求背后的工程

paras.en: As cameras, radar and other sensing technologies become increasingly integrated into modern vehicles, collision repairers must understand how physical repairs can influence electronic safety systems.
paras.zh: 随着摄像头、雷达和其他传感技术越来越多地集成到现代车辆中，碰撞维修人员必须了解物理维修如何影响电子安全系统。

paras.en: The SEMA ADAS Showcase will examine how seemingly minor changes in sensor positioning, mounting, vehicle geometry, ride height and component installation can affect ADAS performance.
paras.zh: SEMA ADAS 展示会将研究传感器定位、安装、车辆几何形状、行驶高度和组件安装等看似微小的变化如何影响 ADAS 性能。

paras.en: Interactive sessions will address practical repair questions through demonstrations and discussions with OEM representatives and working technicians.
paras.zh: 互动会议将通过演示以及与 OEM 代表和工作技术人员的讨论来解决实际的维修问题。

paras.en: “Small Changes, Big Consequences” will examine how sensor alignment, mounting locations, vehicle modifications and other variables influence ADAS functionality.
paras.zh: “小变化，大后果”将研究传感器对准、安装位置、车辆改装和其他变量如何影响 ADAS 功能。

paras.en: “Would You Calibrate It?” will use real-world repair scenarios to explore when calibration is required and the engineering reasoning behind manufacturer procedures.
paras.zh: “你会校准它吗？”将使用现实世界的维修场景来探索何时需要校准以及制造商程序背后的工程推理。

paras.en: Other sessions, including “Calibration Failed. Now What?” and “Find It, Fix It, Recalibrate,” will walk attendees through troubleshooting, diagnosis, corrective procedures and additional verification considerations.
paras.zh: 其他会话，包括“校准失败。现在怎么办？”和“查找、修复、重新校准”将引导与会者完成故障排除、诊断、纠正程序和其他验证注意事项。

paras.en: “Repair, Geometry & ADAS: Why the Repair Matters” will connect structural dimensions, vehicle components and controllers to ADAS performance, while “Successful Calibration ≠ Complete Repair” will explore the distinction between obtaining a successful calibration result and verifying that the overall repair is complete.
paras.zh: “维修、几何和 ADAS：为什么维修很重要”将结构尺寸、车辆部件和控制器与 ADAS 性能联系起来，而“成功校准≠完整维修”将探讨获得成功校准结果和验证整体维修是否完成之间的区别。

paras.en: Additional programming will include hands-on calibration and measurement demonstrations using Asian-brand vehicles, along with “Build My ADAS Space,” which will help shops evaluate the facility, equipment, workflow and process requirements associated with servicing specific vehicle brands.
paras.zh: 其他项目将包括使用亚洲品牌车辆进行动手校准和测量演示，以及“构建我的 ADAS 空间”，这将帮助商店评估与服务特定车辆品牌相关的设施、设备、工作流程和流程要求。

paras.en: Each programmed discussion will be followed by an open-engagement period, allowing attendees to ask questions, examine equipment and discuss unusual repair scenarios directly with engineers and technicians.
paras.zh: 每次计划讨论之后都会有一个开放的参与期，允许与会者提出问题、检查设备并直接与工程师和技术人员讨论异常的维修场景。

paras.en: By bringing OEM representatives together with approved equipment and technology providers, the showcase aims to connect manufacturer requirements with the practical processes needed to perform and verify repairs.
paras.zh: 通过将 OEM 代表与经批准的设备和技术提供商聚集在一起，此次展示旨在将制造商的要求与执行和验证维修所需的实际流程联系起来。

paras.en: OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit Focuses on Vehicle Safety
paras.zh: OEM碰撞修复技术峰会聚焦车辆安全

paras.en: The importance of restoring vehicle safety will also take center stage during the 2026 OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit on Thursday, Nov. 5 in room S233 of the Upper South Education Hallway.
paras.zh: 恢复车辆安全的重要性也将于 11 月 5 日星期四在上南教育走廊 S233 室举行的 2026 年 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会上成为焦点。

paras.en: The three-session program will examine vehicle safety from several perspectives, beginning with national safety priorities, moving into the engineering of advanced safety systems and concluding with the repair and calibration requirements necessary to preserve their intended performance.
paras.zh: 该三期计划将从多个角度审查车辆安全，从国家安全优先事项开始，进入先进安全系统的工程设计，最后以保持其预期性能所需的维修和校准要求结束。

paras.en: The opening session, “The National Safety Objective: Safer Vehicles, Safer Roads,” will feature Lee White, deputy administrator of the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA). White will discuss federal vehicle and roadway safety priorities, emerging transportation technologies, data-driven research and initiatives intended to reduce traffic fatalities and serious injuries.
paras.zh: 开幕式“国家安全目标：更安全的车辆、更安全的道路”将由国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 副局长 Lee White 主持。怀特将讨论联邦车辆和道路安全优先事项、新兴交通技术、数据驱动的研究以及旨在减少交通死亡和严重伤害的举措。

paras.en: Following his presentation, White will join SCRS Executive Director Aaron Schulenburg for a conversation about the relationship between federal safety objectives, automotive innovation and the collision repair industry’s role in maintaining vehicle safety throughout its service life.
paras.zh: 演讲结束后，怀特将与 SCRS 执行董事 Aaron Schulenburg 一起讨论联邦安全目标、汽车创新以及碰撞修复行业在维持车辆整个使用寿命期间安全方面的作用之间的关系。

paras.en: The second session, “Engineering the Safety Benefit: From Requirement to Real-World Performance,” will feature General Motors active-safety leaders Michael Carpenter and Jameson Collins. Moderated by Jake Rodenroth, the discussion will explore how manufacturers establish performance requirements for advanced safety technologies, evaluate their effectiveness and determine whether those systems deliver measurable safety benefits. For collision repairers, a central question will be how to determine whether a vehicle’s pre-collision safety capabilities have been restored following repairs.
paras.zh: 第二场会议“设计安全效益：从要求到实际性能”将由通用汽车主动安全领导者 Michael Carpenter 和 Jameson Collins 主持。在杰克·罗登罗斯 (Jake Rodenroth) 的主持下，讨论将探讨制造商如何建立先进安全技术的性能要求、评估其有效性并确定这些系统是否提供可衡量的安全效益。对于碰撞维修人员来说，一个核心问题是如何确定车辆的碰撞前安全能力在维修后是否已恢复。

paras.en: The final session, “Preserving the Safety System: Sensors, Calibration and Repairability,” will feature engineering experts from General Motors, Ford and Rivian. Participants will include Steven Vance and Chad Zagorski of General Motors, Brian Perkins of Ford and Ryan Davenport of Rivian. Moderated by Danny Gredinberg, administrator of the Database Enhancement Gateway, the discussion will examine the capabilities of modern sensing systems and the variables that can influence their performance. Topics will include sensor positioning, structural dimensions, wheel alignment, ride height, replacement glass, body materials and the engineering considerations behind OEM repair and calibration procedures. The panel will also examine how manufacturers develop service information and calibration strategies, giving repairers a better understanding of the relationship between engineering requirements and the procedures they must follow in the shop.
paras.zh: 最后一场会议“保护安全系统：传感器、校准和可修复性”将由来自通用汽车、福特和 Rivian 的工程专家参加。参与者包括通用汽车公司的 Steven Vance 和 Chad Zagorski、福特公司的 Brian Perkins 和 Rivian 的 Ryan Davenport。由数据库增强网关管理员 Danny Gredinberg 主持，讨论将研究现代传感系统的功能以及可能影响其性能的变量。主题将包括传感器定位、结构尺寸、车轮定位、行驶高度、更换玻璃、车身材料以及 OEM 维修和校准程序背后的工程考虑因素。该小组还将研究制造商如何开发服务信息和校准策略，使维修人员更好地了解工程要求与他们在车间必须遵循的程序之间的关系。

paras.en: Together, the three sessions will provide a progression from the national objectives driving vehicle safety innovation to the engineering behind those technologies and the repair processes necessary to preserve their benefits.
paras.zh: 这三场会议将共同推动从推动车辆安全创新的国家目标到这些技术背后的工程以及维护其效益所需的维修流程。

paras.en: Connect With the People Shaping Collision Repair’s Future
paras.zh: 与塑造碰撞修复未来的人们联系

paras.en: Beyond formal education, the 2026 SEMA Show offers collision repair professionals opportunities to connect with manufacturers, suppliers, technology providers and industry leaders.
paras.zh: 除了正规教育之外，2026 年 SEMA 展会还为碰撞修复专业人士提供了与制造商、供应商、技术提供商和行业领导者建立联系的机会。

paras.en: For shop owners evaluating investments in ADAS calibration, diagnostics, mechanical repair capabilities or other emerging services, direct access to technical experts can help inform purchasing decisions and long-term business strategies.
paras.zh: 对于评估 ADAS 校准、诊断、机械维修能力或其他新兴服务投资的店主来说，直接接触技术专家可以帮助制定购买决策和长期业务战略。

paras.en: The expanded ADAS Showcase is particularly valuable because it allows repairers to engage with the engineers behind the technologies they service, helping bridge the gap between vehicle design and real-world repair practices.
paras.zh: 扩展后的 ADAS 展示特别有价值，因为它允许维修人员与他们所服务的技术背后的工程师互动，帮助弥合车辆设计和实际维修实践之间的差距。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the RDE series offers complementary education on the operational and financial decisions necessary to turn technical capabilities into sustainable business opportunities.
paras.zh: 同时，RDE 系列提供了有关将技术能力转化为可持续商业机会所需的运营和财务决策的补充教育。

paras.en: By combining business education, engineering insight and access to new products and technologies, the SEMA Show provides collision repair professionals with resources to address today’s challenges while preparing for tomorrow’s opportunities.
paras.zh: 通过将商业教育、工程洞察力以及新产品和技术的获取相结合，SEMA 展会为碰撞修复专业人士提供了应对当今挑战的资源，同时为明天的机遇做好准备。

paras.en: Make the Most of Your SEMA Show Experience
paras.zh: 充分利用您的 SEMA 展会体验

paras.en: With multiple educational tracks and interactive demonstrations scheduled throughout the week, attendees are encouraged to plan their SEMA Show experience in advance.
paras.zh: 本周安排了多个教育课程和互动演示，鼓励与会者提前计划他们的 SEMA 展会体验。

paras.en: SCRS recommends the full RDE series pass for attendees seeking maximum flexibility to participate in sessions across the program.
paras.zh: SCRS 建议寻求最大灵活性的与会者使用完整的 RDE 系列通行证来参与整个计划的会议。

paras.en: Registration is open for the 2026 SEMA Show and SCRS RDE programming.
paras.zh: 2026 年 SEMA 展和 SCRS RDE 节目报名现已开放。

paras.zh: 报名参加 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会：点击此处

articles.title: Reports show record-high vehicle financing trends and steady sales in ‘resilient’ market
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: An Edmunds Q3 2026 report on vehicle buying trends found that new-vehicle buyers borrowed at record levels, took on record-high monthly payments, and financed loans for historic lengths.
paras.zh: Edmunds 2026 年第三季度汽车购买趋势报告发现，新车购买者的借款达到创纪录水平，每月还款额创历史新高，贷款融资时间也达到历史最高水平。

paras.en: The average amount financed climbed to $44,664 in Q3 2026, compared with $44,156 in Q2 2026 and $42,744 in Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 2026 年第三季度的平均融资金额攀升至 44,664 美元，而 2026 年第二季度为 44,156 美元，2025 年第三季度为 42,744 美元。

paras.en: More than one in four new-car buyers are now financing their vehicles for 84 months or longer. Loans with terms of 84 months or more accounted for a record 25.5% of financed new-vehicle purchases in Q3 2026, up from 23.9% in Q2 2026 and 21.8% in Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 超过四分之一的新车购买者现在为车辆提供 84 个月或更长时间的融资。 2026 年第三季度，期限为 84 个月或以上的贷款占融资新车购买量的 25.5%，创历史新高，高于 2026 年第二季度的 23.9% 和 2025 年第三季度的 21.8%。

paras.en: The average monthly payment on financed new-vehicle purchases rose to $787 in Q3 2026, up from $777 in Q2 2026 and $756 in Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 2026 年第三季度，购买融资新车的平均每月付款额升至 787 美元，高于 2026 年第二季度的 777 美元和 2025 年第三季度的 756 美元。

paras.en: “Together, these trends are pushing borrowing costs to new all-time highs,” an Edmunds press release states. “The average total interest paid over the life of a financed new-vehicle purchase climbed to a record $9,938 in Q3 2026, up from $9,811 in Q2 2026 and $9,442 a year ago.”
paras.zh: 埃德蒙兹在新闻稿中表示：“这些趋势共同将借贷成本推至历史新高。” “融资新车购买周期内支付的平均总利息在 2026 年第三季度攀升至创纪录的 9,938 美元，高于 2026 年第二季度的 9,811 美元和一年前的 9,442 美元。”

paras.en: The increase came even as the average APR for new-vehicle purchases held steady at 7% in Q3 2026, the same as in Q2 2026 and Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 尽管 2026 年第三季度新车购买的平均年利率稳定在 7%（与 2026 年第二季度和 2025 年第三季度相同），但这一增长还是出现了。

paras.en: The share of new-car buyers taking on monthly payments of $1,000 or more reached a record 21.2% of financed purchases in Q3 2026, up from 20.3% in Q2 2026 and 19.1% in Q3 2025. Six-and-a-half percent of used-vehicle buyers took on $1,000-plus monthly payments, which was also an all-time high, up from 6.3% in Q2 2026 and 6.1% in Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 每月付款 1,000 美元或以上的新车买家所占比例在 2026 年第三季度达到创纪录的 21.2%，高于 2026 年第二季度的 20.3% 和 2025 年第三季度的 19.1%。 百分之六半的二手车买家每月付款超过 1,000 美元，这也是历史最高水平，高于 2026 年第二季度的 20.3%。 2026 年第二季度为 6.3%，2025 年第三季度为 6.1%。

paras.en: “What we’re seeing in the data is a remarkable display of consumer resilience against a very stretched financing landscape,” said Jessica Caldwell, Edmunds’ head of insights, in the release. “Even as monthly payments hit record highs, loan terms stretch to historic lengths, and four-figure monthly payments become more common, buyer demand for new vehicles hasn’t dropped off. Instead of sitting on the sidelines, consumers are adapting: They’re allocating more of their household budgets to their vehicles, stretching out their loan terms, and becoming more proactive about shopping around for financing to find ways to make the numbers work.”
paras.zh: Edmunds 的洞察主管杰西卡·考德威尔 (Jessica Caldwell) 在新闻稿中表示：“我们在数据中看到的是，消费者在融资环境非常紧张的情况下表现出了非凡的韧性。” “尽管每月还款额创下历史新高，贷款期限延长至历史最高水平，四位数的每月还款额变得越来越普遍，但买家对新车的需求并没有下降。消费者没有袖手旁观，而是正在适应：他们将更多的家庭预算分配给他们的车辆，延长贷款期限，并更加积极地四处寻找融资，以找到使数字发挥作用的方法。”

paras.en: Edmunds analysts note that this stretching is particularly apparent among buyers taking on the highest monthly payments. In Q3, 69% of new-car buyers with monthly payments of $1,000 or more chose loan terms of 72 months or longer.
paras.zh: Edmunds 分析师指出，这种压力在每月付款最高的买家中尤为明显。第三季度，月付款 1,000 美元或以上的新车购买者中有 69% 选择了 72 个月或更长的贷款期限。

paras.en: “For some shoppers, a longer loan term may be the only way to get the vehicle they need, but it’s important to understand the trade-off,” said Ivan Drury, Edmunds’ director of insights, in the release. “Stretching out a loan shouldn’t be a way to talk yourself into a vehicle that doesn’t make sense for your budget when you look at the total cost. When buyers are already financing nearly $45,000 and taking on another nearly $10,000 in interest, it’s critical to think beyond whether the monthly payment works today and consider what you’re committing to over the full life of the loan.”
paras.zh: Edmunds 的洞察总监伊万·德鲁里 (Ivan Drury) 在新闻稿中表示：“对于一些购物者来说，较长的贷款期限可能是获得他们所需车辆的唯一途径，但了解权衡很重要。” “当你考虑总成本时，延长贷款不应该是说服自己购买对你的预算没有意义的工具的一种方式。当买家已经融资近 45,000 美元并承担另外近 10,000 美元的利息时，重要的是要考虑现在每月还款是否有效，并考虑你在整个贷款期限内的承诺。”

paras.en: Edmunds noted that affordability pressures reflected in its Q3 auto finance data come amid newly announced changes to federal fuel economy requirements, stating they aren’t necessarily a good thing for vehicle buyers.
paras.zh: 埃德蒙兹指出，第三季度汽车金融数据反映出的负担能力压力是在新宣布的联邦燃油经济性要求变化之际出现的，他表示这对汽车购买者来说不一定是一件好事。

paras.en: “Any potential relief is welcome in an affordability environment like this, but changes to fuel economy requirements don’t necessarily translate into lower prices on dealer lots,” said Caldwell. “Automakers continue to navigate significant cost pressures, and there’s still a substantial gap between where vehicle prices are today and what many households can comfortably afford.”
paras.zh: 考德威尔说：“在这样的负担能力环境下，任何潜在的救济都是受欢迎的，但燃油经济性要求的变化并不一定会转化为经销商的价格降低。” “汽车制造商继续应对巨大的成本压力，目前的汽车价格与许多家庭可以轻松承受的价格之间仍然存在很大差距。”

paras.en: U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT) Secretary Sean P. Duffy released the final rule Sept. 28 to reset the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA)’s corporate average fuel economy (CAFE) standards for model years 2022-2031.
paras.zh: 美国交通部 (USDOT) 部长肖恩·P·达菲 (Sean P. Duffy) 于 9 月 28 日发布了最终规则，重置了国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 2022-2031 年车型的企业平均燃油经济性 (CAFE) 标准。

paras.en: Calling the final rule initiative “Freedom Means Affordable Cars,” USDOT says it will:
paras.zh: 美国交通部将最终规则倡议称为“自由意味着买得起汽车”，表示它将：

paras.en: - “Give automakers the flexibility to manufacture cars the public wants to buy;
paras.zh: - “让汽车制造商能够灵活地生产公众想要购买的汽车；

paras.en: - “Reduce the average cost of a new vehicle by $1,300 for American families;
paras.zh: -“美国家庭购买新车的平均成本降低 1,300 美元；

paras.en: - “Save the American people $138 billion over the next five years; and
paras.zh: - “在未来五年内为美国人民节省 1,380 亿美元；以及

paras.en: - “Prevent more than 300,000 serious injuries and save 1,900 lives by encouraging new car sales.”
paras.zh: - “通过鼓励新车销售，防止超过 300,000 起严重伤害并挽救 1,900 条生命。”

paras.en: According to NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison, the rule “restores integrity to the national fuel economy program, balancing vehicle affordability and energy conservation goals while improving safety on our roadways.”
paras.zh: NHTSA 局长乔纳森·莫里森 (Jonathan Morrison) 表示，该规则“恢复了国家燃油经济性计划的完整性，平衡了车辆负担能力和节能目标，同时提高了道路安全性。”

paras.en: Near the end of September, Cox Automotive raised its full-year new-vehicle sales forecast and expected September sales to be up 6.5% year-over-year, a decline of 2.7% from August. However, the report notes that seasonal factors make month-to-month comparisons challenging.
paras.zh: 临近9月底，考克斯汽车上调了全年新车销量预期，预计9月销量同比增长6.5%，较8月下降2.7%。然而，报告指出，季节性因素使得逐月比较具有挑战性。

paras.en: Charlie Chesbrough, Cox Automotive’s senior economist, said September new-vehicle sales should stay on the path the market has been on since March — a low-mid 16 million pace.
paras.zh: Cox Automotive 高级经济学家 Charlie Chesbrough 表示，9 月份新车销量应该会保持 3 月份以来市场的走势——1600 万辆左右的增速。

paras.en: “Strong fleet sales, wealthier vehicle buyers, and more access to credit are all keeping this market relatively strong in the face of many headwinds,” he said in a press release. “High inflation and historically low consumer confidence have not discouraged buyers as much as might be expected. New-vehicle buyers today are more affluent, so they may not be as impacted by inflationary pressures as other consumers.”
paras.zh: 他在一份新闻稿中表示：“强劲的车队销售、更富裕的车辆购买者以及更多的信贷渠道都使这个市场在面临许多不利因素的情况下保持相对强劲。” “高通胀和历史低迷的消费者信心并没有像预期的那样让买家望而却步。如今的新车买家更加富裕，因此他们可能不会像其他消费者那样受到通胀压力的影响。”

paras.en: Cox Automotive raised its full-year 2026 new-vehicle sales forecast to 16.1 million units from 15.8 million, “reflecting a market that has proven more resilient than expected despite higher fuel prices, elevated interest rates, and ongoing economic uncertainty,” the release states. It adds that strong summer sales performance, improving credit availability, and sustained consumer demand prompted the upward revision.
paras.zh: 考克斯汽车公司 (Cox Automotive) 将 2026 年全年新车销量预测从 1,580 万辆上调至 1,610 万辆，“这反映出，尽管燃油价格上涨、利率上升和持续的经济不确定性，市场仍比预期更具弹性”。它补充说，强劲的夏季销售表现、信贷可用性的改善以及持续的消费者需求促使上调。

paras.en: In the used-vehicle market, Cox Automotive expects 20.5 million used retail sales and 38.5 million total used-vehicle sales this year, while pre-owned sales are forecast at 2.6 million units. Cox increased the 2026 forecast for retail sales and total sales, but total used-vehicle sales in 2026 are still forecast to finish slightly below 2025 levels.
paras.zh: 在二手车市场，Cox Automotive 预计今年二手车零售量为 2,050 万辆，二手车总销量为 3,850 万辆，而二手车销量预计为 260 万辆。考克斯上调了 2026 年零售额和总销量的预测，但 2026 年二手车总销量仍预计略低于 2025 年的水平。

paras.en: “While affordability challenges remain and the industry is still adjusting to the loss of federal EV incentives, vehicle demand has proven remarkably durable heading into the fourth quarter,” said Jeremy Robb, Cox Automotive’s chief economist, in the release.
paras.zh: 考克斯汽车公司首席经济学家 Jeremy Robb 在新闻稿中表示：“虽然负担能力方面的挑战依然存在，而且该行业仍在适应联邦电动汽车激励措施的丧失，但事实证明，进入第四季度的汽车需求将非常持久。”

paras.en: On Oct. 7, Cox Automotive reported that its Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index was 205.9 in September, down 0.6% from a year ago and 1.1% from August after adjustments for mix, mileage, and seasonality.
paras.zh: 10月7日，考克斯汽车报告称，经过组合、里程和季节性调整后，9月份曼海姆二手车价值指数为205.9，较去年同期下降0.6%，较8月份下降1.1%。

paras.en: “The September results capped a quarter in which depreciation accelerated amid higher fuel costs, rising interest rates, and broader economic pressure,” a press release states. “Despite resilient demand for used vehicles, Cox Automotive lowered its year-end outlook and now expects the Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index to finish 2026 up approximately 0.2% year over year, down from the 2% increase forecast in July.”
paras.zh: 一份新闻稿称，“9月份的业绩结束了一个季度，在燃料成本上涨、利率上升和更广泛的经济压力的影响下，贬值加速。” “尽管二手车需求强劲，但考克斯汽车公司还是降低了年终预期，目前预计 Manheim 二手车价值指数到 2026 年将同比增长约 0.2%，低于 7 月份预测的 2% 增幅。”

paras.en: Robb noted in the release that by the end of September, vehicle depreciation was steeper than typically seen at that time of year.
paras.zh: 罗布在新闻稿中指出，到 9 月底，车辆折旧速度比一年中那个时候的通常情况要严重。

paras.en: “[W]ith the conflict in the Middle East ongoing, diesel prices at record highs, and interest rates climbing rapidly, increasingly worrying both businesses and consumers, wholesale prices have felt the sting,” he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“随着中东冲突持续不断，柴油价格创历史新高，利率迅速攀升，企业和消费者越来越担心，批发价格也受到了影响。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, wholesale EV sales at Manheim were up 22% from Q2 and 45% from a year ago. EVs reached a record-high 4.9% of all Manheim transactions in Q3, up from 3.9% in Q2.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Manheim 的电动汽车批发销量比第二季度增长 22%，比去年同期增长 45%。第三季度，电动汽车占曼海姆所有交易量的 4.9% 创历史新高，高于第二季度的 3.9%。

paras.en: Used retail EV sales reached 124,000 in Q3 — the highest level on record, up 11.4% year over year; however, Cox Automotive says that’s still only about 2.8% of all used retail sales.
paras.zh: 第三季度二手电动汽车零售销量达到 12.4 万辆，创历史最高水平，同比增长 11.4%；然而，Cox Automotive 表示，这仍然只占所有二手零售额的 2.8% 左右。

paras.en: Charts provided by Edmunds and Cox Automotive
paras.zh: 图表由 Edmunds 和 Cox Automotive 提供

articles.title: Can R-444A Help Shops Lower A/C Retrofit Costs?
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Every refrigerant change brings another round of questions for shop owners. What equipment do we need? What will it cost? How much training is involved? And how does the investment translate into better service for customers?
paras.zh: 每次制冷剂的更换都会给店主带来新一轮的问题。我们需要什么设备？费用是多少？涉及多少培训？投资如何转化为为客户提供更好的服务？

paras.en: In this episode of Shop Owner Solutions, presented by Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials, Doug Kaufman explores another option: Klea Edge R-444A, which Orbia has positioned as an aftermarket alternative to R-1234yf.
paras.zh: 在 Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials 推出的本期店主解决方案中，Doug Kaufman 探索了另一种选择：Klea Edge R-444A，Orbia 将其定位为 R-1234yf 的售后替代品。

paras.en: Joining the conversation are Chuck Abbott, Orbia’s global marketing manager, and Wade Pugh, owner of Wade’s Fixit Shop. Chuck explains the product’s reported performance and cost advantages, while Wade brings the discussion into the bay with firsthand experience retrofitting vehicles at his shop.
paras.zh: 加入对话的还有 Orbia 全球营销经理 Chuck Abbott 和 Wade’s Fixit Shop 老板 Wade Pugh。查克解释了该产品所报告的性能和成本优势，而韦德则通过在他的商店改装车辆的第一手经验将讨论带入海湾。

paras.en: The conversation moves beyond refrigerant chemistry to the details that affect daily operations: equipment requirements, service time, technician preparation and the potential impact on the shop’s bottom line. They also address retrofit procedures, service fittings, labeling, cross-contamination prevention and safety considerations.
paras.zh: 讨论超越了制冷剂化学，涉及到影响日常运营的细节：设备要求、服务时间、技术人员准备以及对车间利润的潜在影响。它们还涉及改造程序、维修配件、标签、交叉污染预防和安全注意事项。

paras.en: For owners evaluating their next A/C equipment purchase—or looking for additional ways to serve customers—those details matter. Understanding an alternative starts with knowing what the work actually involves.
paras.zh: 对于评估下一次购买空调设备或寻找其他方式来服务客户的业主来说，这些细节很重要。了解替代方案首先要了解工作实际涉及的内容。

paras.en: Watch the episode for a practical conversation about R-444A and what shop owners should consider before bringing it into their A/C service business.
paras.zh: 观看本集，了解有关 R-444A 的实用对话，以及店主在将其引入空调服务业务之前应考虑的事项。

articles.title: What Makes Headlights Look Foggy?
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Halogen headlight bulbs can become dimmer over time, even when they still work. Inside each bulb is a tungsten filament that gradually changes as the bulb operates. As the filament heats up and runs, tiny tungsten particles slowly break off. Those particles stick to the inside of the glass and block some of the light from getting through.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，卤素车头灯灯泡可能会变暗，即使它们仍然工作。每个灯泡内部都有一根钨丝，随着灯泡的工作而逐渐变化。当灯丝加热并运行时，微小的钨颗粒会慢慢脱落。这些颗粒粘附在玻璃内部并阻挡部分光线透过。

paras.en: As a result, the bulb may continue working while producing less light than it did when it was new.
paras.zh: 因此，灯泡可能会继续工作，但产生的光线比新灯泡时要少。

paras.en: As the filament loses material, it becomes thinner. That increases resistance, causes the bulb to run hotter and makes the filament more fragile over bumps in the road.
paras.zh: 当灯丝失去材料时，它会变得更细。这会增加电阻，导致灯泡运行得更热，并使灯丝在道路颠簸时更脆弱。

paras.en: The result is lower light output and a bulb that is more likely to burn out sooner.
paras.zh: 结果是光输出降低，灯泡更有可能更快烧坏。

paras.en: Because both bulbs are usually the same age, when one needs replacing, recommend replacing them as a pair. Replacing both helps keep light output balanced and may save the customer another visit.
paras.zh: 由于两个灯泡的寿命通常相同，因此当其中一个灯泡需要更换时，建议成对更换。更换两者有助于保持光输出平衡，并可能节省客户再次光顾的机会。
