articles.title: Diagnosing GM Super Cruise Systems
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Super Cruise is GM’s hands-free driver-assistance system, offered on certain 2019-205 GM vehicles. Feature-wise, it combines adaptive cruise control, automatic braking, lane centering, driver monitoring, GPS and high-definition map data.
paras.zh: Super Cruise 是通用汽车的免提驾驶辅助系统，在某些 2019-205 款通用汽车车辆上提供。在功能方面，它结合了自适应巡航控制、自动制动、车道居中、驾驶员监控、GPS和高清地图数据。

paras.en: In the shop, diagnosis starts by separating a component fault or configuration problem from a normal system inhibit. A missing condition or failure in any of the above-mentioned areas can prevent engagement.
paras.zh: 在车间中，诊断首先是将组件故障或配置问题与正常系统禁止分开。上述任何区域的缺失或故障都可能阻碍参与。

paras.en: On an approved mapped road, Super Cruise uses Adaptive Cruise Control to manage speed and following distance while the lane-control system commands electric power steering to center the vehicle. The forward camera supplies lane information, and Adaptive Cruise Control sensing hardware tracks traffic ahead. The engine and electronic brake control modules carry out acceleration and braking requests. Because these modules exchange network data, a voltage, communication or configuration fault outside the camera can disable the system.
paras.zh: 在经过批准的地图道路上，超级巡航使用自适应巡航控制来管理速度和跟随距离，而车道控制系统则命令电动助力转向系统使车辆居中。前方摄像头提供车道信息，自适应巡航控制传感硬件跟踪前方交通。发动机和电子制动控制模块执行加速和制动请求。由于这些模块交换网络数据，因此摄像机外部的电压、通信或配置故障可能会禁用系统。

paras.en: Super Cruise also compares GPS position with its map database. GM service information identifies the K179 Automated Driving Mapping Module and a LiDAR-scanned map database. Map and GPS-enhancement updates are downloaded through the vehicle’s OnStar Wi-Fi connection. The K73 telematics module supplies GPS and connectivity functions. If the vehicle cannot establish its location or does not have usable road data, Super Cruise cannot confirm that the road is eligible.
paras.zh: Super Cruise 还将 GPS 位置与其地图数据库进行比较。通用汽车服务信息标识了K179自动驾驶地图模块和激光雷达扫描地图数据库。地图和 GPS 增强更新可通过车辆的 OnStar Wi-Fi 连接下载。 K73 远程信息处理模块提供 GPS 和连接功能。如果车辆无法确定其位置或没有可用的道路数据，Super Cruise 无法确认该道路是否符合条件。

paras.en: Before condemning hardware, verify the enabling conditions. Adaptive Cruise Control must be on, the Forward Collision System set to Alert and Brake, the road approved in the map database, lane markings visible, sensors unobstructed and the driver attentive. Teen Driver mode cannot be active. An OnStar plan and accepted terms may also be required. Requirements vary by model year and RPO, so identify the vehicle configuration before testing.
paras.zh: 在谴责硬件之前，请验证启用条件。自适应巡航控制必须打开，前方碰撞系统设置为警报和制动，地图数据库中批准的道路，车道标记可见，传感器畅通无阻，驾驶员注意力集中。青少年驾驶员模式无法激活。可能还需要 OnStar 计划和接受的条款。要求因车型年份和 RPO 而异，因此在测试前确定车辆配置。

paras.en: The secondary DIC message is often more useful than the general statement that Super Cruise is unavailable. “No Road Information” may indicate an ineligible road, an interchange, reconstruction, missing map data or lost GPS. The message “Sensors Can’t Find Lane Lines” can result from weak markings, glare or precipitation. “Sensor Blocked” points toward contamination. Other normal inhibits include an exit lane, a sharp curve, failure to center the vehicle or excessive speed. The referenced GM application lists 85 MPH, although limits are calibration-dependent.
paras.zh: 辅助 DIC 消息通常比 Super Cruise 不可用的一般声明更有用。 “无道路信息”可能表示不合格的道路、立交桥、重建、地图数据丢失或 GPS 丢失。 “传感器无法找到车道线”的消息可能是由于标记较弱、眩光或降水造成的。 “传感器被阻挡”表明存在污染。其他正常限制包括出口车道、急弯、车辆无法居中或超速。引用的 GM 应用程序列出了 85 MPH，但限制取决于校准。

paras.en: “Could Not Recognize Face,” “Can’t See Face Clearly,” “Driver Attention Assist Unavailable,” momentary engagement followed by a takeover warning, and unexplained disengagement can originate in the monitoring system. Check for glare, a dirty lens, obstructions, steering-column position, a hand covering the infrared emitters, a loose B292 camera in the upper shroud, wiring damage or failed emitters. These complaints may occur without a DTC.
paras.zh: “无法识别面部”、“看不清面部”、“驾驶员注意力辅助不可用”、短暂接合后发出接管警告以及不明原因的脱离可能源于监控系统。检查是否有眩光、镜头是否脏污、障碍物、转向柱位置、是否有手遮住红外发射器、上护罩中是否有松动的 B292 摄像头、接线是否损坏或发射器是否出现故障。这些投诉可能在没有 DTC 的情况下发生。

paras.en: First, record the exact messages the customer received, along with road and location, weather, lighting, speed, engagement time and repeatability. Ask them about recent windshield, collision, steering, alignment, suspension, camera, radar or module work. Verify the OnStar account and terms when applicable, plus Wi-Fi and map-update status.
paras.zh: 首先，记录客户收到的确切消息，以及道路和位置、天气、照明、速度、参与时间和可重复性。询问他们最近的挡风玻璃、碰撞、转向、对准、悬架、摄像头、雷达或模块工作情况。验证 OnStar 帐户和适用条款，以及 Wi-Fi 和地图更新状态。

paras.en: Next, perform GM’s vehicle diagnostic system check. Confirm battery state of charge, 9-16 V operating voltage where specified, clean and tight cables and grounds, intact fuses, seated connectors, correct power modes and the absence of interfering aftermarket equipment. Inspect lenses, radar areas and the steering-column camera before connecting the scan tool.
paras.zh: 接下来，进行通用汽车的车辆诊断系统检查。确认电池充电状态、指定的 9-16 V 工作电压、清洁且紧密的电缆和接地、完好无损的保险丝、就位的连接器、正确的电源模式以及不存在干扰售后设备。连接扫描工具之前，检查镜头、雷达区域和转向柱摄像头。

paras.en: Run a full vehicle DTC scan and document every non-communicating module, DTC, symptom byte and current or history status. Do not erase evidence first. Diagnose voltage, internal-module, communication, power-mode and serial-data authentication faults before the Super Cruise symptom. Check applicable bulletins and calibrations. On covered 2021-2024 vehicles, intermittent startup U1624 in K124 may be a false loss-of-Ethernet fault caused by K73 telematics software; follow the bulletin and update K73. For other programmable modules, GM directs current software and a retest before replacement. Cruise data can retain the last eight disengagement reasons and the most recent engagement inhibit.
paras.zh: 运行全车 DTC 扫描并记录每个非通信模块、DTC、症状字节以及当前或历史状态。不要先删除证据。在出现 Super Cruise 症状之前诊断电压、内部模块、通信、电源模式和串行数据身份验证故障。检查适用的公告和校准。在涵盖的 2021-2024 年车辆上，K124 中的间歇性启动 U1624 可能是由 K73 远程信息处理软件引起的虚假以太网丢失故障；按照公告更新K73。对于其他可编程模块，GM 会指导使用当前软件并在更换前进行重新测试。巡航数据可以保留最后八个脱离原因和最近的接触禁止。

paras.en: For “No Road Information” without a related DTC, move the vehicle to an open-sky area and inspect the K73 telematics data, including Number of Satellites Tracked when available. A value that remains at zero, or an incorrect location during an OnStar blue-button check, supports a GPS or telematics fault on vehicles covered by the applicable bulletin. Separate that failure from temporary map, road or reception limits.
paras.zh: 对于没有相关 DTC 的“无道路信息”，请将车辆移至空旷区域并检查 K73 远程信息处理数据，包括跟踪的卫星数量（如果可用）。在 OnStar 蓝色按钮检查期间保持为零的值或位置不正确，表明适用公告所涵盖的车辆存在 GPS 或远程信息处理故障。将故障与临时地图、道路或接收限制分开。

paras.en: For low-light face-recognition complaints, verify all three infrared emitters on each side of the steering-wheel light bar. GDS2 can command them through K124 Image Processing Module 1 Processor 2 under Configuration Reset Functions and Driver Monitoring System Illumination Command. GM recommends a phone camera with a long-exposure function because infrared output may be difficult to see. If one side is dark, follow the VIN-specific circuit diagnostics.
paras.zh: 对于低光面部识别投诉，请验证方向盘灯条两侧的所有三个红外发射器。 GDS2 可以通过 K124 图像处理模块 1 处理器 2 在配置重置功能和驾驶员监控系统照明命令下对它们进行命令。 GM建议使用具有长时间曝光功能的手机摄像头，因为红外输出可能很难看到。如果一侧变暗，请按照 VIN 特定的电路诊断进行操作。

paras.en: Programming, setup and calibration requirements differ across the 2019-2025 range. Confirm RPO content and follow the exact SI procedure after related components are replaced or disturbed. Some 2022-2023 vehicles with RPO 07Z use an image-processing module only to complete CAN circuits. Installing a functional replacement can create a “Take Steering Wheel” message unless the published configuration procedure is followed.
paras.zh: 2019-2025 年范围内的编程、设置和校准要求有所不同。更换或干扰相关组件后，确认 RPO 内容并遵循准确的 SI 程序。一些 2022-2023 年配备 RPO 07Z 的车辆仅使用图像处理模块来完成 CAN 电路。除非遵循已发布的配置过程，否则安装功能替代品可能会产生“拿起方向盘”消息。

paras.en: Complete all required programming, setup and calibrations, then clear the codes only as directed. Road-test the vehicle safely on a known compatible route and reproduce the original conditions. Confirm that the enabling indicators appear, the original DIC message does not return, driver monitoring responds and no faults reset. A successful bay check does not prove the complaint is resolved by itself.
paras.zh: 完成所有必需的编程、设置和校准，然后仅按照指示清除代码。在已知的兼容路线上安全地对车辆进行道路测试并重现原始条件。确认使能指示灯出现，原始DIC信息没有返回，驱动器监控响应并且没有故障复位。成功的海湾检查并不能证明投诉已自行解决。

articles.title: Where Steering and Suspension Problems Come From
articles.author: TrakMotive

paras.en: Ever drive a vehicle that just doesn’t feel right anymore? Maybe it wanders down the highway. Maybe there’s a clunk every time you hit a pothole. Maybe the steering wheel isn’t centered, the tires are wearing unevenly, or it just doesn’t inspire the confidence it used to.
paras.zh: 曾经驾驶过感觉不再合适的车辆吗？也许它在高速公路上徘徊。也许每次遇到坑洼时都会发出一声沉闷的声音。也许方向盘没有居中，轮胎磨损不均匀，或者它只是不再激发人们以前的信心。

paras.en: The truth is, steering and suspension problems rarely come from a single worn out part. Every control arm, ball joint, tie rod, sway bar link, and bushing work together as one connected system. When one connection starts to wear, it puts added stress on the rest of the system, and before long, that small problem becomes several bigger ones.
paras.zh: 事实是，转向和悬架问题很少来自单个磨损部件。每个控制臂、球窝接头、横拉杆、摆杆连杆和衬套作为一个连接系统一起工作。当一个连接开始磨损时，就会给系统的其他部分带来额外的压力，不久之后，这个小问题就会变成几个更大的问题。

paras.en: That system level approach is exactly how TrakMotive has positioned its Suspensia brand chassis program. Learn more about it in this video, sponsored by TrakMotive.
paras.zh: 这种系统级方法正是 TrakMotive 对其 Suspensia 品牌底盘计划的定位。观看由 TrakMotive 赞助的视频，了解更多相关信息。

articles.title: How Scotty’s Automotive Delivers Dealer Level Diagnostics
articles.author: Autel

paras.en: See how Scotty’s Automotive Service uses Autel diagnostic and TPMS technology to tackle advanced repairs, programming and everyday service more efficiently. From full-system scans and CAN bus diagnostics to Remote Expert programming, TPMS service and digital tire inspections, the team shows how the right tools help keep more work in-house. Discover how modern diagnostic technology can save technicians time, improve shop efficiency and help independent repair facilities deliver dealership-level capabilities to their customers.
paras.zh: 了解 Scotty 的汽车服务如何使用 Autel 诊断和 TPMS 技术来更有效地处理高级维修、编程和日常服务。从全系统扫描和 CAN 总线诊断到远程专家编程、TPMS 服务和数字轮胎检查，该团队展示了正确的工具如何帮助在内部完成更多工作。了解现代诊断技术如何节省技术人员的时间、提高车间效率并帮助独立维修机构向客户提供经销商级别的功能。

paras.en: - Advanced diagnostics: Autel scan tools help technicians perform full-system scans, view multiple data points, and quickly identify where to begin diagnosing complex problems.
paras.zh: - 高级诊断：Autel 扫描工具可帮助技术人员执行全系统扫描、查看多个数据点并快速确定从何处开始诊断复杂问题。

paras.en: - More work stays in-house: Programming and Remote Expert capabilities reduce the need to send vehicles to dealerships, saving the shop time and resources.
paras.zh: - 更多工作留在内部：编程和远程专家功能减少了将车辆发送到经销商的需要，从而节省了车间时间和资源。

paras.en: - Faster electrical troubleshooting: Topology mapping helps technicians diagnose CAN bus and wiring issues more efficiently.
paras.zh: - 更快的电气故障排除：拓扑映射可帮助技术人员更有效地诊断 CAN 总线和接线问题。

paras.en: - Simplified TPMS and brake service: Autel tools support TPMS diagnostics, sensor programming, battery checks, and electronic brake service.
paras.zh: - 简化的 TPMS 和制动服务：Autel 工具支持 TPMS 诊断、传感器编程、电池检查和电子制动服务。

paras.en: - Digital vehicle inspections: Tire tread and brake measurements can be captured electronically and added directly to repair orders for clear, accurate customer information.
paras.zh: - 数字车辆检查：可以电子方式捕获轮胎胎面和制动测量值，并将其直接添加到维修订单中，以获得清晰、准确的客户信息。

paras.en: - Easy-to-use technology: Scotty’s team highlights the speed, reliability, intuitive operation and value of Autel equipment for both experienced and newer technicians.
paras.zh: - 易于使用的技术：Scotty 的团队向经验丰富的技术人员和新手技术人员强调了 Autel 设备的速度、可靠性、直观操作和价值。

paras.en: - Better shop efficiency: By combining diagnostics, programming, inspections and service functions, the technology helps technicians work more efficiently while giving customers access to advanced service close to home.
paras.zh: - 提高车间效率：通过结合诊断、编程、检查和服务功能，该技术可帮助技术人员更高效地工作，同时让客户在家门口就能获得先进的服务。

articles.title: Valvoline Celebrates Two Major Milestones
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Valvoline Inc. is marking 10 years as a public company and 40 years in the retail automotive services business.
paras.zh: 胜牌公司 (Valvoline Inc.) 正在庆祝上市公司 10 周年以及零售汽车服务业务 40 周年。

paras.en: “Forty years ago, Valvoline Inc. entered retail with a simple idea to make routine vehicle care faster, easier, and more trusted for busy drivers,” said Lori Flees, president and chief executive officer of Valvoline Inc. “That promise remains and these milestones are about more than longevity, they’re about the team members, franchisees, and customers who have helped shape our journey. From our first retail service centers to our network today, our purpose remains: we simplify vehicle care so customers can do what drives them.”
paras.zh: 胜牌公司总裁兼首席执行官洛里·弗利斯 (Lori Flees) 表示：“四十年前，胜牌公司进入零售业时，怀着一个简单的想法，即让日常车辆保养变得更快、更容易，并让忙碌的驾驶员更信任。这一承诺依然存在，这些里程碑不仅仅关乎长寿，还关乎帮助塑造我们旅程的团队成员、特许经营商和客户。从我们的第一个零售服务中心到今天的网络，我们的目标仍然是：我们简化车辆保养，让客户可以做他们驾驶的事情。”

paras.en: Valvoline Expands Retail Service Network
paras.zh: 胜牌扩大零售服务网络

paras.en: Valvoline Inc.’s retail growth began in 1986 when the company acquired 42 Rapid Oil Change locations in Minneapolis. The acquisition established its first retail service center network, which the company later renamed Valvoline Instant Oil Change.
paras.zh: Valvoline Inc. 的零售增长始于 1986 年，当时该公司收购了明尼阿波利斯的 42 个快速换油地点。此次收购建立了其第一个零售服务中心网络，该公司后来将其更名为胜牌即时换油。

paras.en: By its initial public offering 10 years ago, the company had surpassed 1,000 stores. Today, Valvoline Inc. operates more than 2,500 service centers across the United States and Canada. The company plans to expand its network to more than 3,500 locations systemwide.
paras.zh: 到 10 年前首次公开募股时，该公司的门店数量已超过 1,000 家。如今，胜牌公司在美国和加拿大运营着 2,500 多个服务中心。该公司计划将其网络扩展到全系统 3,500 多个地点。

paras.en: Valvoline Inc. employs more than 13,500 team members. Approximately 95% of its service center managers began their careers as entry-level technicians. The company also supports communities through its “Happy to Help” initiative, which focuses on children’s physical and mental well-being. The initiative supports people and communities connected to its service center network.
paras.zh: Valvoline Inc. 拥有超过 13,500 名团队成员。大约 95% 的服务中心经理的职业生涯是从初级技术人员开始的。该公司还通过“乐于助人”计划为社区提供支持，该计划重点关注儿童的身心健康。该计划为与其服务中心网络相连的人们和社区提供支持。

paras.en: Earlier this year, the company announced a $750,000 partnership with Ronald McDonald House Global. The agreement made Valvoline Inc. the organization’s first dedicated corporate partner focused on mental health.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，该公司宣布与麦当劳叔叔之家全球公司建立价值 75 万美元的合作伙伴关系。该协议使胜牌公司成为该组织第一个专注于心理健康的企业合作伙伴。

paras.en: Retail Strategy Addresses Changing Vehicle Needs
paras.zh: 零售策略满足不断变化的车辆需求

paras.en: As the company enters its fifth decade in retail services, Valvoline said it continues adapting to drivers’ changing maintenance needs. Increasing vehicle complexity and longer ownership periods are driving demand for preventive maintenance services.
paras.zh: 随着公司零售服务进入第五个十年，胜牌表示将继续适应驾驶员不断变化的维护需求。车辆复杂性的增加和拥有期限的延长正在推动对预防性维护服务的需求。

paras.en: Valvoline added that it plans to continue expanding its service network while emphasizing convenience, technical expertise and customer service.
paras.zh: 胜牌补充说，计划继续扩大服务网络，同时强调便利性、技术专业知识和客户服务。

articles.title: PGI Unveils New Corporate Logo, Updated Brand Identity
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Premium Guard Inc. (PGI) unveiled its new corporate logo, introducing an updated identity that reflects the company’s continued evolution. The company said the new identity represents PGI’s transition from its filtration roots into a diversified automotive products and solutions company. The company continues to expand its product categories, channels and capabilities. The company added that the identity also reflects qualities that define PGI’s culture, including agility, transparency, innovation, ambition and forward momentum.
paras.zh: Premium Guard Inc. (PGI) 推出了新的企业标志，推出了反映公司持续发展的更新标识。该公司表示，新标识代表 PGI 从过滤根源转型为多元化的汽车产品和解决方案公司。公司不断扩大产品类别、渠道和能力。该公司补充说，这一标识还反映了定义 PGI 文化的品质，包括敏捷性、透明度、创新、雄心和前进动力。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1996, PGI has evolved by anticipating change and investing ahead of the market. Today, the company’s capabilities span engineering, product development, manufacturing, global sourcing, distribution, data and analytics, marketing and e-commerce. The company said the new logo reflects that evolution while preserving PGI’s signature blue color palette and connection to its heritage.
paras.zh: 自 1996 年成立以来，PGI 通过预测变化和领先市场投资而不断发展。如今，该公司的能力涵盖工程、产品开发、制造、全球采购、分销、数据和分析、营销和电子商务。该公司表示，新标志反映了这一演变，同时保留了 PGI 标志性的蓝色调色板及其与其传统的联系。

paras.en: According to the company, the redesigned logo introduces clean, bold and angular forms that create a sense of motion and direction. Its simplicity reflects PGI’s commitment to simplifying business interactions. Its design also represents speed, agility, progress and ambition.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，重新设计的标志引入了干净、大胆和棱角分明的形式，创造了一种运动感和方向感。其简单性体现了 PGI 对简化业务交互的承诺。它的设计也代表了速度、敏捷、进步和雄心。

paras.en: “PGI today is a very different company from where we were even 10 years ago, let alone when we started 30 years ago,” said Anan Bishara, founder and CEO of PGI. “What has not changed is the mindset that built the company — staying close to our customers, moving quickly, being transparent, challenging ourselves to improve and investing ahead of where the market is going.”
paras.zh: PGI 创始人兼首席执行官阿南·比沙拉 (Anan Bishara) 表示：“今天的 PGI 与 10 年前相比已经是一家非常不同的公司，更不用说 30 年前刚成立的时候了。” “没有改变的是建立公司的心态——贴近客户、快速行动、透明、挑战自我改进并领先于市场发展方向进行投资。”

paras.en: Bishara continued, “We have invested significantly in our people, products, engineering, technology, data, infrastructure and supply chain. The new identity is clean, dynamic, and forward-looking because that is how we see PGI. It represents our momentum, our agility and our determination to keep moving forward and Be Ahead.”
paras.zh: Bishara 继续说道：“我们在人员、产品、工程、技术、数据、基础设施和供应链方面进行了大量投资。新的形象干净、充满活力且具有前瞻性，因为这就是我们对 PGI 的看法。它代表了我们的动力、我们的敏捷性以及我们不断前进和领先的决心。”

paras.en: Company Expands Manufacturing and Distribution Capabilities
paras.zh: 公司扩大制造和分销能力

paras.en: The new identity comes as PGI strengthens its U.S. manufacturing and distribution footprint and expands into new automotive categories. The company also continues investing in engineering, technology, data, intellectual property and global capabilities. These investments support PGI’s expansion into a broader automotive products and solutions platform.
paras.zh: 新标识的出现正值 PGI 加强其在美国的制造和分销业务并扩展到新的汽车类别之际。该公司还继续投资于工程、技术、数据、知识产权和全球能力。这些投资支持 PGI 扩展到更广泛的汽车产品和解决方案平台。

paras.en: The company serves customers across retail, traditional aftermarket, quick-lube, commercial, original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and e-commerce channels. The refreshed identity reflects the company’s current operations and its plans for continued expansion and innovation.
paras.zh: 该公司为零售、传统售后市场、快速润滑、商业、原始设备制造商 (OEM) 和电子商务渠道的客户提供服务。更新后的形象反映了公司当前的运营情况及其持续扩张和创新的计划。

paras.en: PGI will showcase its new corporate identity at AAPEX 2026 in Las Vegas. The company will also highlight its expanding products, technologies and capabilities. Attendees can visit PGI at Booth V2438 to see the company’s new identity.
paras.zh: PGI 将在拉斯维加斯举行的 AAPEX 2026 上展示其新的企业形象。该公司还将重点介绍其不断扩展的产品、技术和能力。与会者可以参观 PGI 的 V2438 展位，了解公司的新形象。

paras.en: PGI will begin introducing the new identity across its digital platforms, facilities, corporate communications, sales materials, packaging and trade show presence later this year.
paras.zh: PGI 将于今年晚些时候开始在其数字平台、设施、企业通讯、销售材料、包装和贸易展览展示中引入新标识。

articles.title: Continental Battery Systems Names Nick Townsend CFO
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Continental Battery Systems, North American distributor of aftermarket batteries serving automotive, commercial and specialty markets, announced the appointment of Nick Townsend as chief financial officer.
paras.zh: 大陆电池系统公司（Continental Battery Systems）是服务于汽车、商业和专业市场的售后电池北美经销商，宣布任命尼克·汤森德（Nick Townsend）为首席财务官。

paras.en: In his new role, Townsend will lead the company’s finance organization and capital allocation to support Continental Battery Systems’ growth priorities and strengthen financial discipline across the business, the company said. He will also help guide investments in supply chain, inventory management and battery recycling capabilities across the company’s national network.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，在新职位上，汤森将领导公司的财务组织和资本配置，以支持大陆电池系统的增长重点并加强整个业务的财务纪律。他还将帮助指导公司全国网络中供应链、库存管理和电池回收能力的投资。

paras.en: “Nick is an exceptional financial leader with a proven track record of steering complex strategies across the industrial and energy sectors,” said Mike Harris, CEO of Continental Battery Systems. “As we optimize our national footprint and double down on operational excellence, Nick’s expertise will be pivotal in driving disciplined growth and creating long-term value for our customers.”
paras.zh: 大陆电池系统公司首席执行官迈克·哈里斯 (Mike Harris) 表示：“尼克是一位杰出的财务领导者，在指导工业和能源领域的复杂战略方面拥有良好的记录。” “随着我们优化我们的全国足迹并加倍追求卓越运营，尼克的专业知识将在推动有序增长和为客户创造长期价值方面发挥关键作用。”

paras.en: Townsend brings more than 20 years of finance leadership experience across global industrial, energy and battery companies, including GE, Chevron and Ecobat, one of the world’s largest lead battery recyclers. Throughout his career, he has led finance through complex transactions, integrations and operational transformations across public and private equity-backed organizations. Most recently, he served as CFO of KMM, a telecom infrastructure and logistics company, where he led finance, legal, IT and HR.
paras.zh: Townsend 拥有 20 多年在全球工业、能源和电池公司的财务领导经验，其中包括 GE、雪佛龙和全球最大的铅电池回收商之一 Ecobat。在他的整个职业生涯中，他在公共和私募股权支持的组织中领导了复杂的交易、整合和运营转型。最近，他担任电信基础设施和物流公司 KMM 的首席财务官，负责领导财务、法律、IT 和人力资源工作。

paras.en: “Having spent much of my career within the industrial and energy sectors, I have long appreciated Continental Battery Systems’ strong history and market leadership,” said Townsend. “The opportunity to leverage my background in financial transformation and battery supply chains to support Continental’s next phase of growth is incredibly compelling. I am thrilled to join the team and help accelerate our strategic objectives.”
paras.zh: “我的大部分职业生涯都在工业和能源领域度过，我一直很欣赏大陆电池系统公司悠久的历史和市场领导地位，”汤森德说。 “利用我在财务转型和电池供应链方面的背景来支持大陆集团下一阶段的增长的机会非常有吸引力。我很高兴加入这个团队并帮助加速我们的战略目标。”

articles.title: XL Parts | The Parts House Recognizes Top Suppliers
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: XL Parts | The Parts House recognized eight supplier partners during its 2026 Annual Vendor Awards Presentation on Sept. 17. The company held the presentation at The Woodlands Resort.
paras.zh: XL 零件 | Parts House 在 9 月 17 日举行的 2026 年度供应商奖颁奖典礼上表彰了八家供应商合作伙伴。该公司在伍德兰度假村举行了颁奖典礼。

paras.en: The ceremony opened the company’s first of three regional VIP events. The event debuted an expanded two-day format focused on connections, training and collaboration among suppliers, employees and customers.
paras.zh: 该仪式是该公司三场区域 VIP 活动中的第一场。该活动首次扩大了为期两天的形式，重点关注供应商、员工和客户之间的联系、培训和协作。

paras.en: “Our Houston VIP event provided an exceptional setting for meaningful connection, collaboration, and recognition,” said president and CEO Vikrant Aggarwal. “It was a privilege to recognize the suppliers whose dedication and partnership help drive our growth and mutual success.”
paras.zh: “我们的休斯顿 VIP 活动为有意义的联系、协作和认可提供了特殊的环境，”总裁兼首席执行官维克兰特·阿加瓦尔 (Vikrant Aggarwal) 说道。 “我们很荣幸能够认可这些供应商，他们的奉献精神和合作伙伴关系有助于推动我们的成长和共同成功。”

paras.en: XL Parts | The Parts House Honors Supplier Partners
paras.zh: XL 零件 | Parts House 表彰供应商合作伙伴

paras.en: The company evaluated suppliers based on sales growth, program alignment, communication, competitive costs and overall partnership.
paras.zh: 该公司根据销售增长、计划协调、沟通、竞争成本和整体合作伙伴关系来评估供应商。

paras.en: The 2026 Annual Vendor Awards recipients included:
paras.zh: 2026 年年度供应商奖获得者包括：

paras.en: - NA Williams, Representative of the Year Award
paras.zh: - NA Williams，年度代表奖

paras.en: - FCS Automotive, Supplier of the Year Award
paras.zh: - FCS Automotive，年度供应商奖

paras.en: Following the vendor awards, XL Parts | The Parts House leadership reviewed its strategic vision, mission and values. Leaders also outlined future growth plans and loyalty programs.
paras.zh: 继获得供应商奖项后，XL Parts | Parts House 领导层回顾了其战略愿景、使命和价值观。领导人还概述了未来的增长计划和忠诚度计划。

paras.en: The Houston event opened the company’s regional VIP series. The event focused on collaboration and strategic alignment across the company’s operations.
paras.zh: 休斯顿活动拉开了该公司地区 VIP 系列的序幕。该活动的重点是公司运营中的协作和战略协调。

articles.title: Counter Culture: Understanding Torque Converter Shudder
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: In the latest episode of Counter Culture, Pat Burrow, technical director at International Lubricants, discusses the causes of torque converter shudder. He also explains the importance of transmission fluid and how friction modifiers can help technicians diagnose and address the problem.
paras.zh: 在最新一集的《反文化》中，国际润滑油公司技术总监 Pat Burrow 讨论了变矩器颤抖的原因。他还解释了变速箱油的重要性以及摩擦改进剂如何帮助技术人员诊断和解决问题。

paras.en: Burrow Explains Causes of Torque Converter Shudder
paras.zh: Burrow 解释变矩器颤抖的原因

paras.en: Burrow explains that torque converter shudder often feels like driving over railroad tracks, with vibrations ranging from barely noticeable to severe. Although mechanical wear, solenoids and transmission programming can contribute, depleted fluid additives frequently play a significant role.
paras.zh: Burrow 解释说，变矩器的颤抖通常感觉就像在铁轨上行驶一样，振动范围从几乎察觉不到到严重。尽管机械磨损、电磁阀和变速箱编程可能会产生影响，但耗尽的流体添加剂经常发挥重要作用。

paras.en: “Transmission fluid is probably the most complicated lubricant you have in your vehicle,” Burrow said.
paras.zh: “变速箱油可能是车辆中最复杂的润滑剂，”伯罗说。

paras.en: Beyond lubrication, transmission fluid provides cooling, wear protection, hydraulic operation and smooth clutch engagement.
paras.zh: 除了润滑之外，变速箱油还提供冷却、磨损保护、液压操作和平稳的离合器接合。

paras.en: Burrow explains that modern automatic transmission fluids contain friction modifiers designed for specific applications. However, demanding driving conditions can accelerate additive depletion, sometimes causing shudder after just 20,000 to 30,000 miles.
paras.zh: Burrow 解释说，现代自动变速箱油含有专为特定应用而设计的摩擦调节剂。然而，苛刻的驾驶条件会加速添加剂的消耗，有时在行驶 20,000 至 30,000 英里后就会引起颤抖。

paras.en: Burrow emphasizes asking customers about vehicle mileage, driving conditions and specific applications before recommending a solution. Heavy loads, high temperatures and stop-and-go traffic can increase the likelihood of fluid-related problems.
paras.zh: Burrow 强调在推荐解决方案之前询问客户有关车辆行驶里程、驾驶条件和具体应用的信息。重负载、高温和走走停停的交通会增加出现与液体相关的问题的可能性。

paras.en: Burrow also discusses how friction modifiers can serve as diagnostic tools. If a friction modifier reduces or eliminates shudder, technicians can identify fluid-related issues before pursuing mechanical repairs.
paras.zh: Burrow 还讨论了摩擦调节剂如何充当诊断工具。如果摩擦改进剂可以减少或消除颤抖，技术人员可以在进行机械维修之前识别与流体相关的问题。

paras.en: “If the shutter went away, boom, they knew instantly what the problem was. It was fluid,” Burrow said.
paras.zh: “如果百叶窗消失了，砰，他们立刻就知道问题出在哪里。它是不稳定的，”伯罗说。

paras.en: However, Burrow cautions that worn solenoids, valve bodies and other mechanical problems may require repairs that fluid additives cannot address.
paras.zh: 然而，伯罗警告说，磨损的电磁阀、阀体和其他机械问题可能需要修复，而流体添加剂无法解决。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens Second Little River Store
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Little River, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of its second Little River location at 2353 Highway 9 E. with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from Horry-Georgetown Technical College, who were on site to accept a donation supporting the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在 Little River 开设了最新的商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司在 9 E 号高速公路 2353 号的小河第二家工厂举行了剪彩仪式，庆祝其第二家工厂开业，当地官员和霍里乔治敦技术学院的代表在现场接受了支持学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training and career opportunities through HGTC’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians remain in high demand, with about 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过 HGTC 的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很大，预计到 2034 年，每年约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to open our new store in Little River and serve customers throughout the community,” said Mike Fogarty, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “This opening allows us to bring quality parts, trusted service and expert support to even more customers in the area. As we celebrate this milestone, we’re proud to support Horry-Georgetown Technical College and recognize the important role the college plays in our community.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Mike Fogarty 表示：“我们很高兴在 Little River 开设新店，为整个社区的客户提供服务。” “这一开业使我们能够为该地区更多的客户带来优质的零件、值得信赖的服务和专家支持。在庆祝这一里程碑之际，我们很自豪能够支持霍里乔治城技术学院，并认识到该学院在我们社区中发挥的重要作用。”

paras.en: “Partnerships with local businesses play an important role in helping HGTC provide students with the resources and hands-on learning experiences they need to succeed,” said Shannon Detzler, president and CEO of the HGTC Foundation. “We are grateful to Advance Auto Parts for investing in our Automotive Technology program and supporting the students who are preparing to become part of our region’s skilled workforce. We appreciate their generosity and are proud to partner with them in celebration of their new Little River store.”
paras.zh: HGTC 基金会总裁兼首席执行官 Shannon Detzler 表示：“与当地企业的合作在帮助 HGTC 为学生提供成功所需的资源和实践学习经验方面发挥着重要作用。” “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 投资我们的汽车技术项目，并为准备成为我们地区熟练劳动力的学生提供支持。我们感谢他们的慷慨，并很自豪能与他们合作庆祝他们新的小河店的开业。”

paras.en: The store offers parts and accessories, including batteries, brakes, filters, fluids and tools. Hours are Monday through Saturday from 7:30 a.m. to 9 p.m., and Sunday from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.
paras.zh: 该商店提供零件和配件，包括电池、制动器、过滤器、液体和工具。工作时间为周一至周六上午 7:30 至晚上 9:00，周日上午 9:00 至晚上 8:00。

articles.title: 'It gives us a glimpse of a different kind of Viking life': Archaeologist Neil Price on the sea-kings, sorcerers and Sámi who lived during the Viking Age
articles.author: Laura Geggel

paras.en: In the early medieval period, the Vikings were just one part of a vast tapestry of Scandinavians who ruled, sailed, traded and fought around the world, from North America to Asia. In his new book, "The Sea-King and the Sorceress: Life and Death in the Viking Age" (Basic Books, 2026), author Neil Price, professor and chair of archaeology at Uppsala University in Sweden, reveals the true diversity and complexity of people who lived during the Viking Age (often dating from A.D. 793 to 1066).
paras.zh: 在中世纪早期，维京人只是斯堪的纳维亚人的一部分，他们在从北美到亚洲的世界各地进行统治、航行、贸易和战斗。瑞典乌普萨拉大学考古学教授兼系主任尼尔·普莱斯在他的新书《海王与女巫：维京时代的生与死》（基础书籍，2026 年）中揭示了生活在维京时代（通常可追溯到公元 793 年至 1066 年）的人们的真正多样性和复杂性。

paras.en: Price investigates more than 20 burials from the Viking Age, lingering on details that can tell us about these individuals and their world. He also shines a light on frequently overlooked groups, including the enslaved people known as thralls that the Norse ruled over and even sacrificed in some of their burials. Price also delves into the realms of powerful women, including a "shield-maiden" buried with war-grade weapons in Sweden, a "sorceress" in Denmark, and an elderly matriarch whose children carved out a local empire in Sweden.
paras.zh: 普莱斯调查了 20 多个维京时代的墓葬，仔细研究了可以告诉我们这些人和他们的世界的细节。他还揭示了经常被忽视的群体，包括被称为奴隶的奴隶，挪威人统治着他们，甚至在他们的一些墓葬中牺牲了他们。普莱斯还深入研究了有权有势的女性领域，包括瑞典埋葬着战争级武器的“盾女”、丹麦的“女巫”，以及一位年长的女族长，她的孩子们在瑞典建立了一个地方帝国。

paras.en: In an interview with Live Science, Price talks about his new book, and the evidence we have for the familiar yet foreign lives they lived centuries ago.
paras.zh: 在接受《Live Science》采访时，普莱斯谈到了他的新书，以及我们掌握的证据，证明他们几个世纪前过着熟悉但又陌生的生活。

paras.en: Laura Geggel: The Vikings are popularly known for being brutish and bloodthirsty pillagers, but the individuals in your book show the rich diversity of people from this time. Why did you decide to write this book and feature their stories?
paras.zh: 劳拉·格格尔：维京人以野蛮和嗜血的掠夺者而闻名，但你书中的人物展示了这个时代人们的丰富多样性。您为什么决定写这本书并讲述他们的故事？

paras.en: Neil Price: I think quite simply because of the cliche that you've just mentioned, the idea that the Vikings are all barbarian raiders who go about burning down churches and frightening the English and things. Those raiders were certainly real, but they were only ever a tiny minority of the Scandinavian population, and I wanted to bring out all the different kinds of Viking lives, and that's why this book really came together.
paras.zh: 尼尔·普莱斯：我认为这很简单，因为你刚才提到的陈词滥调，即认为维京人都是野蛮的袭击者，他们烧毁教堂并恐吓英国人等等。这些袭击者当然是真实存在的，但他们只占斯堪的纳维亚人口的极少数，我想展现所有不同类型的维京人生活，这就是这本书真正聚集在一起的原因。

paras.en: It's divided into chapters, each one of which looks at a different kind of person, you know, a farmer, or an ambassador, or someone who uses magic, or a hunter. And I'm quite pleased that the Viking — the sort of raiding and pillaging Viking — it takes a while to get to him.
paras.zh: 它分为几个章节，每一章都着眼于不同类型的人，你知道，农民，大使，使用魔法的人，或者猎人。我很高兴维京人——那种袭击和掠夺的维京人——需要一段时间才能找到他。

paras.en: LG: How would you define the epitome of a Viking from that age?
paras.zh: LG：您如何定义那个时代维京人的缩影？

paras.en: The actual Viking, it comes from an old Norse word from their own language: víkingr. And really it's a job description, it means something like pirate — not necessarily negatively. It just describes maritime robbery with violence. So it is the classic image of the Viking stereotype.
paras.zh: 真正的维京人，它来自他们自己语言中的一个古老的北欧单词：víkingr。实际上，这是一份工作描述，它的意思类似于海盗——不一定是负面的。它只是描述了暴力的海上抢劫。所以它是维京人刻板印象的经典形象。

paras.en: But it was never a name for a people. If we could go back in time and just meet some people in Scandinavia and say, "Did you know that you're all Vikings?" — they'd be astonished.
paras.zh: 但它从来都不是一个民族的名字。如果我们能回到过去，在斯堪的纳维亚半岛遇见一些人并说：“你们知道你们都是维京人吗？” ——他们会感到惊讶。

paras.en: It's a name, a collective name that we've given them. It started in the 19th century, really. So, they wouldn't have called themselves that.
paras.zh: 这是一个名字，我们给他们起的一个集体名字。事实上，它始于 19 世纪。所以，他们不会这样称呼自己。

paras.en: LG: Your book starts with the sea-king, a commander and his crew who were buried in boats with swords and shields in Estonia. Usually, the Viking Age is said to have begun in 793 with the raid on the island of Lindisfarne in the U.K., but you say this burial suggests that the Viking Age started earlier and in another part of Europe. Can you tell us more about this?
paras.zh: LG：你的书以海王开始，他是一位指挥官和他的船员，他们被埋在爱沙尼亚的船上，带着剑和盾牌。通常，维京时代据说始于 793 年对英国林迪斯法恩岛的袭击，但你说这个墓葬表明维京时代开始得更早，而且是在欧洲的另一个地方。您能告诉我们更多相关信息吗？

paras.en: NP: When I started studying Vikings at college — so this is back in the early 1980s, a long, long time ago — the Viking Age did start not just in 793; It started on the eighth of June 793 with the Lindisfarne raid.
paras.zh: NP：当我在大学开始研究维京人时——那是在 1980 年代初，很久很久以前——维京时代不仅始于 793 年，而且还始于 793 年。事情始于 793 年 6 月 8 日的林迪斯法恩袭击。

paras.en: Obviously it's absurd that an entire period of time starts on an afternoon, you know, not the day before or the day after. So it's obvious that we're talking about something that is really a matter of social processes, things that go on over a long period of time. But the thing that makes the finds that are in the sea-king chapter — they're from this place called Salme in Estonia — really interesting is that they seem to be the remains of, or the traces of a raid.
paras.zh: 显然，整个时间段是从下午开始，而不是前一天或后一天，这是荒谬的。所以很明显，我们正在谈论的事情实际上是社会过程的问题，是长期持续的事情。但海王一章中的发现——它们来自爱沙尼亚这个叫萨尔梅的地方——真正有趣的是，它们似乎是一次袭击的遗迹或痕迹。

paras.en: It's decades before Lindisfarne, it's about 750. And obviously on an island on the Estonian coast, it's going east, not west. So it really pushes that [raiding] behavior a lot earlier and it reorientates it. Even then, we shouldn't see the Vikings in that find as being the first Vikings. Actually the Scandinavians had been raiding all over the place for generations.
paras.zh: 比林迪斯法恩早了几十年，大约是 750 年。显然，在爱沙尼亚海岸的一个岛屿上，它正在向东而不是向西移动。所以它确实更早地推动了[袭击]行为，并重新定位了它。即便如此，我们也不应该将那个发现中的维京人视为第一批维京人。事实上，斯堪的纳维亚人几代人以来一直在到处劫掠。

paras.en: LG: I really enjoyed your focus on women, since stereotypically the Viking Age is associated with burly male warriors. What are some roles that women held in the Viking Age that you don't think most people know about?
paras.zh: LG：我真的很喜欢你对女性的关注，因为维京时代通常与魁梧的男性战士联系在一起。您认为大多数人不知道维京时代女性所扮演的哪些角色？

paras.en: NP: Something that particularly interests me, which is something I've worked on for a very long time now, is that when we think about Norse religion, everyone thinks about the gods. You know, they're still around in Marvel movies and things — we think of Thor and Odin and Freya and so on.
paras.zh: NP：我特别感兴趣的事情是，当我们想到北欧宗教时，每个人都会想到诸神，这也是我已经研究了很长时间的事情。你知道，他们仍然出现在漫威电影和其他事物中——我们想到雷神、奥丁和芙蕾雅等等。

paras.en: But actually, the [thing that was] far more present than the gods in people's lives were lots of kinds of local spirits and creatures and the elves that live in the stone behind your house. Getting in contact with that world of supernatural creatures and forces and powers — or whatever we call them — was something that was very much in the domain of women.
paras.zh: 但实际上，在人们的生活中，比神更存在的东西是许多当地的神灵和生物，以及住在你房子后面的石头里的精灵。接触那个充满超自然生物、力量和力量的世界——或者无论我们如何称呼它们——在很大程度上是女性的领域。

paras.en: And it's a really important thing. So we shouldn't just say, "Oh, and some of them did magic." They're like negotiators, because you want to get on well with all these little creatures. If you don't, they could mess up your life, you know — your cattle could die, your crops could fail, that kind of thing. You could get sick.
paras.zh: 这是一件非常重要的事情。所以我们不应该只是说，“哦，他们中的一些人变魔术了。”他们就像谈判者，因为你想与所有这些小生物相处融洽。如果你不这样做，他们可能会扰乱你的生活，你知道的——你的牛可能会死，你的庄稼可能歉收，诸如此类的事情。你可能会生病。

paras.en: So the practice of, it's hard to know what to call it in English. Sorcery or magic — they're not very good words, but there's lots of Norse words for it. To be able to do that is a very powerful thing and it's a very prominent role in society. And this was very much in the domain of women.
paras.zh: 所以这样的做法，很难知道用英文怎么称呼它。巫术或魔法——这些词都不是很好的词，但挪威语中有很多词来形容它。能够做到这一点是一件非常强大的事情，并且在社会中扮演着非常重要的角色。这在很大程度上是女性的领域。

paras.en: I think actually women could take on many of the roles that we conventionally assign to men. In terms of capability, of course they could. There are some, rather few I think, but there are some female Vikings, like actual Vikings, there are women conducting trade, owning property, investing in business ventures, things like that. So they have a very prominent role in Norse society.
paras.zh: 我认为实际上女性可以承担我们通常分配给男性的许多角色。就能力而言，当然可以。有一些，我认为很少，但有一些女性维京人，就像真正的维京人一样，有女性进行贸易、拥有财产、投资商业企业，诸如此类。所以他们在挪威社会中扮演着非常重要的角色。

paras.en: We talked about Lindisfarne just now. When I started studying the Vikings, Viking women were one display case in the museum exhibition, next to the display case on pottery or something. Not half the population, and that has really changed. I think we look at Viking Age people now, not just assuming they're male by default.
paras.zh: 我们刚才谈到了林迪斯法恩。当我开始研究维京人时，维京妇女是博物馆展览中的一个展示柜，旁边是陶器或其他东西的展示柜。还不到一半的人口，而情况确实发生了变化。我认为我们现在关注的是维京时代的人，而不仅仅是假设他们默认是男性。

paras.en: LG: Actually, to linger, you described a number of women and their professions. Could you tell me more about these two amazing women in your book from Birka: the merchant and the warrior?
paras.zh: LG：实际上，为了逗留，你描述了一些女性和她们的职业。您能告诉我更多关于比尔卡书中这两位令人惊叹的女性的信息吗：商人和战士？

paras.en: NP: Birka is this huge town. It's Sweden's first urban center, and it's absolutely surrounded by burial mounds. So you have the area of the town and then all the people who lived in it. You can wander through their cemetery, which is a pretty spectacular place — there's 5,000 burial mounds.
paras.zh: NP：比尔卡是一个巨大的城镇。这是瑞典第一个城市中心，周围都是墓葬。所以你有城镇的区域，然后是居住在其中的所有居民。您可以漫步穿过他们的墓地，那是一个非常壮观的地方——有 5,000 个坟墓。

paras.en: The merchant woman that you mentioned, she's one of the earlier graves [circa 840s], so she's one of the first people who would have identified as being someone who lives in a town. Today we talk about "I'm a city person" or a "country person," and that's an identity that was only just beginning to be created in the Viking Age, because everybody was country people. With the first towns, people start to live in a different way, and this woman was one of them.
paras.zh: 你提到的那个女商人，她是较早的坟墓之一（大约 840 年代），所以她是第一批被认定为居住在城镇中的人之一。今天我们谈论“我是一个城市人”或“乡村人”，这是维京时代才刚刚开始创造的身份，因为每个人都是乡村人。随着第一个城镇的建立，人们开始以不同的方式生活，而这个女人就是其中之一。

paras.en: If we look in her grave, she has things that have come from all over the western Viking world, things that I think probably came as loot from the raids, so she knew somebody who was involved in those things.
paras.zh: 如果我们看一下她的坟墓，就会发现她有来自整个西部维京世界的东西，我认为这些东西可能是袭击中的战利品，所以她认识参与这些事情的人。

paras.en: But you look at the stuff that's there, it seems pretty likely that she is a merchant in her own right, perhaps someone dealing in textiles. This idea of a businesswoman setting up a shop in Birka and maybe importing textiles or making them, having them made, because she's probably not working the loom, you know. It gives us a glimpse of a different kind of Viking life, one that I don't think we're accustomed to seeing and we should.
paras.zh: 但你看看那里的东西，她很可能本身就是一个商人，也许是做纺织品生意的。这个想法是一个女商人在比尔卡开一家商店，也许进口纺织品或制造纺织品，因为她可能不操作织布机，你知道。它让我们一睹另一种维京人的生活，我认为我们不习惯看到这种生活，但我们应该看到这种生活。

paras.en: And then the warrior is about 100 years later than the merchant woman, when Birka has grown; it's quite a big settlement by then that's a really powerful place.
paras.zh: 然后，当比尔卡长大时，战士比女商人晚了大约100年；到那时它已经是一个相当大的定居点，是一个非常强大的地方。

paras.en: It's become quite militarized, so it has a fortification wall and it has a fortress, and there's a garrison building, which is a really amazing structure actually. It's partly made of weapons. There are weapons in the walls and on the floors. Around the building are a number of burials with lots of weapons in them. It's quite easy to say that a burial with lots of weapons is a warrior, but that's an interpretation. We can't be sure that the things buried with the dead were their possessions. We kind of assume that that's the case, but clearly not always. So there's a bit of a question mark there.
paras.zh: 它已经变得相当军事化，所以它有一个防御墙，一个堡垒，还有一个驻军建筑，这实际上是一个非常惊人的结构。它的一部分是由武器制成的。墙上和地板上都有武器。建筑物周围有许多墓葬，里面有很多武器。人们很容易说埋藏着大量武器的人是战士，但这是一种解释。我们不能确定与死者一起埋葬的东西是他们的财产。我们假设情况确实如此，但显然并非总是如此。所以这里有一个问号。

paras.en: This burial was excavated like most of the ones in Birka in the 1870s, so a long time ago. And this grave is absolutely full of weapons. It's got all the weapons. And out of all the about 1,100 burials that were excavated on Birka, only two have a complete set of weapons, so this is rare. It's a very spectacular grave.
paras.zh: 这个墓葬和比尔卡的大多数墓葬一样，是在 1870 年代被挖掘出来的，所以是很久以前的事了。而这座坟墓里绝对装满了武器。所有的武器都有了。而在比尔卡发掘的约1100座墓葬中，只有两座拥有全套武器，因此十分罕见。这是一座非常壮观的坟墓。

paras.en: This burial has been reprinted again and again. [Iit's] in like every book on the Vikings. So it's been put forward as a kind of ultimate Viking: This is what proper Vikings looked like, you know, all the gear. And because it was excavated in the 1870s, it's always been assumed that this person was male. It's not hard to see where that assumption comes from, but it's actually been consistent ever since.
paras.zh: 此墓已被一再转载。 [它]就像每本关于维京人的书一样。因此，它被认为是一种终极维京人：这就是真正的维京人的样子，你知道，所有的装备。由于它是在 1870 年代出土的，所以人们一直认为此人是男性。不难看出这个假设的来源，但实际上从那时起它就一直是一致的。

paras.en: Then, between 2011 and 2017, first a series of osteological studies looking at the bones, and then DNA, confirmed that this person was female. And actually the team that worked on it, which included me, none of us were particularly surprised.
paras.zh: 然后，在 2011 年至 2017 年间，首先进行了一系列骨骼学研究，然后进行了 DNA 检测，确认此人是女性。事实上，参与这个项目的团队，包括我在内，没有人感到特别惊讶。

paras.en: It was kind of exciting and interesting, but it's like, "Oh wow, you know, they really did have female warriors." So all the previous interpretations, it seemed to us, were pretty valid, it's just that this is a female, the ultimate Viking.
paras.zh: 这有点令人兴奋和有趣，但就像是，“哦，哇，你知道，他们确实有女战士。”所以之前所有的解释，在我们看来，都是相当有效的，只是这是一个女性，终极的维京人。

paras.en: [Editor's note: Following the 2017 study, there was an intense reaction to the interpretation that the woman in the grave was a Viking Age warrior.]
paras.zh: [编者注：继 2017 年的研究之后，人们对坟墓中的女人是维京时代战士的解释产生了强烈的反应。]

paras.en: LG: So you weren't expecting the backlash that occurred afterward?
paras.zh: LG：所以你没有预料到之后会出现强烈的反对声音？

paras.en: No, we weren't, it was extreme. I'm not going to go into that in any detail, but some people were very, very happy, and some people were really not, and there we are.
paras.zh: 不，我们不是，这太极端了。我不打算详细讨论这个问题，但有些人非常非常高兴，有些人真的不高兴，但我们就是这样。

paras.en: It also highlights that all of these things are interpretations. You very rarely find something that is beyond any doubt what it is. Then there's also things with all of the burials in the book and all the burials that we excavate — people have quite long lives, hopefully. And if you were a warrior when you're 18 and you live to be 70, are you buried with all the weapons? Maybe not. Who knows?
paras.zh: 它还强调所有这些都是解释。你很少能找到毫无疑问的东西。然后还有书中所有的墓葬以及我们挖掘的所有墓葬——希望人们的寿命很长。如果你 18 岁时是一名战士，而你活到了 70 岁，你埋葬时会带着所有武器吗？也许不是。谁知道？

paras.en: That applies to any other kind of profession. So we don't know [if the different events and professions] in somebody's life course [are] represented in the burial. Is it when they die, or is it somebody who did something famous when they were young, and that is in the grave. We don't know. So there's lots of question marks, but the one thing it does show is the diversity of life in the Viking Age. There's so many different kinds of people, which is not a surprise, really, but it's something I just wanted to bring out in the book.
paras.zh: 这适用于任何其他类型的职业。因此，我们不知道墓葬中是否反映了某人生命历程中的[不同事件和职业]。是他们死的时候，还是某个人年轻时做过一些著名的事情，那就是在坟墓里。我们不知道。所以有很多问号，但它确实表明的一件事是维京时代生活的多样性。有这么多不同类型的人，这并不奇怪，真的，但这是我想在书中展示的东西。

paras.en: LG: You don't just talk about Vikings, but about those who lived alongside them. In one chapter, you describe a Sámi burial of a bear that they had killed and feasted on. What do we know about bear burials and why the Sámi did them? [Editor's note: The Sámi are an Indigenous people who currently live in the northern Nordic countries and part of Russia.]
paras.zh: LG：你不仅谈论维京人，还谈论那些与他们生活在一起的人。在一章中，您描述了萨米人对一只被他们杀死并食用的熊的埋葬。我们对熊葬了解多少？萨米人为什么要这样做？ [编者注：萨米人是目前居住在北欧北部国家和俄罗斯部分地区的原住民。]

paras.en: NP: Well, the bear is a holy animal to the Sámi, and it's obviously a massive source of protein and food and pelts, you know, all kinds of useful things. But what I really wanted to get at was the idea of personhood. If you think about all the different kinds of prejudice, some people are sort of "more people" than others. Think about racism, for example.
paras.zh: NP：嗯，熊对萨米人来说是一种神圣的动物，它显然是蛋白质、食物和毛皮的大量来源，你知道，还有各种有用的东西。但我真正想了解的是人格的概念。如果你考虑一下所有不同类型的偏见，就会发现有些人比其他人“更人”。例如，想想种族主义。

paras.en: In the Viking Age, not every human was [seen as] a person, but not every person was human. There are animal persons as well, sentient animals. Everything is sentient actually, and the idea that you converse with animals, that you talk to them, you respect them, they have their personalities.
paras.zh: 在维京时代，并不是每个人都被[视为]一个人，但也不是每个人都是人类。也有动物人，有感情的动物。事实上，一切都是有知觉的，你与动物交谈，你与他们交谈，你尊重他们，他们有自己的个性。

paras.en: I wanted to bring out in that chapter a different kind of way of looking at "persons." So the fact that the Sámi bury the bears they hunt with tremendous respect, it's partly to ensure that the bear will come back in the future from the spirit world as another bear, so that the cycle of hunting and life can go on.
paras.zh: 我想在那一章中提出一种看待“人”的不同方式。因此，萨米人怀着极大的敬意埋葬他们猎杀的熊，部分原因是为了确保这只熊将来能以另一只熊的身份从灵界回来，以便狩猎和生活的循环能够继续下去。

paras.en: LG: You also talk about "thralls," people who were enslaved by the Norse. Can you share some of the archaeological evidence we have for thralls and what their burials look like?
paras.zh: LG：你还谈到了“奴隶”，即那些被挪威人奴役的人。您能分享一些我们掌握的关于奴隶的考古证据以及他们的墓葬是什么样子吗？

paras.en: NP: We don't really know whether they have burials at all, actually. The institution of slavery, or thralldom, is absolutely central to the Norse economy, and just putting that back into the picture is very important, I think.
paras.zh: NP：实际上，我们根本不知道他们是否有墓地。奴隶制或奴役制度绝对是挪威经济的核心，我认为将其重新纳入考虑范围是非常重要的。

paras.en: They are a group of people who have been neglected in our studies. There's a lot of people working on this, this isn't just me by any means. When we find them in the burials — well, when we think we find them, because it's extremely rare to find someone buried in their own right that we think might have been enslaved. But there's also the question of how do we tell? Unless somebody's sort of buried in chains or something, it's very hard.
paras.zh: 他们是一群在我们的学习中被忽视的人。有很多人在做这件事，无论如何这不仅仅是我一个人。当我们在墓葬中找到他们时——好吧，当我们认为我们找到了他们时，因为很少有人会以自己的方式埋葬我们认为可能被奴役的人。但还有一个问题是我们如何判断？除非有人被锁链之类的东西埋着，否则这是非常困难的。

paras.en: But we do find — not often, but it's not that uncommon — that people have been killed in the course of funerals. You have a burial of a man or a woman, and then an extra body is in the grave, which has clearly been treated very differently. So their hands might be tied or they've been decapitated or something, and there's people who have very clearly been killed at the funeral.
paras.zh: 但我们确实发现——虽然不常见，但也不少见——人们在葬礼过程中被杀害。你埋葬了一个男人或一个女人，然后坟墓里有一个额外的尸体，这显然受到了非常不同的对待。所以他们的手可能被绑起来，或者被斩首或者其他什么，而且有些人很明显在葬礼上被杀了。

paras.en: Just the fact of that presumably means that they have a very different kind of status to the primary occupant of the burial. [They're] not necessarily enslaved; they could be prisoners or criminals. But there's been more recent studies looking at the diet of those people. You can use isotopes to study what people have eaten. [Editor's note: Isotopes are variations of elements. When people consume different foods and water, different amounts of certain isotopes are incorporated into their teeth and bones.] And in some cases, the people who've been killed at funerals have a much, much worse diet than other people, which implies that they have a much lower status and poorer nutrition and so on.
paras.zh: 这一事实大概意味着他们与墓葬的主要占有者有着非常不同的地位。 [他们]不一定是奴隶；他们可能是囚犯或罪犯。但最近有更多研究关注这些人的饮食。您可以使用同位素来研究人们吃了什么。 [编者注：同位素是元素的变体。当人们消耗不同的食物和水时，不同数量的某些同位素会融入他们的牙齿和骨骼中。]在某些情况下，在葬礼上被杀的人的饮食比其他人要差得多，这意味着他们的地位要低得多，营养要差等等。

paras.en: So the implication really is that they might be enslaved. So I think that's where we are with the burials of enslaved people.
paras.zh: 所以这实际上意味着他们可能会被奴役。所以我认为这就是我们埋葬被奴役者的地方。

paras.en: LG: You spend an entire chapter on Viking Age children. What was it like to grow up in Scandinavia during this time, and what can we learn about their lives from grave goods and skeletal analyses?
paras.zh: LG：你用了整整一章来讲述维京时代的孩子。这段时间在斯堪的纳维亚长大是什么感觉？我们可以从随葬品和骨骼分析中了解他们的生活吗？

paras.en: NP: The first thing is that an awful lot of people didn't make it out of childhood at all. Putting numbers on this is a bit of a game, but probably less than half the population got past the age of 10. So child mortality is massive.
paras.zh: NP：首先，很多人根本没有走出童年。用数字来计算这有点像游戏，但可能只有不到一半的人口过了 10 岁。因此，儿童死亡率很高。

paras.en: When we imagine the Viking Age or think back to it, remember that almost every single family will have lost children, with the psychological effects of that and the emotional effects and so on. And we shouldn't be entirely sure what those effects were, because if child mortality is so high, they have different coping mechanisms. But it still must have been utterly awful.
paras.zh: 当我们想象或回想维京时代时，请记住，几乎每个家庭都会失去孩子，从而产生心理影响和情感影响等等。我们不应该完全确定这些影响是什么，因为如果儿童死亡率如此之高，他们就有不同的应对机制。但它仍然一定是非常可怕的。

paras.en: We don't find as many child burials as we should. There are a couple of written sources that mention that dead children are effectively discarded, and maybe this is connected with a coping mechanism for child mortality that people don't become sort of "full people" until they get to a certain age. We don't know.
paras.zh: 我们没有找到应有的儿童墓葬。有一些书面资料提到，死去的孩子实际上被丢弃了，也许这与儿童死亡的应对机制有关，即人们直到达到一定年龄才成为“完整的人”。我们不知道。

paras.en: But there are child burials and, quite often they're buried with scaled-down versions of the things that adults have. So young girls are buried with women's jewelry, but smaller. And they obviously had their possessions; they had their clothes and their jewelry, and we find toys, not in the graves, but on settlement sites — we find dolls, wooden animals, there's a fantastic horse on wheels that you can roll it about, lots and lots of little wooden boats that you can sail down. So they're thinking about boats quite early. I think their lives are quite recognizable up to a point, though very hard.
paras.zh: 但也有儿童墓葬，而且通常埋葬的是成人物品的缩小版。因此，年轻女孩的陪葬品是女性珠宝，但尺寸较小。他们显然拥有自己的财产；他们有他们的衣服和珠宝，我们找到了玩具，不是在坟墓里，而是在定居点——我们发现了洋娃娃、木制动物、一匹带轮子的神奇马，你可以滚动它，还有很多很多你可以航行的小木船。所以他们很早就开始考虑造船了。我认为他们的生活在某种程度上是相当容易辨认的，尽管非常困难。

paras.en: The age of maturity seems to be somewhere between about 14 and 16. After that, you're an adult, and then you're just out there with the rest.
paras.zh: 成熟的年龄似乎在 14 岁到 16 岁之间。在那之后，你就是一个成年人了，然后你就和其他人一样了。

paras.en: LG: To us that seems young, but for them to make it that far would have been an accomplishment.
paras.zh: LG：对我们来说，这似乎还很年轻，但对他们来说，能走到这一步已经是一项成就了。

paras.en: NP: And even in adults — you asked about skeletal analysis — there are an awful lot of adults that are malnourished as children, and it leaves traces in their bones.
paras.zh: NP：即使在成年人中——你询问了骨骼分析——也有很多成年人在儿童时期就营养不良，这在他们的骨骼中留下了痕迹。

paras.en: There's also a rather grim set of data from a fairly small sample, but still — the proportion of adult women who were malnourished as children is much greater than the proportion of men. In other words, if food was scarce, they gave it to the boys. So it's also a glimpse of their priorities and the realities of their world.
paras.zh: 还有一组来自相当小的样本的相当严峻的数据，但仍然是——儿童时期营养不良的成年女性比例远远高于男性比例。换句话说，如果食物短缺，他们就会给男孩们。因此，这也是他们的优先事项和世界现实的一瞥。

paras.en: LG: The Scandinavians settled in the Rus' in what is now Ukraine. What do we know about these people? Were they traders, warriors, or a mix of many things?
paras.zh: LG：斯堪的纳维亚人定居在罗斯境内，即现在的乌克兰。我们对这些人了解多少？他们是商人、战士，还是多种身份的混合体？

paras.en: NP: I think [it's] a mixture. The identity of the Rus' is one of the big questions of the Viking Age. They used to be seen very simply as what the Vikings are called when they go east. And there's some truth to that. They seem to be culturally Scandinavian in the beginning, so we're talking the early ninth century or probably the eighth century.
paras.zh: NP：我认为[这是]一种混合物。罗斯人的身份是维京时代的重大问题之一。他们过去被简单地视为维京人向东行进时的称呼。这有一定道理。他们一开始似乎是斯堪的纳维亚文化，所以我们谈论的是九世纪初或可能是八世纪。

paras.en: Over time, as they travel on the eastern rivers, they become much more ethnically diverse. So it's a culture that grows up around an activity, rather than people from a particular place. Probably the closest parallel [is] if you think of the fur trade on the Canadian rivers and some parts of the states as well — the sort of 1600s and 1700s.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，当他们在东部河流中航行时，他们的种族变得更加多样化。因此，这是一种围绕一项活动而不是来自特定地方的人成长起来的文化。如果您想到加拿大河流和各州某些地区的毛皮贸易，那么最接近的相似之处可能是 1600 年代和 1700 年代。

paras.en: They're certainly militaristic though; they're armed traders. There's no doubt about that. And they found trading settlements, together with local people and other incomers as well. And they settle there. After a time, they're not actually [newcomers], they live there. And then, over time, quite late in the Viking Age and on into the Middle Ages, you get this Rus' state, with its capital of Kiev. But they range over a very large part of Eastern Europe and actually I think further east as well.
paras.zh: 但他们确实是军国主义的；他们是武装商人。毫无疑问。他们还与当地人和其他收入者一起找到了贸易定居点。他们在那里定居。过了一段时间，他们实际上就不再是[新人]，他们住在那里。然后，随着时间的推移，从维京时代晚期一直到中世纪，你就得到了这个罗斯国家，其首都为基辅。但它们分布在东欧的很大一部分地区，实际上我认为也包括更东的地区。

paras.en: LG: You focus on this group of Rus' warriors, the Varangians, and you give the example of them leaving graffiti on a marble lion statue that's now in Venice. Can you tell us the story about these runes they carved?
paras.zh: LG：您重点关注了这群罗斯战士瓦兰吉亚人，并举了他们在威尼斯大理石狮子雕像上留下涂鸦的例子。您能告诉我们他们雕刻的这些符文的故事吗？

paras.en: NP: Yeah sure, it's a bit strange that the best monument to these guys is a lion that's much, much older than the Viking Age. It's from classical antiquity. It's outside the Arsenal now in Venice, but it used to stand in the harbor of Athens at a place called Piraeus.
paras.zh: NP：是的，当然，有点奇怪的是，这些人最好的纪念碑是一只比维京时代古老得多的狮子。它来自古典时期。它现在位于威尼斯的兵工厂外面，但它曾经矗立在雅典港口的一个叫比雷埃夫斯的地方。

paras.en: The Varangians were kind of a subset of the Rus', but they're basically Scandinavians who take very clear contracted employment in the armies of Byzantium, the Eastern Roman Empire. So they're mercenaries, and they were very sought after, and there's lots and lots of written sources about them.
paras.zh: 瓦兰吉人是罗斯人的一个子集，但他们基本上是斯堪的纳维亚人，在东罗马帝国拜占庭的军队中接受非常明确的合同雇佣。所以他们是雇佣兵，他们非常受追捧，并且有很多很多关于他们的书面资料。

paras.en: This lion, which once stood in the Athenian harbor, had three inscriptions in runes over its shoulders and legs and things. Two of the inscriptions are very fragmentary, so you can't get much from them. But the biggest one is a memorial to a guy called Haursi. It actually calls him Haursi the farmer, so it really does emphasize that you could be a farmer, but maybe you do a season in the army down in Greece and make a bit of money and go home. So people have professions and they have choices, and they do this for a bit, but then they go back and do what they did before.
paras.zh: 这头狮子曾经矗立在雅典港口，它的肩膀、腿上和其他东西上刻有三道符文铭文。其中两处铭文非常零碎，所以你无法从中得到太多信息。但最大的一座是纪念一位名叫 Haursi 的人的纪念碑。它实际上称他为农民 Haursi，所以它确实强调你可以成为一名农民，但也许你在希腊军队服役一个赛季，赚点钱然后回家。所以人们有职业，他们有选择，他们这样做了一段时间，但然后他们又回去做他们以前做过的事情。

paras.en: - 'His urine goes on tour around Europe, showing the kings and queens this glowing pee': The weird world of alchemy before chemistry
paras.zh: -“他的尿液在欧洲巡回演出，向国王和王后展示了这种发光的尿液”：化学之前的炼金术的奇怪世界

paras.en: - 'Call it Genghis Khan's final victory': Why the tomb of the 'Disturber of the Universe' remains hidden after 800 years
paras.zh: - “称之为成吉思汗的最终胜利”：为什么“宇宙扰乱者”的坟墓在 800 年后仍然被隐藏

paras.en: - He looked like Ramses the Great': How experimental archaeologists used ancient techniques to mummify a modern-day person
paras.zh: - 他看起来像拉美西斯大帝：实验考古学家如何使用古代技术将现代人制成木乃伊

paras.en: This inscription is written by this guy's friends or his comrades, and it specifically says that he was killed before he got paid. And it's kind of a hint. It's "So, pay up, because you owe him, or you owe his family."
paras.zh: 这段碑文是这家伙的朋友或者战友写的，上面特别写着他在得到报酬之前就被杀了。这是一种暗示。就是“所以，还钱吧，因为你欠他，或者你欠他的家人。”

paras.en: You get this little vignette of a soldier's life. And also carving the inscription on this lion is a pretty major job. This isn't like scribbling on a wall or something — they're carving it, and so they're there a long time. And presumably have control of the harbor because you can't just chisel this thing on, you know, people are trying to stop you.
paras.zh: 你会看到一个士兵生活的小插曲。而且在这头狮子上刻上铭文也是一项相当艰巨的工作。这不像在墙上乱涂乱画什么的——他们是在雕刻，所以他们在那里呆了很长时间。大概控制了港口，因为你不能只是凿这个东西，你知道，人们正在试图阻止你。

paras.en: We can think of the Varangians being stationed in Athens or waiting for a ship or something like that. It's this wonderful snapshot.
paras.zh: 我们可以想象瓦兰吉人驻扎在雅典或等待船只或类似的事情。这是这张精彩的快照。

paras.en: LG: Your book is loaded with details about Viking Age people. What do you hope readers will take away from your work?
paras.zh: LG：您的书中充满了有关维京时代人们的详细信息。您希望读者从您的作品中学到什么？

paras.en: NP: That they were more than actual Vikings. The people of the Viking Age were individuals, every bit as varied and complicated as we are. So that's it.
paras.zh: NP：他们不仅仅是真正的维京人。维京时代的人们都是独立的个体，和我们一样多样化和复杂。就是这样。

paras.en: This interview has been condensed and edited lightly for clarity.
paras.zh: 为了清晰起见，本次采访经过了精简和轻微编辑。

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: Drawing on the latest archaeological research and scientific analysis, The Sea-King and the Sorceress brings us closer to understanding the lives and times of the Vikings. The era that bears their name will never seem so simple again.
paras.zh: 《海王与女巫》借鉴了最新的考古研究和科学分析，让我们更加了解维京人的生活和时代。以他们的名字命名的时代将不再显得如此简单。

paras.en: Laura is the managing editor at Live Science. She also runs the archaeology section and the Life's Little Mysteries series. Her work has appeared in The New York Times, Scholastic, Popular Science and Spectrum, a site on autism research. She has won multiple awards from the Society of Professional Journalists and the Washington Newspaper Publishers Association for her reporting at a weekly newspaper near Seattle. Laura holds a bachelor's degree in English literature and psychology from Washington University in St. Louis and a master's degree in science writing from NYU.
paras.zh: 劳拉 (Laura) 是《Live Science》的总编辑。她还负责考古学部分和“生命的小秘密”系列。她的作品曾发表在《纽约时报》、《学术》、《大众科学》和《Spectrum》（一个自闭症研究网站）上。她因在西雅图附近一家周报的报道而获得了职业记者协会和华盛顿报纸出版商协会颁发的多项奖项。劳拉拥有圣路易斯华盛顿大学英国文学和心理学学士学位以及纽约大学科学写作硕士学位。

articles.title: 'I won't trust AI': Readers share mixed reaction to AI tools that calculate people's biological ages
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Scientists are harnessing the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to measure people's biological ages.
paras.zh: 科学家正在利用人工智能（AI）的力量来测量人们的生物年龄。

paras.en: Unlike chronological age, or the number of years a person has been living, biological age should reflect how well a person's bodily systems are working. Someone with a higher biological age has a higher risk for age-related diseases, such as cancer or dementia, than a person with a younger biological age. While some AI clocks look at epigenetic markers, others focus on other features, like the pitch and pace of people's voices, to calculate a biological age.
paras.zh: 与实际年龄或一个人的生存年数不同，生物年龄应该反映一个人的身体系统的运作情况。与生物年龄较小的人相比，生物年龄较高的人患癌症或痴呆等与年龄相关的疾病的风险更高。虽然一些人工智能时钟着眼于表观遗传标记，但其他人工智能时钟则专注于其他特征，例如人们声音的音调和节奏，以计算生物年龄。

paras.en: We recently asked our readers if they would trust such AI tools to measure their biological age. Over 170 people responded, with 44% of voters choosing "Yes, I would take the results with a grain of salt, but it can still provide some helpful insights." The next-largest group, including 23% of voters, also chose a positive answer, clicking the "Yes, I think it would provide useful health information."
paras.zh: 我们最近询问读者是否愿意相信此类人工智能工具来测量他们的生物年龄。超过 170 人做出了回应，其中 44% 的选民选择“是的，我对结果持保留态度，但它仍然可以提供一些有用的见解。”第二大群体，包括 23% 的选民，也选择了肯定的答案，点击“是的，我认为这会提供有用的健康信息”。

paras.en: But readers' comments seemed to reflect the opposite trend, with one commenter writing, "NO!!! Unplug it !!! Heed the warnings!" Another reader posted a similar sentiment, saying: "A.I. is dangerous! It's often going beyond its programming and doing things it's not supposed to do! Trusting it with my life is something I will never do!"
paras.zh: 但读者的评论似乎反映了相反的趋势，一位评论者写道：“不！！！拔掉插头！！！注意警告！”另一位读者也发表了类似的观点，他说：“人工智能很危险！它经常超越它的编程范围，做它不应该做的事情！我永远不会把我的生命托付给它！”

paras.en: - Can AI detect cognitive decline better than a doctor? New study reveals surprising accuracy
paras.zh: - 人工智能能否比医生更好地检测认知能力下降？新研究揭示了惊人的准确性

paras.en: - Doctors say AI model can predict 'biological age' from a selfie — and want to use it to guide cancer treatment
paras.zh: - 医生表示人工智能模型可以通过自拍照预测“生物年龄”，并希望用它来指导癌症治疗

paras.en: - 'There's a sense that these algorithms are objective and they get to know you': How social media warps our understanding of healthcare
paras.zh: - “有一种感觉，这些算法是客观的，它们会了解你”：社交媒体如何扭曲我们对医疗保健的理解

paras.en: Other commenters highlighted the need for more research to be conducted before using they'd use the tools, with one reader writing, "I might wait at least a few years before trying this, because the genetic research the AI is basing its results on is likely to expand quickly, so results are likely to be more accurate & meaningful."
paras.zh: 其他评论者强调，在使用这些工具之前需要进行更多研究，一位读者写道：“我可能至少要等几年才能尝试这一点，因为人工智能所基于的基因研究可能会迅速扩大，因此结果可能会更加准确和有意义。”

paras.en: Another reader commented on the idea of accuracy and truth when using these tools, saying, "I won't trust AI. Al on one hand gives amazing possibilities, but on another hand with AI we would never know what the real truth is."
paras.zh: 另一位读者在使用这些工具时评论了准确性和真实性的想法，他说：“我不会相信人工智能。一方面，人工智能提供了令人惊叹的可能性，但另一方面，有了人工智能，我们永远不会知道真正的真相是什么。”

paras.en: What do you think? Let us know in the comments!
paras.zh: 你怎么认为？请在评论中告诉我们！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: 2,000-year-old burial found in Russia near a human sacrifice and a cup to ward off magical threats
articles.author: Tom Metcalfe

paras.en: Archaeologists in southern Russia have unearthed the 2,000-year-old grave of an elite warrior who was buried with his weapons, horse — and a human sacrifice. The grave and sacrifices were found with other lavish goods, including two gold coins featuring Alexander the Great.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯南部的考古学家挖掘出了一座 2000 年前的精英战士坟墓，墓中埋葬着他的武器、马匹以及活人祭品。坟墓和祭品中还发现了其他奢华物品，其中包括两枚刻有亚历山大大帝的金币。

paras.en: A team found the elite grave in Russia's Kuban region east of the Crimean Peninsula, in a necropolis of more than 150 ancient graves arranged around it. This central placement indicates the man had been a member of the social elite, according to the study, which was published in September in the journal Russian Archaeology.
paras.zh: 一个团队在克里米亚半岛以东的俄罗斯库班地区发现了这座精英坟墓，周围有 150 多个古代坟墓。这项研究发表在 9 月份的《俄罗斯考古学》杂志上，该研究表明，这个中心位置表明该男子是社会精英的一员。

paras.en: The evidence of a human sacrifice comes from another burial assemblage beside the warrior's grave. This neighboring burial had the remains of three horses, two cattle, a pig, a dog and a fragment of a human pelvis that seems to have come from a sacrificed person, the researchers wrote.
paras.zh: 活人祭祀的证据来自于战士坟墓旁边的另一个墓葬群。研究人员写道，邻近的墓地里有三匹马、两头牛、一头猪、一只狗的遗骸，以及一块似乎来自牺牲者的人类骨盆碎片。

paras.en: The two gold coins — one found on the warrior's skeleton and one found nearby — indicate that the burial took place in the early first century B.C., while the location and style of the burial indicated the warrior had been a noble of the Indigenous Maeotian people. At that time, the Maeotians were allied with the neighboring Mithridatic Empire, a Hellenistic-Persian kingdom and the enemy of the expanding Roman Republic.
paras.zh: 这两枚金币（一枚在战士骨架上发现的，一枚在附近发现的）表明该墓葬发生在公元前一世纪初，而墓葬的地点和风格表明该战士曾是土著梅奥蒂亚人的贵族。当时，梅奥蒂亚人与邻近的米特拉达梯帝国结盟，米特里达梯帝国是希腊化波斯王国，也是不断扩张的罗马共和国的敌人。

paras.en: The researchers think the two gold coins were prestige items, rather than ordinary currency for commerce. "It is likely not money in the conventional sense, but rather a means of storing wealth, akin to a … cryptocurrency," study first author Mikhail Abramzon of the Institute of Archaeology at Russia's Academy of Sciences, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为这两枚金币是珍贵物品，而不是普通的商业货币。研究第一作者、俄罗斯科学院考古研究所的米哈伊尔·阿布拉姆宗 (Mikhail Abramzon) 在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》：“它可能不是传统意义上的货币，而是一种存储财富的手段，类似于……加密货币。”

paras.en: The two gold coins are key to the discovery. One was found in a ritual shaft near the burial in the center of the necropolis; the researchers think it was placed there as an offering to the gods.
paras.zh: 这两枚金币是这一发现的关键。其中一件是在墓地中心墓葬附近的仪式井中发现的。研究人员认为它是作为献给神的祭品放在那里的。

paras.en: The second was found beneath the jaw of the skeleton of the ancient warrior, which indicates it had been placed in the dead man's mouth before the burial and is an example of "Charon's obol" — the traditional ancient Greek payment for the mythical ferryman of the dead.
paras.zh: 第二个是在古代武士骨骼的下颌下方发现的，这表明它在埋葬前被放入死者的嘴里，并且是“卡戎的奥博尔”的一个例子——古希腊对死者神话摆渡人的传统报酬。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Both coins are gold "staters" in the Greek style adopted by Alexander the Great (who lived from 356 to 323 B.C.) and show portraits of Alexander.
paras.zh: 这两枚硬币都是亚历山大大帝（生活于公元前 356 至 323 年）采用的希腊风格的金制“staters”，并刻有亚历山大的肖像。

paras.en: Experts have determined that these coins were minted during the much later reign of Mithridates Eupator (lived 135 to 63 B.C.), also known as Mithridates the Great, who claimed descent from both Alexander and the Persian nobility and who initiated the three Mithridatic Wars with Rome. The Alexander portraits on the coins are designed to also look like Mithridates Eupator, the researchers wrote in the study.
paras.zh: 专家们确定，这些硬币是在米特里达梯·尤帕托（Mithridates Eupator，生活于公元前 135 年至前 63 年）更晚的统治时期铸造的，他也被称为米特里达梯大帝，他声称自己是亚历山大和波斯贵族的后裔，并发起了与罗马的三场米特里达梯战争。研究人员在研究中写道，硬币上的亚历山大肖像也被设计得像米特里达梯·尤帕托。

paras.en: According to the Greek geographer Strabo, writing in the first century A.D., the Maeotians were an Indigenous people integrated into the nearby Bosporan kingdom, a Greek and Scythian state founded on the north side of the Black Sea in the fifth century B.C. The Greek historian Appian, in the second century A.D., wrote that the Bosporan kingdom became part of the expanding Mithridatic Empire in the second century B.C. — and so the Maeotians were Mithridatic allies at the time of the burial in the first century B.C.
paras.zh: 根据希腊地理学家斯特拉波在公元一世纪的著作，梅奥蒂亚人是融入附近博斯普鲁斯王国的原住民，博斯普鲁斯王国是一个于公元前五世纪在黑海北侧建立的希腊和斯基泰国家。公元二世纪的希腊历史学家亚庇安 (Appian) 写道，博斯普鲁斯王国在公元前二世纪成为不断扩张的米特拉达梯帝国的一部分。 ——因此，在公元前一世纪埋葬时，梅奥蒂亚人是米特拉达梯的盟友。

paras.en: The warrior was buried with weapons — two iron spearheads and an iron arrowhead were found in his grave — as well as his riding gear and his horse, which had been sacrificed. The grave also held luxury items, including a rare glass "alabastron" — a small vessel for oil or perfumes, which had probably been imported from Cyprus or the Levant region of the eastern Mediterranean, the researchers wrote.
paras.zh: 这位战士的陪葬品包括武器——在他的坟墓中发现了两个铁矛头和一个铁箭头——以及他的骑马装备和被牺牲的马匹。研究人员写道，坟墓中还藏有奢侈品，包括一种罕见的玻璃“alabastron”——一种盛放油或香水的小容器，可能是从塞浦路斯或地中海东部黎凡特地区进口的。

paras.en: - Stunning reconstruction reveals warrior and his weapons from 4,000-year-old burial in Siberia
paras.zh: - 令人惊叹的重建揭示了西伯利亚 4000 年前墓葬中的战士和他的武器

paras.en: - 10th-century woman buried with weapons in Hungary is 1st of her kind, but researchers are hesitant to call her a warrior
paras.zh: - 匈牙利一位埋藏着武器的 10 世纪女性是同类中的第一人，但研究人员对于称她为战士犹豫不决

paras.en: - 2,100-year-old skeleton of warrior nicknamed 'Lord of Sakar,' buried in a stunning gold wreath, unearthed in Bulgaria
paras.zh: - 保加利亚出土的一具绰号为“萨卡之王”的 2,100 岁战士骨架，埋在令人惊叹的金花环中

paras.en: A two-handled clay cup, called a "kantharos" in ancient Greek, was also found in the grave. Its surface was engraved with a pentagram, a symbol of the sun, which the researchers think was considered spiritual protection against magical threats.
paras.zh: 坟墓中还发现了一个两柄粘土杯，在古希腊语中被称为“kantharos”。它的表面刻有五角星，这是太阳的象征，研究人员认为这被认为是抵御魔法威胁的精神保护。

paras.en: The researchers think the sacrifices in the nearby burial assemblages could have had different purposes. The cattle may have been offerings in the style of an ancient "hecatomb" — a mass slaughter of animals that would supposedly please a god. The horses were for riding in the afterlife, the pig was for eating in the afterlife, and the dog may have been intended to guide the dead warrior's spirit. The role of the human sacrificed with the animals is unknown, but it may have been to act as a servant for the warrior.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，附近墓葬群中的祭祀可能有不同的目的。这些牛可能是古代“屠宰场”风格的祭品——大规模屠杀动物，据说可以取悦神灵。马是用来在来世骑马的，猪是用来在来世吃东西的，而狗可能是用来引导死去的战士的灵魂的。与动物一起牺牲的人类的角色尚不清楚，但可能是充当战士的仆人。

paras.en: The researchers wrote that the coins and grave goods illustrate both the beliefs of the Maeotian people at this time, and the extent to which they had been influenced by the ancient Greek traditions of the neighboring Bosporon kingdom.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道，这些硬币和随葬品既说明了当时梅奥蒂亚人的信仰，也说明了他们受到邻近博斯普隆王国古希腊传统影响的程度。

paras.en: Abramzon, M. G. (2026). First-century BC Complexes with Gold Lysimachus Type Staters from the Maeotian Necropolis Of Vinogradny 1. Russian Archaeology. https://journals.rcsi.science/0869-6063/article/view/454250
paras.zh: 艾布拉姆宗，M.G.（2026）。公元前一世纪的建筑群，带有来自维诺格拉德尼梅奥蒂安墓地的黄金利西马科斯型雕像 1. 俄罗斯考古学。 https://journals.rcsi.science/0869-6063/article/view/454250

paras.en: Tom Metcalfe is a freelance journalist and regular Live Science contributor who is based in London in the United Kingdom. Tom writes mainly about science, space, archaeology, the Earth and the oceans. He has also written for the BBC, NBC News, National Geographic, Scientific American, Air & Space, and many others.
paras.zh: 汤姆·梅特卡夫 (Tom Metcalfe) 是一名自由撰稿人，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人，常驻英国伦敦。汤姆主要撰写有关科学、太空、考古学、地球和海洋的文章。他还为 BBC、NBC 新闻、国家地理、科学美国人、航空航天等多家媒体撰稿。
